        );

        throw UnsupportedError(
          'DefaultFirebaseOptions are not supported for this platform.',
        );
    }
  }

// Must be top-level for FCM background handling
@pragma('vm:entry-point')
Future<void> _firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler(RemoteMessage message) async {
  await Firebase.initializeApp(options: DefaultFirebaseOptions.currentPlatform);
}

void main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  await Firebase.initializeApp(
    options: DefaultFirebaseOptions.currentPlatform,
  );
  FirebaseMessaging.onBackgroundMessage(_firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler);
  await initDiaryNotifications();
  await appSettings.load();
  SystemChrome.setSystemUIOverlayStyle(const SystemUiOverlayStyle(
    statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
    statusBarIconBrightness: Brightness.light,
  ));
  runApp(const LoreApp());
}

// SPLASH
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class SplashScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SplashScreen({super.key});
  @override State<SplashScreen> createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}
class _SplashScreenState extends State<SplashScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _ctrl;
  late Animation<double> _fadeIn, _fadeOut;
  final _player = AudioPlayer();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ctrl = AnimationController(vsync: this,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 4500));
    _fadeIn = Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: 1).animate(CurvedAnimation(
        parent: _ctrl,
        curve: const Interval(0.0, 0.35, curve: Curves.easeIn)));
    _fadeOut = Tween<double>(begin: 1, end: 0).animate(CurvedAnimation(
        parent: _ctrl,
        curve: const Interval(0.75, 1.0, curve: Curves.easeOut)));

    // Start music
    _playMusic();

    _ctrl.forward().then((_) async {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final auth = AuthService();
      final hasSession = await auth.restoreSession();
      if (hasSession) {
        await appSettings.syncFromCloud();
        await _pullSandboxIfAny();
      }
      if (!mounted) return;

      // Lock decision happens BEFORE home mounts. Otherwise home builds
      // underneath the lock screen and flashes for a frame.
      if (hasSession) {
        final code = auth.currentCode;
        if (code != null) {
          final crypto = CryptoService();
          bool shouldLock = await auth.shouldLock();

          // Wiped-device recovery: server has keys, local has nothing.
          if (!crypto.isUnlocked && !shouldLock) {
            final hasRemote = await crypto.hasRemoteKeyMaterial(code);
            if (hasRemote) shouldLock = true;
          }

          if (shouldLock) {
            if (!mounted) return;
            await showLockScreen(context);
            if (!mounted) return;
          } else {
            await crypto.silentUnlock(code);
          }
        }
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      // Fade out music over 2 seconds
      _fadeOutMusic();
      Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement(fadeRoute(
        hasSession
            ? const HomeScreen()
            : (kIsWeb ? const LoginScreen() : const LandingScreen()),
      ));
    });
  }

  Future<void> _playMusic() async {
    try {
      await _player.setVolume(0.8);
      await _player.play(AssetSource('sounds/echoes_of_the_deep.mp3'));
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _fadeOutMusic() async {
    try {
      for (double v = 0.8; v >= 0; v -= 0.05) {
        await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
        await _player.setVolume(v.clamp(0.0, 1.0));
      }
      await _player.stop();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _pullSandboxIfAny() async {
    await SandboxSync.syncOnLogin();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _ctrl.dispose();
    _player.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    backgroundColor: cVoid,
    body: Center(
      child: AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: _ctrl,
        builder: (_, child) =>
            Opacity(opacity: _fadeIn.value * _fadeOut.value, child: child),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 40),
          child: Image.asset(
            'assets/images/1234.png',
            fit: BoxFit.contain,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

class IntroFlow extends StatefulWidget {
  const IntroFlow({super.key});
  @override State<IntroFlow> createState() => _IntroFlowState();
}
class _IntroFlowState extends State<IntroFlow> {
  final _pageCtrl = PageController();
  int _page = 0;
  void _next() {
    if (_page < 4) {
      _pageCtrl.nextPage(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500), curve: Curves.easeInOut);
    }
  }
  @override void dispose() { _pageCtrl.dispose(); super.dispose(); }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    backgroundColor: cVoid,
    body: SafeArea(
      child: Stack(children: [
        PageView(
          controller: _pageCtrl,
          onPageChanged: (i) => setState(() => _page = i),
          children: [
            _ChapterOne(onNext: _next),
            _ChapterTwo(onNext: _next),
            _ChapterThree(onNext: _next),
            _ChapterFour(onNext: _next),
            const _ChapterFive(),
          ],
        ),
        Positioned(
          bottom: 24, left: 0, right: 0,
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: List.generate(5, (i) => AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
              margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 3),
              width: i == _page ? 20 : 5, height: 5,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: i == _page ? cGold : cAsh,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(3)),
            )),
          ),
        ),
        Positioned(
          top: 12, left: 16,
          child: LoreTap(
            onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
            child: const Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(8),
                child: Text('â†',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, color: cSmoke))),
          ),
        ),
      ]),
    ),
  );
}

class _ChapterFourState extends State<_ChapterFour>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _ctrl;
  late List<Animation<double>> _anims;
  final genres = ['Fantasy','Sci-Fi','Modern','Historical',
    'Horror','Romance','Post-Apocalyptic','Freeform'];
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ctrl = AnimationController(vsync: this,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1200));
    _anims = List.generate(genres.length, (i) =>
        Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: 1).animate(CurvedAnimation(
            parent: _ctrl,
            curve: Interval(i * 0.08, i * 0.08 + 0.4,
                curve: Curves.easeOut))));
    _ctrl.forward();
  }
  @override void dispose() { _ctrl.dispose(); super.dispose(); }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 36),
    child: Column(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      goldLabel('Every world is welcome'),
      const SizedBox(height: 36),
      AnimatedBuilder(animation: _ctrl, builder: (_, _) => Wrap(
        spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8,
        children: List.generate(genres.length, (i) => Opacity(
          opacity: _anims[i].value,
          child: Transform.scale(scale: 0.9 + 0.1 * _anims[i].value,
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
              child: Text(genres[i], style: const TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 11,
                  letterSpacing: 2, color: cSmoke)),
            ),
          ),
        )),
      )),
      const SizedBox(height: 28),
      const Text('No genre walls. No restrictions on imagination.',

              color: cMist, height: 1.6)),
      const SizedBox(height: 48),
      swipeHint(label: 'Swipe to sign up'),

}

  @override State<_ChapterFive> createState() => _ChapterFiveState();

class _ChapterFiveState extends State<_ChapterFive>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _ctrl;
  late Animation<double> _fade;
  final _nameCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _emailCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _passCtrl = TextEditingController();
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ctrl = AnimationController(vsync: this,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 800));
    _fade = CurvedAnimation(parent: _ctrl, curve: Curves.easeOut);
    _ctrl.forward();
  }
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _ctrl.dispose();
    _nameCtrl.dispose(); _emailCtrl.dispose(); _passCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => FadeTransition(opacity: _fade,
    child: SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 36),
      child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        const SizedBox(height: 80),
        const Text('Your story\nstarts here.', style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 42, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
            fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, color: cParchment, height: 1.1)),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        const Text('Create an account. It takes thirty seconds.',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, color: cSmoke)),
        const SizedBox(height: 40),
        LoreField(controller: _nameCtrl,
            hint: 'Choose a name â€” real or imagined'),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        LoreField(controller: _emailCtrl, hint: 'Email address',
            keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        LoreField(controller: _passCtrl, hint: 'Password', obscure: true),
        const SizedBox(height: 32),
        LoreButton(label: 'B E G I N   W R I T I N G', filled: true,
            onTap: () => Navigator.of(context)
                .pushReplacement(fadeRoute(const LoginScreen()))),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
        LoreTap(
          onTap: () => Navigator.of(context)
              .pushReplacement(fadeRoute(const LoginScreen(startOnLogin: true))),
          child: const Center(child: Text('Already have an account? Sign in â†’',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1))),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 60),
      ]),
    ),
  );
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// HOME SCREEN
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class HomeScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const HomeScreen({super.key});
  @override State<HomeScreen> createState() => _HomeScreenState();
}
class _HomeScreenState extends State<HomeScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin, WidgetsBindingObserver {
  late AnimationController _fadeCtrl;
  late Animation<double> _fade;
  bool _loadingData = true;

  // â”€â”€ Desktop layout state â”€â”€
  // null  â†’ the "Overview" view (mobile-style, centered on wide screens)
  // string â†’ split view with the sidebar collapsed and this block shown
  String? _activeBlock;

  bool get _isDesktop => MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width >= 900;

  final _auth = AuthService();
  final _fs = FirestoreService();

  List<_NotifData> _notifications = [];
  List<_RPData> _roleplays = [];
  List<_RPData> _brainstorms = [];
  Map<String, dynamic>? _profile;
  _RPData? _continueSession;

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    // If the window was shrunk below the desktop breakpoint while a
    // block was open, drop back to the mobile layout cleanly instead
    // of leaving orphaned split-mode state around.
    if (_activeBlock != null && MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width < 900) {
      _activeBlock = null;
    }
  }


  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    _fadeCtrl = AnimationController(vsync: this,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 600));
    _fade = CurvedAnimation(parent: _fadeCtrl, curve: Curves.easeOut);
    _fadeCtrl.forward();
    appSettings.addListener(_onSettingsChanged);
    _loadData();
    _setupFCMRouting();
    _initialChecks();
  }

  /// Runs on cold start. Session version check first â€” if we've been
  /// signed out from elsewhere, return to Landing before anything else.
  ///
  /// Lock-on-start is now handled by the splash screen before home
  /// mounts, so this only does the remote-sign-out check.
  Future<void> _initialChecks() async {
    final valid = await _auth.verifySessionVersion();
    if (!valid && mounted) {
      await _handleSessionKicked();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _handleSessionKicked() async {
    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    final navigator = Navigator.of(context);
    await _auth.signOut();
    if (!mounted) return;
    messenger.showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(),
      content: Text(
          'You were signed out because your account signed in elsewhere.',
          style: TextStyle(color: cParchment)),
    ));
    navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
      fadeRoute(kIsWeb ? const LoginScreen() : const LandingScreen()),
      (_) => false);
  }

// ignore: unused_element
  Future<void> _checkLockOnStart() async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return;

    // â”€â”€ Wiped-device recovery â”€â”€
    // If the private key isn't in memory but Firestore still has
    // encrypted key material, force the lock screen regardless of local
    // lock settings. This is the "fresh install, sign in with unique
    // code" path â€” local prefs and secure storage are empty, so we
    // must consult Firestore and let the user enter their PIN.
    if (!CryptoService().isUnlocked) {
      final hasRemote = await CryptoService().hasRemoteKeyMaterial(code);
      if (hasRemote && mounted) {
        await showLockScreen(context);
        return;
      }
    }

    final shouldLock = await _auth.shouldLock();
    if (!shouldLock || !mounted) {
      if (code.isNotEmpty) await CryptoService().silentUnlock(code);
      return;
    }
    final mode = await _auth.getLockMode();
    if (mode == 'none') {
      await CryptoService().silentUnlock(code);
      return;
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    await showLockScreen(context);
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) async {
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.paused) {
      await _auth.saveBackgroundTimestamp();
    } else if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) {
      // Session version check â€” signed in elsewhere?
      final valid = await _auth.verifySessionVersion();
      if (!valid && mounted) {
        await _handleSessionKicked();
      }
      // No re-lock on resume. The PIN is only required on cold start
      // when the encryption keys need loading. Once they're in memory
      // they stay for the session.
    }
  }

  void _setupFCMRouting() {
    // App opened from terminated state via notification tap
    FirebaseMessaging.instance.getInitialMessage().then((message) {
      if (message != null && mounted) {
        WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
          _routeFromMessage(message.data);
        });
      }
    });

    // App in background, notification tapped
    FirebaseMessaging.onMessageOpenedApp.listen((message) {
      if (mounted) _routeFromMessage(message.data);
    });
  }

  void _routeFromMessage(Map<String, dynamic> data) async {
    final type = data['type'] as String? ?? '';
    final sessionId = data['sessionId'] as String? ?? '';
    final notifId = data['notifId'] as String? ?? '';

    if (sessionId.isNotEmpty && (type == 'rp_post' || type == 'ooc_message' || type == 'brainstorm_message')) {
      // Fetch session doc to get partnerName and genre
      try {
        final doc = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('sessions')
            .doc(sessionId)
            .get();
        if (!mounted) return;
        final sessionData = doc.data() ?? {};
        final myCode = AuthService().currentCode ?? '';
        final participants = List<String>.from(sessionData['participants'] ?? []);
        final partnerCode = participants.firstWhere((p) => p != myCode, orElse: () => '');
        final partnerName = sessionData['participantNames']?[partnerCode] as String? ?? partnerCode;
        final genre = sessionData['genre'] as String? ?? '';

        if (type == 'brainstorm_message') {
          Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(BrainstormRoomScreen(
            sessionId: sessionId,
            partnerName: partnerName,
            partnerCode: partnerCode,
            genre: genre,
          )));
        } else {
          Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(RPRoomScreen(
            sessionId: sessionId,
            partnerName: partnerName,
            partnerCode: partnerCode,
            genre: genre,
          )));
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    } else if (type == 'interest' || type == 'accepted') {
      setState(() {});
    }

    if (notifId.isNotEmpty) {
      FirestoreService().markNotificationRead(notifId);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadData() async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return;

    final profile = await _fs.getProfile(code);
    if (mounted) setState(() => _profile = profile);

        if (profile != null) {
      _CardState.bio = profile['bio'] as String? ?? '';
      _CardState.writingStyle = profile['writingStyle'] as String? ?? '';
      _CardState.frequency = profile['postFrequency'] as String? ?? '';
      final tagList = profile['tags'] as List<dynamic>?;
      _CardState.tags = (tagList ?? [])
          .map((t) => _TagData(
                t['label'] as String,
                Color(t['color'] as int),
              ))
          .toList();
            _CardState.accentColor = profile['accentColor'] != null
          ? Color(profile['accentColor'] as int)
          : cGold;
      _CardState.bgTint = profile['bgTint'] != null
          ? Color(profile['bgTint'] as int)
          : Colors.transparent;
      final bs = profile['borderStyle'] as String?;
      _CardState.borderStyle = bs != null
          ? _BorderStyle.values.firstWhere(
              (e) => e.name == bs,
              orElse: () => _BorderStyle.solid)
          : _BorderStyle.solid;
      // â”€â”€ TCG card frame + foil â”€â”€
      _CardState.frameSeed = profile['requestCardSeed'] as int? ?? 7;
      _CardState.frameGlow = profile['requestCardGlow'] as bool? ?? true;
      _CardState.frameOrnate = profile['requestCardOrnate'] as bool? ?? true;
      _CardState.frameDense = profile['requestCardDense'] as bool? ?? false;
      _CardState.foilEnabled = profile['requestCardFoil'] as bool? ?? true;
      _CardState.foilIntensity =
          (profile['requestCardFoilLevel'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.6;
      if (profile['isDiscoverable'] != null) {
        appSettings.setDiscoverable(profile['isDiscoverable'] as bool);
      }
    }

    _fs.mySessions().listen((sessions) async {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final blocked = await _fs.getBlockedCodes(code);
      final blockedBy = await _fs.getWhoBlockedMe(code);
      final hiddenCodes = <String>{...blocked, ...blockedBy};
      final rps = <_RPData>[];
      final brains = <_RPData>[];
      for (final s in sessions) {
        final participants = List<String>.from(s['participants'] ?? []);
        final names = Map<String, dynamic>.from(s['participantNames'] ?? {});
        final partnerCode = participants.firstWhere((p) => p != code, orElse: () => '');
        if (hiddenCodes.contains(partnerCode)) continue;
        final partnerName = names[partnerCode] as String? ?? partnerCode;
        final genre = s['genre'] as String? ?? '';
        final postCount = s['postCount'] as int? ?? 0;
        final status = s['status'] as String? ?? '';
        final sessionId = s['id'] as String? ?? '';
                final lastPostRaw = s['lastPostAt'];
        DateTime? lastPostAt;
        if (lastPostRaw is Timestamp) {
          lastPostAt = lastPostRaw.toDate();
        } else if (lastPostRaw is DateTime) {
          lastPostAt = lastPostRaw;
        }
        final item = _RPData(
          partnerName, partnerCode, genre, postCount, false,
          id: sessionId,
          lastPostAt: lastPostAt,
          status: status.isEmpty ? 'active' : status,
          title: (s['title'] as String?) ?? '',
        );
        if (status == 'brainstorm') {
          brains.add(item);
        } else {
          rps.add(item);
        }
      }
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
        _roleplays = rps;
        _brainstorms = brains;
        _loadingData = false;
        _recomputeContinue();
      });
      }
    });

    _fs.myNotifications().listen((notifs) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _notifications = notifs.map((n) => _NotifData(
          n['title'] as String? ?? '',
          n['subtitle'] as String? ?? '',
          n['read'] as bool? ?? false,
          id: n['id'] as String? ?? '',
          type: n['type'] as String? ?? '',
          data: Map<String, dynamic>.from(n['data'] as Map? ?? {}),
        )).toList();
      });
    });
  }

  void _onSettingsChanged() { if (mounted) setState(() {}); }

  
  Future<void> _refreshProfile() async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    final profile = await _fs.getProfile(code);
    if (mounted) setState(() => _profile = profile);
  }

  String _humanAgo(DateTime t) {
    final d = DateTime.now().difference(t);
    if (d.inSeconds < 60) return 'now';
    if (d.inMinutes < 60) return '${d.inMinutes}m';
    if (d.inHours < 24) return '${d.inHours}h';
    if (d.inDays < 7) return '${d.inDays}d';
    return '${d.inDays ~/ 7}w';
  }

  Future<void> _pushPanel(String title, Widget child) {
    return Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(_ExpansionRoute(
      title: title,
      child: child,
    )));
  }

  void _openProfile() {
    if (_isDesktop) {
      setState(() => _activeBlock = 'profile');
      return;
    }
    _pushPanel('Profile', _ProfileContent(profile: _profile));
  }

  void _openNotifications() {
    if (_isDesktop) {
      setState(() => _activeBlock = 'notifications');
      return;
    }
    _pushPanel('Notifications', _NotificationsContent(
      notifications: _notifications,
      roleplays: _roleplays,
      brainstorms: _brainstorms,
    ));
  }

  void _openRoleplays() {
    if (_isDesktop) {
      setState(() => _activeBlock = 'roleplays');
      return;
    }
    _pushPanel('Roleplays', _RoleplaysContent(
      roleplays: _roleplays,
      onEnter: (rp) => Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(RPRoomScreen(
        partnerName: rp.partner,
        partnerCode: rp.partnerCode,
        genre: rp.genre,
        sessionId: rp.id,
        title: rp.title,
      ))),
      onArchive: (rp) async {
        await _fs.updateSessionStatus(rp.id, 'archived');
      },
      onUnarchive: (rp) async {
        await _fs.updateSessionStatus(rp.id, 'active');
      },
      onBlock: (rp) {
        showBlockDialog(
          context: context,
          partnerName: rp.partner,
          myCode: _auth.currentCode ?? '',
          partnerCode: rp.partnerCode,
          fs: _fs,
        );
      },
    ));
  }

  void _openBrainstorms() {
    if (_isDesktop) {
      setState(() => _activeBlock = 'preludes');
      return;
    }
    _pushPanel('Preludes', _BrainstormContent(
      brainstorms: _brainstorms,
      onEnter: (b) => Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(BrainstormRoomScreen(
        partnerName: b.partner,
        partnerCode: b.partnerCode,
        genre: b.genre,
        sessionId: b.id,
      ))),
    ));
  }

  void _openRequestCard() {
    if (_isDesktop) {
      setState(() => _activeBlock = 'card');
      return;
    }
    _pushPanel('Request Card', _RequestCardContent());
  }

  void _openSettings() {
    if (_isDesktop) {
      setState(() => _activeBlock = 'settings');
      return;
    }
    _pushPanel('Settings', const _SettingsContent());
  }


    List<ProfileStat> _computeStats() {
    final visible = appSettings.visibleStatKeys;
    if (visible.isEmpty) return const [];

    final allSessions = [..._roleplays, ..._brainstorms];
    final totalPosts = allSessions.fold<int>(0, (a, b) => a + b.posts);
    final partnerCodes = allSessions
        .map((r) => r.partnerCode)
        .where((c) => c.isNotEmpty)
        .toSet();

    int daysActive = 0;
    final createdRaw = _profile?['createdAt'];
    if (createdRaw is Timestamp) {
      daysActive =
          DateTime.now().difference(createdRaw.toDate()).inDays + 1;
    } else if (createdRaw is DateTime) {
      daysActive =
          DateTime.now().difference(createdRaw).inDays + 1;
    }

    // Populated once the sandbox syncs these counters onto the user doc.
    // Until then they read 0.
    final worldsCreated = (_profile?['worldsCreated'] as int?) ?? 0;
    final charactersCreated =
        (_profile?['charactersCreated'] as int?) ?? 0;

    final stats = <ProfileStat>[];
    for (final key in visible) {
      switch (key) {
        case AppSettings.statActiveRPs:
          stats.add(ProfileStat(
            key: key, label: 'Active RPs',
            value: '${_roleplays.length}'));
          break;
        case AppSettings.statTotalPosts:
          stats.add(ProfileStat(
            key: key, label: 'Posts',
            value: '$totalPosts'));
          break;
        case AppSettings.statBrainstormRooms:
          stats.add(ProfileStat(
            key: key, label: 'Brainstorms',
            value: '${_brainstorms.length}'));
          break;
        case AppSettings.statWritingPartners:
          stats.add(ProfileStat(
            key: key, label: 'Partners',
            value: '${partnerCodes.length}'));
          break;
        case AppSettings.statDaysActive:
          stats.add(ProfileStat(
            key: key, label: 'Days',
            value: '$daysActive'));
          break;
                case AppSettings.statLastPost:
          DateTime? latest;
          for (final s in allSessions) {
            final t = s.lastPostAt;
            if (t == null) continue;
            if (latest == null || t.isAfter(latest)) latest = t;
          }
          stats.add(ProfileStat(
            key: key, label: 'Last Post',
            value: latest == null ? 'â€”' : _humanAgo(latest)));
          break;
        case AppSettings.statWorldsCreated:
          stats.add(ProfileStat(
            key: key, label: 'Worlds',
            value: '$worldsCreated'));
          break;
        case AppSettings.statCharactersCreated:
          stats.add(ProfileStat(
            key: key, label: 'Characters',
            value: '$charactersCreated'));
          break;
      }
    }
    return stats;
  }

  @override void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    appSettings.removeListener(_onSettingsChanged);
    _fadeCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

    void _recomputeContinue({bool advance = false}) {
    final active = _roleplays.where((r) => !r.isArchived).toList();
    if (active.isEmpty) {
      _continueSession = null;
      return;
    }

    final mode = appSettings.continueMode;
    final preferred = appSettings.continueIds;

    // Build candidate pool depending on mode
    List<_RPData> pool;
    if (mode == AppSettings.continueModeCycleSelected &&
        preferred.isNotEmpty) {
      pool = active.where((r) => preferred.contains(r.id)).toList();
      if (pool.isEmpty) pool = active;
    } else {
      pool = active;
    }

    // Pinned mode: straight to the pinned session
    if (mode == AppSettings.continueModePinned && preferred.isNotEmpty) {
      final match = pool.where((r) => r.id == preferred.first).toList();
      _continueSession = match.isNotEmpty ? match.first : pool.first;
      appSettings.setContinueLastShown(_continueSession!.id);
      return;
    }

    // Keep the current session if it's still valid and we're not advancing
    if (!advance &&
        _continueSession != null &&
        pool.any((r) => r.id == _continueSession!.id)) {
      return;
    }

    // Rotate: pick the session after continueLastShown
    final lastId = appSettings.continueLastShown;
    int index = 0;
    if (lastId != null) {
      final i = pool.indexWhere((r) => r.id == lastId);
      if (i != -1) index = (i + 1) % pool.length;
    }
    _continueSession = pool[index];
    appSettings.setContinueLastShown(_continueSession!.id);
  }

    void _openContinuePrefs() {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
      builder: (_) => _ContinuePrefsSheet(
        roleplays: _roleplays,
        onChanged: () {
          if (mounted) {
            setState(() => _recomputeContinue(advance: true));
          }
        },
      ),
    );
  }

    @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final width = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width;
    final isDesktop = width >= 900;
    final inSplitMode = isDesktop && _activeBlock != null;

    return Scaffold(
      body: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: RadialGradient(
            center: const Alignment(1.0, -1.0),
            radius: 1.4,
            colors: [
              Color.lerp(appSettings.bgColor, appSettings.bgGlowColor, 0.5)!,
              appSettings.bgColor,
            ],
          ),
        ),
        child: SafeArea(
          child: FadeTransition(
            opacity: _fade,
            child: Column(children: [
              LoreTopBar(
                onLogoTap: () {
                  if (inSplitMode) {
                    setState(() => _activeBlock = null);
                  }
                },
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: AnimatedSwitcher(
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
                  switchInCurve: Curves.easeOut,
                  switchOutCurve: Curves.easeIn,
                  child: !isDesktop
                      ? KeyedSubtree(
                          key: const ValueKey('mobile'),
                          child: _buildMobileBody(),
                        )
                      : inSplitMode
                          ? KeyedSubtree(
                              key: const ValueKey('desktop-split'),
                              child: _buildDesktopSplitBody(),
                            )
                          : KeyedSubtree(
                              key: const ValueKey('desktop-full'),
                              child: _buildDesktopFullBody(),
                            ),
                ),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // â”€â”€ MOBILE BODY â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // The same layout as before, just extracted into its own method so
  // the outer build can decide what to show. Nothing inside this
  // method changed.
    Widget _buildMobileBody() {
    final isDesktop = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width >= 900;
    
    return Center(
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: isDesktop ? 900 : double.infinity),
        child: Column(children: [
          Expanded(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
              child: Column(children: [
                HomeProfileCard(
                  name: _auth.currentName ?? 'â€”',
                  code: _auth.currentCode ?? 'â€”',
                  bio: _profile?['bio'] as String? ?? '',
                  stats: _computeStats(),
                  onTap: _openProfile,
                  onLongPress: () => ProfileStyleSheet.show(context),
                ),
                AnimatedBuilder(
                  animation: appSettings,
                  builder: (_, _) => HomeGrid(blocks: [
                    HomeGridBlock(
                      icon: Icons.notifications_none,
                      title: 'Notifications',
                      subtitle: _notifications.isEmpty
                          ? 'All caught up'
                          : '${_notifications.where((n) => !n.read).length} unread',
                      badge: _notifications.where((n) => !n.read).length,
                      accent: cGold,
                      onTap: _openNotifications,
                      style: appSettings.styleForBlock(AppSettings.blockNotifications),
                      onLongPress: () => BlockStyleSheet.show(
                          context, AppSettings.blockNotifications),
                    ),
                    HomeGridBlock(
                      icon: Icons.auto_stories_outlined,
                      title: 'Roleplays',
                      subtitle: _roleplays.isEmpty
                          ? 'Find a partner'
                          : '${_roleplays.length} active',
                      accent: cGold,
                      onTap: _openRoleplays,
                      style: appSettings.styleForBlock(AppSettings.blockRoleplays),
                      onLongPress: () => BlockStyleSheet.show(
                          context, AppSettings.blockRoleplays),
                    ),
                    HomeGridBlock(
                      icon: Icons.lightbulb_outline,
                      title: 'Preludes',
                      subtitle: _brainstorms.isEmpty
                          ? 'Start one'
                          : '${_brainstorms.length} open',
                      accent: cIce,
                      onTap: _openBrainstorms,
                      style: appSettings.styleForBlock(AppSettings.blockBrainstorms),
                      onLongPress: () => BlockStyleSheet.show(
                          context, AppSettings.blockBrainstorms),
                    ),
                    HomeGridBlock(
                      icon: Icons.credit_card_outlined,
                      title: 'Request Card',
                      subtitle: 'Edit your public card',
                      accent: cMist,
                      onTap: _openRequestCard,
                      style: appSettings.styleForBlock(AppSettings.blockRequestCard),
                      onLongPress: () => BlockStyleSheet.show(
                          context, AppSettings.blockRequestCard),
                    ),
                    HomeGridBlock(
                      icon: Icons.tune,
                      title: 'Settings',
                      subtitle: 'Appearance, security, notifications',
                      accent: cSmoke,
                      fullWidth: true,
                      onTap: _openSettings,
                      style: appSettings.styleForBlock(AppSettings.blockSettings),
                      onLongPress: () => BlockStyleSheet.show(
                          context, AppSettings.blockSettings),
                    ),
                  ]),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                FriendsStrip(
                  onFindFriends: () => Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(const CardDiscoveryScreen())),
                  onFriendTap: (code) {
                   Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(const CardDiscoveryScreen()));
                  },
                 ),
              ]),
            ),
          ),
          _ContinueCard(
            session: _continueSession,
            mode: appSettings.continueMode,
            isLoading: _loadingData,
            onOpen: () {
              final s = _continueSession;
              if (s == null) return;
              Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(RPRoomScreen(
                partnerName: s.partner,
                partnerCode: s.partnerCode,
                genre: s.genre,
                sessionId: s.id,
              )));
            },
            onLongPress: _openContinuePrefs,
            onFindPartner: () => Navigator.of(context)
                .push(fadeRoute(const CardDiscoveryScreen())),
          ),
          Container(
            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
            child: Stack(
              clipBehavior: Clip.none,
              alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
              children: [
                Row(children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: LoreTap(
                      onTap: () async {
                        await Navigator.of(context)
                            .push(fadeRoute(const SandboxScreen()));
                        if (mounted) await _refreshProfile();
                      },
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 18),
                        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                            border: Border(right: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
                        child: const Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                          children: [
                            Icon(Icons.public_outlined, size: 16, color: cSmoke),
                            SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text('Sandbox', style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
                                letterSpacing: 2,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 90),
                  Expanded(
                    child: LoreTap(
                      onTap: () => Navigator.of(context)
                          .push(fadeRoute(const CardDiscoveryScreen())),
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 18),
                        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                            border: Border(left: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
                        child: const Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                          children: [
                            Icon(Icons.explore_outlined, size: 16, color: cGold),
                            SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text('Find Partners', style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13, color: cGold,
                                letterSpacing: 2,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ]),
                Positioned(
                  top: -22,
                  child: LoreTap(
                    onTap: () => Navigator.of(context)
                        .push(fadeRoute(const DiaryScreen())),
                    child: Container(
                      width: 90,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: appSettings.bgColor,
                        border: Border.all(color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.6)),
                        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(
                            top: Radius.circular(8)),
                      ),
                      child: const Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                        Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined, size: 16, color: cGold),
                        SizedBox(height: 4),
                        Text('Diary', style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                            color: cGold, letterSpacing: 2)),
                      ]),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  // â”€â”€ DESKTOP: FULL / OVERVIEW â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // Same content as mobile, centered at a comfortable reading width
  // so a 4K monitor doesn't stretch the profile card across the whole
  // screen.
  Widget _buildDesktopFullBody() {
    return Center(
      child: SizedBox(
        width: 900,
        child: _buildMobileBody(),
      ),
    );
  }

  // â”€â”€ DESKTOP: SPLIT â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // Left sidebar (fixed width) + right content panel (expands).
  Widget _buildDesktopSplitBody() {
    return Row(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        _buildSideNav(),
        Expanded(child: _buildContentPanel()),
      ],
    );
  }

  // The persistent left rail shown in split mode.
  Widget _buildSideNav() {
    final unread = _notifications.where((n) => !n.read).length;
    return Container(
      width: 280,
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        border: Border(right: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
      ),
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            // â”€â”€ Back to overview â”€â”€
            LoreTap(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _activeBlock = null),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 16, vertical: 16),
                child: Row(children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios, size: 11, color: cSmoke),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Text('OVERVIEW',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 9,
                        color: cGold,
                        letterSpacing: 3,
                      )),
                ]),
              ),
            ),
            const Divider(color: cAsh, height: 1),

            // â”€â”€ Mini profile â”€â”€
            LoreTap(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _activeBlock = 'profile'),
              child: Container(
                padding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: _activeBlock == 'profile'
                      ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.06)
                      : Colors.transparent,
                  border: Border(
                    left: BorderSide(
                      color: _activeBlock == 'profile'
                          ? cGold
                          : Colors.transparent,
                      width: 2,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                child: Row(children: [
                  Container(
                    width: 40, height: 40,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      border: Border.all(color: cAsh),
                      color: cVoid.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                    ),
                    child: const Icon(Icons.person,
                        color: cSmoke, size: 20),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(_auth.currentName ?? 'â€”',
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 14,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                              color: cParchment,
                            )),
                        const SizedBox(height: 2),
                        Text(_auth.currentCode ?? 'â€”',
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontFamily: 'monospace',
                              fontSize: 9,
                              color: cSmoke,
                              letterSpacing: 1,
                            )),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ]),
              ),
            ),
            const Divider(color: cAsh, height: 1),

            // â”€â”€ Block list â”€â”€
            _railTile('notifications', Icons.notifications_none,
                'Notifications', badge: unread),
            _railTile('roleplays', Icons.auto_stories_outlined, 'Roleplays'),
            _railTile('preludes', Icons.lightbulb_outline, 'Preludes'),
            _railTile('card', Icons.credit_card_outlined, 'Request Card'),
            _railTile('settings', Icons.tune, 'Settings'),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _railTile(String key, IconData icon, String label, {int? badge}) {
    final active = _activeBlock == key;
    final showBadge = badge != null && badge > 0;
    return LoreTap(
      onTap: () => setState(() => _activeBlock = key),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: active ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.06) : Colors.transparent,
          border: Border(
            left: BorderSide(
              color: active ? cGold : Colors.transparent,
              width: 2,
            ),
            bottom: const BorderSide(color: cAsh, width: 0.5),
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 16, color: active ? cGold : cSmoke),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(label,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                  color: active ? cGold : cMist,
                )),
          ),
          if (showBadge)
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: cGold,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              ),
              child: Text('$badge',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 9,
                    color: cVoid,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  )),
            ),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Right-hand content panel â€” one of these per block.
  Widget _buildContentPanel() {
    switch (_activeBlock) {
      case 'notifications':
        return _panel(
          title: 'Notifications',
          child: _NotificationsContent(
            notifications: _notifications,
            roleplays: _roleplays,
            brainstorms: _brainstorms,
          ),
        );
      case 'roleplays':
        return _panel(
          title: 'Roleplays',
          child: _RoleplaysContent(
            roleplays: _roleplays,
            onEnter: (rp) =>
                Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(RPRoomScreen(
                  partnerName: rp.partner,
                  partnerCode: rp.partnerCode,
                  genre: rp.genre,
                  sessionId: rp.id,
                  title: rp.title,
                ))),
            onArchive: (rp) async {
              await _fs.updateSessionStatus(rp.id, 'archived');
            },
            onUnarchive: (rp) async {
              await _fs.updateSessionStatus(rp.id, 'active');
            },
            onBlock: (rp) {
              showBlockDialog(
                context: context,
                partnerName: rp.partner,
                myCode: _auth.currentCode ?? '',
                partnerCode: rp.partnerCode,
                fs: _fs,
              );
            },
          ),
        );
      case 'preludes':
        return _panel(
          title: 'Preludes',
          child: _BrainstormContent(
            brainstorms: _brainstorms,
            onEnter: (b) =>
                Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(BrainstormRoomScreen(
                  partnerName: b.partner,
                  partnerCode: b.partnerCode,
                  genre: b.genre,
                  sessionId: b.id,
                ))),
          ),
        );
      case 'card':
        return _panel(
          title: 'Request Card',
          child: _RequestCardContent(),
        );
      case 'settings':
        return _panel(
          title: 'Settings',
          child: const _SettingsContent(),
        );
      case 'profile':
        return _panel(
          title: 'Profile',
          child: _ProfileContent(profile: _profile),
        );
      default:
        return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }
  }

  // Shared chrome for every content panel: a title bar with a close
  // button, then the scrollable content underneath.
  Widget _panel({required String title, required Widget child}) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 18),
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
          ),
          child: Row(children: [
            Text(title,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 20,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                  color: cParchment,
                )),
            const Spacer(),
            LoreTap(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _activeBlock = null),
              child: const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.all(4),
                child: Icon(Icons.close, size: 18, color: cSmoke),
              ),
            ),
          ]),
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Center(
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 800),
                child: child,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
    }

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// SETTINGS CONTENT
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class _SettingsContent extends StatefulWidget {
  const _SettingsContent();
  @override State<_SettingsContent> createState() => _SettingsContentState();
}

class _SettingsContentState extends State<_SettingsContent> {
  final _auth = AuthService();
    Future<void> _confirmSignOutOthers() async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => Dialog(
        backgroundColor: cInk,
        shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              const Text('SIGN OUT OTHER DEVICES',
                  style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 9, color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              const Text(
                'This ends every other session on your account. The device '
                'you\'re on now stays signed in.\n\n'
                'Use this if you signed in on a phone you no longer have, '
                'or if your phone was stolen.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.7),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              Row(children: [
                Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                  onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Cancel',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
                  ),
                )),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                  onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.85),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Sign out others',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 9, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 1))),
                  ),
                )),
              ]),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (confirm != true) return;
    await _auth.signOutOtherDevices();
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(),
      content: Text('All other sessions ended.',
          style: TextStyle(color: cParchment)),
    ));
  }


  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    appSettings.addListener(_onChanged);
  }

  void _onChanged() { if (mounted) setState(() {}); }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    appSettings.removeListener(_onChanged);
    super.dispose();
  }

    Future<void> _launchDonationPage() async {
    final Uri url = Uri.parse('https://ko-fi.com/loretherpapp');
    if (!await launchUrl(url, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication)) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          backgroundColor: cInk,
          content: Text('Could not open the donation page.',
              style: TextStyle(color: cParchment)),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
    child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      // â”€â”€ Home screen glow â”€â”€
      // Long-press the header to toggle developer tools. Nothing else
      // in the UI reveals the gesture â€” the dev section appears above
      // the fold once you know it's there.
      GestureDetector(
        onLongPress: () async {
          await appSettings.setDevModeUnlocked(!appSettings.devModeUnlocked);
          if (!context.mounted) return;
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
            backgroundColor: cInk,
            behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
            shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
            content: Text(
              appSettings.devModeUnlocked
                  ? 'Developer tools unlocked'
                  : 'Developer tools hidden',
              style: const TextStyle(color: cParchment),
            ),
          ));
        },
        child: const Text('HOME GLOW', style: TextStyle(
            fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
            color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3)),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 4),
      const Text('The soft light in the corner of your home screen.',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      const SizedBox(height: 16),
      Row(children: [
        LoreTap(
          onTap: () => LoreColourPicker.show(
            context,
            current: appSettings.bgGlowColor,
            onPicked: (c) async => appSettings.setBgGlowColor(c),
          ),
          child: Container(
            width: 44, height: 44,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: appSettings.bgGlowColor,
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                border: Border.all(color: Colors.white24)),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 16),
        Expanded(child: Container(
          height: 44,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: RadialGradient(
              center: const Alignment(1.0, -1.0),
              radius: 1.4,
              colors: [
                Color.lerp(appSettings.bgColor,
                    appSettings.bgGlowColor, 0.5)!,
                appSettings.bgColor,
              ],
            ),
            border: Border.all(color: cAsh),
          ),
        )),
      ]),
      const SizedBox(height: 24),
      const Divider(color: cAsh),
      const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // â”€â”€ Reference â”€â”€
      const Text('REFERENCE', style: TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
          color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3)),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),
      LoreTap(
        onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).push(
            fadeRoute(const GesturesScreen())),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14, horizontal: 14),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: cInk, border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
          child: Row(children: const [
            Icon(Icons.touch_app_outlined, size: 16, color: cSmoke),
            SizedBox(width: 12),
            Text('Gestures & Shortcuts', style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 14, color: cMist, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
            Spacer(),
            Icon(Icons.chevron_right, size: 16, color: cSmoke),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
      
      const SizedBox(height: 24),
      const Divider(color: cAsh),
      const SizedBox(height: 16),

      // â”€â”€ Security â”€â”€
      const Text('SECURITY', style: TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
          color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3)),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),
      LoreTap(
        onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).push(
            fadeRoute(LockSetupScreen(isFirstTime: false))),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14, horizontal: 14),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: cInk, border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
          child: Row(children: const [
            Icon(Icons.lock_outline, size: 16, color: cSmoke),
            SizedBox(width: 12),
            Text('PIN & Lock screen', style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 14, color: cMist, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
            Spacer(),
            Icon(Icons.chevron_right, size: 16, color: cSmoke),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
      LoreTap(
        onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).push(
            fadeRoute(const QRScannerScreen())),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14, horizontal: 14),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: cInk, border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
          child: Row(children: const [
            Icon(Icons.qr_code_scanner, size: 16, color: cSmoke),
            SizedBox(width: 12),
            Text('Link Desktop (Web)', style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 14, color: cMist, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
            Spacer(),

          ]),
        ),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 10),
      LoreTap(
        onTap: _confirmSignOutOthers,
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14, horizontal: 14),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: cInk, border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
          child: Row(children: const [
            Icon(Icons.logout, size: 16, color: cSmoke),
            SizedBox(width: 12),
            Text('Sign out other devices', style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 14, color: cMist, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
            Spacer(),
            Icon(Icons.chevron_right, size: 16, color: cSmoke),
          ]),
        ),
      ),

      const SizedBox(height: 24),
      const Divider(color: cAsh),
      const SizedBox(height: 16),

      // â”€â”€ Appearance â”€â”€

      // â”€â”€ Appearance â”€â”€
      const Text('APPEARANCE', style: TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
          color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3)),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),
      _settingsToggle('Card border effects',
          'Animated glows on discovery cards',
          appSettings.cardBorderEffects,
          (v) => appSettings.setCardBorderEffects(v)),
      const SizedBox(height: 14),
      _settingsSegment('Text size', ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large'],
          appSettings.textSize,
          (v) => appSettings.setTextSize(v)),
      const SizedBox(height: 14),
      _settingsSegment('Orientation', ['Portrait', 'Landscape', 'Both'],
          appSettings.orientation,
          (v) => appSettings.setOrientation(v)),

      const SizedBox(height: 24),
      const Divider(color: cAsh),
      const SizedBox(height: 16),

      // â”€â”€ Ambience â”€â”€
      const Text('AMBIENCE', style: TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
          color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3)),
      const SizedBox(height: 4),
      const Text('Lore reads the mood of your story and shifts the scene around it.',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),
      _settingsToggle('Mood generator',
          'Shifts the background based on what you write',
          appSettings.aiMood,

Widget _settingsToggle(String label, String subtitle, bool value,
    ValueChanged<bool> onChanged) =>
    Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      Expanded(child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
        Text(label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
            color: cMist, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
        if (subtitle.isNotEmpty) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 2),
          Text(subtitle, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
              color: cSmoke, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
        ],
      ])),
      const SizedBox(width: 12),
      Switch(
        value: value,
        onChanged: onChanged,
        activeThumbColor: cGold,
        inactiveTrackColor: cAsh,
        materialTapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
      ),
    ]);

Widget _settingsSegment(String label, List<String> options, String current,
    ValueChanged<String> onChanged) =>
    Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      Text(label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
          color: cMist, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      Row(children: options.map((o) {
        final active = current == o;
        return LoreTap(
          onTap: () => onChanged(o),
          child: Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 7),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                border: Border.all(color: active ? cGold : cAsh),
                color: active ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.1) : Colors.transparent),
            child: Text(o, style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 1,
                color: active ? cGold : cSmoke)),
          ),
        );
      }).toList()),
    ]);

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class _CardData {
  final String code, name, genre, seeking, writingStyle, frequency, ageRating;
  final bool isOpen;
  final _CardBorderStyle borderStyle;
  final List<String> extraTags;
  final Color accentColor;
  final Color bgTint;
  final int frameSeed;
  final bool frameGlow, frameOrnate, frameDense;
  final bool foilEnabled;
  final double foilIntensity;
  const _CardData({
    required this.code, required this.name, required this.genre,
    required this.seeking, required this.writingStyle,
    required this.frequency, required this.ageRating,
    required this.isOpen, required this.borderStyle,
    this.extraTags = const [], this.accentColor = cGold,
    this.bgTint = Colors.transparent,
    this.frameSeed = 7,
    this.frameGlow = true,
    this.frameOrnate = true,
    this.frameDense = false,
    this.foilEnabled = true,
    this.foilIntensity = 0.6,
  });
}

enum _CardBorderStyle { solid, thick, faded, glow }

_CardBorderStyle _borderStyleFromString(String? s) {
  switch (s) {
    case 'double_': return _CardBorderStyle.thick;
    case 'dashed': return _CardBorderStyle.faded;
    case 'glow': return _CardBorderStyle.glow;
    default: return _CardBorderStyle.solid;
  }
}

_CardData _cardFromFirestore(Map<String, dynamic> d) {
  final tags = (d['tags'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [])
      .map((t) => t['label'] as String? ?? '').toList();
  final code = d['code'] as String? ?? '';
  return _CardData(
    code: code,
    name: d['displayNameOriginal'] as String? ?? d['displayName'] as String? ?? '?',
    genre: tags.isNotEmpty ? tags.first : 'Freeform',
    seeking: d['bio'] as String? ?? '',
    writingStyle: d['writingStyle'] as String? ?? '',
    frequency: d['postFrequency'] as String? ?? '',
    ageRating: tags.any((t) => t == '18+') ? '18+' :
               tags.any((t) => t == '16+') ? '16+' : 'All ages',
    isOpen: d['isDiscoverable'] as bool? ?? false,
    borderStyle: _borderStyleFromString(d['borderStyle'] as String?),
    accentColor: d['accentColor'] != null ? Color(d['accentColor'] as int) : cGold,
    bgTint: d['bgTint'] != null ? Color(d['bgTint'] as int) : Colors.transparent,
    extraTags: tags,
    frameSeed: d['requestCardSeed'] as int? ?? code.hashCode,
    frameGlow: d['requestCardGlow'] as bool? ?? true,
    frameOrnate: d['requestCardOrnate'] as bool? ?? true,
    frameDense: d['requestCardDense'] as bool? ?? false,
    foilEnabled: d['requestCardFoil'] as bool? ?? true,
    foilIntensity: (d['requestCardFoilLevel'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.6,
  );
}

const _allGenres = ['All', 'Fantasy', 'Sci-Fi', 'Modern', 'Historical',
  'Horror', 'Romance', 'Post-Apocalyptic', 'Freeform'];
const _allAges = ['All', 'All ages', '16+', '18+'];

class CardDiscoveryScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CardDiscoveryScreen({super.key});
  @override State<CardDiscoveryScreen> createState() =>
      _CardDiscoveryScreenState();
}
class _CardDiscoveryScreenState extends State<CardDiscoveryScreen> {
  String _genre = 'All';
  String _age = 'All';
  String _search = '';
  final _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _fs = FirestoreService();
  final _auth = AuthService();

  List<_CardData> _allCards = [];
  Set<String> _hiddenCodes = {}; // blocked by me + blocked me
  bool _loading = true;

  List<_CardData> get _filtered => _allCards.where((c) {
    if (_hiddenCodes.contains(c.code)) return false;
    final genreOk = _genre == 'All' || c.genre == _genre;
    final ageOk = _age == 'All' || c.ageRating == _age;
    final searchOk = _search.isEmpty ||
        c.name.toLowerCase().contains(_search.toLowerCase()) ||
        c.genre.toLowerCase().contains(_search.toLowerCase()) ||
        c.seeking.toLowerCase().contains(_search.toLowerCase());
    return genreOk && ageOk && searchOk;
  }).toList();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    appSettings.addListener(_onSettingsChanged);
    _loadAndListen();
  }

  Future<void> _loadAndListen() async {
    final myCode = _auth.currentCode ?? '';
    if (myCode.isNotEmpty) {
      final blocked = await _fs.getBlockedCodes(myCode);
      final blockedBy = await _fs.getWhoBlockedMe(myCode);
      if (mounted) setState(() => _hiddenCodes = {...blocked, ...blockedBy});
    }
    _fs.discoverableUsers().listen((users) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _allCards = users.map(_cardFromFirestore).toList();
        _loading = false;
      });
    });
  }

  void _onSettingsChanged() { if (mounted) setState(() {}); }

    @override void dispose() {
    appSettings.removeListener(_onSettingsChanged);
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

      void _openCardSheet(_CardData card) {
    RequestCardSheet.show(
      context,
      card: RequestCardView(
        name: card.name,
        code: card.code,
        genre: card.genre,
        bio: card.seeking,
        writingStyle: card.writingStyle,
        frequency: card.frequency,
        ageRating: card.ageRating,
        isOpen: card.isOpen,
        tags: card.extraTags,
        accent: card.accentColor,
        bgTint: card.bgTint,
        frame: CardFrameSpec(
          seed: card.frameSeed,
          accent: card.accentColor,
          glow: card.frameGlow,
          ornate: card.frameOrnate,
          dense: card.frameDense,
        ),
        foilEnabled: card.foilEnabled,
        foilSeed: card.frameSeed,
        foilIntensity: card.foilIntensity,
      ),
      canSendInterest: card.isOpen,
      onSendInterest: () => _showInterestDialog(card),
    );
  }
  void _showInterestDialog(_CardData card) {
    final msgCtrl = TextEditingController();
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => Dialog(
        backgroundColor: cInk,
        shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
            Text('Send interest to ${card.name}',
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, color: cParchment)),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            const Text(
                'Write a short message about what kind of story you have in mind.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.6)),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            TextField(
              controller: msgCtrl,
              maxLines: 4,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
                  color: cParchment, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'I had an idea about...',
                hintStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
                focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderSide: BorderSide(color: cSmoke)),
                filled: false,
              ),
              cursorColor: cGold,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            Row(children: [
              Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                  child: const Center(child: Text('Cancel',
                      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                          fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
                ),
              )),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                onTap: () async {
                  Navigator.of(context).pop();
                  await FirestoreService().sendInterest(
                    toCode: card.code,
                    message: msgCtrl.text.trim(),
                    genre: card.genre,
                  );
                  sounds.play(SoundKey.interestSent);
                  if (context.mounted) {
                    if (!mounted) return;
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
                        backgroundColor: cInk,
                        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                        shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
                        content: Text('Interest sent to ${card.name}',
                            style: const TextStyle(color: cParchment,
                                fontSize: 13,
                                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic))));
                  }
                },
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                  color: cParchment,
                  child: const Center(child: Text('Send',
                      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                          fontSize: 10, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 2))),
                ),
              )),
            ]),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    backgroundColor: appSettings.bgColor,
    body: SafeArea(
      child: Column(children: [
        LoreTopBar(
          onLogoTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
              fadeRoute(const HomeScreen()), (_) => false),
          trailing: LoreTap(
            onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
            child: const Text('â† Home', style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
          ),
        ),
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 0),
          child: TextField(
            controller: _searchCtrl,
            onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _search = v),
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: cParchment),
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              hintText: 'Search by name, genre or keywords...',
              hintStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
              prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search, color: cSmoke, size: 18),
              suffixIcon: _search.isNotEmpty
                  ? LoreTap(
                      onTap: () { _searchCtrl.clear();
                        setState(() => _search = ''); },
                      child: const Icon(Icons.close, color: cSmoke, size: 16))
                  : null,
              enabledBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
              focusedBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: cSmoke)),
              filled: true, fillColor: cInk,
              contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
            ),
            cursorColor: cGold,
          ),
        ),
        _FilterRow(options: _allGenres, selected: _genre,
            onSelect: (v) => setState(() {
              _genre = v; })),
        _FilterRow(options: _allAges, selected: _age,
            accentColor: cEmber,
            onSelect: (v) => setState(() {
              _age = v; })),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 4),
          child: Row(children: [
            Text('${_filtered.length} cards',
                style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2)),
          ]),
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: _loading
              ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                  color: cGold, strokeWidth: 1))
              : _filtered.isEmpty
              ? const Center(child: Text('No cards found.',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: cSmoke,
                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)))
              : ScrollConfiguration(
                  behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
                  child: ListView.builder(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 24),
                    itemCount: _filtered.length,
                    itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                      final card = _filtered[i];
                      return _DiscoveryCard(
                        key: ValueKey('${card.name}_$i'),
                        data: card,
                        isExpanded: false,
                        onTap: () => _openCardSheet(card),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                ),
        ),
      ]),
    ),
  );
}

class _FilterRow extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<String> options;
  final String selected;
  final Color accentColor;
  final ValueChanged<String> onSelect;
  const _FilterRow({required this.options, required this.selected,
      required this.onSelect, this.accentColor = cGold});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => SizedBox(
    height: 38,
    child: ScrollConfiguration(
      behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
      child: ListView.builder(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
        itemCount: options.length,
        itemBuilder: (_, i) {
          final opt = options[i];
          final active = opt == selected;
          return LoreTap(
            onTap: () => onSelect(opt),
            child: AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6, top: 6, bottom: 6),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: active
                      ? accentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.12) : Colors.transparent,
                  border: Border.all(color: active ? accentColor : cAsh)),
              child: Center(child: Text(opt, style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                  letterSpacing: 1.5,
                  color: active ? accentColor : cSmoke))),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    ),
  );
}

class _DiscoveryCard extends StatefulWidget {
  final _CardData data;
  final bool isExpanded;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  const _DiscoveryCard({super.key, required this.data,
      required this.isExpanded, required this.onTap});
  @override State<_DiscoveryCard> createState() => _DiscoveryCardState();
}
class _DiscoveryCardState extends State<_DiscoveryCard>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _ctrl, _borderCtrl;
  late Animation<double> _expand;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ctrl = AnimationController(vsync: this,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 350));
    _expand = CurvedAnimation(parent: _ctrl, curve: Curves.easeInOut);
    _borderCtrl = AnimationController(vsync: this,
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 2))..repeat();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(_DiscoveryCard old) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(old);
    if (widget.isExpanded != old.isExpanded) {
      widget.isExpanded ? _ctrl.forward() : _ctrl.reverse();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _ctrl.dispose(); _borderCtrl.dispose(); super.dispose();
  }

String _genreSymbol(String genre) {
    switch (genre.toLowerCase()) {
