      case 'fantasy':          return 'âš”';
      case 'sci-fi':           return 'âš™';
      case 'modern':           return 'â—ˆ';
      case 'historical':       return 'âŒ›';
      case 'horror':           return 'â˜¾';
      case 'romance':          return 'â™¡';
      case 'post-apocalyptic': return 'â˜¢';
      case 'freeform':         return 'âˆ¿';
      case 'mystery':          return 'âŒ•';
      case 'thriller':         return 'âœ¦';
      case 'literary':         return 'âœŽ';
      case 'journal':          return 'â–¤';
      default:                 return '';
    }
  }

  Widget _miniTag(String label, Color color, {bool withSymbol = false}) {
    final symbol = withSymbol ? _genreSymbol(label) : '';
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          border: Border.all(color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.5))),
      child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
        if (symbol.isNotEmpty) ...[
          Text(symbol, style: TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
              color: color, height: 1.0)),
          const SizedBox(width: 5),
        ],
        Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
            fontSize: 9, color: color, letterSpacing: 1.5)),
      ]),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(
    animation: _borderCtrl,
            builder: (_, child) {
      final pulse = appSettings.cardBorderEffects
          ? (sin(_borderCtrl.value * 2 * pi) * 0.5 + 0.5)
          : 0.5;
      final style = widget.data.borderStyle;

      return Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: cInk,
          boxShadow: style == _CardBorderStyle.glow
              ? [BoxShadow(
                  color: widget.data.accentColor
                      .withValues(alpha: 0.10 + pulse * 0.08),
                  blurRadius: 8.0,
                  spreadRadius: 0)]
              : [],
        ),
        child: CustomPaint(
          painter: _CornerBracketPainter(
            color: widget.data.accentColor,
            pulse: pulse,
            style: style,
          ),
          child: child,
        ),
      );
    },
    child: Column(children: [
      LoreTap(
        onTap: widget.onTap,
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
          child: Row(children: [
            Container(width: 8, height: 8, margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    color: widget.data.accentColor)),
            Expanded(child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
              Text(widget.data.name, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                  color: cParchment)),
              const SizedBox(height: 2),
              Row(children: [
                 _miniTag(widget.data.genre, cGold, withSymbol: true),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                _miniTag(widget.data.ageRating, cEmber),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                _miniTag(widget.data.isOpen ? 'Open' : 'Closed',
                    widget.data.isOpen ? cVine : cSmoke),
              ]),
            ])),
            AnimatedRotation(turns: widget.isExpanded ? 0.5 : 0,
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
                child: const Icon(Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                    color: cSmoke, size: 18)),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
      SizeTransition(
        sizeFactor: _expand,
        child: Container(
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
              border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
            Text(widget.data.seeking, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, color: cMist, height: 1.8)),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6,
                children: widget.data.extraTags
                    .map((t) => _miniTag(t, cSmoke, withSymbol: true))
                    .toList()),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            Row(children: [
              const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, size: 12, color: cSmoke),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Text(widget.data.writingStyle, style: const TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                  color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
              const SizedBox(width: 16),
              const Icon(Icons.schedule, size: 12, color: cSmoke),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Text(widget.data.frequency, style: const TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                  color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
            ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            widget.data.isOpen
                ? LoreTap(
                    onTap: () => _showInterestDialog(context, widget.data),
                    child: Container(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                      color: cParchment,
                      child: const Center(child: Text('S E N D   I N T E R E S T',
                          style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                              fontSize: 10, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 3))),
                    ))
                : Container(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('NOT ACCEPTING',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 3)))),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    ]),
  );

  void _showInterestDialog(BuildContext context, _CardData card) {
    final msgCtrl = TextEditingController();
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => Dialog(
        backgroundColor: cInk,
        shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
            Text('Send interest to ${card.name}', style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, color: cParchment)),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            const Text('Write a short message about what kind of story you have in mind.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.6)),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            TextField(controller: msgCtrl, maxLines: 4,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cParchment,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'I had an idea about...',
                    hintStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
                        fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
                    focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderSide: BorderSide(color: cSmoke)),
                    filled: false),
                cursorColor: cGold),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            Row(children: [
              Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Cancel',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2)))),
              )),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                onTap: () async {
                  Navigator.of(context).pop();
                  await FirestoreService().sendInterest(
                    toCode: card.code,
                    message: msgCtrl.text.trim(),
                    genre: card.genre,
                  );
                  sounds.play(SoundKey.interestSent);
                  if (context.mounted) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
                        backgroundColor: cInk,
                        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                        shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
                        content: Text('Interest sent to ${card.name}',
                            style: const TextStyle(color: cParchment,
                                fontSize: 13, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic))));
                  }
                },
                child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    color: cParchment,
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Send',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 10, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 2)))),
              )),
            ]),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// â”€â”€ STRIP CONTENTS â”€â”€
class _ProfileContent extends StatefulWidget {
  final Map<String, dynamic>? profile;
  const _ProfileContent({this.profile});
  @override State<_ProfileContent> createState() => _ProfileContentState();
}
class _ProfileContentState extends State<_ProfileContent> {
    bool _statsExpanded = false;
  final _auth = AuthService();
  final _fs = FirestoreService();
  late TextEditingController _bioCtrl;
  bool _editingBio = false;
  bool _codeRevealed = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final bio = widget.profile?['bio'] as String? ?? '';
    _bioCtrl = TextEditingController(text: bio);
    appSettings.addListener(_onSettingsChanged);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(_ProfileContent old) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(old);
    if (old.profile != widget.profile && !_editingBio) {
      _bioCtrl.text = widget.profile?['bio'] as String? ?? '';
    }
  }

  void _onSettingsChanged() { if (mounted) setState(() {}); }

  Future<void> _saveBio() async {
    await _fs.updateProfile({'bio': _bioCtrl.text.trim()});
    setState(() => _editingBio = false);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _bioCtrl.dispose();
    appSettings.removeListener(_onSettingsChanged);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final name = widget.profile?['displayNameOriginal'] as String?
        ?? _auth.currentName ?? 'â€”';
    final code = _auth.currentCode ?? 'â€”';

    return Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [

    // â”€â”€ Avatar + name â”€â”€
    Row(children: [
      Container(width: 56, height: 56,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(shape: BoxShape.circle,
              border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
          child: const Icon(Icons.person, color: cSmoke, size: 28)),
      const SizedBox(width: 16),
      Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        Text(name, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
            color: appSettings.textColourFor('profile_name') ?? cParchment)),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        _codeRevealed
          ? Row(children: [
              Text(code, style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color: appSettings.textColourFor('profile_code') ?? cGold,
                  letterSpacing: 2)),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              LoreTap(
                onTap: () async {
                  final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
                    context: context,
                    builder: (ctx) => Dialog(
                      backgroundColor: cInk,
                      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
                      child: Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                        child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            const Text('COPY UNIQUE CODE', style: TextStyle(
                                fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                                color: cEmber, letterSpacing: 4)),
                            const SizedBox(height: 12),
                            const Text(
                              'Only do this if you are transferring to a new device.\n\nNever give your unique code to anyone else â€” it is your permanent identity and cannot be changed.',
                              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
                                  height: 1.7, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                            const SizedBox(height: 24),
                            Row(children: [
                              Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                                onTap: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(false),
                                child: Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                                  child: const Center(child: Text('Cancel',
                                      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                          fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
                                ),
                              )),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                                onTap: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(true),
                                child: Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                                  color: cEmber.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
                                  child: const Center(child: Text('Copy anyway',
                                      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                          fontSize: 9, color: cParchment, letterSpacing: 2))),
                                ),
                              )),
                            ]),
                          ]),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                  if (confirm == true && context.mounted) {
                    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
                    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: code));
                    if (!mounted) return;
                      messenger.showSnackBar(SnackBar(
                      backgroundColor: cInk,
                      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
                      content: const Text('Unique code copied. Guard it carefully.',
                          style: TextStyle(color: cParchment,
                              fontSize: 13, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                    ));
                  }
                },
                child: const Icon(Icons.copy, size: 13, color: cSmoke),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              LoreTap(
                onTap: () => setState(() => _codeRevealed = false),
                child: const Icon(Icons.visibility_off, size: 13, color: cSmoke),
              ),
            ])
          : LoreTap(
              onTap: () async {
                final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
                  context: context,
                  builder: (ctx) => Dialog(
                    backgroundColor: cInk,
                    shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                      child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          const Text('UNIQUE CODE', style: TextStyle(
                              fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                              color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          const Text(
                            'This is your permanent identity on Lore. It cannot be changed or recovered.\n\nNever share it with anyone. It is only needed if you transfer to a new device.',
                            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
                                height: 1.7, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 24),
                          Row(children: [
                            Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                              onTap: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(false),
                              child: Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                                child: const Center(child: Text('Cancel',
                                    style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                        fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
                              ),
                            )),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                              onTap: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(true),
                              child: Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                                color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                                child: const Center(child: Text('Reveal',
                                    style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                        fontSize: 9, color: cGold, letterSpacing: 2))),
                              ),
                            )),
                          ]),
                        ]),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
                if (confirm == true) setState(() => _codeRevealed = true);
              },
              child: Row(children: [
                const Icon(Icons.lock_outline, size: 11, color: cSmoke),
                const SizedBox(width: 5),
                const Text('UNIQUE CODE â€” tap to reveal',
                    style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
              ]),
            ),
      ]),
    ]),

    const SizedBox(height: 20),

    // â”€â”€ Bio â”€â”€
    _sectionLabel('BIO'),
    const SizedBox(height: 8),
    _editingBio
      ? Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end, children: [
          TextField(
            controller: _bioCtrl,
            maxLines: 4,
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: appSettings.baseFontSize,
                color: cMist, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.7),
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              filled: true, fillColor: cInk,
              border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero,
                  borderSide: const BorderSide(color: cGold)),
              focusedBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero,
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: cGold)),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
            LoreTap(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _editingBio = false),
              child: const Text('cancel', style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1))),
            const SizedBox(width: 16),
            LoreTap(
              onTap: _saveBio,
              child: const Text('save', style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 11, color: cGold, letterSpacing: 1))),
          ]),
        ])
      : LoreTap(
          onTap: () => setState(() => _editingBio = true),
          child: Container(
            width: double.infinity,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
            child: Text(
              _bioCtrl.text.isEmpty
                ? 'Tap to add a bio...'
                : _bioCtrl.text,
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: appSettings.baseFontSize,
                  color: _bioCtrl.text.isEmpty
                      ? cSmoke
                      : (appSettings.textColourFor('profile_bio') ?? cMist),
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.7)),
          ),
        ),

    const SizedBox(height: 24),
    _divider(),

    // â”€â”€ Stats on card â”€â”€
    _buildStatsSection(),
    _divider(),

    // â”€â”€ Privacy â”€â”€
    _sectionLabel('PRIVACY'),
    const SizedBox(height: 12),
    _toggle('Discoverable', 'Allow others to find your card',
        appSettings.discoverable,
        (v) async {
          appSettings.setDiscoverable(v);
          await FirestoreService().updateProfile({'isDiscoverable': v});
        }),

    const SizedBox(height: 16),
    _divider(),

    // â”€â”€ Account â”€â”€
    _sectionLabel('ACCOUNT'),
    const SizedBox(height: 12),

    // Transfer Account
    LoreTap(
      onTap: () async {
        final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
          context: context,
          builder: (ctx) => Dialog(
            backgroundColor: cInk,
            shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
              child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  const Text('TRANSFER ACCOUNT', style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                      color: cEmber, letterSpacing: 4)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  const Text(
                    'This will release your account from this device so you can log in on a new one.\n\nYou will be signed out. To recover your account, you will need your unique code.',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
                        height: 1.7, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  Row(children: [
                    Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                      onTap: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(false),
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                        child: const Center(child: Text('Cancel',
                            style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
                      ),
                    )),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                      onTap: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(true),
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                        color: cEmber.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
                        child: const Center(child: Text('Transfer',
                            style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                fontSize: 9, color: cParchment, letterSpacing: 2))),
                      ),
                    )),
                  ]),
                ]),
            ),
          ),
        );
        if (confirm == true && context.mounted) {
          await appSettings.flushToCloud();
          await SandboxSync.flush();
          await _auth.releaseDeviceLock();
          await _auth.signOut();
          if (context.mounted) {
            Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
              fadeRoute(kIsWeb ? const LoginScreen() : const LandingScreen()),
              (_) => false,
            );
          }
        }
      },
      child: const Text('Transfer to new device',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cEmber,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, letterSpacing: 1)),
    ),
    const SizedBox(height: 16),

        LoreTap(
      onTap: () async {
        await appSettings.flushToCloud();
        await SandboxSync.flush();
        await AuthService().signOut();
        if (context.mounted) {
          Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
            fadeRoute(kIsWeb ? const LoginScreen() : const LandingScreen()),
            (_) => false,
          );
        }
      },
      child: const Text('Sign out',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
    ),
    const SizedBox(height: 4),
  ]);
  }

  // â”€â”€ Helpers â”€â”€

  Widget _buildStatsSection() => Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    children: [
      GestureDetector(
        onTap: () => setState(() => _statsExpanded = !_statsExpanded),
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
          child: Row(children: [
            Text('STATS ON MY CARD',
                style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                    color: appSettings.textColourFor('section_header') ?? cGold,
                    letterSpacing: 4)),
            const Spacer(),
            AnimatedRotation(
              turns: _statsExpanded ? 0.5 : 0,
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
              child: const Icon(Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                  size: 14, color: cSmoke),
            ),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      _toggle(
        'Show stats on card',
        'Master switch for every stat below',
        appSettings.profileStatsMaster,
        (v) async {
          await appSettings.setProfileStatsMaster(v);
          setState(() {});
        },
      ),
      if (_statsExpanded) ...[
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        ...AppSettings.statKeys.map((key) {
          final enabled = appSettings.profileStatsMaster &&
              (appSettings.profileStats[key] ?? false);
          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
            child: Opacity(
              opacity: appSettings.profileStatsMaster ? 1.0 : 0.4,
              child: _toggle(
                AppSettings.statLabels[key] ?? key,
                '',
                enabled,
                appSettings.profileStatsMaster
                    ? (v) async {
                        await appSettings.setProfileStatVisible(key, v);
                        setState(() {});
                      }
                    : (_) {},
              ),
            ),
          );
        }),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        const Text(
          'Worlds and Characters will show real numbers once sandbox sync is enabled.',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.5),
        ),
      ],
      const SizedBox(height: 16),
    ],
  );


  Widget _sectionLabel(String text) => Text(text,
      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
          color: appSettings.textColourFor('section_header') ?? cGold,
          letterSpacing: 4));

  Widget _divider() => Container(
      height: 1, color: cAsh,
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16));

  Widget _toggle(String label, String subtitle, bool value,
      ValueChanged<bool> onChanged) =>
      Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        Expanded(child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
          Text(label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
              color: cMist, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
          if (subtitle.isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 2),
            Text(subtitle, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
                color: cSmoke, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
          ],
        ])),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        LoreTap(
          onTap: () => onChanged(!value),
          child: AnimatedContainer(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
            width: 44, height: 24,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: value ? cGold : cAsh,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
            child: AnimatedAlign(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
              alignment: value
                  ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
              child: Container(margin: const EdgeInsets.all(3),
                  width: 18, height: 18,
                  decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                      color: cVoid, shape: BoxShape.circle)),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ]);

// ignore: unused_element
  Widget _textAction(String label, Color color) => LoreTap(
    onTap: () {},
    child: Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
      child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
          color: color, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
          decoration: TextDecoration.underline,
          decorationColor: color.withValues(alpha: 0.4))),
    ),
  );
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// SOUND SETTINGS WIDGET
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class _SoundSettings extends StatefulWidget {
  const _SoundSettings();
  @override State<_SoundSettings> createState() => _SoundSettingsState();
}

class _SoundSettingsState extends State<_SoundSettings> {
  bool _masterMute = false;
  final Map<String, bool> _enabled = {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    await sounds.init();
    final master = sounds.masterMute;
    final map = <String, bool>{};
    for (final key in SoundKey.all) {
      map[key] = sounds.isEnabled(key) || master;
    }
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
      _masterMute = master;
      _enabled.addAll(map);
    });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      // Master mute toggle
      _soundRow(
        label: 'All sounds',
        subtitle: 'Master mute',
        value: !_masterMute,
        onChanged: (v) async {
          await sounds.setMasterMute(!v);
          setState(() => _masterMute = !v);
        },
        icon: _masterMute ? Icons.volume_off : Icons.volume_up,
        color: cGold,
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),
      Container(height: 1, color: cAsh.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12)),
      // Individual sound toggles
      ...SoundKey.all.map((key) {
        final label = SoundKey.labels[key] ?? key;
        final enabled = _enabled[key] ?? true;
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
          child: _soundRow(
            label: label,
            value: enabled,
            muted: _masterMute,
            onChanged: _masterMute ? null : (v) async {
              await sounds.setEnabled(key, v);
              setState(() => _enabled[key] = v);
            },
          ),
        );
      }),
    ]);
  }

  Widget _soundRow({
    required String label,
    String? subtitle,
    required bool value,
    bool muted = false,
    IconData? icon,
    Color? color,
    ValueChanged<bool>? onChanged,
  }) {
    return Row(children: [
      if (icon != null) ...[
        Icon(icon, size: 14, color: color ?? cSmoke),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
      ],
      Expanded(child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
          Text(label, style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 13, color: muted && onChanged != null ? cSmoke : cMist,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
          if (subtitle != null)
            Text(subtitle, style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
        ],
      )),
      Switch(
        value: value,
        onChanged: onChanged,
        activeThumbColor: color ?? cGold,
        inactiveThumbColor: cAsh,
        inactiveTrackColor: cInk,
        materialTapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
      ),
    ]);
  }
}

class _NotifData {
  final String title, subtitle, id, type;
  final Map<String, dynamic> data;
  bool read;
  _NotifData(this.title, this.subtitle, this.read,
      {this.id = '', this.type = '', this.data = const {}});
}

class _NotificationsContent extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<_NotifData> notifications;
  final List<_RPData> roleplays;
  final List<_RPData> brainstorms;
  const _NotificationsContent({
    required this.notifications,
    required this.roleplays,
    required this.brainstorms,
  });
  @override State<_NotificationsContent> createState() =>
      _NotificationsContentState();
}
class _NotificationsContentState extends State<_NotificationsContent> {
  final _fs = FirestoreService();
  final _auth = AuthService();

  List<_RPData> get _roleplays => widget.roleplays;
  List<_RPData> get _brainstorms => widget.brainstorms;

  Future<void> _markRead(String id) async {
    if (id.isEmpty) return;
    await _fs.markNotificationRead(id);
  }

  Future<String> _respond(_NotifData n, bool accepted) async {
    final fromCode = n.data['fromCode'] as String? ?? '';
    final genre = n.data['genre'] as String? ?? '';
    if (fromCode.isEmpty) return '';

    final snap = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('interests')
        .where('fromCode', isEqualTo: fromCode)
        .where('toCode', isEqualTo: _auth.currentCode)
        .where('status', isEqualTo: 'pending')
        .limit(1)
        .get();

    if (snap.docs.isEmpty) return '';
    final interestId = snap.docs.first.id;
    final fromName = (snap.docs.first.data()['fromName'] as String?) ?? fromCode;

    final sessionId = await _fs.respondToInterest(
      interestId: interestId,
      fromCode: fromCode,
      fromName: fromName,
      genre: genre,
      accepted: accepted,
    );
    await _markRead(n.id);
    if (accepted && sessionId.isNotEmpty) sounds.play(SoundKey.sessionAccept);
    return sessionId;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (widget.notifications.isEmpty) {
      return const Center(child: Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Text('No notifications yet.',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      ));
    }
    return Column(
      children: widget.notifications.map((n) {
        final isInterest = n.type == 'interest';
        final isAccepted = n.type == 'accepted';
        final isRpPost = n.type == 'rp_post';
        final isBrainstorm = n.type == 'brainstorm_message';
        final isOoc = n.type == 'ooc_message';
        final isInviteRequest = n.type == 'invite_request';
        final isSecurityWarning = n.type == 'security_warning';

        return LoreTap(
          onTap: (isRpPost || isBrainstorm || isOoc) ? () async {
            await _markRead(n.id);
            setState(() => n.read = true);
            final sessionId = n.data['sessionId'] as String? ?? '';
            if (!context.mounted || sessionId.isEmpty) return;
            // Find partner name from sessions
            final session = _roleplays.firstWhere((r) => r.id == sessionId,
                orElse: () => _brainstorms.firstWhere((b) => b.id == sessionId,
                    orElse: () => const _RPData('', '', '', 0, false)));
            if (isRpPost || isOoc) {
              Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(RPRoomScreen(
                partnerName: session.partner,
                partnerCode: session.partnerCode,
                genre: session.genre,
                sessionId: sessionId,
              )));
            } else {
              Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(BrainstormRoomScreen(
                partnerName: session.partner,
                partnerCode: session.partnerCode,
                genre: session.genre,
                sessionId: sessionId,
              )));
            }
          } : null,
          child: Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
              border: Border.all(
                color: !n.read && isAccepted ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
                     : !n.read && isInterest ? cIce.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
                     : !n.read && isRpPost ? cEmber.withValues(alpha: 0.4)
                     : !n.read && isBrainstorm ? cMagic.withValues(alpha: 0.4)
                     : !n.read && isOoc ? cSmoke.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
                     : !n.read && isSecurityWarning ? cEmber.withValues(alpha: 0.7)
                     : n.read ? cAsh : cSmoke,
              ),
              color: !n.read && isAccepted ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                   : !n.read && isInterest ? cIce.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                   : !n.read && isRpPost ? cEmber.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                   : !n.read && isBrainstorm ? cMagic.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                   : !n.read && isOoc ? cAsh.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                   : !n.read && isInviteRequest ? cVine.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                   : !n.read && isSecurityWarning ? cEmber.withValues(alpha: 0.15)
                   : n.read ? Colors.transparent : cInk,),
          child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
            Row(children: [
              if (isAccepted)
                Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 10),
                  child: Icon(Icons.check_circle_outline, size: 16,
                      color: n.read ? cSmoke : cGold)),
              if (isInterest)
                Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 10),
                  child: Icon(Icons.mail_outline, size: 16,
                      color: n.read ? cSmoke : cIce)),
              if (isRpPost)
                Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 10),
                  child: Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, size: 16,
                      color: n.read ? cSmoke : cEmber)),
              if (isOoc)
                Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 10),
                  child: Icon(Icons.chat_bubble_outline, size: 16,
                      color: n.read ? cSmoke : cMist)),
              if (isInviteRequest)
                Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 10),
                  child: Icon(Icons.card_giftcard_outlined, size: 16,
                      color: n.read ? cSmoke : cVine)),
              if (isSecurityWarning)
                Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 10),
                  child: Icon(Icons.shield_outlined, size: 16,
                      color: n.read ? cSmoke : cEmber)),
              Expanded(child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
                Text(n.title, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
                    color: n.read ? cSmoke
                         : isAccepted ? cGold
                         : isInterest ? cIce
                         : isRpPost ? cEmber
                         : isBrainstorm ? cMagic
                         : isOoc ? cMist
                         : isInviteRequest ? cVine
                         : isSecurityWarning ? cEmber
                         : cParchment,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(n.subtitle, style: const TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                    color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
              ])),
              LoreTap(
                onTap: () async {
                  await _markRead(n.id);
                  setState(() => n.read = true);
                },
                child: Icon(Icons.close, size: 14,
                    color: n.read ? cAsh : cSmoke)),
            ]),

            // Interest notification â€” Accept / Decline
            if (isInterest && !n.read) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Row(children: [
                Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                  onTap: () async {
                    await _respond(n, false);
                    setState(() => n.read = true);
                  },
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Decline',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2)))),
                )),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                  onTap: () async {
                    final sessionId = await _respond(n, true);
                    setState(() => n.read = true);
                    if (context.mounted) {
                      showSessionStartChoice(
                        context,
                        partnerName: n.data['fromCode'] as String? ?? '?',
                        partnerCode: n.data['fromCode'] as String? ?? '',
                        genre: n.data['genre'] as String? ?? '',
                        sessionId: sessionId,
                      );
                    }
                  },
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                    color: cParchment,
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Accept',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 9, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 2)))),
                )),
              ]),
            ],

            // Invite request notification â€” Accept / Decline
            if (isInviteRequest && !n.read) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Row(children: [
                Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                  onTap: () async {
                    await _markRead(n.id);
                    setState(() => n.read = true);
                  },
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Decline',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2)))),
                )),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                  onTap: () async {
                    final fromCode = n.data['fromCode'] as String? ?? '';
                    final fromName = n.data['fromName'] as String? ?? fromCode;
                    final genre = n.data['genre'] as String? ?? '';
                    await _markRead(n.id);
                    setState(() => n.read = true);
                    // Create a session directly
                    final sessionId = await FirestoreService().respondToInterest(
                      interestId: n.id,
                      fromCode: fromCode,
                      fromName: fromName,
                      genre: genre,
                      accepted: true,
                    );
                    if (context.mounted && sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
                      showSessionStartChoice(
                        context,
                        partnerName: fromName,
                        partnerCode: fromCode,
                        genre: genre,
                        sessionId: sessionId,
                      );
                    }
                  },
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                    color: cVine.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Accept',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 9, color: cParchment, letterSpacing: 2)))),
                )),
              ]),
            ],

            // Accepted notification â€” tap to begin
            if (isAccepted && !n.read) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              LoreTap(
                onTap: () async {
                  await _markRead(n.id);
                  setState(() => n.read = true);
                  if (context.mounted) {
                    final sessionId = n.data['sessionId'] as String? ?? '';
                    showSessionStartChoice(
                      context,
                      partnerName: n.subtitle.split(' Â· ').first,
                      partnerCode: n.data['partnerCode'] as String? ?? '',
                      genre: n.data['genre'] as String? ?? '',
                      sessionId: sessionId,
                    );
                  }
                },
                child: const Text('Tap to choose how to begin â†’',
                    style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                        color: cGold, letterSpacing: 1)),
              ),
            ],
            // RP post / brainstorm tap hint
            if ((isRpPost || isBrainstorm || isOoc) && !n.read) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(isRpPost ? 'Tap to enter the RP room â†’'
                  : isBrainstorm ? 'Tap to enter prelude â†’'
                  : 'Tap to open OOC â†’',
                  style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                      color: isRpPost ? cEmber
                           : isBrainstorm ? cMagic
                           : cMist,
                      letterSpacing: 1)),
            ],
          ]),
        ), // Container
        ); // GestureDetector
      }).toList(),
    );
  }
}

class _RPData {
  final String partner, partnerCode, genre, id;
  final int posts;
  final bool yourTurn;
  final DateTime? lastPostAt;
  final String status;
  final String title;
  const _RPData(
    this.partner,
    this.partnerCode,
    this.genre,
    this.posts,
    this.yourTurn, {
    this.id = '',
    this.lastPostAt,
    this.status = 'active',
    this.title = '',
  });

  bool get isArchived => status == 'archived';
  bool get hasTitle => title.trim().isNotEmpty;

  _RPData copyWithStatus(String newStatus) => _RPData(
        partner, partnerCode, genre, posts, yourTurn,
        id: id, lastPostAt: lastPostAt, status: newStatus, title: title,
      );
}

class _RoleplaysContent extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<_RPData> roleplays;
  final void Function(_RPData rp) onEnter;
  final Future<void> Function(_RPData rp)? onArchive;
  final Future<void> Function(_RPData rp)? onUnarchive;
  final void Function(_RPData rp)? onBlock;
  const _RoleplaysContent({
    required this.roleplays,
    required this.onEnter,
    this.onArchive,
    this.onUnarchive,
    this.onBlock,
  });
  @override
  State<_RoleplaysContent> createState() => _RoleplaysContentState();
}

class _RoleplaysContentState extends State<_RoleplaysContent> {
  late List<_RPData> _items;
  bool _showArchived = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _items = List.of(widget.roleplays);
  }

  List<_RPData> get _visible => _items
      .where((r) => _showArchived || !r.isArchived)
      .toList();

  int get _archivedCount => _items.where((r) => r.isArchived).length;

  Future<void> _archive(_RPData rp) async {
    await widget.onArchive?.call(rp);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      final i = _items.indexWhere((x) => x.id == rp.id);
      if (i != -1) _items[i] = _items[i].copyWithStatus('archived');
    });
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
      content: Text(
        'Archived the story with ${rp.partner}.',
        style: const TextStyle(
            color: cParchment, fontSize: 13, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
      ),
    ));
  }

  Future<void> _unarchive(_RPData rp) async {
    await widget.onUnarchive?.call(rp);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      final i = _items.indexWhere((x) => x.id == rp.id);
      if (i != -1) _items[i] = _items[i].copyWithStatus('active');
    });
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
      content: Text(
        'Restored the story with ${rp.partner}.',
        style: const TextStyle(
            color: cParchment, fontSize: 13, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
      ),
    ));
  }

  void _openMenu(_RPData rp) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
      builder: (ctx) => Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 32),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Center(
              child: Container(
                width: 32, height: 3,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: cAsh, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2)),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            if (rp.hasTitle) ...[
              Text(
                rp.title,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, color: cParchment),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 2),
              Text(
                rp.partner,
                style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2),
              ),
            ] else
              Text(
                rp.partner,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, color: cParchment),
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              '${rp.genre} Â· ${rp.posts} posts',
              style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            if (!rp.isArchived)
              _menuTile(
                icon: Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
                title: 'Archive',
                subtitle: 'Hide from your list. Restore any time.',
                color: cMist,
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.of(ctx).pop();
                  _archive(rp);
                },
              )
            else
              _menuTile(
                icon: Icons.unarchive_outlined,
                title: 'Restore',
                subtitle: 'Bring this story back to your active list.',
                color: cVine,
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.of(ctx).pop();
                  _unarchive(rp);
                },
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            _menuTile(
              icon: Icons.block,
              title: 'Block this user',
              subtitle: 'Never see or hear from them again.',
              color: cEmber,
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(ctx).pop();
                widget.onBlock?.call(rp);
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _menuTile({
    required IconData icon,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    required Color color,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: onTap,
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
        child: Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
              child: Icon(icon, size: 16, color: color),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    title,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14, color: color,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    subtitle,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke,
                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.5,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final items = _visible;
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        // Show archived toggle â€” only if there are archived items
        if (_archivedCount > 0) ...[
          GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => setState(() => _showArchived = !_showArchived),
            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
            child: Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                border: Border.all(
                    color: _showArchived ? cGold : cAsh),
                color: _showArchived
                    ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.06)
                    : Colors.transparent,
              ),
              child: Row(children: [
                Icon(
                  _showArchived
                      ? Icons.visibility
                      : Icons.visibility_outlined,
                  size: 14,
                  color: _showArchived ? cGold : cSmoke,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Text(
                  _showArchived
                      ? 'Showing archived ($_archivedCount)'
                      : 'Show archived ($_archivedCount)',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontSize: 9,
                    letterSpacing: 2,
                    color: _showArchived ? cGold : cSmoke,
                  ),
                ),
              ]),
            ),
          ),
        ],

        if (items.isEmpty)
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 24),
            child: Column(children: [
              Text(
                _showArchived
                    ? 'No stories yet.'
                    : 'No active roleplays.',
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14, color: cMist,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w300),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              const Text('Send an interest to start a story.',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke)),
            ]),
          )
        else
          ...items.map((rp) => GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => widget.onEnter(rp),
                onLongPress: () => _openMenu(rp),
                behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                child: Opacity(
                  opacity: rp.isArchived ? 0.55 : 1.0,
                  child: Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      border: Border.all(
                          color: rp.isArchived ? cAsh : cAsh),
                    ),
                    child: Row(children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            if (rp.hasTitle) ...[
                              Text(rp.title,
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 15,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                                      color: cParchment)),
                              const SizedBox(height: 2),
                              Text(rp.partner,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                      fontSize: 10,
                                      color: cSmoke,
                                      letterSpacing: 1)),
                            ] else
                              Text(rp.partner,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 16,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                                      color: cParchment)),
                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                            Text(
                              rp.isArchived
                                  ? '${rp.genre} Â· archived'
                                  : '${rp.genre} Â· ${rp.posts} posts',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                  fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke,
                                  letterSpacing: 1),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                        children: [
                          if (!rp.isArchived && rp.yourTurn)
                            Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                              color: cGold,
                              child: const Text('YOUR TURN',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                      fontSize: 8,
                                      color: cVoid,
                                      letterSpacing: 1)),
                            ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          const Text('Enter â†’',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke,
                                  letterSpacing: 1)),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ]),
                  ),
                ),
              )),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _BrainstormContent extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<_RPData> brainstorms;
  final void Function(_RPData b) onEnter;
  const _BrainstormContent({required this.brainstorms, required this.onEnter});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => brainstorms.isEmpty
    ? const Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 24),
        child: Column(children: [
          Text('No brainstorm rooms.',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: cMist,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
          SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text('Accept an interest to start planning.',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke)),
        ]),
      )
    : Column(
        children: brainstorms.map((b) => LoreTap(
          onTap: () => onEnter(b),
          child: Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
            child: Row(children: [
              Expanded(child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                Text(b.partner, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                    color: cParchment)),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(b.genre, style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
              ])),
              Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end, children: [
                if (b.yourTurn) Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                    color: cIce,
                    child: const Text('WAITING', style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 8,
                        color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 1))),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                const Text('Enter â†’', style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
              ]),
            ]),
          ),
        )).toList(),
      );
}

class _RequestCardContent extends StatefulWidget {
  @override State<_RequestCardContent> createState() =>
      _RequestCardContentState();
}

class _RequestCardContentState extends State<_RequestCardContent> {
  final _fs = FirestoreService();
  final _auth = AuthService();
  String? _inviteCode;
  bool _loadingInvite = false;
  final _redeemCtrl = TextEditingController();
  bool _redeemLoading = false;
  String? _redeemError;
  bool _redeemSuccess = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadInviteCode();
  }

  Future<void> _redeemInviteCode() async {
    final code = _redeemCtrl.text.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (code.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() { _redeemLoading = true; _redeemError = null; _redeemSuccess = false; });
    final ownerCode = await _fs.validateInviteCode(code);
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (ownerCode == null) {
      setState(() { _redeemError = 'Invalid or already used code.'; _redeemLoading = false; });
      return;
    }
    if (ownerCode == _auth.currentCode) {
      setState(() { _redeemError = 'You cannot use your own invite code.'; _redeemLoading = false; });
      return;
    }
    await _fs.redeemInviteCode(
      inviteCode: code,
      fromCode: _auth.currentCode ?? '',
      fromName: _auth.currentName ?? '',
    );
    if (mounted) {
      _redeemCtrl.clear();
      setState(() { _redeemLoading = false; _redeemSuccess = true; });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _redeemCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadInviteCode() async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    final invite = await _fs.getActiveInviteCode(code);
    if (mounted) setState(() => _inviteCode = invite);
  }

  void _showRedeemSheet(BuildContext context) {
    _redeemCtrl.clear();
    _redeemError = null;
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
      builder: (ctx) => Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(
          left: 24, right: 24, top: 32,
          bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom + 32,
        ),
        child: StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (ctx, setSheet) => Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              const Text('ENTER A CODE', style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                  color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextField(
                controller: _redeemCtrl,
                autofocus: true,
                textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.characters,
                style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontSize: 20, color: cParchment, letterSpacing: 4),
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  filled: true, fillColor: cVoid,
                  hintText: 'XXXXXXXX',
                  hintStyle: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 18, color: cAsh, letterSpacing: 3),
                  contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
                  border: const OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero,
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
                  focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero,
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.6))),
                  errorText: _redeemError,
                  errorStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
                      color: cEmber, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                ),
                onChanged: (_) => setSheet(() => _redeemError = null),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              LoreTap(
                onTap: _redeemLoading ? null : () async {
                  await _redeemInviteCode();
                  if (!mounted) return;
                  if (_redeemSuccess) {
                    if (!ctx.mounted) return;
                    Navigator.of(ctx).pop();
                  } else {
                    setSheet(() {});
                  }
                },
                child: Container(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                  color: cVine.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
                  child: Center(child: _redeemLoading
                      ? const SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 1.5, color: cParchment))
                      : const Text('Send request', style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                          color: cParchment, letterSpacing: 2))),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _generateInviteCode() async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    setState(() => _loadingInvite = true);
    final invite = await _fs.generateInviteCode(code);
    if (mounted) setState(() { _inviteCode = invite; _loadingInvite = false; });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      const Text(
        'Your public request card is visible to others browsing for a partner.',
        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
            fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.7)),
      const SizedBox(height: 16),
      // Preview of the card
      _CardPreview(),
      const SizedBox(height: 16),
      // Edit button â€” opens full screen editor
      LoreTap(
        onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).push(
            fadeRoute(const _RequestCardEditor())),
        child: Container(
          width: double.infinity,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
          child: const Center(child: Text('Edit card',
              style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
        ),
      ),

      const SizedBox(height: 20),

      // â”€â”€ Invite Code â”€â”€
      const Text('INVITE CODE', style: TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9, color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),

      // MY CODE
      const Text('MY CODE', style: TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 8, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 3)),
      const SizedBox(height: 6),
      const Text('Share this with someone so they can send you a direct brainstorm request.',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.6)),
      const SizedBox(height: 10),
      if (_inviteCode != null) ...[
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            border: Border.all(color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.4)),
            color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
          ),
          child: Row(children: [
            Expanded(child: Text(_inviteCode!,
                style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontSize: 18, color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4))),
            LoreTap(
              onTap: () {
                Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: _inviteCode!));
                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
                  backgroundColor: cInk,
                  behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                  shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
                  content: const Text('Invite code copied',
                      style: TextStyle(color: cParchment,
                          fontSize: 13, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                ));
              },
              child: const Icon(Icons.copy, size: 16, color: cSmoke),
            ),
          ]),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        LoreTap(
          onTap: _loadingInvite ? null : _generateInviteCode,
          child: Text('Generate new code',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
                  color: _loadingInvite ? cSmoke : cEmber, letterSpacing: 1)),
        ),
      ] else ...[
        LoreTap(
          onTap: _loadingInvite ? null : _generateInviteCode,
          child: Container(
            width: double.infinity,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.4))),
            child: Center(child: _loadingInvite
              ? const SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 1, color: cGold))
              : const Text('Generate invite code',
                  style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 10, color: cGold, letterSpacing: 2))),
          ),
        ),
      ],

      const SizedBox(height: 20),

      // ENTER A CODE
      const Text('ENTER A CODE', style: TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 8, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 3)),
      const SizedBox(height: 6),
      const Text('Got someone\'s invite code? Enter it to send them a direct brainstorm request.',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.6)),
      const SizedBox(height: 10),
      if (_redeemSuccess) ...[
        const Text('Request sent! Waiting for them to accept.',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: cVine,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        LoreTap(
          onTap: () => setState(() => _redeemSuccess = false),
          child: const Text('Send another',
              style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                  color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
        ),
      ] else
        LoreTap(
          onTap: () => _showRedeemSheet(context),
          child: Container(
            width: double.infinity,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
            child: const Center(child: Text('Enter a code',
                style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                    color: cMist, letterSpacing: 2))),
          ),
        ),
    ]);
  }
}

// â”€â”€ Shared card state (simple static for now) â”€â”€
class _CardState {
  static String bio = 'I write long, immersive posts and expect the same in return. My stories tend toward the dark and morally complex.';
  static List<_TagData> tags = [
    _TagData('Historical', cGold),
    _TagData('18+', cEmber),
    _TagData('Open to ideas', cVine),
  ];
  static Color accentColor = cGold;
  static _BorderStyle borderStyle = _BorderStyle.solid;
  static Color bgTint = Colors.transparent;
  static String writingStyle = 'Long form Â· Literary Â· Dark themes';
  static String frequency = '1â€“2 posts per day';

  // â”€â”€ TCG card frame + foil (new) â”€â”€
  static int frameSeed = 7;
  static bool frameGlow = true;
  static bool frameOrnate = true;
  static bool frameDense = false;
    static bool foilEnabled = true;
  static double foilIntensity = 0.6;

  // Bumped when the editor saves. Anything showing the card listens
  // to this and rebuilds â€” so panels that are sitting in the background
  // while the editor is on top stay in sync without a navigation trip.
  static final ValueNotifier<int> revision = ValueNotifier<int>(0);
  static void bump() => revision.value++;
}

class _TagData {
  String label; Color color;
  _TagData(this.label, this.color);
}

enum _BorderStyle { solid, double_, dashed, glow }

// â”€â”€ Card preview (shown in strip) â”€â”€
class _CardPreview extends StatefulWidget {
  @override State<_CardPreview> createState() => _CardPreviewState();
}

class _CardPreviewState extends State<_CardPreview> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _CardState.revision.addListener(_onCardChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _CardState.revision.removeListener(_onCardChanged);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onCardChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Derive genre + age rating from tags, same rules as discovery list.
    final tagLabels = _CardState.tags.map((t) => t.label).toList();
    final genre = tagLabels.isNotEmpty ? tagLabels.first : 'Freeform';
    final ageRating = tagLabels.any((t) => t == '18+')
        ? '18+'
        : tagLabels.any((t) => t == '16+')
            ? '16+'
            : 'All ages';

    final spec = CardFrameSpec(
      seed: _CardState.frameSeed,
      accent: _CardState.accentColor,
      glow: _CardState.frameGlow,
      ornate: _CardState.frameOrnate,
      dense: _CardState.frameDense,
    );

    return Center(
      child: SizedBox(
        width: 280, // <--- THIS constrains the size
        child: RequestCardView(
          name: 'You',
          code: 'DEMO-A1B2',
          genre: genre,
          bio: _CardState.bio,
          writingStyle: _CardState.writingStyle,
          frequency: _CardState.frequency,
          ageRating: ageRating,
          isOpen: true,
          tags: tagLabels,
          accent: _CardState.accentColor,
          frame: spec,
          foilEnabled: _CardState.foilEnabled,
          foilSeed: _CardState.frameSeed,
          foilIntensity: _CardState.foilIntensity,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}


// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// REQUEST CARD EDITOR  (full screen)
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class _RequestCardEditor extends StatefulWidget {
  const _RequestCardEditor();
  @override State<_RequestCardEditor> createState() =>
      _RequestCardEditorState();
}

class _RequestCardEditorState extends State<_RequestCardEditor>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late TabController _tab;
  late TextEditingController _bioCtrl;
  late TextEditingController _styleCtrl;
  late TextEditingController _freqCtrl;
  late TextEditingController _newTagCtrl;
  Color _newTagColor = cGold;

  final _accentOptions = [cGold, cIce, cEmber, cMagic, cVine,
    const Color(0xFFa0c4a0), Colors.white70, cParchment];
  final _bgOptions = [
    Colors.transparent, cGold, cIce, cEmber, cMagic,
    cVine, const Color(0xFF1a1a2e), const Color(0xFF2e1a1a),
  ];
  final _tagColorOptions = [cGold, cIce, cEmber, cMagic, cVine,
    cParchment, Colors.white70, const Color(0xFFa0c4a0)];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tab = TabController(length: 3, vsync: this);
    _bioCtrl = TextEditingController(text: _CardState.bio);
    _styleCtrl = TextEditingController(text: _CardState.writingStyle);
    _freqCtrl = TextEditingController(text: _CardState.frequency);
    _newTagCtrl = TextEditingController();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tab.dispose();
    _bioCtrl.dispose();
    _styleCtrl.dispose();
    _freqCtrl.dispose();
    _newTagCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _save() async {
    _CardState.bio = _bioCtrl.text.trim();
    _CardState.writingStyle = _styleCtrl.text.trim();
    _CardState.frequency = _freqCtrl.text.trim();

    // Persist to Firestore
    await FirestoreService().updateProfile({
      'bio': _CardState.bio,
      'writingStyle': _CardState.writingStyle,
      'postFrequency': _CardState.frequency,
      'accentColor': _CardState.accentColor.toARGB32(),
      'bgTint': _CardState.bgTint.toARGB32(),
      'borderStyle': _CardState.borderStyle.name,
      'tags': _CardState.tags.map((t) => {
        'label': t.label,
        'color': t.color.toARGB32(),
      }).toList(),
      // â”€â”€ TCG card frame + foil â”€â”€
      'requestCardSeed': _CardState.frameSeed,
      'requestCardGlow': _CardState.frameGlow,
      'requestCardOrnate': _CardState.frameOrnate,
      'requestCardDense': _CardState.frameDense,
      'requestCardFoil': _CardState.foilEnabled,
      'requestCardFoilLevel': _CardState.foilIntensity,
    });

    _CardState.bump();
    if (mounted) Navigator.of(context).pop();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: appSettings.bgColor,
      // Key fix: resizeToAvoidBottomInset moves content above keyboard
