      resizeToAvoidBottomInset: true,
      body: SafeArea(child: Column(children: [
        // Header
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
              border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
          child: Row(children: [
            LoreTap(
              onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
              child: const Icon(Icons.close, color: cSmoke, size: 18)),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            const Text('Request Card',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, color: cParchment)),
            const Spacer(),
            LoreTap(
              onTap: _save,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
                color: cParchment,
                child: const Text('Save',
                    style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 10, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 1)))),
          ]),
        ),
        // Tab bar
        Container(
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
              border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
          child: TabBar(
            controller: _tab,
            indicatorColor: cGold,
            indicatorWeight: 1,
            labelColor: cGold,
            unselectedLabelColor: cSmoke,
            labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 2),
            tabs: const [
              Tab(text: 'CONTENT'),
              Tab(text: 'TAGS'),
              Tab(text: 'APPEARANCE'),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        // Tabs â€” wrapped in Expanded so keyboard doesn't overflow
        Expanded(
          child: TabBarView(controller: _tab, children: [
            _buildContentTab(),
            _buildTagsTab(),
            _buildAppearanceTab(),
          ]),
        ),
      ])),
    );
  }

  // â”€â”€ CONTENT TAB â”€â”€
  Widget _buildContentTab() {
    return ScrollConfiguration(
      behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        // padding adapts when keyboard appears
        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
            20, 20, 20, MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom + 20),
        child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
          _label('Bio'),
          TextField(
            controller: _bioCtrl,
            maxLines: null,
            minLines: 5,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: cParchment,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.7),
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              hintText: 'What kind of writer are you? What are you looking for?',
              hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cSmoke, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                  fontSize: 13),
              enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
              focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: cSmoke)),
              filled: true, fillColor: cInk,
            ),
            cursorColor: cGold,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          _label('Writing style'),
          TextField(
            controller: _styleCtrl,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: cParchment,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              hintText: 'e.g. Long form Â· Literary Â· Dark themes',
              hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cSmoke, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
              enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
              focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: cSmoke)),
              filled: true, fillColor: cInk,
            ),
            cursorColor: cGold,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          _label('Post frequency'),
          TextField(
            controller: _freqCtrl,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: cParchment,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              hintText: 'e.g. 1â€“2 posts per day',
              hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cSmoke, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
              enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
              focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: cSmoke)),
              filled: true, fillColor: cInk,
            ),
            cursorColor: cGold,
          ),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  // â”€â”€ TAGS TAB â”€â”€
  Widget _buildTagsTab() {
    return ScrollConfiguration(
      behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
            20, 20, 20, MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom + 20),
        child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
          _label('Current tags'),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          const Text('Long press a tag to remove it.',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8,
            children: _CardState.tags.map((t) => GestureDetector(
              onLongPress: () => setState(() => _CardState.tags.remove(t)),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 12, vertical: 7),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    border: Border.all(color: t.color.withValues(alpha: 0.6))),
                child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
                  Text(t.label, style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 10, color: t.color, letterSpacing: 1)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Icon(Icons.close, size: 10, color: t.color.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
                ]),
              ),
            )).toList(),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          _label('Add a tag'),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6,
            children: _tagColorOptions.map((c) => LoreTap(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _newTagColor = c),

                  color: c, shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: _newTagColor == c ? Colors.white : Colors.transparent,

              ),
            )).toList()),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          LoreTap(
            onTap: () => LoreColourPicker.show(
              context,
              current: _newTagColor,
              onPicked: (c) => setState(() => _newTagColor = c),

                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, fontSize: 13),

                  focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: _newTagColor)),
                  filled: true, fillColor: cInk,
                ),
                cursorColor: _newTagColor,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            LoreTap(
              onTap: () {
                final label = _newTagCtrl.text.trim();
                if (label.isEmpty) return;
                setState(() {
                  _CardState.tags.add(_TagData(label, _newTagColor));
                  _newTagCtrl.clear();
                });
              },
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
                color: cParchment,
                child: const Text('Add', style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                    color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 1))),

          _frameToggle('Ornate corners', _CardState.frameOrnate,

          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          _frameToggle('Dense details', _CardState.frameDense,

          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          _label('Foil'),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          const Text('A holo effect that follows your finger across the card.',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          _frameToggle('Shimmer', _CardState.foilEnabled,
              (v) => setState(() => _CardState.foilEnabled = v)),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Row(children: [
            const Text('Strength', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
                color: cMist, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
            Expanded(
              child: Slider(
                value: _CardState.foilIntensity.clamp(0.1, 1.0),
                min: 0.1, max: 1.0,
                activeColor: cGold,
                inactiveColor: cAsh,
                onChanged: _CardState.foilEnabled
                    ? (v) => setState(() => _CardState.foilIntensity = v)
                    : null,
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(width: 44, child: Text(
                '${(_CardState.foilIntensity * 100).round()}%',
                style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1))),
          ]),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _frameToggle(String label, bool value, ValueChanged<bool> onChanged) =>
      Row(children: [
        Expanded(child: Text(label, style: const TextStyle(
            fontSize: 13, color: cMist, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300))),
        Switch(
          value: value,
          onChanged: onChanged,
          activeThumbColor: cGold,
          inactiveTrackColor: cAsh,
          materialTapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
        ),
      ]);

  Widget _buildPreview() {
    final tagLabels = _CardState.tags.map((t) => t.label).toList();
    final genre = tagLabels.isNotEmpty ? tagLabels.first : 'Freeform';
    final ageRating = tagLabels.any((t) => t == '18+')
        ? '18+'
        : tagLabels.any((t) => t == '16+')
            ? '16+'
            : 'All ages';

    return Center(
      child: SizedBox(
        width: 260,
        child: RequestCardView(
          name: 'You',
          code: 'DEMO-A1B2',
          genre: genre,
          bio: _CardState.bio,
          writingStyle: _CardState.writingStyle,
          frequency: _CardState.frequency,
          ageRating: ageRating,
          isOpen: true,
          tags: tagLabels,
          accent: _CardState.accentColor,
          bgTint: _CardState.bgTint,
          frame: CardFrameSpec(
            seed: _CardState.frameSeed,
            accent: _CardState.accentColor,
            glow: _CardState.frameGlow,
            ornate: _CardState.frameOrnate,
            dense: _CardState.frameDense,
          ),
          foilEnabled: _CardState.foilEnabled,
          foilSeed: _CardState.frameSeed,
          foilIntensity: _CardState.foilIntensity,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _label(String t) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
    child: Text(t.toUpperCase(),
        style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
            fontSize: 9, color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3)),
  );
}

      ]),
    ),
  );
}

class _CornerBracketPainter extends CustomPainter {
  final Color color;
  final double pulse;
  final _CardBorderStyle style;
  _CornerBracketPainter({
    required this.color,
    required this.pulse,
    required this.style,
  });

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    const l = 14.0;
    final w = size.width;
    final h = size.height;

    final path = Path()
      ..moveTo(0, l)..lineTo(0, 0)..lineTo(l, 0)
      ..moveTo(w - l, 0)..lineTo(w, 0)..lineTo(w, l)
      ..moveTo(0, h - l)..lineTo(0, h)..lineTo(l, h)
      ..moveTo(w - l, h)..lineTo(w, h)..lineTo(w, h - l);

    double opacity;
    double strokeWidth;
    bool glow = false;
    double glowBlur = 0;

    switch (style) {
      case _CardBorderStyle.solid:
        opacity = 0.65 + pulse * 0.25;
        strokeWidth = 1.5;
        break;
      case _CardBorderStyle.thick:
        opacity = 0.85;
        strokeWidth = 3.0;
        break;
      case _CardBorderStyle.faded:
        opacity = 0.28 + pulse * 0.15;
        strokeWidth = 1.0;
        break;
      case _CardBorderStyle.glow:
        opacity = 0.85;
        strokeWidth = 1.8;
        glow = true;
        glowBlur = 6 + pulse * 4;
        break;
    }

    if (glow) {
      final glowPaint = Paint()
        ..color = color.withValues(alpha: opacity * 0.5)
        ..strokeWidth = strokeWidth * 2.5
        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
        ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
        ..maskFilter = MaskFilter.blur(BlurStyle.normal, glowBlur);
      canvas.drawPath(path, glowPaint);
    }

    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = color.withValues(alpha: opacity)
      ..strokeWidth = strokeWidth
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;
    canvas.drawPath(path, paint);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _CornerBracketPainter old) =>
      old.color != color || old.pulse != pulse || old.style != style;
}

class _ContinuePrefsSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<_RPData> roleplays;
  final VoidCallback onChanged;
  const _ContinuePrefsSheet({
    required this.roleplays,
    required this.onChanged,
  });
  @override
  State<_ContinuePrefsSheet> createState() => _ContinuePrefsSheetState();
}

class _ContinuePrefsSheetState extends State<_ContinuePrefsSheet> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final mode = appSettings.continueMode;
    return Container(
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        color: cInk,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(14)),
      ),
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 20, 24),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Center(child: Container(
              width: 32, height: 3,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: cAsh, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2)),
            )),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Row(children: [
              const Text('CONTINUE CARD', style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 11,
                  color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
              const Spacer(),
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                child: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 18, color: cSmoke),
              ),
            ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            const Text(
              'Choose what shows in the Continue card at the bottom of home. Long-press that card any time to reopen this.',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.5),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            _modeTile(
              AppSettings.continueModeCycle,
              'Rotate through all',
              'Remind me of every story I have going.',
              mode,
            ),
            _modeTile(
              AppSettings.continueModePinned,
              'Pin one story',
              'Always show the same session. Good for a main RP.',
              mode,
            ),
            _modeTile(
              AppSettings.continueModeCycleSelected,
              'Rotate through selected',
              'Only cycle between the sessions I pick below.',
              mode,
            ),
            if (mode == AppSettings.continueModeCycleSelected) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              const Text('SELECTED STORIES', style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                  color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3)),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              if (widget.roleplays.isEmpty)
                const Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                  child: Text('No stories to select yet.',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke,
                          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                )
              else
                ...widget.roleplays.map((rp) {
                  final selected =
                      appSettings.continueIds.contains(rp.id);
                  return GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () async {
                      final current =
                          List<String>.from(appSettings.continueIds);
                      if (selected) {
                        current.remove(rp.id);
                      } else {
                        current.add(rp.id);
                      }
                      await appSettings.setContinueIds(current);
                      widget.onChanged();
                      if (mounted) setState(() {});
                    },
                    behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                    child: Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        border: Border.all(
                            color: selected ? cGold : cAsh),
                        color: selected
                            ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.08)
                            : Colors.transparent,
                      ),
                      child: Row(children: [
                        Container(
                          width: 16, height: 16,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            border: Border.all(
                                color: selected ? cGold : cSmoke),
                            color: selected
                                ? cGold : Colors.transparent,
                          ),
                          child: selected
                              ? const Icon(Icons.check,
                                  size: 11, color: cVoid)
                              : null,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 12),
                        Expanded(child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment:
                              CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Text(rp.partner, style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 14,
                              color: selected ? cParchment : cMist,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                            const SizedBox(height: 2),
                            Text('${rp.genre} Â· ${rp.posts} posts',
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                  fontSize: 10,
                                  color: cSmoke,
                                  letterSpacing: 1)),
                          ],
                        )),
                      ]),
                    ),
                  );
                }),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                  color: cParchment,
                  child: const Center(child: Text('Done',
                      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                          fontSize: 10, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 2))),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _modeTile(
      String mode, String title, String subtitle, String current) {
    final active = mode == current;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () async {
        await appSettings.setContinueMode(mode);
        widget.onChanged();
        if (mounted) setState(() {});
      },
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          border: Border.all(color: active ? cGold : cAsh),
          color: active ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.06) : Colors.transparent,
        ),
        child: Row(children: [
          Container(
            width: 16, height: 16,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
              border: Border.all(color: active ? cGold : cSmoke),
              color: active ? cGold : Colors.transparent,
            ),
            child: active
                ? const Icon(Icons.check, size: 11, color: cVoid)
                : null,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 14),
          Expanded(child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(title, style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 14,
                  color: active ? cParchment : cMist,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
              const SizedBox(height: 3),
              Text(subtitle, style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.5)),
            ],
          )),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }
}


class _ContinueCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final _RPData? session;
  final String mode;
  final bool isLoading;
  final VoidCallback onOpen;
  final VoidCallback onLongPress;
  final VoidCallback onFindPartner;

  const _ContinueCard({
    required this.session,
    required this.mode,
    this.isLoading = false,
    required this.onOpen,
    required this.onLongPress,
    required this.onFindPartner,
  });

  String _modeLabel() {
    switch (mode) {
      case AppSettings.continueModePinned:
        return 'PINNED';
      case AppSettings.continueModeCycleSelected:
        return 'SELECTED';
      default:
        return 'ROTATING';
    }
  }

  IconData _modeIcon() {
    switch (mode) {
      case AppSettings.continueModePinned:
        return Icons.push_pin;
      case AppSettings.continueModeCycleSelected:
        return Icons.filter_alt;
      default:
        return Icons.autorenew;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final has = session != null;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 32),
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
      ),
      child: LoreTap(
        onTap: has
            ? onOpen
            : isLoading
                ? null
                : onFindPartner,
        onLongPress: has ? onLongPress : null,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 14, 20, 14),
          child: Row(children: [
            _leadingIcon(has),
            const SizedBox(width: 14),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  _topRow(has),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  _body(has),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            if (isLoading && !has)
              const SizedBox(
                width: 16, height: 16,
                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                    strokeWidth: 1.5, color: cSmoke),
              )
            else
              Icon(
                Icons.arrow_forward,
                size: 16,
                color: has ? cGold : cSmoke,
              ),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _leadingIcon(bool has) {
    if (isLoading && !has) {
      return const Icon(Icons.auto_stories_outlined,
          size: 18, color: cSmoke);
    }
    return Icon(
      has ? Icons.auto_stories_outlined : Icons.explore_outlined,
      size: 18,
      color: has ? cGold : cSmoke,
    );
  }

  Widget _topRow(bool has) {
    return Row(children: [
      Text(
        has
            ? 'CONTINUE'
            : isLoading
                ? 'LOADING'
                : 'NO STORIES IN PROGRESS',
        style: const TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
          color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3,
        ),
      ),
      if (has) ...[
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Icon(_modeIcon(), size: 11, color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.6)),
        const SizedBox(width: 4),
        Text(_modeLabel(),
            style: TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 8,
              color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
              letterSpacing: 1,
            )),
      ],
    ]);
  }

  Widget _body(bool has) {
    if (has) {
      return Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            'The story with ${session!.partner}',
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, color: cParchment,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 3),
          Text(
            '${session!.genre} Â· ${session!.posts} posts',
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
              color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      );
    }
    if (isLoading) {
      return const Text(
        'Fetching your storiesâ€¦',
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
        ),
      );
    }
    return const Text(
      'Find a partner to begin one',
      style: TextStyle(
        fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
        fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
      ),
    );
  }
}

// Single global instance
final appSettings = AppSettings();

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// BLOCK STYLE
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class BlockStyle {
  final Color? background;
  final Color? borderColor;
  final String borderStyle; // 'solid' | 'thick' | 'faded' | 'glow'
  final Color? accent;

  const BlockStyle({
    this.background,
    this.borderColor,
    this.borderStyle = 'solid',
    this.accent,
  });

  bool get isDefault =>
      background == null &&
      borderColor == null &&
      accent == null &&
      borderStyle == 'solid';

  BlockStyle copyWith({
    Color? background,
    Color? borderColor,
    String? borderStyle,
    Color? accent,
    bool clearBackground = false,
    bool clearBorderColor = false,
    bool clearAccent = false,
  }) =>
      BlockStyle(
        background: clearBackground ? null : (background ?? this.background),
        borderColor: clearBorderColor ? null : (borderColor ?? this.borderColor),
        borderStyle: borderStyle ?? this.borderStyle,
        accent: clearAccent ? null : (accent ?? this.accent),
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        if (background != null) 'bg': background!.toARGB32(),
        if (borderColor != null) 'bc': borderColor!.toARGB32(),
        'bs': borderStyle,
        if (accent != null) 'ac': accent!.toARGB32(),
      };

  factory BlockStyle.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) => BlockStyle(
        background: j['bg'] != null ? Color(j['bg'] as int) : null,
        borderColor: j['bc'] != null ? Color(j['bc'] as int) : null,
        borderStyle: j['bs'] as String? ?? 'solid',
        accent: j['ac'] != null ? Color(j['ac'] as int) : null,
      );
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// APP SETTINGS
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class AppSettings extends ChangeNotifier {
  static const _kCardBorder         = 'as_card_border';
  static const _kParchment          = 'as_parchment';
  static const _kTextSize           = 'as_text_size';
  static const _kOrientation        = 'as_orientation';
  static const _kSound              = 'as_sound';
  static const _kDefaultStyle       = 'as_default_style';
  static const _kTextColours        = 'as_text_colours_v2';
  static const _kTextColoursLegacy  = 'as_text_colours';
  static const _kGradient           = 'as_gradient';
  static const _kBorderColor        = 'as_border_color';
  static const _kBorderStyle        = 'as_border_style';
  static const _kAiMood             = 'as_ai_mood';
  static const _kNotifPost          = 'as_notif_post';
  static const _kNotifInterest      = 'as_notif_interest';
  static const _kNotifBrain         = 'as_notif_brain';
  static const _kAutoScroll         = 'as_auto_scroll';
  static const _kOocSide            = 'as_ooc_side';
  static const _kEnterToSend        = 'as_enter_to_send';
  static const _kDiscoverable       = 'as_discoverable';
  static const _kBgGlow             = 'as_bg_glow';
  static const _kProfileStatsMaster = 'as_profile_stats_master';
  static const _kProfileStatsMap    = 'as_profile_stats_map';
  static const _kContinueMode       = 'as_continue_mode';
  static const _kContinueIds        = 'as_continue_ids';
  static const _kContinueLastShown  = 'as_continue_last_shown';
  static const _kBlockStyles        = 'as_block_styles_v1';
  static const _kDevModeUnlocked    = 'as_dev_mode_unlocked';

  // â”€â”€ Stat keys â”€â”€
  static const statActiveRPs          = 'active_rps';
  static const statTotalPosts         = 'total_posts';
  static const statBrainstormRooms    = 'brainstorm_rooms';
  static const statWritingPartners    = 'writing_partners';
  static const statDaysActive         = 'days_active';
  static const statLastPost           = 'last_post';
  static const statWorldsCreated      = 'worlds_created';
  static const statCharactersCreated  = 'characters_created';

  static const List<String> statKeys = [
    statActiveRPs, statTotalPosts, statBrainstormRooms,
    statWritingPartners, statDaysActive, statLastPost,
    statWorldsCreated, statCharactersCreated,
  ];

  static const Map<String, String> statLabels = {
    statActiveRPs:         'Active Roleplays',
    statTotalPosts:        'Total Posts',
    statBrainstormRooms:   'Brainstorm Rooms',
    statWritingPartners:   'Writing Partners',
    statDaysActive:        'Days Active',
    statLastPost:          'Last Post',
    statWorldsCreated:     'Worlds Created',
    statCharactersCreated: 'Characters Created',
  };

  // â”€â”€ Block keys â”€â”€
  static const blockProfile        = 'profile';
  static const blockNotifications  = 'notifications';
  static const blockRoleplays      = 'roleplays';
  static const blockBrainstorms    = 'brainstorms';
  static const blockRequestCard    = 'request_card';
  static const blockSettings       = 'settings';

  static const List<String> blockKeys = [
    blockProfile, blockNotifications, blockRoleplays,
    blockBrainstorms, blockRequestCard, blockSettings,
  ];

  static const Map<String, String> blockLabels = {
    blockProfile:       'Profile Card',
    blockNotifications: 'Notifications',
    blockRoleplays:     'Roleplays',
    blockBrainstorms:   'Brainstorms',
    blockRequestCard:   'Request Card',
    blockSettings:      'Settings',
  };

  // â”€â”€ Text colour keys â”€â”€
  static const textKeyPostContent    = 'post_content';
  static const textKeyCharName       = 'char_name';
  static const textKeyLocationName   = 'location_name';
  static const textKeyOoc            = 'ooc';
  static const textKeyBrainstorm     = 'brainstorm';
  static const textKeyStripLabel     = 'strip_label';
  static const textKeyTimestamp      = 'timestamp';
  static const textKeyProfileName    = 'profile_name';
  static const textKeyProfileBio     = 'profile_bio';
  static const textKeyProfileCode    = 'profile_code';
  static const textKeySectionHeader  = 'section_header';
  static const textKeyButtonText     = 'button_text';
  static const textKeyPartnerName    = 'partner_name';

  static const Map<String, String> textKeyLabels = {
    textKeyPostContent:   'Post content',
    textKeyCharName:      'Character name',
    textKeyLocationName:  'Location name',
    textKeyOoc:           'OOC messages',
    textKeyBrainstorm:    'Brainstorm text',
    textKeyStripLabel:    'Strip labels',
    textKeyTimestamp:     'Timestamps',
    textKeyProfileName:   'Profile name',
    textKeyProfileBio:    'Profile bio',
    textKeyProfileCode:   'Profile code',
    textKeySectionHeader: 'Section headers',
    textKeyButtonText:    'Button text',
    textKeyPartnerName:   'Partner name',
  };

  /// Which text colour keys each block owns.
  static const Map<String, List<String>> blockTextKeys = {
    blockProfile: [
      textKeyProfileName, textKeyProfileBio, textKeyProfileCode,
    ],
    blockRoleplays: [
      textKeyPostContent, textKeyCharName, textKeyLocationName,
      textKeyTimestamp, textKeyPartnerName, textKeyOoc,
    ],
    blockBrainstorms: [textKeyBrainstorm],
    blockSettings: [
      textKeySectionHeader, textKeyStripLabel, textKeyButtonText,
    ],
    blockNotifications: [],
    blockRequestCard: [],
  };

  // â”€â”€ Continue band modes â”€â”€
  static const continueModePinned         = 'pinned';
  static const continueModeCycle          = 'cycle';
  static const continueModeCycleSelected  = 'cycle_selected';

  // â”€â”€ State â”€â”€
  bool   _cardBorderEffects = true;
  bool   _parchmentMode     = false;
  String _textSize          = 'Medium';
  String _orientation       = 'Both';
  bool   _soundEnabled      = true;
  Map<String, Color> _textColours = {};
  List<Color> _profileGradient = [const Color(0xFF080808), const Color(0xFF0E0E0E)];
  Color  _bgGlowColor          = const Color(0xFFC9A96E);
  Color  _profileBorderColor   = const Color(0xFF2a2a2a);
  String _profileBorderStyle   = 'solid';
  bool   _aiMood            = true;
  bool   _notifNewPost      = true;
  bool   _notifInterest     = true;
  bool   _autoScroll        = true;
  final String _defaultStyle      = 'Novella';
  String _oocSide           = 'Right';
  bool   _enterToSend       = false;
  bool   _discoverable      = true;

  bool _profileStatsMaster = true;
  Map<String, bool> _profileStats = {
    statActiveRPs:          true,
    statTotalPosts:         true,
    statBrainstormRooms:    true,
    statWritingPartners:    true,
    statDaysActive:         true,
    statLastPost:           true,
    statWorldsCreated:      false,
    statCharactersCreated:  false,
  };

  String  _continueMode      = continueModeCycle;
  List<String> _continueIds  = [];
  String? _continueLastShown;

  Map<String, BlockStyle> _blockStyles = {};

    bool _devModeUnlocked = false;

  final _auth = AuthService();
  Timer? _cloudDebounce;

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // LOAD (local only)
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  Future<void> load() async {
    final p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    _cardBorderEffects = p.getBool(_kCardBorder)    ?? true;
    _parchmentMode     = p.getBool(_kParchment)     ?? false;
    _textSize          = p.getString(_kTextSize)    ?? 'Medium';
    _orientation       = p.getString(_kOrientation) ?? 'Both';
    _soundEnabled      = p.getBool(_kSound)         ?? true;
    _aiMood            = p.getBool(_kAiMood)        ?? true;
    _notifNewPost      = p.getBool(_kNotifPost)     ?? true;
    _notifInterest     = p.getBool(_kNotifInterest) ?? true;
    _autoScroll        = p.getBool(_kAutoScroll)    ?? true;
    _oocSide           = p.getString(_kOocSide)     ?? 'Right';
    _enterToSend       = p.getBool(_kEnterToSend)   ?? false;
    _discoverable      = p.getBool(_kDiscoverable)  ?? true;
    _profileBorderStyle= p.getString(_kBorderStyle) ?? 'solid';
    _profileStatsMaster = p.getBool(_kProfileStatsMaster) ?? true;
    _continueMode      = p.getString(_kContinueMode) ?? continueModeCycle;
    _continueIds       = p.getStringList(_kContinueIds) ?? [];
    _continueLastShown = p.getString(_kContinueLastShown);
    _devModeUnlocked = p.getBool(_kDevModeUnlocked) ?? false;

    final bg = p.getInt(_kBgGlow);
    if (bg != null) _bgGlowColor = Color(bg);
    final bc = p.getInt(_kBorderColor);
    if (bc != null) _profileBorderColor = Color(bc);

    // Text colours â€” new format first, then legacy migration
    final tcNew = p.getString(_kTextColours);
    if (tcNew != null) {
      try {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(tcNew) as Map;
        _textColours = decoded.map((k, v) =>
            MapEntry(k as String, Color(v as int)));
      } catch (_) {}
    } else {
      final tcOld = p.getString(_kTextColoursLegacy);
      if (tcOld != null) {
        try {
          final list = jsonDecode(tcOld) as List;
          for (final e in list) {
            final m = Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map);
            final k = m['key'] as String?;
            final c = m['color'] as int?;
            if (k != null && c != null) _textColours[k] = Color(c);
          }
          // Persist in new format and drop the old key
          await p.setString(
              _kTextColours,
              jsonEncode(_textColours.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toARGB32()))));
          await p.remove(_kTextColoursLegacy);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    final gRaw = p.getString(_kGradient);
    if (gRaw != null) {
      try {
        final list = jsonDecode(gRaw) as List;
        _profileGradient = list.map((v) => Color(v as int)).toList();
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    final statsRaw = p.getString(_kProfileStatsMap);
    if (statsRaw != null) {
      try {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(statsRaw) as Map;
        final merged = Map<String, bool>.from(_profileStats);
        for (final k in statKeys) {
          if (decoded.containsKey(k) && decoded[k] is bool) {
            merged[k] = decoded[k] as bool;
          }
        }
        _profileStats = merged;
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    final bsRaw = p.getString(_kBlockStyles);
    if (bsRaw != null) {
      try {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(bsRaw) as Map;
        _blockStyles = decoded.map((k, v) => MapEntry(
            k as String,
            BlockStyle.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(v as Map))));
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    notifyListeners();
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // CLOUD SYNC
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  //
  // Call syncFromCloud() once after login / restore. Local changes are
  // debounced up to Firestore so a user dragging a colour slider doesn't
  // fire 60 writes.
  //
  // What syncs: appearance, text colours, block styles, continue prefs,
  // notification prefs, sound prefs. What doesn't: PIN / lock settings
  // (those are handled separately via the auth flow) and continueLastShown
  // (per-device rotation state â€” doesn't make sense to sync).

  /// Pull from Firestore. Cloud wins on first load. If cloud has nothing
  /// yet, push local up as the baseline.
  Future<void> syncFromCloud() async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    try {
      final doc = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('users')
          .doc(code)
          .get();
      final data = doc.data();
      if (data == null) return;

      final raw = data['preferences'] as String?;
      if (raw == null) {
        // Account has never synced. Reset to defaults first so a
        // previous user's settings on this device don't get pushed
        // into this account's cloud copy.
        await resetForSignOut();
        await _pushToCloudNow(code);
        return;
      }

      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw) as Map;
      _applyCloudJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded));
      await _saveAllToPrefs();
      notifyListeners();
    } catch (e) {
      print('[settings] syncFromCloud failed: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Force a push to Firestore immediately. Called on sign-out so pending
  /// changes aren't lost to the debounce window.
  Future<void> flushToCloud() async {
    _cloudDebounce?.cancel();
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    await _pushToCloudNow(code);
  }

  void _touch() {
    _cloudDebounce?.cancel();
    _cloudDebounce = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 2), () {
      final code = _auth.currentCode;
      if (code == null) return;
      _pushToCloudNow(code);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _pushToCloudNow(String code) async {
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(code).update({
        'preferences': jsonEncode(_serializeAll()),
        'enterToSend': _enterToSend,
        'preferencesUpdatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      print('[settings] cloud push failed: $e');
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> _serializeAll() => {
        'cardBorderEffects': _cardBorderEffects,
        'parchmentMode': _parchmentMode,
        'textSize': _textSize,
        'orientation': _orientation,
        'soundEnabled': _soundEnabled,
        'textColours':
            _textColours.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toARGB32())),
        'profileGradient': _profileGradient.map((c) => c.toARGB32()).toList(),
        'bgGlowColor': _bgGlowColor.toARGB32(),
        'profileBorderColor': _profileBorderColor.toARGB32(),
        'profileBorderStyle': _profileBorderStyle,
        'aiMood': _aiMood,
        'notifNewPost': _notifNewPost,
        'notifInterest': _notifInterest,
        'autoScroll': _autoScroll,
        'oocSide': _oocSide,
        'profileStatsMaster': _profileStatsMaster,
        'profileStats': _profileStats,
        'continueMode': _continueMode,
        'continueIds': _continueIds,
        'blockStyles':
            _blockStyles.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toJson())),
      };

  void _applyCloudJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) {
    _cardBorderEffects = j['cardBorderEffects'] as bool? ?? _cardBorderEffects;
    _parchmentMode     = j['parchmentMode'] as bool? ?? _parchmentMode;
    _textSize          = j['textSize'] as String? ?? _textSize;
    _orientation       = j['orientation'] as String? ?? _orientation;
    _soundEnabled      = j['soundEnabled'] as bool? ?? _soundEnabled;
    _profileBorderStyle= j['profileBorderStyle'] as String? ?? _profileBorderStyle;
    _aiMood            = j['aiMood'] as bool? ?? _aiMood;
    _notifNewPost      = j['notifNewPost'] as bool? ?? _notifNewPost;
    _notifInterest     = j['notifInterest'] as bool? ?? _notifInterest;
    _autoScroll        = j['autoScroll'] as bool? ?? _autoScroll;
    _oocSide           = j['oocSide'] as String? ?? _oocSide;
    _profileStatsMaster= j['profileStatsMaster'] as bool? ?? _profileStatsMaster;
    _continueMode      = j['continueMode'] as String? ?? _continueMode;
    _continueIds       = List<String>.from(j['continueIds'] ?? _continueIds);
    _enterToSend = j['enterToSend'] as bool? ?? _enterToSend;

    if (j['bgGlowColor'] is int) {
      _bgGlowColor = Color(j['bgGlowColor'] as int);
    }
    if (j['profileBorderColor'] is int) {
      _profileBorderColor = Color(j['profileBorderColor'] as int);
    }
    if (j['textColours'] is Map) {
      _textColours = (j['textColours'] as Map).map((k, v) =>
          MapEntry(k as String, Color(v as int)));
    }
    if (j['profileGradient'] is List) {
      _profileGradient = (j['profileGradient'] as List)
          .map((v) => Color(v as int))
          .toList();
    }
    if (j['profileStats'] is Map) {
      final merged = Map<String, bool>.from(_profileStats);
      (j['profileStats'] as Map).forEach((k, v) {
        if (v is bool) merged[k as String] = v;
      });
      _profileStats = merged;
    }
    if (j['blockStyles'] is Map) {
      _blockStyles = (j['blockStyles'] as Map).map((k, v) => MapEntry(
          k as String,
          BlockStyle.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(v as Map))));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveAllToPrefs() async {
    final p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await p.setBool(_kCardBorder, _cardBorderEffects);
    await p.setBool(_kParchment, _parchmentMode);
    await p.setString(_kTextSize, _textSize);
    await p.setString(_kOrientation, _orientation);
    await p.setBool(_kSound, _soundEnabled);
    await p.setString(_kBorderStyle, _profileBorderStyle);
    await p.setBool(_kAiMood, _aiMood);
    await p.setBool(_kNotifPost, _notifNewPost);
    await p.setBool(_kNotifInterest, _notifInterest);
    await p.setBool(_kAutoScroll, _autoScroll);
    await p.setString(_kOocSide, _oocSide);
    await p.setString(_kDefaultStyle, _defaultStyle);
    await p.setBool(_kProfileStatsMaster, _profileStatsMaster);
    await p.setString(_kContinueMode, _continueMode);
    await p.setStringList(_kContinueIds, _continueIds);
    await p.setInt(_kBgGlow, _bgGlowColor.toARGB32());
    await p.setInt(_kBorderColor, _profileBorderColor.toARGB32());
    await p.setString(_kTextColours,
        jsonEncode(_textColours.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toARGB32()))));
    await p.setString(_kGradient,
        jsonEncode(_profileGradient.map((c) => c.toARGB32()).toList()));
    await p.setString(_kProfileStatsMap, jsonEncode(_profileStats));
    await p.setString(_kBlockStyles,
        jsonEncode(_blockStyles.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toJson()))));
        await p.setBool(_kEnterToSend, _enterToSend);
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // GETTERS
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  bool   get cardBorderEffects => _cardBorderEffects;
  bool   get parchmentMode     => _parchmentMode;
  String get textSize          => _textSize;
  String get orientation       => _orientation;
  bool get devModeUnlocked => _devModeUnlocked;
  bool   get soundEnabled      => _soundEnabled;
  List<Color> get profileGradient => List.unmodifiable(_profileGradient);
  Color  get profileBorderColor   => _profileBorderColor;
  String get profileBorderStyle   => _profileBorderStyle;
  bool   get aiMood            => _aiMood;
  bool   get notifNewPost      => _notifNewPost;
  bool   get notifInterest     => _notifInterest;
  bool   get autoScroll        => _autoScroll;
  String get oocSide           => _oocSide;
  bool get enterToSend => _enterToSend;
  bool   get discoverable      => _discoverable;
  bool   get profileStatsMaster => _profileStatsMaster;
  Map<String, bool> get profileStats => Map.unmodifiable(_profileStats);
  String get continueMode      => _continueMode;
  List<String> get continueIds => List.unmodifiable(_continueIds);
  String? get continueLastShown => _continueLastShown;

  // Legacy API â€” kept for compatibility with the old Settings UI. Will be
  // removed when that UI is replaced by per-block long-press.
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get textColours => _textColours.entries
      .map((e) => {
            'key': e.key,
            'label': textKeyLabels[e.key] ?? e.key,
            'color': e.value.toARGB32(),
          })
      .toList();

  Color? textColourFor(String key) => _textColours[key];

  /// The text colour keys owned by a block, for the long-press sheet.
  List<String> textKeysForBlock(String blockKey) =>
      blockTextKeys[blockKey] ?? const [];

  /// True if the block has any colours currently set.
  bool blockHasCustomText(String blockKey) =>
      textKeysForBlock(blockKey).any((k) => _textColours.containsKey(k));

  // â”€â”€ Block styles â”€â”€
  BlockStyle styleForBlock(String blockKey) =>
      _blockStyles[blockKey] ?? const BlockStyle();

  Map<String, BlockStyle> get blockStyles =>
      Map.unmodifiable(_blockStyles);

  bool isStatVisible(String key) {
    if (!_profileStatsMaster) return false;
    return _profileStats[key] ?? false;
  }

  List<String> get visibleStatKeys =>
      statKeys.where(isStatVisible).toList();

  double get baseFontSize {
    switch (_textSize) {
      case 'Small': return 12.0;
      case 'Large': return 17.0;
      default:      return 14.0;
    }
  }

  Color get bgColor => _parchmentMode
      ? const Color(0xFF1a1814) : const Color(0xFF080808);

  Color get surfaceColor => _parchmentMode
      ? const Color(0xFF221e1a) : const Color(0xFF0E0E0E);

  Color get bgGlowColor => _bgGlowColor;

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // SETTERS

  Future<void> setCardBorderEffects(bool v) async {

    (await SharedPreferences.getInstance()).setBool(_kParchment, v);

      statusBarIconBrightness: v ? Brightness.dark : Brightness.light));

  Future<void> setOrientation(String v) async {
    _orientation = v;
    (await SharedPreferences.getInstance()).setString(_kOrientation, v);
    switch (v) {
      case 'Portrait':
        SystemChrome.setPreferredOrientations(
            [DeviceOrientation.portraitUp, DeviceOrientation.portraitDown]);
        break;
      case 'Landscape':
        SystemChrome.setPreferredOrientations(
            [DeviceOrientation.landscapeLeft, DeviceOrientation.landscapeRight]);
        break;
      default:
        SystemChrome.setPreferredOrientations(DeviceOrientation.values);
    }
    _touch();
    notifyListeners();
  }

    _touch();

    _discoverable = v;
    (await SharedPreferences.getInstance()).setBool(_kDiscoverable, v);
    // Note: also written to users/{code}.isDiscoverable via FirestoreService.
    // Deliberately NOT synced through preferences to avoid two sources of truth.
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setProfileStatsMaster(bool v) async {
    _profileStatsMaster = v;
    (await SharedPreferences.getInstance()).setBool(_kProfileStatsMaster, v);
    _touch();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setProfileStatVisible(String key, bool v) async {
    if (!statKeys.contains(key)) return;
    _profileStats[key] = v;
    (await SharedPreferences.getInstance())
        .setString(_kProfileStatsMap, jsonEncode(_profileStats));
    _touch();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setContinueMode(String v) async {
    if (v != continueModePinned &&
        v != continueModeCycle &&
        v != continueModeCycleSelected) {
      return;
    }
    _continueMode = v;
    (await SharedPreferences.getInstance()).setString(_kContinueMode, v);
    _touch();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setContinueIds(List<String> ids) async {
    _continueIds = List.from(ids);
    (await SharedPreferences.getInstance())
        .setStringList(_kContinueIds, _continueIds);
    _touch();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setContinueLastShown(String? id) async {
    _continueLastShown = id;
    final p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (id == null) {
      await p.remove(_kContinueLastShown);
    } else {
      await p.setString(_kContinueLastShown, id);
    }
    // No _touch() â€” per-device bookkeeping, doesn't sync.
  }

  // â”€â”€ Text colour setters â”€â”€

  Future<void> setTextColour(String key, Color? colour) async {
    if (colour == null) {
      _textColours.remove(key);
    } else {
      _textColours[key] = colour;
    }
    (await SharedPreferences.getInstance()).setString(
        _kTextColours,
        jsonEncode(_textColours.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toARGB32()))));
    _touch();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Legacy â€” the old flat-list setter. Kept so the old Settings UI keeps
  /// building until we remove it.
  Future<void> setTextColours(List<Map<String, dynamic>> v) async {
    _textColours.clear();
    for (final e in v) {
      final k = e['key'] as String?;
      final c = e['color'] as int?;
      if (k != null && c != null) _textColours[k] = Color(c);
    }
    (await SharedPreferences.getInstance()).setString(
        _kTextColours,
        jsonEncode(_textColours.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toARGB32()))));
    _touch();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Resets every in-memory setting to its default and writes those
  /// defaults to SharedPreferences. Called on sign-out so the next
  /// account doesn't inherit the last one's appearance.
  Future<void> resetForSignOut() async {
    _cardBorderEffects = true;
    _parchmentMode     = false;
    _textSize          = 'Medium';
    _orientation       = 'Both';
    _soundEnabled      = true;
    _aiMood            = true;
    _notifNewPost      = true;
    _notifInterest     = true;
    _autoScroll        = true;
    _oocSide           = 'Right';
    _discoverable      = true;
    _profileBorderStyle = 'solid';
    _profileStatsMaster = true;
    _continueMode      = continueModeCycle;
    _continueIds       = [];
    _continueLastShown = null;
    _bgGlowColor       = const Color(0xFFC9A96E);
    _profileBorderColor = const Color(0xFF2a2a2a);
    _profileGradient   = [const Color(0xFF080808), const Color(0xFF0E0E0E)];
    _textColours       = {};
    _blockStyles       = {};
    _profileStats = {
      statActiveRPs:          true,
      statTotalPosts:         true,
      statBrainstormRooms:    true,
      statWritingPartners:    true,
      statDaysActive:         true,
      statLastPost:           true,
      statWorldsCreated:      false,
      statCharactersCreated:  false,
    };

    final p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await p.remove(_kCardBorder);
    await p.remove(_kParchment);
    await p.remove(_kTextSize);
    await p.remove(_kOrientation);
    await p.remove(_kSound);
    await p.remove(_kTextColours);
    await p.remove(_kTextColoursLegacy);
    await p.remove(_kGradient);
    await p.remove(_kBorderColor);
    await p.remove(_kBorderStyle);
    await p.remove(_kAiMood);
    await p.remove(_kNotifPost);
    await p.remove(_kNotifInterest);
    await p.remove(_kNotifBrain);
    await p.remove(_kAutoScroll);
    await p.remove(_kOocSide);
    await p.remove(_kDiscoverable);
    await p.remove(_kBgGlow);
    await p.remove(_kProfileStatsMaster);
    await p.remove(_kProfileStatsMap);
    await p.remove(_kContinueMode);
    await p.remove(_kContinueIds);
    await p.remove(_kContinueLastShown);
    await p.remove(_kBlockStyles);
    await p.remove(_kEnterToSend);

    // Cancel any in-flight debounce so a stale push doesn't fire after
    // the next user is signed in.
    _cloudDebounce?.cancel();

    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setDevModeUnlocked(bool v) async {
    _devModeUnlocked = v;
    (await SharedPreferences.getInstance()).setBool(_kDevModeUnlocked, v);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  // â”€â”€ Block style setters â”€â”€

  Future<void> setBlockStyle(String blockKey, BlockStyle style) async {
    if (style.isDefault) {
      _blockStyles.remove(blockKey);
    } else {
      _blockStyles[blockKey] = style;
    }
    (await SharedPreferences.getInstance()).setString(
        _kBlockStyles,
        jsonEncode(_blockStyles.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toJson()))));
    _touch();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Full reset â€” tile appearance and all text colours owned by the block.
  Future<void> resetBlock(String blockKey) async {
    _blockStyles.remove(blockKey);
    for (final key in textKeysForBlock(blockKey)) {
      _textColours.remove(key);
    }
    final p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await p.setString(_kBlockStyles,
        jsonEncode(_blockStyles.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toJson()))));
    await p.setString(_kTextColours,
        jsonEncode(_textColours.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toARGB32()))));
    _touch();
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// SANDBOX STORAGE  (shared_preferences)
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
class SandboxStorage {
  static const _worldsKey = 'sandbox_worlds';
  static const _charsKey  = 'sandbox_characters';

  static Future<List<WorldEntry>> loadWorlds() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString(_worldsKey);
    if (raw == null) return [];
    try {
      final list = jsonDecode(raw) as List;
      return list.map((e) => WorldEntry.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList();
    } catch (_) { return []; }
  }

  static Future<void> saveWorlds(List<WorldEntry> worlds) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(_worldsKey, jsonEncode(worlds.map((w) => w.toJson()).toList()));
  }

  static Future<List<CharacterEntry>> loadCharacters() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString(_charsKey);
    if (raw == null) return [];
    try {
      final list = jsonDecode(raw) as List;
      return list.map((e) => CharacterEntry.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList();
    } catch (_) { return []; }
  }

    static Future<void> saveCharacters(List<CharacterEntry> chars) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(_charsKey, jsonEncode(chars.map((c) => c.toJson()).toList()));
  }

  /// Wipes the local sandbox. Called on sign-out so the next account
  /// on this device starts empty. Cloud has the backup.
  static Future<void> clear() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(_worldsKey);
    await prefs.remove(_charsKey);
  }
}

// â”€â”€ WORLD â”€â”€
class WorldEntry {
  final String id;
  String name;
  String genre;
  String overview;
  String tone;
  final List<WorldLocation> locations;
  final List<WorldFaction> factions;
  String history;
  String rules; // laws of physics, magic system, etc.
  String notes;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  bool isDraft;

  WorldEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    this.genre = '',
    this.overview = '',
    this.tone = '',
    List<WorldLocation>? locations,
    List<WorldFaction>? factions,
    this.history = '',
    this.rules = '',
    this.notes = '',
    DateTime? createdAt,
    this.isDraft = true,
  })  : locations = locations ?? [],
        factions = factions ?? [],
        createdAt = createdAt ?? DateTime.now();

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'id': id, 'name': name, 'genre': genre, 'overview': overview,
    'tone': tone, 'history': history, 'rules': rules, 'notes': notes,
    'isDraft': isDraft,
    'createdAt': createdAt.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
    'locations': locations.map((l) => {'name': l.name, 'description': l.description}).toList(),
    'factions': factions.map((f) => {'name': f.name, 'description': f.description}).toList(),
  };

  factory WorldEntry.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) => WorldEntry(
    id: j['id'] as String,
    name: j['name'] as String? ?? '',
    genre: j['genre'] as String? ?? '',
    overview: j['overview'] as String? ?? '',
    tone: j['tone'] as String? ?? '',
    history: j['history'] as String? ?? '',
    rules: j['rules'] as String? ?? '',
    notes: j['notes'] as String? ?? '',
    isDraft: j['isDraft'] as bool? ?? true,
    createdAt: j['createdAt'] != null ? DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(j['createdAt'] as int) : null,
    locations: (j['locations'] as List? ?? []).map((l) => WorldLocation(name: l['name'] as String? ?? '', description: l['description'] as String? ?? '')).toList(),
    factions: (j['factions'] as List? ?? []).map((f) => WorldFaction(name: f['name'] as String? ?? '', description: f['description'] as String? ?? '')).toList(),
  );
}

class WorldLocation {
  String name;
  String description;
  WorldLocation({required this.name, this.description = ''});
}

class WorldFaction {
  String name;
  String description;
  WorldFaction({required this.name, this.description = ''});
}

// â”€â”€ CHARACTER â”€â”€
enum CharacterType { playerCharacter, npc }

class CharacterEntry {
  final String id;
  String name;
  String pronouns;
  String age;
  String appearance;
  String personality;
  String backstory;
  String relationships;
  String notes;
  CharacterType type;
  String? linkedWorldId;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  Color accentColor;

  CharacterEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    this.pronouns = '',
    this.age = '',
    this.appearance = '',
    this.personality = '',
    this.backstory = '',
    this.relationships = '',
    this.notes = '',
    this.type = CharacterType.playerCharacter,
    this.linkedWorldId,
    DateTime? createdAt,
    Color? accentColor,
  })  : createdAt = createdAt ?? DateTime.now(),
        accentColor = accentColor ?? const Color(0xFFC9A96E);

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'id': id, 'name': name, 'pronouns': pronouns, 'age': age,
    'appearance': appearance, 'personality': personality,
    'backstory': backstory, 'relationships': relationships, 'notes': notes,
    'type': type.index,
    'linkedWorldId': linkedWorldId,
    'createdAt': createdAt.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
    'accentColor': accentColor.toARGB32(),
  };

  factory CharacterEntry.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) => CharacterEntry(
    id: j['id'] as String,
    name: j['name'] as String? ?? '',
    pronouns: j['pronouns'] as String? ?? '',
    age: j['age'] as String? ?? '',
    appearance: j['appearance'] as String? ?? '',
    personality: j['personality'] as String? ?? '',
    backstory: j['backstory'] as String? ?? '',
    relationships: j['relationships'] as String? ?? '',
    notes: j['notes'] as String? ?? '',
    type: CharacterType.values[j['type'] as int? ?? 0],
    linkedWorldId: j['linkedWorldId'] as String?,
    createdAt: j['createdAt'] != null
        ? DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(j['createdAt'] as int) : null,
    accentColor: j['accentColor'] != null ? Color(j['accentColor'] as int) : null,
  );
}

// â”€â”€ STAT BLOCK â”€â”€
enum StatBarStyle { stripe, cuts, blocks }

class StatBlock {
  String name; // e.g. "D&D Style" or "Custom"
  final List<StatEntry> stats;
  /// true â†’ classic tile grid (D&D). false â†’ horizontal bar stack.
  final bool useTiles;
  StatBlock({
    required this.name,
    List<StatEntry>? stats,
    this.useTiles = false,
  }) : stats = stats ?? [];

  /// The largest ceiling across all stats. Pools use their maxValue,
  /// plain stats use their value. Bars are scaled against this.
  int get maxDisplayValue {
    if (stats.isEmpty) return 1;
    int m = 1;
    for (final s in stats) {
      final v = s.isPool ? (s.maxValue > s.value ? s.maxValue : s.value) : s.value;
      if (v > m) m = v;
    }
    return m;
  }

  static StatBlock dndPreset() => StatBlock(
    name: 'D&D Style',
    useTiles: true,
    stats: [
      StatEntry(name: 'Strength',     value: 10),
      StatEntry(name: 'Dexterity',    value: 10),
      StatEntry(name: 'Constitution', value: 10),
      StatEntry(name: 'Intelligence', value: 10),
      StatEntry(name: 'Wisdom',       value: 10),
      StatEntry(name: 'Charisma',     value: 10),
      StatEntry(name: 'HP',           value: 20, isPool: true, maxValue: 20),
      StatEntry(name: 'AC',           value: 10),
    ],
  );

  static StatBlock customPreset() => StatBlock(
    name: 'Custom',
    useTiles: false,
    stats: [
      StatEntry(name: 'Health',  value: 1000, isPool: true, maxValue: 1000,
          barColor: const Color(0xFFD4614A)),
      StatEntry(name: 'Stamina', value: 200,  isPool: true, maxValue: 200,
          barColor: const Color(0xFF7AB8D4)),
      StatEntry(name: 'Hunger',  value: 50,   isPool: true, maxValue: 50,
          barColor: const Color(0xFFC9A96E)),
      StatEntry(name: 'Thirst',  value: 50,   isPool: true, maxValue: 50,
          barColor: const Color(0xFF7BAF7B)),
    ],
  );
}

class StatEntry {
  String name;
  int value;
  bool isPool; // shows current/max
  int maxValue;

  // â”€â”€ Bar appearance (custom blocks only) â”€â”€
  Color barColor;
  StatBarStyle barStyle;
  int segments;

  StatEntry({
    required this.name,
    required this.value,
    this.isPool = false,
    this.maxValue = 0,
    Color? barColor,
    this.barStyle = StatBarStyle.stripe,
    this.segments = 10,
  })  : barColor = barColor ?? const Color(0xFFC9A96E);

  int get modifier => ((value - 10) / 2).floor(); // D&D style modifier

  /// The ceiling used for scaling the bar. Pools use maxValue; plain
  /// stats use their current value.
  int get ceiling => isPool ? (maxValue > value ? maxValue : value) : value;
}

// â”€â”€ DICE â”€â”€
enum DiceType { d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20, d100 }

extension DiceTypeExt on DiceType {
  int get sides {
    switch (this) {
      case DiceType.d4:   return 4;
      case DiceType.d6:   return 6;
      case DiceType.d8:   return 8;
      case DiceType.d10:  return 10;
      case DiceType.d12:  return 12;
      case DiceType.d20:  return 20;
      case DiceType.d100: return 100;
    }
  }
  String get label {
    switch (this) {
      case DiceType.d4:   return 'd4';
      case DiceType.d6:   return 'd6';
      case DiceType.d8:   return 'd8';
      case DiceType.d10:  return 'd10';
      case DiceType.d12:  return 'd12';
      case DiceType.d20:  return 'd20';
      case DiceType.d100: return 'd100';
    }
  }
}

  RPNote({

    DateTime? createdAt,
