import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import 'package:local_auth/local_auth.dart';
import 'gestures_screen.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show kIsWeb;

// â”€â”€ Entry point â”€â”€
Future<bool> showLockScreen(BuildContext context) async {
  final result = await Navigator.of(context).push<bool>(
    PageRouteBuilder(
      opaque: true,
      pageBuilder: (_, _, _) => const LockScreen(),
      transitionsBuilder: (_, anim, _, child) =>
          FadeTransition(opacity: anim, child: child),
      transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
    ),
  );
  return result ?? false;
}

class LockScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LockScreen({super.key});
  @override State<LockScreen> createState() => _LockScreenState();
}

class _LockScreenState extends State<LockScreen> {
  final _localAuth = LocalAuthentication();
  bool _biometricsAvailable = false;
  final _auth = AuthService();
  String _mode = 'pin'; // 'pin' | 'code'
  String _pinInput = '';
  int _pinLength = AuthService.pinMinLength;
  bool _loading = true;
  bool _verifying = false;
  String? _error;
  final _codeCtrl = TextEditingController();
  bool _codeLoading = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _init();
  }

  Future<void> _init() async {
    final pinLen = await _auth.pinLength();
    
    // Check if biometrics are enabled and available
    final bioEnabled = await _auth.isBiometricsEnabled();
    if (bioEnabled) {
      try {
        final canCheck = await _localAuth.canCheckBiometrics;
        final isSupported = await _localAuth.isDeviceSupported();
        if (canCheck && isSupported && !kIsWeb) {
          if (mounted) setState(() => _biometricsAvailable = true);
          _promptBiometrics(); // Auto-trigger
        }
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('Biometrics init error: $e');
      }
    }

    if (mounted) {
      setState(() { _pinLength = pinLen; _loading = false; });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _promptBiometrics() async {
    if (_verifying) return;
    setState(() => _verifying = true);
    try {
      final authenticated = await _localAuth.authenticate(
        localizedReason: 'Unlock your stories',
        options: const AuthenticationOptions(
          stickyAuth: true,
          biometricOnly: true,
        ),
      );
      
      if (authenticated) {
        final success = await _auth.silentUnlock();
        if (success && mounted) {
          Navigator.of(context).pop(true);
        } else {
          if (mounted) {
            setState(() {
              _verifying = false;
              _error = 'Biometric unlock failed. Please use your PIN.';
            });
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _verifying = false);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _verifying = false;
          _error = 'Biometric error. Please use your PIN.';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _onDigit(String digit) {
    if (_pinInput.length >= _pinLength) return;
    setState(() { _pinInput += digit; _error = null; });
    if (_pinInput.length == _pinLength) _verifyPin();
  }

  void _onDelete() {
    if (_pinInput.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() => _pinInput = _pinInput.substring(0, _pinInput.length - 1));
  }

  Future<void> _verifyPin() async {
    setState(() => _verifying = true);

    bool ok = await _auth.verifyPin(_pinInput);
    if (!ok) {
      final code = _auth.currentCode;
      if (code != null) {
        final remote = await _auth.verifyPinRemote(code, _pinInput);
        ok = remote.success;
      }
    }

    if (ok && mounted) {
      await _auth.clearLockScreenAttempts();
      await _auth.unlockWithPin(_pinInput);
      if (mounted) Navigator.of(context).pop(true);
    } else if (mounted) {
      await _auth.recordFailedLockScreenAttempt();
      HapticFeedback.heavyImpact();
      setState(() {
        _pinInput = '';
        _verifying = false;
        _error = 'Incorrect PIN. Try again.';
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _verifyCode() async {
    final code = _codeCtrl.text.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (code.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() { _codeLoading = true; _error = null; });
    final result = await _auth.login(code);
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (result.success) {
      Navigator.of(context).pop(true);
    } else {
      setState(() {
        _codeLoading = false;
        _error = result.isDeviceLocked
            ? 'This account is locked to another device.'
            : 'Code not found.';
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _codeCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_loading) {
      return const Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: cVoid,
        body: Center(child: SizedBox(width: 20, height: 20,
            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 1, color: cGold))),
      );
    }
    
    return Focus(
      autofocus: true,
      onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
        // Only listen if we are on the PIN screen (not the unique code screen)
        if (_mode != 'pin' || _verifying) return KeyEventResult.ignored;

        if (event is KeyDownEvent) {
          final key = event.logicalKey;
          if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.backspace) {
            _onDelete();
            return KeyEventResult.handled;
          }
          final numString = event.character;
          if (numString != null && RegExp(r'^[0-9]$').hasMatch(numString)) {
            _onDigit(numString);
            return KeyEventResult.handled;
          }
        }
        return KeyEventResult.ignored;
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: cVoid,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 32),
            child: Column(children: [
              const Spacer(),
              const Text('L o r e', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
                  color: cGold, letterSpacing: 6, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
              const SizedBox(height: 48),
              if (_mode == 'pin') _buildPinPrompt() else _buildCodePrompt(),
              const Spacer(),
              if (_mode == 'pin') ...[
                GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => setState(() { _mode = 'code'; _error = null; }),
                  child: const Text('Forgot PIN â€” use unique code',
                      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                          color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
              ],
              if (_mode == 'code') ...[
                GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => setState(() {
                    _mode = 'pin'; _error = null; _codeCtrl.clear();
                  }),
                  child: const Text('â† Back to PIN',
                      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                          color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 32),
            ]),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPinPrompt() {
    return Column(children: [
      Text('Enter your $_pinLength-digit PIN',
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: cMist,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      const SizedBox(height: 32),
      Row(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: List.generate(_pinLength, (i) => Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
          width: 14, height: 14,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            shape: BoxShape.circle,
            color: i < _pinInput.length ? cGold : Colors.transparent,
            border: Border.all(color: i < _pinInput.length ? cGold : cAsh),
          ),
        )),
      ),
      if (_biometricsAvailable) ...[
        const SizedBox(height: 24),
        GestureDetector(
          onTap: _promptBiometrics,
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
              border: Border.all(color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
            ),
            child: const Icon(Icons.fingerprint, size: 32, color: cGold),
          ),
        ),
      ],
      if (_error != null) ...[
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Text(_error!, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
            color: cEmber, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      ],
      const SizedBox(height: 40),
      _buildNumpad(),
    ]);
  }

  Widget _buildCodePrompt() {
    return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      const Text('Enter your unique code',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: cMist,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      const Text('Use this if you\'ve forgotten your PIN.',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      const SizedBox(height: 24),
      TextField(
        controller: _codeCtrl,
        textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.characters,
        style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
            fontSize: 18, color: cParchment, letterSpacing: 4),
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          filled: true, fillColor: cInk,
          hintText: 'LR-XXXX-XXXX',
          hintStyle: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
              fontSize: 14, color: cAsh, letterSpacing: 2),
          contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
          border: const OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero,
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
          focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero,
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.6))),
        ),
      ),
      if (_error != null) ...[
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Text(_error!, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
            color: cEmber, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      ],
      const SizedBox(height: 16),
      GestureDetector(
        onTap: _codeLoading ? null : _verifyCode,
        child: Container(
          width: double.infinity,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
          color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
          child: Center(child: _codeLoading
              ? const SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 1.5, color: cGold))
              : const Text('Unlock', style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  fontSize: 10, color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3))),
        ),
      ),
    ]);
  }

  Widget _buildNumpad() => _verifying
      ? const Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 48),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              SizedBox(
                width: 22, height: 22,
                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                    strokeWidth: 1.5, color: cGold),
              ),
              SizedBox(height: 16),
              Text('Unlocking...',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 10,
                      color: cSmoke,
                      letterSpacing: 3)),
            ],
          ),
        )
      : _Numpad(
          onDigit: _onDigit,
          onDelete: _onDelete,
        );
}

/// Shared numpad with press feedback. Highlights the tapped key for
/// ~120ms and fires a light haptic tap.
class _Numpad extends StatefulWidget {
  final void Function(String) onDigit;
  final VoidCallback onDelete;
  const _Numpad({required this.onDigit, required this.onDelete});

  @override
  State<_Numpad> createState() => _NumpadState();
}

class _NumpadState extends State<_Numpad> {
  String? _pressed;

  void _tap(String d) {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    if (d == 'âŒ«') {
      widget.onDelete();
    } else {
      widget.onDigit(d);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _flash(String d) async {
    setState(() => _pressed = d);
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 120));
    if (mounted) setState(() => _pressed = null);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const rows = [['1','2','3'],['4','5','6'],['7','8','9'],['','0','âŒ«']];
    return Column(children: rows.map((row) => Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      child: Row(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: row.map((d) {
          if (d.isEmpty) return const SizedBox(width: 92, height: 72);
          final isPressed = _pressed == d;
          return GestureDetector(
            onTapDown: (_) => setState(() => _pressed = d),
            onTapUp: (_) {
              _flash(d);
              _tap(d);
            },
            onTapCancel: () => setState(() => _pressed = null),
            child: AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 90),
              width: 72, height: 72,
              margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                color: isPressed
                    ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.15) : cInk,
                border: Border.all(
                  color: isPressed ? cGold : cAsh,
                  width: isPressed ? 1.5 : 1,
                ),
              ),
              child: Center(child: d == 'âŒ«'
                  ? Icon(Icons.backspace_outlined, size: 20,
                      color: isPressed ? cGold : cSmoke)
                  : Text(d, style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 22,
                      color: isPressed ? cGold : cParchment,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w300))),
            ),
          );
        }).toList()),
    )).toList());
  }
}


// â”€â”€ Lock Setup Screen â”€â”€
class LockSetupScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool isFirstTime;
  const LockSetupScreen({super.key, this.isFirstTime = false});
  @override State<LockSetupScreen> createState() => _LockSetupScreenState();
}

class _LockSetupScreenState extends State<LockSetupScreen> {
  final _auth = AuthService();
  final LocalAuthentication _localAuth = LocalAuthentication();
  bool _bioEnabled = false;
  bool _bioAvailable = false;

  int _step = 1;
  final int _pinLength = AuthService.pinMinLength;
  String _pinFirst = '';
  String _pinInput = '';
  String? _error;
  bool _savingPin = false;

  String _currentTiming = 'always';
  bool _loadingCurrent = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.isFirstTime) {
      _loadingCurrent = false;
    } else {
      _loadCurrent();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadCurrent() async {
    final timing = await _auth.getLockTiming();
    
    final bioEnabled = await _auth.isBiometricsEnabled();
    bool bioAvailable = false;
    try {
      bioAvailable = await _localAuth.canCheckBiometrics && await _localAuth.isDeviceSupported();
    } catch (_) {}

    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _currentTiming = timing;
        _bioEnabled = bioEnabled;
        _bioAvailable = bioAvailable;
        _loadingCurrent = false;
        _step = 0;
      });
    }
  }

  void _onDigit(String digit) {
    if (_savingPin) return;
    if (_pinInput.length >= _pinLength) return;
    setState(() { _pinInput += digit; _error = null; });
    if (_pinInput.length == _pinLength) {
      Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 150), _onPinComplete);
    }
  }

  void _onDelete() {
    if (_savingPin) return;
    if (_pinInput.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() => _pinInput = _pinInput.substring(0, _pinInput.length - 1));
  }

  void _onPinComplete() {
    if (_step == 1) {
      setState(() { _pinFirst = _pinInput; _pinInput = ''; _step = 2; });
    } else if (_step == 2) {
      if (_pinInput == _pinFirst) {
        _savePin();
      } else {
        setState(() {
          _pinInput = '';
          _error = 'PINs don\'t match. Try again.';
          _step = 1;
          _pinFirst = '';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _savePin() async {
    setState(() { _savingPin = true; _error = null; });
    try {
      await _auth.savePin(_pinFirst);
      await _auth.unlockWithPin(_pinFirst);
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (widget.isFirstTime) {
        setState(() { _step = 4; _pinInput = ''; _savingPin = false; });
      } else {
        setState(() {
          _step = 0; _pinInput = ''; _pinFirst = ''; _savingPin = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _savingPin = false;
        _pinInput = '';
        _pinFirst = '';
        _step = 1;
        _error = 'Could not save PIN. ${e.toString().replaceFirst('Invalid argument(s): ', '')}';
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveTimingOnly(String timing) async {
    await _auth.saveLockTiming(timing);
    if (mounted) setState(() { _currentTiming = timing; _step = 0; });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Focus(
      autofocus: true,
      onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
        // Only listen when we are actually entering a PIN (step 1 or 2)
        if (_step != 1 && _step != 2) return KeyEventResult.ignored;
        if (_savingPin) return KeyEventResult.ignored;

        if (event is KeyDownEvent) {
          final key = event.logicalKey;
          if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.backspace) {
            _onDelete();
            return KeyEventResult.handled;
          }
          final numString = event.character;
          if (numString != null && RegExp(r'^[0-9]$').hasMatch(numString)) {
            _onDigit(numString);
            return KeyEventResult.handled;
          }
        }
        return KeyEventResult.ignored;
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: cVoid,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: _loadingCurrent
              ? const Center(child: SizedBox(width: 20, height: 20,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 1, color: cGold)))
              : Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),
              child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
                if (widget.isFirstTime) ...[
                  const Text('SECURE YOUR ACCOUNT', style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                      color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    _step == 1
                        ? 'Choose a $_pinLength-digit PIN. You\'ll need this to recover your account.'
                        : _step == 2
                            ? 'Enter your PIN again to confirm.'
                            : '',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
                        fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 40),
                ] else ...[
                  Row(children: [
                    GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () {
                        if (_step == 0) {
                          Navigator.of(context).pop();
                        } else {
                          setState(() {
                            _step = 0;
                            _pinInput = '';
                            _pinFirst = '';
                            _error = null;
                          });
                        }
                      },
                      child: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios, color: cSmoke, size: 16),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    const Text('SECURITY SETTINGS', style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                        color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 40),
                ],
                Expanded(child: _buildStep()),
              ]),
            ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStep() {
    switch (_step) {
      case 0:  return _buildOverview();
      case 1:  return _buildPinEntry(isConfirm: false);
      case 2:  return _buildPinEntry(isConfirm: true);
      case 4:  return _buildDone();
      case 12: return _buildTimingEdit();
      default: return const SizedBox();
    }
  }

  Widget _buildOverview() {
    return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      const Text('PIN', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
          color: cSmoke, fontFamily: 'monospace', letterSpacing: 3)),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      GestureDetector(
        onTap: () => setState(() {
          _step = 1; _pinInput = ''; _pinFirst = ''; _error = null;
        }),
        child: Container(
          width: double.infinity,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
          child: Row(children: [
            const Text('Change PIN', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15,
                color: cParchment, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
            const Spacer(),
            const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, size: 16, color: cAsh),
          ]),
        ),
      ),

      if (_bioAvailable && !kIsWeb) ...[
        const SizedBox(height: 24),
        const Text('BIOMETRICS', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
            color: cSmoke, fontFamily: 'monospace', letterSpacing: 3)),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        GestureDetector(
          onTap: () async {
            try {
              final success = await _localAuth.authenticate(
                localizedReason: 'Confirm to enable biometric unlock',
                options: const AuthenticationOptions(
                  stickyAuth: true,
                  biometricOnly: true,
                ),
              );
              if (success) {
                await _auth.setBiometricsEnabled(!_bioEnabled);
                if (mounted) setState(() => _bioEnabled = !_bioEnabled);
              }
            } catch (e) {
              debugPrint('Biometric setup error: $e');
            }
          },
          child: Container(
            width: double.infinity,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              border: Border.all(
                  color: _bioEnabled ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.4) : cAsh),
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.fingerprint, size: 20, color: cSmoke),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Text(_bioEnabled ? 'Enabled' : 'Disabled',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 15,
                        color: _bioEnabled ? cGold : cMist,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
                const Spacer(),
                Container(
                  width: 36, height: 20,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: _bioEnabled ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.2) : cAsh,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  ),
                  child: AnimatedAlign(
                    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
                    alignment: _bioEnabled ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
                      child: Container(
                        width: 14, height: 14,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                          color: _bioEnabled ? cGold : cSmoke,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],

      const SizedBox(height: 32),
      const Text('LOCK BEHAVIOUR', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
          color: cSmoke, fontFamily: 'monospace', letterSpacing: 3)),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
        child: const Text(
          'Your PIN is required every time Lore opens, to unlock your '
          'encryption keys. This protects your stories if your phone '
          'is ever in someone else\'s hands.',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cMist,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.6),
        ),
      ),
    ]);
  }

  Widget _buildPinEntry({required bool isConfirm}) {
    if (_savingPin) {
      return Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          const SizedBox(
            width: 24, height: 24,
            child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                strokeWidth: 1.5, color: cGold),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          const Text(
            'Securing your account...',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: cMist,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          const Text(
            'Generating your encryption key. This takes a few seconds, '
            'but only happens once.',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.5),
          ),
        ],
      );
    }

    final title = isConfirm ? 'Confirm your PIN' : 'Set your PIN';
    return Column(children: [
      Text(title, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, color: cParchment,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      const SizedBox(height: 32),
      Row(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: List.generate(_pinLength, (i) => Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
          width: 14, height: 14,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            shape: BoxShape.circle,
            color: i < _pinInput.length ? cGold : Colors.transparent,
            border: Border.all(color: i < _pinInput.length ? cGold : cAsh),
          ),
        )),
      ),
      if (_error != null) ...[
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Text(_error!, textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
                color: cEmber, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      ],
      const SizedBox(height: 40),
      _buildNumpad(),
    ]);
  }

  Widget _buildTimingEdit() {
    return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      const Text('When should Lore lock?',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, color: cParchment,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      const SizedBox(height: 32),
      _timingEditOption('Every time you open the app', 'always', 'Most secure'),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      _timingEditOption('After 5 minutes in background', 'background',
          'Locks if you switch away for more than 5 minutes'),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      _timingEditOption('Only when fully closed', 'close',
          'Only locks after you fully close the app'),
    ]);
  }

  Widget _timingEditOption(String label, String value, String sub) {
    final selected = _currentTiming == value;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => _saveTimingOnly(value),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          border: Border.all(color: selected ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.5) : cAsh),
          color: selected ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.04) : Colors.transparent,
        ),
        child: Row(children: [
          Expanded(child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
            Text(label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13,
                color: cParchment, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
            const SizedBox(height: 2),
            Text(sub, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
                color: cSmoke, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
          ])),
          if (selected) const Icon(Icons.check, size: 14, color: cGold),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDone() {
    return Column(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
      const Text('All set.', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 28,
          color: cParchment, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),
      const Text(
        'Your story is sealed. Only you hold the key â€” keep your PIN '
        'safe, and it will follow you to any device you sign in on.',
        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
            fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.7)),
      const SizedBox(height: 48),
      GestureDetector(
        onTap: () {
          if (widget.isFirstTime) {
            // Show the tutorial first, then go to Home
            Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement(
              fadeRoute(const GesturesScreen(isFirstTime: true)),
            );
            // We use pushReplacement so they can't back out of the tutorial to the lock screen.
            // We will handle going to Home from inside the GesturesScreen next.
          } else {
            Navigator.of(context).pop(true);
          }
        },
        child: Container(
          width: double.infinity,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
          color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
          child: const Center(child: Text('Continue',
              style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                  color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3))),
        ),
      ),
    ]);
  }

  Widget _buildNumpad() => _Numpad(
    onDigit: _onDigit,
    onDelete: _onDelete,
  );
}

import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:qr_flutter/qr_flutter.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/shared.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../settings.dart';
import '../services/sandbox_sync.dart';
import '../services/firestore_service.dart';
import '../widgets/support_link.dart';
import '../main.dart' show HomeScreen;
import 'lock_screen.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show kIsWeb;

class LoginScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool startOnLogin;
  const LoginScreen({super.key, this.startOnLogin = false});
  @override State<LoginScreen> createState() => _LoginScreenState();
}

class _LoginScreenState extends State<LoginScreen> {
  late int _mode; // 0 = Login, 1 = Register, 2 = Web QR

    @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (kIsWeb) {
      _mode = 2; // Default to Web QR on desktop
    } else {
      _mode = widget.startOnLogin ? 0 : 1;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: cVoid,
      resizeToAvoidBottomInset: true,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: AnimatedSwitcher(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
          child: _mode == 0
              ? _LoginPanel(
                  onSwitch: () => setState(() => _mode = 1),
                  onWebLogin: () => setState(() => _mode = 2),
                )
              : _mode == 1
                  ? _RegisterPanel(onSwitch: () => setState(() => _mode = 0))
                  : const _WebQRPanel(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// REGISTER PANEL
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class _RegisterPanel extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback onSwitch;
  const _RegisterPanel({required this.onSwitch});
  @override State<_RegisterPanel> createState() => _RegisterPanelState();
}

class _RegisterPanelState extends State<_RegisterPanel> {
  final _ctrl = TextEditingController();
  final _inviteCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _auth = AuthService();
  final _fs = FirestoreService();
  bool _loading = false;
  String? _error;
  String? _generatedCode;
  String? _registeredName;
  bool _showInviteEntry = false;
  String? _inviteError;
  bool _inviteLoading = false;
  bool _acceptedTerms = false;

  @override void dispose() {
    _ctrl.dispose();
    _inviteCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _redeemInviteAndContinue() async {
    final code = _inviteCtrl.text.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (code.isEmpty) { _continue(); return; }
    setState(() { _inviteLoading = true; _inviteError = null; });
    final ownerCode = await _fs.validateInviteCode(code);
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (ownerCode == null) {
      setState(() { _inviteError = 'Invalid or already used invite code.'; _inviteLoading = false; });
      return;
    }
    await _fs.redeemInviteCode(
      inviteCode: code,
      fromCode: _auth.currentCode ?? '',
      fromName: _registeredName ?? '',
    );
    if (mounted) _continue();
  }

  Future<void> _register() async {
    setState(() { _loading = true; _error = null; });
    final result = await _auth.register(_ctrl.text);
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (result.success) {
      setState(() {
        _generatedCode = result.code;
        _registeredName = result.name;
        _loading = false;
      });
    } else {
      setState(() { _error = result.errorMessage; _loading = false; });
    }
  }

  void _copyCode() {
    if (_generatedCode == null) return;
    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: _generatedCode!));
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
      content: const Text('Code copied to clipboard',
          style: TextStyle(color: cParchment, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
              fontSize: 13)),
    ));
  }

  void _continue() {
    Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
      fadeRoute(const LockSetupScreen(isFirstTime: true)),
      (_) => false,
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_generatedCode != null) {
      return _buildCodeReveal();
    }
    return _buildNamePicker();
  }

  Widget _buildNamePicker() {
    return ScrollConfiguration(
      behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
            32, 32, 32, MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom + 32),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const SizedBox(height: 40),
            const Text('LORE',
                style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 11,
                    color: cGold, letterSpacing: 6)),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            const Text('Choose your name.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 32, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, color: cParchment, height: 1.3)),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            const Text(
              'This is how others will find you. No email. No password. '
              'You\'ll receive a private code that is the key to your world.',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.7),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 40),
            Container(
              decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
              child: TextField(
                controller: _ctrl,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, color: cParchment,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  hintText: 'Your name...',
                  hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cSmoke, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                      fontSize: 18),
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  border: InputBorder.none,
                ),
                cursorColor: cGold,
                maxLength: 24,
                buildCounter: (_, {required currentLength, required isFocused,
                    maxLength}) => Text('$currentLength/$maxLength',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke)),
                onSubmitted: (_) => _register(),
              ),
            ),
            if (_error != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(_error!, style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12, color: cEmber, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _acceptedTerms = !_acceptedTerms),
              behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
              child: Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    _acceptedTerms ? Icons.check_box : Icons.check_box_outline_blank,
                    size: 20,
                    color: _acceptedTerms ? cGold : cSmoke,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  const Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      'I am 18 or older and I agree to the Terms of Service & Privacy Policy. I understand this platform is for fictional roleplay.',

                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            LoreTap(
              onTap: (_loading || !_acceptedTerms) ? null : _register,
              child: Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                color: _acceptedTerms ? cParchment : cAsh,
                child: Center(child: _loading
                    ? const SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                            strokeWidth: 1.5, color: cVoid))
                    : Text('Claim your name â†’',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 11, color: _acceptedTerms ? cVoid : cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            Center(
              child: LoreTap(
                onTap: widget.onSwitch,
                child: const Text('Already have a code? Enter it here',
                    style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                        color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            const Center(
              child: SupportLink(
                contextNote: 'Sent from the registration screen.',
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 40),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

// LOGIN PANEL
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class _LoginPanel extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback onSwitch;
  final VoidCallback onWebLogin;
  const _LoginPanel({required this.onSwitch, required this.onWebLogin});
  @override State<_LoginPanel> createState() => _LoginPanelState();
}

class _LoginPanelState extends State<_LoginPanel> {
  final _ctrl = TextEditingController();
  final _auth = AuthService();
  bool _loading = false;
  String? _error;

  @override void dispose() { _ctrl.dispose(); super.dispose(); }

  Future<void> _login() async {
    setState(() { _loading = true; _error = null; });
    final result = await _auth.login(_ctrl.text);
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (result.success) {
      await appSettings.syncFromCloud();
      await SandboxSync.syncOnLogin();
      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
        fadeRoute(const HomeScreen()),
        (_) => false,
      );
    } else if (result.isDeviceLocked) {
      setState(() { _loading = false; });
      _showDeviceLockedDialog();
    } else {
      setState(() { _error = result.errorMessage; _loading = false; });
    }
  }

    void _showDeviceLockedDialog() {
    final pinCtrl = TextEditingController();
    bool loading = false;
    String? error;

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDialogState) => Dialog(
          backgroundColor: cInk,
          shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                const Text('ACCOUNT LOCKED', style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                    color: cEmber, letterSpacing: 4)),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                const Text(
                  'This account is locked to another device.\n\n'
                  'If this is you on a new phone, enter your PIN to transfer the account here.',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
                      height: 1.7, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                TextField(
                  controller: pinCtrl,
                  autofocus: true,
                  obscureText: true,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 20,
                      color: cGold, letterSpacing: 6),
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢',
                    hintStyle: const TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 20,
                        color: cAsh, letterSpacing: 6),
                    counterText: '',
                    enabledBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
                    focusedBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderSide: BorderSide(color: cGold)),
                    filled: true, fillColor: cVoid,
                  ),
                  cursorColor: cGold,
                ),
                if (error != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(error!, style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 11, color: cEmber,
                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                ],
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                Row(children: [
                  Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                    onTap: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(),
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                      child: const Center(child: Text('Cancel',
                          style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                              fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
                    ),
                  )),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Expanded(child: LoreTap(
                    onTap: loading ? null : () async {
                      if (pinCtrl.text.isEmpty) {
                        setDialogState(
                            () => error = 'Please enter your PIN.');
                        return;
                      }
                      setDialogState(() { loading = true; error = null; });
                      final nav = Navigator.of(context); // <--- CAPTURE IT HERE
                      final result = await _auth.completeLoginWithPin(
                        code: _ctrl.text.trim().toUpperCase(),
                        pin: pinCtrl.text,
                      );
                      if (!ctx.mounted) return;
                      if (result.success) {
                        await appSettings.syncFromCloud();
                        await SandboxSync.syncOnLogin();
                        
                        if (!ctx.mounted) return;
                        Navigator.of(ctx).pop();

                        nav.pushAndRemoveUntil(
                        fadeRoute(const HomeScreen()),
                        (_) => false,
                      );
                        
                        if (!mounted) return; // <--- ADD THIS LINE
                        Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
                          fadeRoute(const HomeScreen()),
                          (_) => false,
                        );
                      } else {
                        setDialogState(() {
                          loading = false;
                          error = result.errorMessage ?? 'Incorrect PIN.';
                        });
                      }
                    },
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                      color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.9),
                      child: Center(child: loading
                          ? const SizedBox(width: 14, height: 14,
                              child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                  strokeWidth: 1.5, color: cVoid))
                          : const Text('Transfer here',
                              style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                  fontSize: 9, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 1))),
                    ),
                  )),
                ]),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ScrollConfiguration(
      behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
            32, 32, 32, MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom + 32),

            const Text('Enter your code.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 32, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,

            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            const Text(
              'Your code is the only key to your world.',

            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 40),
            Container(
              decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),

                textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.characters,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  hintText: 'LR-XXXX-XXXX',
                  hintStyle: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', color: cAsh,
                      fontSize: 20, letterSpacing: 3),
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  border: InputBorder.none,
                ),
                cursorColor: cGold,
                onSubmitted: (_) => _login(),
              ),
            ),
            if (_error != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(_error!, style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12, color: cEmber, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            LoreTap(
              onTap: _loading ? null : _login,
              child: Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                color: cParchment,
                child: Center(child: _loading
                    ? const SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                            strokeWidth: 1.5, color: cVoid))
                    : const Text('Enter â†’',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 11, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 2))),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            Center(
              child: LoreTap(
                onTap: widget.onSwitch,
                child: const Text('New here? Choose a name',
                    style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                        color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            if (kIsWeb) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Center(
                child: LoreTap(
                  onTap: widget.onWebLogin,
                  child: const Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Icon(Icons.qr_code_scanner, size: 16, color: cGold),
                      SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Text('Log in with your phone',
                          style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 11,
                              color: cGold, letterSpacing: 1)),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            const Center(
              child: SupportLink(
                contextNote: 'Sent from the login screen.',
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 40),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// WEB QR PANEL
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class _WebQRPanel extends StatefulWidget {
  const _WebQRPanel();
  @override State<_WebQRPanel> createState() => _WebQRPanelState();
}

class _WebQRPanelState extends State<_WebQRPanel> {
  final String _sessionId =
      '${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_${Random().nextInt(9999)}';
  final _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  final _auth = AuthService();
  final _pinCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _codeCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _pinFocus = FocusNode();

  bool _approved = false;
  bool _loggingIn = false;
  bool _showManualEntry = false;
  String _userCode = '';
  String? _error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _listenToApproval();
        WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      FocusScope.of(context).requestFocus(_pinFocus);
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pinCtrl.dispose();
    _codeCtrl.dispose();
    _pinFocus.dispose(); // Add this
    super.dispose();
  }

  // â”€â”€ Manual code entry â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // Called when the user types their code and taps Continue.
  // Validates the code and logs in. This is what previously lived
  // in _LoginPanel and was calling the wrong mobile login() path.
  Future<void> _submitManualCode() async {
        WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      FocusScope.of(context).requestFocus(_pinFocus);
    });
    final code = _codeCtrl.text.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (code.isEmpty) {
      setState(() => _error = 'Enter your code.');
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _loggingIn = true;
      _error = null;
    });

        WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _pinFocus.requestFocus();
    });

    final result = await _auth.loginWeb(code);
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (!result.success) {
      setState(() {
        _loggingIn = false;
        _error = 'Code not found. Check and try again.';
      });
      return;
    }

    // Success â€” move on to the PIN step. Note we do NOT call
    // unlockWithPin here; that's done in _completeWebLogin so the
    // QR path and the manual path share the same end step.
    setState(() {
      _userCode = code;
      _approved = true;
      _loggingIn = false;
    });
  }

  // â”€â”€ Final step: enter PIN, unlock crypto, go Home â”€â”€â”€â”€
  Future<void> _completeWebLogin() async {
    final pin = _pinCtrl.text.trim();
    if (pin.isEmpty) {
      setState(() => _error = 'Please enter your PIN.');
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _loggingIn = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    // The manual path already called loginWeb in _submitManualCode.
    // The QR path hasn't. Only call it if we still need to.
    if (_auth.currentCode != _userCode) {
      final result = await _auth.loginWeb(_userCode);
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (!result.success) {
        setState(() {
          _loggingIn = false;
          _error = 'Could not find account.';
        });
        return;
      }
    }

    final unlocked = await _auth.unlockWithPin(pin);
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (!unlocked) {
      await _auth.signOut();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _loggingIn = false;
        _error = 'Incorrect PIN.';
      });
      return;
    }

    await appSettings.syncFromCloud();
    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
      fadeRoute(const HomeScreen()),
      (_) => false,
    );
  }

  void _listenToApproval() {
    _db.collection('web_auth_sessions').doc(_sessionId).snapshots().listen((snap) {
      if (snap.exists && snap.data()?['status'] == 'authorized') {
        if (!mounted) return;
        setState(() {
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
          _pinFocus.requestFocus();
        });
          _approved = true;
          _userCode = snap.data()!['userCode'];
        });
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ScrollConfiguration(
      behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),
        child: Center(
          // Keep it readable on wide desktop monitors.
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 480),
            child: Column(
              children: [
                const SizedBox(height: 40),
                const Text(
                  'Scan to Log In',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 28,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                    color: cParchment,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                const Text(
                  'Open Lore on your phone,\ngo to Settings > Link Desktop, and scan this code.',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    color: cSmoke,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                    height: 1.6,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 48),
                if (_approved) _buildPinEntry() else _buildQrOrManual(),
                const SizedBox(height: 48),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildQrOrManual() {
    return Column(
      children: [
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          color: Colors.white,
          child: QrImageView(
            data: _sessionId,
            version: QrVersions.auto,
            size: 200.0,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 32),
        if (!_showManualEntry)
          LoreTap(
            onTap: () => setState(() {
              _showManualEntry = true;
              _error = null;
            }),
            child: const Text(
              'Log in with unique code and pin',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'monospace',
                fontSize: 11,
                color: cSmoke,
                letterSpacing: 1,
              ),
            ),
          )
        else
          _buildManualEntry(),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildManualEntry() {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        const Text(
          'ENTER YOUR UNIQUE CODE',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontFamily: 'monospace',
            fontSize: 9,
            color: cGold,
            letterSpacing: 3,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
          child: TextField(
            controller: _codeCtrl,
            autofocus: true,
            textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.characters,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'monospace',
              fontSize: 18,
              color: cGold,
              letterSpacing: 3,
            ),
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              hintText: 'LR-XXXX-XXXX',
              hintStyle: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'monospace',
                color: cAsh,
                fontSize: 18,
                letterSpacing: 3,
              ),
              contentPadding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
              border: InputBorder.none,
            ),
            cursorColor: cGold,
            onSubmitted: (_) => _submitManualCode(),
          ),
        ),
        if (_error != null) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Text(
            _error!,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 12,
              color: cEmber,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
            ),
          ),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        LoreTap(
          onTap: _loggingIn ? null : _submitManualCode,
          child: Container(
            width: double.infinity,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
            color: cParchment,
            child: Center(
              child: _loggingIn
                  ? const SizedBox(
                      width: 16,
                      height: 16,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                        strokeWidth: 1.5,
                        color: cVoid,
                      ),
                    )
                  : const Text(
                      'Continue â†’',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 11,
                        color: cVoid,
                        letterSpacing: 2,
                      ),
                    ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        Center(
          child: LoreTap(
            onTap: () => setState(() {
              _showManualEntry = false;
              _error = null;
              _codeCtrl.clear();
            }),
            child: const Text(
              'Back to QR',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'monospace',
                fontSize: 9,
                color: cSmoke,
                letterSpacing: 1,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPinEntry() {
    return Column(
      children: [
        const Text(
          'Code accepted.',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 20,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
            fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
            color: cGold,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        const Text(
          'Enter your PIN to unlock your stories on this device.',
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 13,
            color: cSmoke,
            fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 24),
        Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
          child: TextField(
            controller: _pinCtrl,
            focusNode: _pinFocus,
            autofocus: true,
            obscureText: true,
            // ONLY use number type on mobile. On web, let it be a normal text field.
            keyboardType: kIsWeb ? TextInputType.visiblePassword : TextInputType.number,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'monospace',
              fontSize: 24,
              color: cGold,
              letterSpacing: 8,
            ),
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              hintText: 'â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢',
              hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cAsh, letterSpacing: 8),
              contentPadding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
              border: InputBorder.none,
            ),
            cursorColor: cGold,
            onSubmitted: (_) => _completeWebLogin(),
          ),
        ),
        if (_error != null) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Text(
            _error!,
            style: const TextStyle(color: cEmber, fontSize: 12),
          ),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
        LoreTap(
          onTap: _loggingIn ? null : _completeWebLogin,
          child: Container(
            width: double.infinity,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
            color: cParchment,
            child: Center(
              child: _loggingIn
                  ? const SizedBox(
                      width: 16,
                      height: 16,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                        strokeWidth: 1.5,
                        color: cVoid,
                      ),
                    )
                  : const Text(
                      'Unlock Web App â†’',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 11,
                        color: cVoid,
                        letterSpacing: 2,
                      ),
                    ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}


--- FILE: C:\Flutter Dev\lore2-1\lib\screens\qr_scanner_screen.dart ---

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:mobile_scanner/mobile_scanner.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';

class QRScannerScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const QRScannerScreen({super.key});
  @override State<QRScannerScreen> createState() => _QRScannerScreenState();
}

class _QRScannerScreenState extends State<QRScannerScreen> {
  final _auth = AuthService();
  bool _scanned = false;

  void _onDetect(BarcodeCapture capture) async {
    if (_scanned) return;
    final barcode = capture.barcodes.first;
    final sessionId = barcode.rawValue;
    final myCode = _auth.currentCode;

    if (sessionId != null && myCode != null) {
      setState(() => _scanned = true);
      
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('web_auth_sessions').doc(sessionId).set({
        'status': 'authorized',
        'userCode': myCode,
        'authorizedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });

      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
          backgroundColor: cInk,
          content: Text('Desktop Logged In!', style: TextStyle(color: cGold)),
        ));
        Navigator.pop(context);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: cVoid,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: cInk,
        title: const Text('Scan Desktop QR', style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 14, color: cParchment)),
        iconTheme: const IconThemeData(color: cSmoke),
      ),
      body: MobileScanner(
        onDetect: _onDetect,
        errorBuilder: (context, error, child) {
          return Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
              child: Text(
                'Camera Error:\n$error',
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red, fontSize: 14),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:dart_sentiment/dart_sentiment.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/shared.dart';
import '../widgets/rp_tools.dart';
import '../widgets/session_log.dart';
import '../models/world.dart';
import '../settings.dart';
import '../services/firestore_service.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../services/sound_service.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show kIsWeb;


// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// DISPLAY MODE
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
enum RPDisplayMode { cards, bubbles, classical }

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// DATA MODELS
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
class RPPost {
  final String id;
  final String author;
  final bool isUser;
  String content;
  final DateTime timestamp;
  final int wordCount;
  String? quotedContent;
  String? quotedAuthor;
  final Color textColor;
  final double fontSize;
  final bool bold;
  final bool italic;
  final String? characterName;
  final String? locationName;

  RPPost({
    required this.id,
    required this.author,
    required this.isUser,
    required this.content,
    required this.timestamp,
    this.quotedContent,
    this.quotedAuthor,
    this.textColor = cParchment,
    this.fontSize = 15,
    this.bold = false,
    this.italic = true,
    this.characterName,
    this.locationName,
  }) : wordCount = content.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+')).length;
}

class OOCMessage {
  final String author;
  final String content;
  final bool isUser;
  final DateTime timestamp;
  OOCMessage({
    required this.author,
    required this.content,
    required this.isUser,
    required this.timestamp,
  });
}

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// MOOD ENGINE
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
enum StoryMood { neutral, dark, tense, warm, eerie, battle, rain, snow }

class MoodEngine {
  static final _sentiment = Sentiment();

  static const _genreWeights = <StoryMood, Map<String, int>>{
    StoryMood.rain: {
      'rain': 3, 'storm': 3, 'downpour': 4, 'drizzle': 3, 'thunder': 3,
      'lightning': 3, 'puddle': 2, 'soaked': 2, 'drenched': 3, 'grey sky': 4,
      'gray sky': 4, 'overcast': 3, 'monsoon': 4, 'torrent': 3, 'flood': 3,
    },
    StoryMood.snow: {
      'snow': 3, 'blizzard': 4, 'frost': 3, 'frozen': 3, 'bleak': 2,
      'tundra': 4, 'glacier': 4, 'ice storm': 5, 'snowfall': 3, 'frostbite': 4,
      'bitter cold': 4, 'freezing': 3, 'white out': 4, 'avalanche': 4,
    },
    StoryMood.battle: {
      'battle': 4, 'war': 3, 'sword': 3, 'blood': 3, 'clash': 3,
      'combat': 4, 'wound': 3, 'blade': 2, 'charge': 2, 'siege': 4,
      'skirmish': 4, 'slaughter': 4, 'carnage': 5, 'armor': 2, 'arrow': 2,
      'gunshot': 4, 'explosion': 4, 'sniper': 4, 'ambush': 4, 'rifle': 3,
    },
    StoryMood.eerie: {
      'ghost': 4, 'haunt': 4, 'horror': 4, 'terror': 4, 'sinister': 4,
      'whisper': 2, 'shadow moved': 5, 'pale': 2, 'hollow': 3, 'void': 3,
      'cursed': 4, 'wrongness': 4, 'unnatural': 4, 'grinned': 2,
      'crawled': 2, 'crept': 2, 'vanished': 2, 'shapeless': 4, 'ritual': 3,
    },
    StoryMood.dark: {
      'death': 4, 'dead': 3, 'grave': 3, 'mourning': 4, 'despair': 5,
      'loss': 2, 'grief': 4, 'hollow': 3, 'hopeless': 5, 'forsaken': 4,
      'doomed': 4, 'shattered': 3, 'broken': 2, 'ruin': 3, 'ash': 2,
      'wept': 3, 'wept silently': 5, 'no way out': 5, 'resigned': 3,
    },
    StoryMood.tense: {
      'danger': 3, 'escape': 3, 'chase': 4, 'urgent': 3, 'panic': 4,
      'trap': 3, 'cornered': 4, 'heartbeat': 3, 'sweat': 2, 'breathless': 4,
      'raced': 3, 'sprinted': 3, 'alarm': 3, 'timer': 3, 'seconds left': 5,
      'no time': 4, 'closing in': 5, 'locked': 2, 'ticking': 3,
    },
    StoryMood.warm: {
      'love': 3, 'smile': 2, 'laugh': 2, 'hope': 3, 'joy': 3,
      'warmth': 3, 'embrace': 3, 'tender': 3, 'gentle': 2, 'soft light': 4,
      'firelight': 4, 'safe': 3, 'peace': 3, 'grateful': 3, 'cherish': 4,
      'comfort': 3, 'together': 2, 'home': 2, 'laughter': 3, 'relief': 3,
    },
  };

  static (StoryMood, int) _genreScore(String lower) {
    final scores = <StoryMood, int>{};
    for (final entry in _genreWeights.entries) {
      int total = 0;
      for (final kw in entry.value.entries) {
        if (lower.contains(kw.key)) total += kw.value;
      }
      if (total > 0) scores[entry.key] = total;
    }
    if (scores.isEmpty) return (StoryMood.neutral, 0);
    final top = scores.entries.reduce((a, b) => a.value >= b.value ? a : b);
    return (top.key, top.value);
  }

  static StoryMood detectMood(String text) {
    final lower = text.toLowerCase();
    final (genreMood, genreScore) = _genreScore(lower);

    final result = _sentiment.analysis(text, emoji: true);
    final comparative = (result['comparative'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
    final wordCount = (result['words'] as List?)?.length ?? 0;

    if (genreScore >= 4) return genreMood;

    if (genreScore >= 1) {
      if (genreMood == StoryMood.warm && comparative > 0.3) return StoryMood.warm;
      if (genreMood == StoryMood.dark && comparative < -0.3) return StoryMood.dark;
      if (genreMood == StoryMood.tense && comparative < -0.1) return StoryMood.tense;
      if (genreMood == StoryMood.eerie && comparative < -0.2) return StoryMood.eerie;
      if (genreScore >= 2) return genreMood;
    }

    if (wordCount < 2 && genreScore == 0) return StoryMood.neutral;

    if (comparative <= -0.6) return StoryMood.dark;
    if (comparative <= -0.3) return StoryMood.tense;
    if (comparative >= 0.4) return StoryMood.warm;

    return StoryMood.neutral;
  }

  static Color bgColor(StoryMood mood) {
    switch (mood) {
      case StoryMood.dark:    return const Color(0xFF06060E);
      case StoryMood.tense:   return const Color(0xFF0C0606);
      case StoryMood.warm:    return const Color(0xFF0C0904);
      case StoryMood.eerie:   return const Color(0xFF050806);
      case StoryMood.battle:  return const Color(0xFF0C0505);
      case StoryMood.rain:    return const Color(0xFF050810);
      case StoryMood.snow:    return const Color(0xFF060810);
      case StoryMood.neutral: return cVoid;
    }
  }

  static String moodLabel(StoryMood mood) {
    switch (mood) {
      case StoryMood.dark:    return 'Dark';
      case StoryMood.tense:   return 'Tense';
      case StoryMood.warm:    return 'Warm';
      case StoryMood.eerie:   return 'Eerie';
      case StoryMood.battle:  return 'Battle';
      case StoryMood.rain:    return 'Rain';
      case StoryMood.snow:    return 'Snow';
      case StoryMood.neutral: return 'Neutral';
    }
  }
}

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// PARTICLES
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
class Particle {
  double x, y, vx, vy, size, opacity;
  final StoryMood type;

  Particle(this.type, double width, double height)
      : x = 0, y = 0, vx = 0, vy = 0, size = 1, opacity = 0 {
    reset(width, height);
  }

  void reset(double w, double h) {
    final rnd = Random();
    switch (type) {
      case StoryMood.rain:
        x = rnd.nextDouble() * w;
        y = -10;
        vx = rnd.nextDouble() * 1.5 - 0.5;
        vy = rnd.nextDouble() * 10 + 10;
        size = rnd.nextDouble() * 1.5 + 0.5;
        opacity = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.5 + 0.2;
        break;
      case StoryMood.snow:
        x = rnd.nextDouble() * w;
        y = -10;
        vx = rnd.nextDouble() * 1.2 - 0.6;
        vy = rnd.nextDouble() * 1.5 + 0.5;
        size = rnd.nextDouble() * 4 + 1.5;
        opacity = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.6 + 0.3;
        break;
      case StoryMood.battle:
        x = rnd.nextDouble() * w;
        y = h + 5;
        vx = rnd.nextDouble() * 4 - 2;
        vy = -(rnd.nextDouble() * 8 + 4);
        size = rnd.nextDouble() * 3 + 1;
        opacity = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.7 + 0.3;
        break;
      case StoryMood.tense:
        x = rnd.nextDouble() < 0.5 ? -5 : w + 5;
        y = rnd.nextDouble() * h;
        vx = x < 0 ? rnd.nextDouble() * 3 + 2 : -(rnd.nextDouble() * 3 + 2);
        vy = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.6 - 0.3;
        size = rnd.nextDouble() * 1.5 + 0.5;
        opacity = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.5 + 0.2;
        break;
      case StoryMood.eerie:
        x = rnd.nextDouble() * w;
        y = rnd.nextDouble() * h;
        vx = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.6 - 0.3;
        vy = -(rnd.nextDouble() * 0.8 + 0.2);
        size = rnd.nextDouble() * 5 + 2;
        opacity = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.25 + 0.05;
        break;
      case StoryMood.dark:
        x = rnd.nextDouble() * w;
        y = -10;
        vx = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.8 - 0.4;
        vy = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.8 + 0.3;
        size = rnd.nextDouble() * 2.5 + 0.5;
        opacity = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.4 + 0.1;
        break;
      case StoryMood.warm:
        x = rnd.nextDouble() * w;
        y = h + 5;
        vx = rnd.nextDouble() * 1.2 - 0.6;
        vy = -(rnd.nextDouble() * 1.5 + 0.5);
        size = rnd.nextDouble() * 3 + 1;
        opacity = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.5 + 0.15;
        break;
      default:
        x = rnd.nextDouble() * w;
        y = rnd.nextDouble() * h;
        vx = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.4 - 0.2;
        vy = -(rnd.nextDouble() * 0.4 + 0.1);
        size = rnd.nextDouble() * 2 + 0.5;
        opacity = rnd.nextDouble() * 0.1 + 0.02;
    }
  }

  bool update(double w, double h) {
    x += vx; y += vy;
    return y > h + 10 || x < -10 || x > w + 10;
  }
}

class MoodParticlePainter extends CustomPainter {
  final List<Particle> particles;
  final StoryMood mood;
  MoodParticlePainter(this.particles, this.mood);

  Color get _particleColor {
    switch (mood) {
      case StoryMood.rain:   return const Color(0xFF7AB8D4);
      case StoryMood.snow:   return Colors.white;
      case StoryMood.battle: return const Color(0xFFD4614A);
      case StoryMood.eerie:  return const Color(0xFF6aff8a);
      case StoryMood.warm:   return const Color(0xFFC9A96E);
      case StoryMood.dark:   return const Color(0xFF7060C0);
      case StoryMood.tense:  return const Color(0xFFCC3030);
      default:               return const Color(0xFF5a5a5a);
    }
  }

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final paint = Paint();
    for (final p in particles) {
      paint.color = _particleColor.withValues(alpha: p.opacity * 0.5);
      if (mood == StoryMood.rain) {
        paint.strokeWidth = p.size;
        canvas.drawLine(Offset(p.x, p.y),
            Offset(p.x + p.vx * 2, p.y + p.vy * 1.5),
            paint..style = PaintingStyle.stroke);
      } else if (mood == StoryMood.tense) {
        paint.strokeWidth = p.size;
        canvas.drawLine(Offset(p.x, p.y),
            Offset(p.x - p.vx * 6, p.y),
            paint..style = PaintingStyle.stroke);
      } else if (mood == StoryMood.battle) {
        paint.strokeWidth = p.size * 0.6;
        canvas.drawLine(Offset(p.x, p.y),
            Offset(p.x - p.vx, p.y - p.vy),
            paint..style = PaintingStyle.stroke);
      } else {
        canvas.drawCircle(Offset(p.x, p.y), p.size,
            paint..style = PaintingStyle.fill);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant CustomPainter old) => true;
}

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// SHARED: selectable post text
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
Widget _selectablePostText({
  required String text,
  required TextStyle style,
  required void Function(String) onAddToLog,
  void Function(String)? onSelectionChanged,
}) {
  return Text(text, style: style);
}

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// SCREEN
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
class RPRoomScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String partnerName;
  final String partnerCode;
  final String genre;
  final String sessionId;
  final String title;
  const RPRoomScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.partnerName,
    required this.partnerCode,
    required this.genre,
    this.sessionId = '',
    this.title = '',
  });

  @override
  State<RPRoomScreen> createState() => _RPRoomScreenState();
}

class _RPRoomScreenState extends State<RPRoomScreen>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  final List<RPPost> _posts = [];
  final List<OOCMessage> _oocMessages = [];

  Timer? _selectionDebounce;

  final _fs = FirestoreService();
  final _auth = AuthService();
  StreamSubscription? _postsSub;
  StreamSubscription? _oocSub;
  bool _loadingPosts = true;

  final _editorCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _scrollCtrl = ScrollController();
  final _editorFocus = FocusNode();
  bool _editorExpanded = false;

  bool _bold = false;
  bool _italic = true;
  double _fontSize = 15;
  Color _fontColor = cParchment;

  bool _aiMoodEnabled = true;
  double _moodIntensity = 0.5;
  bool _moodLockedByUser = false;
  final List<StoryMood> _moodHistory = [];

  StoryMood _currentMood = StoryMood.rain;
  late AnimationController _moodCtrl;
  late Animation<Color?> _bgAnim;
  Color _fromColor = cVoid;

  late AnimationController _particleCtrl;
  final List<Particle> _particles = [];
  final _rnd = Random();
  final _particleTick = ValueNotifier<int>(0);
  Size _canvasSize = Size.zero;

  bool _desktopOOCExpanded = false;
  bool _oocOpen = false;
  final _oocCtrl = TextEditingController();

  bool _settingsOpen = false;
  late String _sessionTitle;

  final List<RPNote> _notes = [];
  StatBlock? _myStats;
  final ValueNotifier<StatBlock?> _partnerStatsN = ValueNotifier(null);
  StreamSubscription? _statsSub;
  Timer? _statsSaveDebounce;
  final List<WorldEntry> _importedWorlds = [];
  final List<CharacterEntry> _importedCharacters = [];
  List<WorldEntry> _sandboxWorlds = [];
  List<CharacterEntry> _sandboxCharacters = [];

  List<String> get _availableLocations {
    final locs = <String>[];
    for (final w in _importedWorlds) {
      for (final l in w.locations) {
        if (l.name.isNotEmpty && !locs.contains(l.name)) locs.add(l.name);
      }
    }
    return locs;
  }

  String? _expandedPostId;
  String? _quotingPostId;
  String? _editingPostId;

  RPDisplayMode _displayMode = RPDisplayMode.cards;

  CharacterEntry? _activeCharacter;
  String? _activeLocation;

  bool _draftSaved = false;
  static const _draftDebounce = Duration(milliseconds: 800);
  DateTime? _lastTyped;
  String _selectedText = '';

  SessionLog get _log => SessionLog.forSession(
      widget.sessionId.isEmpty ? 'default' : widget.sessionId);
