  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _sessionTitle = widget.title;
    _aiMoodEnabled = appSettings.aiMood;
    appSettings.addListener(_onSettingsChanged);
    if (widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty && _sessionTitle.isEmpty) {
      _loadSessionTitle();
    }

    _moodCtrl = AnimationController(
        vsync: this, duration: const Duration(seconds: 3));
    final toColor = MoodEngine.bgColor(_currentMood);
    _fromColor = toColor;
    _bgAnim = ColorTween(begin: _fromColor, end: toColor)
        .animate(CurvedAnimation(parent: _moodCtrl, curve: Curves.easeInOut));

    _particleCtrl = AnimationController(
        vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 50))
      ..addListener(_onParticleTick)
      ..repeat();

    _initParticles();
    _loadDraft();
    _editorCtrl.addListener(_onEditorChanged);

    if (widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
      _subscribeToFirestore();
      _subscribeToStats();
      _log.load();
    }
    _loadSandboxData();
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€ Firestore streams â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  void _subscribeToFirestore() {
    _postsSub = _fs.sessionPosts(widget.sessionId).listen(
      (data) {
        final myCode = _auth.currentCode ?? '';

        final wasAtBottom = !_scrollCtrl.hasClients ||
            (_scrollCtrl.position.maxScrollExtent -
                    _scrollCtrl.position.pixels) <
                100;

        final posts = data.map((d) {
          final isUser = d['authorCode'] == myCode;
          return RPPost(
            id: d['id'] as String,
            author: d['authorName'] as String? ?? '?',
            isUser: isUser,
            content: d['content'] as String? ?? '',
            timestamp: (d['createdAt'] != null)
                ? (d['createdAt'] as dynamic).toDate()
                : DateTime.now(),
            quotedContent: d['quotedContent'] as String?,
            quotedAuthor: d['quotedAuthor'] as String?,
            characterName: d['characterName'] as String?,
            locationName: d['locationName'] as String?,
          );
        }).toList();

        if (!mounted) return;
        setState(() {
          _posts
            ..clear()
            ..addAll(posts);
          _loadingPosts = false;
        });

        if (wasAtBottom && appSettings.autoScroll) {
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
            if (_scrollCtrl.hasClients) {
              _scrollCtrl.animateTo(_scrollCtrl.position.maxScrollExtent,
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
                  curve: Curves.easeOut);
            }
          });
        }
      },
      onError: _handleStreamError,
    );

    _oocSub = _fs.oocMessages(widget.sessionId).listen(
      (data) {
        final myCode = _auth.currentCode ?? '';
        final msgs = data.map((d) {
          final isUser = d['authorCode'] == myCode;
          return OOCMessage(
            author: d['authorName'] as String? ?? '?',
            content: d['content'] as String? ?? '',
            isUser: isUser,
            timestamp: (d['createdAt'] != null)
                ? (d['createdAt'] as dynamic).toDate()
                : DateTime.now(),
          );
        }).toList();
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() => _oocMessages
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(msgs));
        }
      },
      onError: _handleStreamError,
    );
  }

  void _handleStreamError(Object e) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _loadingPosts = false);
    final msg = e.toString().contains('permission-denied')
        ? 'Lost access to this session.'
        : 'Could not load session.';
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      content: Text(msg, style: const TextStyle(color: cParchment)),
    ));
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€ Session stats sync â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  void _subscribeToStats() {
    print('[stats] subscribing, sessionId=${widget.sessionId}');
    _statsSub = _fs.sessionStats(widget.sessionId).listen(
      (statsMap) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        print('[stats] received ${statsMap.length} blocks: '
            '${statsMap.keys.toList()}');
      final myCode = _auth.currentCode ?? '';

      if (_myStats == null && statsMap.containsKey(myCode)) {
        setState(() => _myStats = statsMap[myCode]);
      }

      StatBlock? partner;
      for (final e in statsMap.entries) {
        if (e.key != myCode && e.key.isNotEmpty) {
          partner = e.value;
          break;
        }
      }
      _partnerStatsN.value = partner;
      },
      onError: (e) => print('[stats] STREAM ERROR: $e'),
    );
  }

  void _saveMyStats(StatBlock? block) {
    setState(() => _myStats = block);
    print('[stats] save requested, sessionId=${widget.sessionId}, '
        'block=${block?.name} stats=${block?.stats.length}');
    if (widget.sessionId.isEmpty) {
      print('[stats] bailing â€” no session id');
      return;
    }
    _statsSaveDebounce?.cancel();
    _statsSaveDebounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), () {
      _fs.saveSessionStats(widget.sessionId, block);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _loadSandboxData() async {
    final worlds = await SandboxStorage.loadWorlds();
    final chars = await SandboxStorage.loadCharacters();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _sandboxWorlds = worlds;
        _sandboxCharacters = chars;
        for (final w in worlds) {
          if (!_importedWorlds.any((x) => x.id == w.id)) {
            _importedWorlds.add(w);
          }
        }
        for (final c in chars) {
          if (!_importedCharacters.any((x) => x.id == c.id)) {
            _importedCharacters.add(c);
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  void _onSettingsChanged() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _aiMoodEnabled = appSettings.aiMood);
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€ Draft â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  String get _draftKey =>
      'draft_${widget.sessionId.isEmpty ? 'default' : widget.sessionId}';

  Future<void> _loadDraft() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final saved = prefs.getString(_draftKey) ?? '';
    if (saved.isNotEmpty && mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _editorCtrl.text = saved;
        _draftSaved = true;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveDraft(String text) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (text.isEmpty) {
      await prefs.remove(_draftKey);
      if (mounted) setState(() => _draftSaved = false);
    } else {
      await prefs.setString(_draftKey, text);
      if (mounted) setState(() => _draftSaved = true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _clearDraft() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(_draftKey);
    if (mounted) setState(() => _draftSaved = false);
  }

    Future<void> _sendOocMessage() async {
    final text = _oocCtrl.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return;
    
    sounds.play(SoundKey.oocMsg);
    
    if (widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        await _fs.addOocMessage(
            sessionId: widget.sessionId, content: text);
        _oocCtrl.clear();
      } catch (e) {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
              backgroundColor: cInk,
              content: Text('Send failed: $e',
                  style: const TextStyle(color: cParchment))));
        }
      }
    } else {
      _oocCtrl.clear();
      setState(() => _oocMessages.add(OOCMessage(
          author: _auth.currentName ?? 'You',
          content: text,
          isUser: true,
          timestamp: DateTime.now())));
    }
  }

  void _onEditorChanged() {
    final text = _editorCtrl.text;
    _lastTyped = DateTime.now();
    final captured = _lastTyped;
    Future.delayed(_draftDebounce, () {
      if (_lastTyped == captured && mounted) _saveDraft(text);
    });
    setState(() {});
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€ Particles â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  void _initParticles() {
    _particles.clear();
    final base = switch (_currentMood) {
      StoryMood.rain => 45,
      StoryMood.snow => 28,
      StoryMood.battle => 32,
      StoryMood.tense => 18,
      StoryMood.eerie => 15,
      StoryMood.dark => 14,
      StoryMood.warm => 22,
      StoryMood.neutral => 0,
    };
    final count = (base * (0.4 + _moodIntensity * 1.2)).round();
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      final p = Particle(_currentMood, 400, 800);
      p.y = _rnd.nextDouble() * 800;
      _particles.add(p);
    }
  }

  void _onParticleTick() {
    if (!mounted || _canvasSize == Size.zero) return;
    for (final p in _particles) {
      if (p.update(_canvasSize.width, _canvasSize.height)) {
        p.reset(_canvasSize.width, _canvasSize.height);
      }
    }
    _particleTick.value++;
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€ Mood â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  void _setMood(StoryMood mood, {String? reason}) {
    if (mood == _currentMood) return;
    setState(() {
      _fromColor = _bgAnim.value ?? _fromColor;
      _currentMood = mood;
      final toColor = MoodEngine.bgColor(mood);
      _bgAnim = ColorTween(begin: _fromColor, end: toColor)
          .animate(CurvedAnimation(parent: _moodCtrl, curve: Curves.easeInOut));
      _moodCtrl.forward(from: 0);
      _initParticles();
    });
    _particleTick.value++;

    if (widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty && reason != 'silent') {
      _log.addEvent(
        title: 'Mood Â· ${MoodEngine.moodLabel(mood)}',
        body: 'The room shifted to ${MoodEngine.moodLabel(mood)}.',
        source: 'mood',
        meta: {'mood': mood.name},
      );
    }
  }

  void _setMoodManual(StoryMood mood) {
    setState(() => _moodLockedByUser = true);
    sounds.play(SoundKey.moodSwitch);
    _setMood(mood);
  }

  void _unlockMood() {
    _moodHistory.clear();
    setState(() => _moodLockedByUser = false);
  }

  void _analyseAndSetMood(String text) {
    if (!_aiMoodEnabled || _moodLockedByUser) return;
    final detected = MoodEngine.detectMood(text);

    _moodHistory.add(detected);
    if (_moodHistory.length > 3) _moodHistory.removeAt(0);

    final counts = <StoryMood, int>{};
    for (final m in _moodHistory) {
      counts[m] = (counts[m] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    final dominant =
        counts.entries.reduce((a, b) => a.value >= b.value ? a : b).key;

    _setMood(dominant);
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€ Submit â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  Future<void> _submitPost() async {
    final text = _editorCtrl.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return;

    // â”€â”€ EDIT MODE â”€â”€
    if (_editingPostId != null) {
      final postId = _editingPostId!;
      if (widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
        try {
          await _fs.editPost(
            sessionId: widget.sessionId,
            postId: postId,
            newContent: text,
          );
        } catch (e) {
          if (mounted) {
            ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
              backgroundColor: cInk,
              content: Text('Save failed: $e',
                  style: const TextStyle(color: cParchment)),
            ));
          }
          return;
        }
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        final i = _posts.indexWhere((p) => p.id == postId);
        if (i != -1) {
          _posts[i] = RPPost(
            id: _posts[i].id,
            author: _posts[i].author,
            isUser: _posts[i].isUser,
            content: text,
            timestamp: _posts[i].timestamp,
            quotedContent: _posts[i].quotedContent,
            quotedAuthor: _posts[i].quotedAuthor,
            characterName: _posts[i].characterName,
            locationName: _posts[i].locationName,
            textColor: _posts[i].textColor,
            fontSize: _posts[i].fontSize,
            bold: _posts[i].bold,
            italic: _posts[i].italic,
          );
        }
        _editorCtrl.text = '';
        _editingPostId = null;
        _editorExpanded = false;
      });
      return;
    }

    // â”€â”€ NEW POST â”€â”€
    RPPost? quotedPost;
    if (_quotingPostId != null) {
      for (final p in _posts) {
        if (p.id == _quotingPostId) {
          quotedPost = p;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    _analyseAndSetMood(text);

    if (widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        await _fs.addPost(
          sessionId: widget.sessionId,
          content: text,
          quotedContent: quotedPost?.content
                  .substring(0, min(100, quotedPost.content.length)),
          quotedAuthor: quotedPost != null
              ? (quotedPost.characterName ?? quotedPost.author)
              : null,
          characterName: _activeCharacter?.name,
          locationName: _activeLocation,
        );
      } catch (e) {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
            backgroundColor: cInk,
            content: Text('Post failed: $e',
                style: const TextStyle(color: cParchment)),
          ));
        }
        return; // keep the draft
      }
      await _clearDraft();
      sounds.play(SoundKey.rpPost);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _editorCtrl.text = '';
          _quotingPostId = null;
          _editorExpanded = false;
        });
      }
    } else {
      // Local-only path
      final displayName =
          _activeCharacter?.name ?? (_auth.currentName ?? 'You');
      final postColor = _activeCharacter != null
          ? _activeCharacter!.accentColor
          : _fontColor;
      setState(() {
        _posts.add(RPPost(
          id: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
          author: displayName,
          isUser: true,
          content: text,
          timestamp: DateTime.now(),
          quotedContent: quotedPost?.content
                  .substring(0, min(100, quotedPost.content.length)),
          quotedAuthor:
              quotedPost?.characterName ?? quotedPost?.author,
          textColor: postColor,
          fontSize: _fontSize,
          bold: _bold,
          italic: _italic,
          characterName: _activeCharacter?.name,
          locationName: _activeLocation,
        ));
        _editorCtrl.text = '';
        _quotingPostId = null;
        _editorExpanded = false;
      });
      _clearDraft();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _deletePost(String id) async {
    final i = _posts.indexWhere((p) => p.id == id);
    if (i == -1) return;
    final original = _posts[i];
    setState(() => _posts.removeAt(i));

    if (widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        await _fs.deletePost(
            sessionId: widget.sessionId, postId: id);
      } catch (e) {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() => _posts.insert(i, original));
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
            backgroundColor: cInk,
            content: Text('Delete failed: $e',
                style: const TextStyle(color: cParchment)),
          ));
        }
      }
    }
  }

  void _quotePost(String id) {
    setState(() {
      _quotingPostId = id;
      _editorExpanded = true;
    });
    _editorFocus.requestFocus();
  }

  void _editPost(RPPost post) {
    _editorCtrl.text = post.content;
    setState(() {
      _editingPostId = post.id;
      _quotingPostId = null;
      _editorExpanded = true;
    });
    _editorFocus.requestFocus();
  }

  Future<void> _loadSessionTitle() async {
    try {
      final sessions = await _fs.mySessions().first;
      final match = sessions.where((s) => s['id'] == widget.sessionId);
      if (match.isNotEmpty && mounted) {
        final t = match.first['title'] as String? ?? '';
        if (t.isNotEmpty) setState(() => _sessionTitle = t);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _editSessionTitle() async {
    final ctrl = TextEditingController(text: _sessionTitle);
    final result = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => Dialog(
        backgroundColor: cInk,
        shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              const Text('SESSION TITLE',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                      color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              const Text(
                'Give this story a name. Both of you can see and change it.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.5),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextField(
                controller: ctrl,
                autofocus: true,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 15, color: cParchment,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  hintText: 'The Whitethorn Heist...',
                  hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cSmoke,
                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                  filled: true, fillColor: cVoid,
                  enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero),
                  focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: cGold),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero),
                ),
                cursorColor: cGold,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              Row(children: [
                Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Cancel',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
                  ),
                )),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, ctrl.text),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    color: cParchment,
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Save',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 10, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 2))),
                  ),
                )),
              ]),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    ctrl.dispose();
    if (result == null) return;
    final newTitle = result.trim();
    setState(() => _sessionTitle = newTitle);
    if (widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        await _fs.updateSessionTitle(widget.sessionId, newTitle);
      } catch (e) {
        print('[session] title update failed: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  void _openLog() {
    if (widget.sessionId.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
        backgroundColor: cInk,
        content: Text('The log is available in shared rooms.',
            style: TextStyle(color: cParchment)),
      ));
      return;
    }
    SessionLogSheet.show(context, widget.sessionId);
  }

  void _addToLogFromText(String selectedText) {
    if (widget.sessionId.isEmpty) return;
    SessionLogSheet.promptFromSelection(
      context: context,
      sessionId: widget.sessionId,
      selectedText: selectedText,
    );
  }

  void _onSelectionChanged(String text) {
    final t = text.trim();
    if (t == _selectedText) return;
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _selectedText = t);

    if (kIsWeb && t.isNotEmpty) {
      _selectionDebounce?.cancel();
      _selectionDebounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 800), () {
        if (mounted && _selectedText == t) {
          _addSelectionToLog();
        }
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _addSelectionToLog() async {
    final text = _selectedText;
    if (text.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() => _selectedText = '');
    _selectionDebounce?.cancel();
    _addToLogFromText(text);
  }

  void _dismissSelection() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _selectedText = '');
  }

  Widget _buildSelectionPill() {
    final preview = _selectedText.length > 40
        ? '${_selectedText.substring(0, 40)}â€¦'
        : _selectedText;
    return Material(
      color: Colors.transparent,
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: cInk,
          border: Border.all(color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
                color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                blurRadius: 12,
                spreadRadius: 1),
          ],
        ),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
        child: Row(children: [
          const Icon(Icons.text_fields, size: 14, color: cSmoke),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Expanded(
            child: Text('"$preview"',
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12, color: cMist,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          GestureDetector(
            onTap: _addSelectionToLog,
            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
              color: cGold,
              child: const Text('Add to log',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                      color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 1,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 4),
          GestureDetector(
            onTap: _dismissSelection,
            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
            child: const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(4),
              child: Icon(Icons.close, size: 14, color: cSmoke),
            ),
          ),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    appSettings.removeListener(_onSettingsChanged);
    _selectionDebounce?.cancel();
    _editorCtrl.removeListener(_onEditorChanged);
    _postsSub?.cancel();
    _oocSub?.cancel();
    _statsSub?.cancel();
    _statsSaveDebounce?.cancel();
    _partnerStatsN.dispose();
    _moodCtrl.dispose();
    _particleCtrl.dispose();
    _particleTick.dispose();
    _editorCtrl.dispose();
    _scrollCtrl.dispose();
    _editorFocus.dispose();
    _oocCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDesktop = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width >= 900;
    if (isDesktop) {
      return _buildDesktopLayout();
    }
    return _buildMobileLayout();
  }

  Widget _buildDesktopLayout() {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _moodCtrl,
      builder: (_, child) {
        final bg = _bgAnim.value ?? cVoid;
        return Scaffold(
          backgroundColor: bg,
          body: Stack(children: [
            Positioned.fill(
              child: LayoutBuilder(builder: (_, constraints) {
                _canvasSize = Size(constraints.maxWidth, constraints.maxHeight);
                return RepaintBoundary(
                  child: ValueListenableBuilder<int>(
                    valueListenable: _particleTick,
                    builder: (_, _, _) => CustomPaint(
                      painter: MoodParticlePainter(_particles, _currentMood),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }),
            ),
            SafeArea(
              child: Column(children: [
                _buildTopBar(),
                Expanded(
                  child: Row(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: [
                      // â”€â”€ LEFT: SESSION LOG â”€â”€
                      SizedBox(
                        width: 300,
                        child: Container(
                          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.black12,
                            border: Border(right: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
                          ),
                          child: SessionLogView(log: _log, isSidebar: true),
                        ),
                      ),

                      // â”€â”€ CENTER: STORY + EDITOR â”€â”€
                      Expanded(
                        child: Center(
                          child: ConstrainedBox(
                            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 800),
                            child: Column(
                              children: [
                                Expanded(child: _buildPostList()),
                                _buildFullEditor(),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),

                      // â”€â”€ RIGHT: TOOLS + OOC â”€â”€
                      SizedBox(
                        width: 320,
                        child: Container(
                          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.black12,
                            border: Border(left: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
                          ),
                          child: Column(
                            children: [
                              Expanded(
                                child: RPToolsPanel(
                                  isSidebar: true,
                                  notes: _notes,
                                  myStats: _myStats,
                                  partnerStats: _partnerStatsN.value,
                                  partnerName: widget.partnerName,
                                  importedWorlds: _importedWorlds,
                                  importedCharacters: _importedCharacters,
                                  availableWorlds: _sandboxWorlds,
                                  availableCharacters: _sandboxCharacters,
                                  onDiceRolled: (msg) {
                                    if (widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
                                      _fs.addOocMessage(sessionId: widget.sessionId, content: msg, isSystem: true);
                                      _log.addEvent(title: 'Dice roll', body: msg, source: 'dice');
                                    }
                                  },
                                  onMyStatsChanged: (block) => _saveMyStats(block),
                                  onImportWorld: (w) {
                                    setState(() {
                                      if (!_importedWorlds.any((x) => x.id == w.id)) _importedWorlds.add(w);
                                    });
                                  },
                                  onImportCharacter: (c) {
                                    setState(() {
                                      if (!_importedCharacters.any((x) => x.id == c.id)) _importedCharacters.add(c);
                                    });
                                  },
                                  onRemoveWorld: (w) => setState(() => _importedWorlds.removeWhere((x) => x.id == w.id)),
                                  onRemoveCharacter: (c) => setState(() => _importedCharacters.removeWhere((x) => x.id == c.id)),
                                ),
                              ),
                              const Divider(color: cAsh, height: 1),
                              AnimatedContainer(
                                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
                                curve: Curves.easeInOut,
                                height: _desktopOOCExpanded ? 300 : 50,
                                child: Column(
                                  children: [
                                    Material(
                                      color: cInk,
                                      child: InkWell(
                                        onTap: () => setState(() => _desktopOOCExpanded = !_desktopOOCExpanded),
                                        child: Container(
                                          height: 50,
                                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                                          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                                            border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
                                          ),
                                          child: Row(
                                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                                            children: [
                                              const Text('OOC CHAT', style: TextStyle(
                                                  fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 11, color: cIce, letterSpacing: 4)),
                                              Icon(
                                                _desktopOOCExpanded ? Icons.keyboard_arrow_down : Icons.keyboard_arrow_up,
                                                size: 16,
                                                color: cSmoke,
                                              ),
                                            ],
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    if (_desktopOOCExpanded)
                                      Expanded(child: _buildOOCDesktopWidget()),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ]),
            ),
            if (!kIsWeb && _selectedText.isNotEmpty && !_desktopOOCExpanded && !_settingsOpen)
              Positioned(
                left: 300,
                right: 320,
                bottom: 100,
                child: _buildSelectionPill(),
              ),
          ]),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMobileLayout() {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _moodCtrl,
      builder: (_, child) {
        final bg = _bgAnim.value ?? cVoid;
        return Scaffold(
          backgroundColor: bg,
          body: Stack(children: [
            Positioned.fill(
              child: LayoutBuilder(builder: (_, constraints) {
                _canvasSize =
                    Size(constraints.maxWidth, constraints.maxHeight);
                return RepaintBoundary(
                  child: ValueListenableBuilder<int>(
                    valueListenable: _particleTick,
                    builder: (_, _, _) => CustomPaint(
                      painter:
                          MoodParticlePainter(_particles, _currentMood),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }),
            ),
            SafeArea(
              child: Column(children: [
                _buildTopBar(),
                Expanded(child: _buildPostList()),
                if (_editorExpanded)
                  _buildFullEditor()
                else
                  _buildCollapsedEditor(),
              ]),
            ),
            if (!_oocOpen)
              Positioned(
                right: 16,
                bottom: _editorExpanded ? 320 : 90,
                child: GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => setState(() => _oocOpen = true),
                  child: Container(
                    width: 48,
                    height: 48,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: cInk,
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                    child: const Icon(Icons.chat_bubble_outline,
                        color: cSmoke, size: 20),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            if (_oocOpen) _buildOOCPanel(),
            if (_settingsOpen) _buildSettingsPanel(),
            if (!kIsWeb && _selectedText.isNotEmpty && !_oocOpen && !_settingsOpen)
              Positioned(
                left: 16,
                right: 16,
                bottom: _editorExpanded ? 340 : 100,
                child: _buildSelectionPill(),
              ),
          ]),
        );
      },
    );
  }

    Widget _buildTopBar() {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
          border: const Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
      child: Row(children: [
        LoreTap(
          onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          child: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios, color: cSmoke, size: 16),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Expanded(
          child: LoreTap(
            onTap: _editSessionTitle,
            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
            child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
              if (_sessionTitle.isNotEmpty)
                Text(_sessionTitle,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 16,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                        fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                        color: cParchment))
              else
                Text(widget.partnerName,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 16,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                        fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                        color: cParchment)),
              Text(
                _sessionTitle.isNotEmpty
                    ? '${widget.partnerName} Â· ${widget.genre}'
                    : widget.genre,
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontSize: 9,
                    color: cSmoke,
                    letterSpacing: 2),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        if (_aiMoodEnabled)
          LoreTap(
            onTap: _moodLockedByUser ? _unlockMood : null,
            child: Container(
              padding:
                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                border: Border.all(
                    color: _moodLockedByUser
                        ? cSmoke
                        : cMagic.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
                color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
              ),
              child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
                if (_moodLockedByUser) ...[
                  const Icon(Icons.lock_outline, size: 9, color: cSmoke),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Text(MoodEngine.moodLabel(_currentMood),
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'monospace',
                          fontSize: 9,
                          color: cSmoke,
                          letterSpacing: 2)),
                ] else ...[
                  const Text('âœ¦',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9, color: cMagic)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Text(MoodEngine.moodLabel(_currentMood).toUpperCase(),
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'monospace',
                          fontSize: 9,
                          color: cMagic,
                          letterSpacing: 2)),
                ],
              ]),
            ),
          ),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        LoreTap(
          onTap: _openLog,
          child: const Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined,
              color: cSmoke, size: 18),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        LoreTap(
          onTap: _openToolsPanel,
          child: const Icon(Icons.construction_outlined,
              color: cSmoke, size: 18),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        LoreTap(
          onTap: () => setState(() => _settingsOpen = !_settingsOpen),
          child: const Icon(Icons.tune, color: cSmoke, size: 18),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPostList() {
    if (_loadingPosts && widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
      return const Center(
          child: SizedBox(
              width: 20,
              height: 20,
              child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                  strokeWidth: 1.5, color: cSmoke)));
    }
    if (_posts.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
          child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),
        child: Text('The story begins here.\nWrite the first post.',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 13,
                color: cSmoke,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                height: 1.8)),
      ));
    }
    switch (_displayMode) {
      case RPDisplayMode.cards:
        return _buildCardsView();
      case RPDisplayMode.bubbles:
        return _buildBubblesView();
      case RPDisplayMode.classical:
        return _buildClassicalView();
    }
  }

  Widget _buildCardsView() {
    return SelectionArea(
      onSelectionChanged: (value) => _onSelectionChanged(value?.plainText ?? ''),
      contextMenuBuilder: (context, state) {
        return AdaptiveTextSelectionToolbar.buttonItems(
          anchors: state.contextMenuAnchors,
          buttonItems: [
            ...state.contextMenuButtonItems,
            ContextMenuButtonItem(
              label: 'Add to log',
              onPressed: () {
                state.hideToolbar();
                _addSelectionToLog();
              },
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
      child: ScrollConfiguration(
        behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
        child: ListView.builder(
          controller: _scrollCtrl,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 12, 12, 8),
          itemCount: _posts.length,
          itemBuilder: (_, i) => _PostCard(
            post: _posts[i],
            isExpanded: _expandedPostId == _posts[i].id,
            onTap: () => setState(() => _expandedPostId =
                _expandedPostId == _posts[i].id ? null : _posts[i].id),
            onLongPress: () => _showPostActions(_posts[i]),
            onAddToLog: _addToLogFromText,
            onSelectionChanged: _onSelectionChanged,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBubblesView() {
    return SelectionArea(
      onSelectionChanged: (value) => _onSelectionChanged(value?.plainText ?? ''),
      contextMenuBuilder: (context, state) {
        return AdaptiveTextSelectionToolbar.buttonItems(
          anchors: state.contextMenuAnchors,
          buttonItems: [
            ...state.contextMenuButtonItems,
            ContextMenuButtonItem(
              label: 'Add to log',
              onPressed: () {
                state.hideToolbar();
                _addSelectionToLog();
              },
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
      child: ScrollConfiguration(
        behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
        child: ListView.builder(
          controller: _scrollCtrl,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 16, 12, 8),
          itemCount: _posts.length,
          itemBuilder: (_, i) {
            final post = _posts[i];
            final isUser = post.isUser;
            return Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisAlignment:
                    isUser ? MainAxisAlignment.end : MainAxisAlignment.start,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  if (!isUser) ...[
                    Container(
                      width: 28,
                      height: 28,
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8, top: 2),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                          color: cAsh,
                          border: Border.all(color: cSmoke)),
                      child: Center(
                          child: Text(
                              post.author.isNotEmpty
                                  ? post.author[0].toUpperCase()
                                  : '?',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                  fontSize: 11,
                                  color: cMist))),
                    ),
                  ],
                  Flexible(
                    child: ConstrainedBox(
                      constraints: BoxConstraints(
                          maxWidth:
                              MediaQuery.of(context).size.width * 0.72),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: isUser
                            ? CrossAxisAlignment.end
                            : CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          GestureDetector(
                            onLongPress: () => _showPostActions(post),
                            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(
                                  bottom: 4, left: 2, right: 2),
                              child: Row(
                                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                children: [
                                  Text(
                                    post.characterName ?? post.author,
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                      fontSize: 9,
                                      letterSpacing: 2,
                                      color: isUser
                                          ? (appSettings.textColourFor(
                                                  'char_name') ??
                                              (post.textColor == cParchment
                                                  ? cGold
                                                  : post.textColor))
                                          : (appSettings.textColourFor(
                                                  'partner_name') ??
                                              cMist),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  if (post.locationName != null) ...[
                                    const Text(' Â· ',
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                            fontSize: 9,
                                            color: cSmoke)),
                                    Text(post.locationName!,
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                            fontSize: 9,
                                            color: appSettings
                                                    .textColourFor(
                                                        'location_name') ??
                                                cSmoke,
                                            letterSpacing: 1)),
                                  ],
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: isUser
                                  ? Color.lerp(cVoid, cGold, 0.15)!
                                      .withValues(alpha: 0.85)
                                  : const Color(0xFF08080A)
                                      .withValues(alpha: 0.82),
                              border: Border.all(
                                  color: isUser
                                      ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.3)
                                      : cAsh),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
                                topLeft: const Radius.circular(2),
                                topRight: const Radius.circular(2),
                                bottomLeft: Radius.circular(isUser ? 2 : 0),
                                bottomRight: Radius.circular(isUser ? 0 : 2),
                              ),
                            ),
                            child: _selectablePostText(
                              text: post.content,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: post.fontSize,
                                color: appSettings
                                        .textColourFor('post_content') ??
                                    post.textColor,
                                fontStyle: post.italic
                                    ? FontStyle.italic
                                    : FontStyle.normal,
                                fontWeight: post.bold
                                    ? FontWeight.bold
                                    : FontWeight.w300,
                                height: 1.7,
                              ),
                              onAddToLog: _addToLogFromText,
                              onSelectionChanged: _onSelectionChanged,
                            ),
                          ),
                          Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(
                                top: 4, left: 2, right: 2),
                            child: Text('${post.wordCount}w',
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                    fontSize: 8,
                                    color: cSmoke,
                                    letterSpacing: 1)),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (isUser) const SizedBox(width: 8),
                ],
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildClassicalView() {
    return SelectionArea(
      onSelectionChanged: (value) => _onSelectionChanged(value?.plainText ?? ''),
      contextMenuBuilder: (context, state) {
        return AdaptiveTextSelectionToolbar.buttonItems(
          anchors: state.contextMenuAnchors,
          buttonItems: [
            ...state.contextMenuButtonItems,
            ContextMenuButtonItem(
              label: 'Add to log',
              onPressed: () {
                state.hideToolbar();
                _addSelectionToLog();
              },
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
      child: ScrollConfiguration(
        behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
        child: ListView.builder(
          controller: _scrollCtrl,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 24, 24, 8),
          itemCount: _posts.length,
          itemBuilder: (_, i) {
            final post = _posts[i];
            return Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 28),
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    GestureDetector(
                      onLongPress: () => _showPostActions(post),
                      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                      child: Row(children: [
                        Text(
                          (post.characterName ?? post.author).toUpperCase(),
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 10,
                            letterSpacing: 4,
                            color: post.isUser
                                ? (appSettings.textColourFor('char_name') ??
                                    (post.textColor == cParchment
                                        ? cGold
                                        : post.textColor.withValues(alpha: 0.9)))
                                : (appSettings.textColourFor(
                                        'partner_name') ??
                                    cMist),
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (post.locationName != null) ...[
                          const Text('  Â·  ',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                  fontSize: 10,
                                  color: cSmoke)),
                          Text(post.locationName!.toUpperCase(),
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                  fontSize: 10,
                                  letterSpacing: 2,
                                  color: appSettings.textColourFor(
                                          'location_name') ??
                                      cSmoke)),
                        ],
                      ]),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    if (post.quotedContent != null)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                              border: Border(
                                  left:
                                      BorderSide(color: cSmoke, width: 2))),
                          child: Text(
                              '${post.quotedAuthor ?? ""}: ${post.quotedContent}...',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11,
                                  color: cSmoke,
                                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    _selectablePostText(
                      text: post.content,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: post.fontSize,
                        color: appSettings.textColourFor('post_content') ??
                            post.textColor,
                        fontStyle: post.italic
                            ? FontStyle.italic
                            : FontStyle.normal,
                        fontWeight: post.bold
                            ? FontWeight.bold
                            : FontWeight.w300,
                        height: 2.0,
                      ),
                      onAddToLog: _addToLogFromText,
                      onSelectionChanged: _onSelectionChanged,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    Row(children: [
                      const Expanded(
                          child: Divider(color: cAsh, height: 1)),
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10),
                        child: Text('${post.wordCount}w',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                fontSize: 8,
                                color: appSettings.textColourFor(
                                        'timestamp') ??
                                    cSmoke,
                                letterSpacing: 1)),
                      ),
                      const Expanded(
                          child: Divider(color: cAsh, height: 1)),
                    ]),
                  ]),
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openToolsPanel() {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (_) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setModalState) => ValueListenableBuilder<StatBlock?>(
          valueListenable: _partnerStatsN,
          builder: (_, partnerStats, _) => RPToolsPanel(
            isSidebar: false,
            notes: _notes,
            myStats: _myStats,
            partnerStats: partnerStats,
            partnerName: widget.partnerName,
            importedWorlds: _importedWorlds,
            importedCharacters: _importedCharacters,
            availableWorlds: _sandboxWorlds,
            availableCharacters: _sandboxCharacters,
            onDiceRolled: (msg) {
              if (widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
                _fs.addOocMessage(
                    sessionId: widget.sessionId,
                    content: msg,
                    isSystem: true);
                _log.addEvent(
                  title: 'Dice roll',
                  body: msg,
                  source: 'dice',
                );
              } else {
                setState(() => _oocMessages.add(OOCMessage(
                    author: 'System',
                    content: msg,
                    isUser: false,
                    timestamp: DateTime.now())));
              }
              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
                backgroundColor: cInk,
                behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
                duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
                content: Text(msg,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 16,
                        color: cParchment,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
              ));
            },
            onMyStatsChanged: (block) {
              _saveMyStats(block);
              setModalState(() {});
            },
            onImportWorld: (w) {
              setState(() {
                if (!_importedWorlds.any((x) => x.id == w.id)) {
                  _importedWorlds.add(w);
                }
              });
              setModalState(() {});
            },
            onImportCharacter: (c) {
              setState(() {
                if (!_importedCharacters.any((x) => x.id == c.id)) {
                  _importedCharacters.add(c);
                }
              });
              setModalState(() {});
            },
            onRemoveWorld: (w) {
              setState(() => _importedWorlds.removeWhere((x) => x.id == w.id));
              setModalState(() {});
            },
            onRemoveCharacter: (c) {
              setState(() =>
                  _importedCharacters.removeWhere((x) => x.id == c.id));
              setModalState(() {});
            },
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showPostActions(RPPost post) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      builder: (_) => Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
          Container(
              width: 32,
              height: 3,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: cAsh, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2))),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          _actionTile(Icons.format_quote, 'Quote this post', () {
            Navigator.pop(context);
            _quotePost(post.id);
          }),
          _actionTile(Icons.menu_book_outlined, 'Add to log', () {
            Navigator.pop(context);
            _addToLogFromText(post.content);
          }),
          if (post.isUser) ...[
            _actionTile(Icons.edit_outlined, 'Edit post', () {
              Navigator.pop(context);
              _editPost(post);
            }),
            _actionTile(Icons.delete_outline, 'Delete post', () {
              Navigator.pop(context);
              _deletePost(post.id);
            }, color: cEmber),
          ],
          _actionTile(Icons.copy, 'Copy text', () {
            Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: post.content));
            Navigator.pop(context);
            ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
                backgroundColor: cInk,
                content: Text('Copied',
                    style: TextStyle(color: cParchment))));
          }),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _actionTile(IconData icon, String label, VoidCallback onTap,
      {Color color = cMist}) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: onTap,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
        child: Row(children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 18, color: color),
          const SizedBox(width: 16),
          Text(label,
              style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 14,
                  color: color,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showCharacterSwitcher() {
    final characters = [null, ..._importedCharacters];
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      builder: (_) => Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Container(
                  width: 32,
                  height: 3,
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 20, left: 0),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: cAsh,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2))),
              Row(children: [
                const Text('WRITING AS',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 9,
                        color: cSmoke,
                        letterSpacing: 3)),
                const Spacer(),
                if (_activeCharacter != null)
                  GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () {
                      setState(() => _activeCharacter = null);
                      Navigator.pop(context);
                    },
                    child: const Text('Reset to self',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 9,
                            color: cSmoke,
                            decoration: TextDecoration.underline)),
                  ),
              ]),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              if (characters.length == 1)
                const Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
                  child: Text(
                      'Import characters from the Tools panel first to use character switching.',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13,
                          color: cSmoke,
                          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                          height: 1.6)),
                ),
              ...characters.map((c) {
                final isSelected = c == null
                    ? _activeCharacter == null
                    : _activeCharacter?.id == c.id;
                return GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () {
                    setState(() => _activeCharacter = c);
                    Navigator.pop(context);
                    if (c != null && widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
                      _log.addEvent(
                        title: 'Writing as ${c.name}',
                        body: 'Switched to ${c.name}.',
                        source: 'character',
                        meta: {
                          'characterId': c.id,
                          'characterName': c.name,
                        },
                      );
                    }
                  },
                  child: Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      border: Border.all(
                          color: isSelected
                              ? (c?.accentColor ?? cGold)
                              : cAsh),
                      color: isSelected
                          ? (c?.accentColor ?? cGold).withValues(alpha: 0.06)
                          : Colors.transparent,
                    ),
                    child: Row(children: [
                      Container(
                          width: 10,
                          height: 10,
                          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 12),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                              color: c?.accentColor ?? cParchment,
                              border: Border.all(color: cAsh))),
                      Expanded(
                          child: Text(c?.name ?? 'Myself',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 14,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                                  fontStyle: c != null
                                      ? FontStyle.italic
                                      : FontStyle.normal,
                                  color: isSelected
                                      ? (c?.accentColor ?? cGold)
                                      : cMist))),
                      if (isSelected)
                        Icon(Icons.check,
                            size: 14, color: c?.accentColor ?? cGold),
                    ]),
                  ),
                );
              }),
            ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCollapsedEditor() {
    final charColor = _activeCharacter?.accentColor ?? cGold;
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
          border: const Border(top: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
      child: Row(children: [
        Expanded(
          child: GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => setState(() => _editorExpanded = true),
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  border: Border.all(color: cAsh), color: cInk),
              child: Text(
                _draftSaved ? 'Draft restored...' : 'Continue the story...',
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14,
                    color: _draftSaved
                        ? charColor.withValues(alpha: 0.6)
                        : cSmoke,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        GestureDetector(
          onTap: _showCharacterSwitcher,
          child: Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: 10, vertical: 12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              border: Border.all(
                  color: _activeCharacter != null
                      ? charColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
                      : cAsh),
              color: _activeCharacter != null
                  ? charColor.withValues(alpha: 0.08)
                  : Colors.transparent,
            ),
            child: Icon(Icons.person_outline,
                size: 16,
                color:
                    _activeCharacter != null ? charColor : cSmoke),
          ),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFullEditor() {
    final charColor = _activeCharacter?.accentColor ?? _fontColor;
    final displayName = _activeCharacter?.name ?? 'You';
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
          border: const Border(top: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
      child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
        if (_editingPostId != null)
          Container(
            padding:
                const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 6),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: cIce.withValues(alpha: 0.06),
              border: Border(
                  bottom: BorderSide(color: cIce.withValues(alpha: 0.2))),
            ),
            child: Row(children: [
              const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, size: 12, color: cIce),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              const Text('editing post',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 9,
                      color: cIce,
                      letterSpacing: 2)),
              const Spacer(),
              LoreTap(
                onTap: () => setState(() {
                  _editingPostId = null;
                  _editorCtrl.text = '';
                }),
                child: const Text('cancel',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 8,
                        color: cSmoke,
                        letterSpacing: 1)),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
        if (_activeCharacter != null)
          Container(
            padding:
                const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 6),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: charColor.withValues(alpha: 0.06),
              border: Border(
                  bottom:
                      BorderSide(color: charColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2))),
            ),
            child: Row(children: [
              Container(
                  width: 8,
                  height: 8,
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      shape: BoxShape.circle, color: charColor)),
              Text(displayName,
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 9,
                      color: charColor,
                      letterSpacing: 2)),
              const Spacer(),
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => setState(() => _activeCharacter = null),
                child: const Text('exit character',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 8,
                        color: cSmoke,
                        letterSpacing: 1)),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
        if (_availableLocations.isNotEmpty)
          Container(
            padding:
                const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 6),
            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
            child: Row(children: [
              const Icon(Icons.location_on_outlined,
                  size: 12, color: cSmoke),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Expanded(
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  child: Row(children: [
                    GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () => setState(() => _activeLocation = null),
                      child: Container(
                        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: _activeLocation == null
                              ? cSmoke.withValues(alpha: 0.2)
                              : Colors.transparent,
                          border: Border.all(
                              color: _activeLocation == null
                                  ? cSmoke
                                  : cAsh),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                        ),
                        child: const Text('none',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                fontSize: 8,
                                color: cSmoke,
                                letterSpacing: 1)),
                      ),
                    ),
                    ..._availableLocations.map((loc) => GestureDetector(
                          onTap: () {
                            setState(() => _activeLocation = loc);
                            if (widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
                              _log.addEvent(
                                title: 'Location Â· $loc',
                                body: 'The scene moved to $loc.',
                                source: 'location',
                                meta: {'locationName': loc},
                              );
                            }
                          },
                          child: Container(
                            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: _activeLocation == loc
                                  ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.15)
                                  : Colors.transparent,
                              border: Border.all(
                                  color: _activeLocation == loc
                                      ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
                                      : cAsh),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                            ),
                            child: Text(loc,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                    fontSize: 8,
                                    color: _activeLocation == loc
                                        ? cGold
                                        : cSmoke,
                                    letterSpacing: 1)),
                          ),
                        )),
                  ]),
                ),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
        if (_quotingPostId != null) _buildQuotePreview(),
        _buildFormattingBar(),
        Container(
          constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 180),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 0),
          child: ScrollConfiguration(
            behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
            child: Focus(
              onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
                if (!kIsWeb) return KeyEventResult.ignored;
                if (event is KeyDownEvent) {
                  final isEnter = event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter || 
                                  event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.numpadEnter;
                  final isShift = HardwareKeyboard.instance.isShiftPressed;
                  
                  if (isEnter) {
                    if (appSettings.enterToSend && !isShift) {
                      _submitPost();
                      return KeyEventResult.handled;
                    } else if (!appSettings.enterToSend && isShift) {
                      _submitPost();
                      return KeyEventResult.handled;
                    }
                  }
                }
                return KeyEventResult.ignored;
              },
              child: TextField(
                controller: _editorCtrl,
                focusNode: _editorFocus,
                maxLines: null,
                autofocus: true,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: _fontSize,
                  color: _activeCharacter != null ? charColor : _fontColor,
                  fontStyle: _italic ? FontStyle.italic : FontStyle.normal,
                  fontWeight:
                      _bold ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w300,
                  height: 1.8,
                ),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  hintText: 'Write your post...',
                  hintStyle: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14,
                      color: cSmoke,
                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                  border: InputBorder.none,
                ),
                cursorColor: cGold,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 6, 16, 12),
          child: Row(children: [
            Row(children: [
              Text('$_wordCount words',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 10,
                      color: cSmoke,
                      letterSpacing: 1)),
              if (_draftSaved && _editorCtrl.text.isNotEmpty) ...[
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                const Icon(Icons.circle, size: 5, color: cVine),
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                const Text('saved',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 8,
                        color: cVine,
                        letterSpacing: 1)),
              ],
            ]),
            const Spacer(),
            GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => setState(() {
                _editorExpanded = false;
                _quotingPostId = null;
                _editingPostId = null;
                _editorCtrl.text = '';
              }),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
                decoration:
                    BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                child: const Text('Cancel',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 10,
                        color: cSmoke,
                        letterSpacing: 1)),
              ),
            ),
            LoreTap(
              onTap: _submitPost,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
                color: _editorCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty
                    ? cAsh
                    : _editingPostId != null
                        ? cIce.withValues(alpha: 0.8)
                        : cParchment,
                child: Text(
                  _editingPostId != null ? 'Save' : 'Post',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 10,
                      color: _editorCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty
                          ? cSmoke
                          : cVoid,
                      letterSpacing: 1),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ]),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  int get _wordCount {
    final text = _editorCtrl.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return 0;
    return text.split(RegExp(r'\s+')).length;
  }

  Widget _buildQuotePreview() {
    RPPost? post;
    for (final p in _posts) {
      if (p.id == _quotingPostId) {
        post = p;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (post == null) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted && _quotingPostId != null) {
          setState(() => _quotingPostId = null);
        }
      });
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }
    final preview = post.content.substring(
        0, min(80, post.content.length));
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 0),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          border: Border(left: BorderSide(color: cSmoke, width: 2))),
      child: Row(children: [
        Expanded(
            child: Text(
                '${post.characterName ?? post.author}: $preview...',
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    color: cSmoke,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic))),
        GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => setState(() => _quotingPostId = null),
            child: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 14, color: cSmoke)),
      ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFormattingBar() {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
      child: Row(children: [
        GestureDetector(
          onTap: _showCharacterSwitcher,
          child: Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
            padding:
                const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: _activeCharacter != null
                  ? (_activeCharacter!.accentColor).withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                  : Colors.transparent,
              border: Border.all(
                  color: _activeCharacter != null
                      ? _activeCharacter!.accentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
                      : cAsh),
            ),
            child: Row(children: [
              Icon(Icons.person_outline,
                  size: 12,
                  color: _activeCharacter != null
                      ? _activeCharacter!.accentColor
                      : cSmoke),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              Text(
                _activeCharacter?.name ?? 'Self',
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontSize: 9,
                    letterSpacing: 1,
                    color: _activeCharacter != null
