                        ? _activeCharacter!.accentColor
                        : cSmoke),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 4),
        _fmtBtn('B', _bold, () => setState(() => _bold = !_bold),
            style: const TextStyle(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                fontSize: 13,
                color: cMist)),
        _fmtBtn('I', _italic, () => setState(() => _italic = !_italic),
            style: const TextStyle(
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                fontSize: 13,
                color: cMist)),
        const SizedBox(width: 6),
        _fmtLabel('Size'),
        ...[12.0, 14.0, 16.0, 18.0, 22.0].map((s) => _fmtBtn(
            s.toInt().toString(),
            _fontSize == s,
            () => setState(() => _fontSize = s),
            style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 10,
                color: cMist,
                fontFamily: 'monospace'))),
        if (_activeCharacter == null) ...[
          const SizedBox(width: 6),
          _fmtLabel('Colour'),
          ...[
            cParchment,
            cGold,
            cIce,
            cEmber,
            cMagic,
            cVine,
            Colors.white,
            const Color(0xFFa0c4a0)
          ].map((c) => GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => setState(() => _fontColor = c),
                child: Container(
                    width: 20,
                    height: 20,
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: c,
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        border: Border.all(
                            color: _fontColor == c
                                ? Colors.white
                                : Colors.transparent,
                            width: 2))),
              )),
        ],
      ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _fmtBtn(String label, bool active, VoidCallback onTap,
      {TextStyle? style}) {
    return LoreTap(
      onTap: onTap,
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: active ? cAsh : Colors.transparent,
            border: Border.all(color: active ? cSmoke : cAsh)),
        child: Text(label,
            style: style ?? const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cMist)),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _fmtLabel(String t) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6),
      child: Text(t,
          style: const TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'monospace',
              fontSize: 9,
              color: cSmoke,
              letterSpacing: 2)),
    );
  }

    Widget _buildOOCPanel() {
    return Positioned(
      left: 0,
      right: 0,
      bottom: 0,
      child: Container(
        height: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.55,
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            color: cInk,
            border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
        child: Column(children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
            child: Row(children: [
              const Text('OOC',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 11,
                      color: cIce,
                      letterSpacing: 4)),
              const Spacer(),
              GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => setState(() => _oocOpen = false),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.close,
                      color: cSmoke, size: 18)),
            ]),
          ),
          const Divider(color: cAsh, height: 1),
          Expanded(
            child: ScrollConfiguration(
              behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
              child: ListView.builder(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                itemCount: _oocMessages.length,
                itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                  final msg = _oocMessages[i];
                  return Align(
                    alignment: msg.isUser
                        ? Alignment.centerRight
                        : Alignment.centerLeft,
                    child: Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                      constraints: BoxConstraints(
                          maxWidth:
                              MediaQuery.of(context).size.width * 0.75),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: msg.isUser ? cAsh : cVoid,
                          border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                      child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            if (!msg.isUser)
                              Text(msg.author,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                      fontSize: 9,
                                      color: appSettings
                                              .textColourFor(
                                                  'partner_name') ??
                                          cIce,
                                      letterSpacing: 2)),
                            Text(msg.content,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 13,
                                    color: appSettings
                                            .textColourFor('ooc') ??
                                        cMist,
                                    height: 1.5)),
                          ]),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 16),
            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
            child: Row(children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Focus(
                  onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
                    if (!kIsWeb) return KeyEventResult.ignored;
                    if (event is KeyDownEvent) {
                      final isEnter = event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter || 
                                      event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.numpadEnter;
                      final isShift = HardwareKeyboard.instance.isShiftPressed;
                      if (isEnter) {
                        if (appSettings.enterToSend && !isShift) {
                          _sendOocMessage();
                          return KeyEventResult.handled;
                        } else if (!appSettings.enterToSend && isShift) {
                          _sendOocMessage();
                          return KeyEventResult.handled;
                        }
                      }
                    }
                    return KeyEventResult.ignored;
                  },
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: _oocCtrl,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13, color: cParchment),
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'Out of character...',
                        hintStyle: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke),
                        border: InputBorder.none),
                    cursorColor: cIce,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              LoreTap(
                onTap: _sendOocMessage,
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
                  color: cAsh,
                  child: const Text('Send',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'monospace',
                          fontSize: 10,
                          color: cMist,
                          letterSpacing: 1)),
                ),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _modeBtn(RPDisplayMode mode, IconData icon, String label) {
    final active = _displayMode == mode;
    return Expanded(
        child: GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => setState(() {
        _displayMode = mode;
        _settingsOpen = false;
      }),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: active ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.1) : Colors.transparent,
          border: Border.all(color: active ? cGold : cAsh),
        ),
        child: Column(children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 16, color: active ? cGold : cSmoke),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Text(label,
              style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  fontSize: 8,
                  letterSpacing: 1,
                  color: active ? cGold : cSmoke)),
        ]),
      ),
    ));
  }

  Widget _settingToggle(
      String label, bool value, ValueChanged<bool> onChanged) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
      child: Row(children: [
        Text(label,
            style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 12,
                color: cMist,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
        const Spacer(),
        GestureDetector(
          onTap: () => onChanged(!value),
          child: AnimatedContainer(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
            width: 36,
            height: 20,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: value ? cGold : cAsh,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
            child: AnimatedAlign(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
              alignment:
                  value ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
              child: Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
                  width: 16,
                  height: 16,
                  decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                      color: cVoid, shape: BoxShape.circle)),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

    Widget _buildOOCDesktopWidget() {
    return Column(children: [
      Expanded(
        child: ScrollConfiguration(
          behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
          child: ListView.builder(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            itemCount: _oocMessages.length,
            itemBuilder: (_, i) {
              final msg = _oocMessages[i];
              return Align(
                alignment: msg.isUser ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
                child: Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 260),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: msg.isUser ? cAsh : cVoid,
                      border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                  child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        if (!msg.isUser)
                          Text(msg.author, style: TextStyle(
                                  fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                                  color: appSettings.textColourFor('partner_name') ?? cIce,
                                  letterSpacing: 2)),
                        Text(msg.content, style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13,
                                color: appSettings.textColourFor('ooc') ?? cMist,
                                height: 1.5)),
                      ]),
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      ),
      Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 16),
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
        child: Row(children: [
          Expanded(
            child: Focus(
              onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
                if (!kIsWeb) return KeyEventResult.ignored;
                if (event is KeyDownEvent) {
                  final isEnter = event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter || 
                                  event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.numpadEnter;
                  final isShift = HardwareKeyboard.instance.isShiftPressed;
                  if (isEnter) {
                    if (appSettings.enterToSend && !isShift) {
                      _sendOocMessage();
                      return KeyEventResult.handled;
                    } else if (!appSettings.enterToSend && isShift) {
                      _sendOocMessage();
                      return KeyEventResult.handled;
                    }
                  }
                }
                return KeyEventResult.ignored;
              },
              child: TextField(
                controller: _oocCtrl,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cParchment),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'Out of character...',
                    hintStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke),
                    border: InputBorder.none),
                cursorColor: cIce,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          LoreTap(
            onTap: () async {
              final text = _oocCtrl.text.trim();
              if (text.isEmpty) return;
              sounds.play(SoundKey.oocMsg);
              if (widget.sessionId.isNotEmpty) {
                try {
                  await _fs.addOocMessage(sessionId: widget.sessionId, content: text);
                  _oocCtrl.clear();
                } catch (e) {
                  if (mounted) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
                        backgroundColor: cInk,
                        content: Text('Send failed: $e', style: const TextStyle(color: cParchment))));
                  }
                }
              } else {
                _oocCtrl.clear();
                setState(() => _oocMessages.add(OOCMessage(
                    author: _auth.currentName ?? 'You',
                    content: text,
                    isUser: true,
                    timestamp: DateTime.now())));
              }
            },
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
              color: cAsh,
              child: const Text('Send', style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10, color: cMist, letterSpacing: 1)),
            ),
          ),
        ]),
      ),
    ]);
  }
  }
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// POST CARD (Cards mode)
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
class _PostCard extends StatefulWidget {
  final RPPost post;
  final bool isExpanded;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final VoidCallback onLongPress;
  final void Function(String selectedText)? onAddToLog;
  final void Function(String selectedText)? onSelectionChanged;

  const _PostCard({
    required this.post,
    required this.isExpanded,
    required this.onTap,
    required this.onLongPress,
    this.onAddToLog,
    this.onSelectionChanged,
  });

  @override
  State<_PostCard> createState() => _PostCardState();
}

class _PostCardState extends State<_PostCard>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _ctrl;
  late Animation<double> _expand;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ctrl = AnimationController(
        vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300));
    _expand = CurvedAnimation(parent: _ctrl, curve: Curves.easeInOut);
    if (widget.isExpanded) _ctrl.value = 1;
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(_PostCard old) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(old);
    if (widget.isExpanded != old.isExpanded) {
      if (widget.isExpanded) {
        _ctrl.forward();
      } else {
        _ctrl.reverse();
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _ctrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final post = widget.post;
    final preview = post.content.length > 120
        ? '${post.content.substring(0, 120)}...'
        : post.content;
    final nameColor = post.isUser
        ? (post.textColor == cParchment ? cGold : post.textColor)
        : cMist;

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: widget.onTap,
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFF08080A).withValues(alpha: 0.82),
          border: Border(
            left: BorderSide(
                color: post.isUser ? nameColor : cSmoke,
                width: post.isUser ? 2 : 1),
            top: const BorderSide(color: cAsh),
            right: const BorderSide(color: cAsh),
            bottom: const BorderSide(color: cAsh),
          ),
        ),
        child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              if (post.quotedContent != null)
                Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 10, 12, 0),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                  decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                      border: Border(
                          left: BorderSide(color: cSmoke, width: 2))),
                  child: Text(
                      '${post.quotedAuthor ?? ""}: ${post.quotedContent}...',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: cSmoke,
                          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                ),
              GestureDetector(
                onLongPress: widget.onLongPress,
                behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 10, 12, 6),
                  child: Row(children: [
                    Text(post.characterName ?? post.author,
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 10,
                            color: nameColor,
                            letterSpacing: 2)),
                    if (post.locationName != null) ...[
                      const Text(' Â· ',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontFamily: 'monospace',
                              fontSize: 10,
                              color: cSmoke)),
                      Text(post.locationName!,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              fontFamily: 'monospace',
                              fontSize: 10,
                              color: cSmoke,
                              letterSpacing: 1)),
                    ],
                    const Spacer(),
                    Text('${post.wordCount} words',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 9,
                            color: cSmoke,
                            letterSpacing: 1)),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    AnimatedRotation(
                        turns: widget.isExpanded ? 0.5 : 0,
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
                        child: const Icon(Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                            size: 14, color: cSmoke)),
                  ]),
                ),
              ),
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 10),
                child: _selectablePostText(
                  text: preview,
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: post.fontSize,
                      color: post.textColor.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
                      fontStyle: post.italic
                          ? FontStyle.italic
                          : FontStyle.normal,
                      fontWeight:
                          post.bold ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w300,
                      height: 1.7),
                  onAddToLog: widget.onAddToLog ?? (_) {},
                  onSelectionChanged: widget.onSelectionChanged,
                ),
              ),
              SizeTransition(
                sizeFactor: _expand,
                child: Container(
                  decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                      border:
                          Border(top: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 10, 12, 12),
                  child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        _selectablePostText(
                          text: post.content,
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: post.fontSize,
                              color: post.textColor,
                              fontStyle: post.italic
                                  ? FontStyle.italic
                                  : FontStyle.normal,
                              fontWeight: post.bold
                                  ? FontWeight.bold
                                  : FontWeight.w300,
                              height: 1.9),
                          onAddToLog: widget.onAddToLog ?? (_) {},
                          onSelectionChanged: widget.onSelectionChanged,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 10),
                        Text(
                          '${post.timestamp.hour
                                  .toString()
                                  .padLeft(2, '0')}:${post.timestamp.minute
                                  .toString()
                                  .padLeft(2, '0')}',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              fontFamily: 'monospace',
                              fontSize: 9,
                              color: cSmoke,
                              letterSpacing: 2),
                        ),
                      ]),
                ),
              ),
            ]),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../settings.dart';
import '../models/world.dart';
import '../services/firestore_service.dart';
import '../services/sandbox_sync.dart';
import '../widgets/colour_picker.dart';

// SandboxStorage is defined in world.dart

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// SANDBOX SCREEN  (top-level, two tabs)
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class SandboxScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SandboxScreen({super.key});
  @override State<SandboxScreen> createState() => _SandboxScreenState();
}

class _SandboxScreenState extends State<SandboxScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
     final _fs = FirestoreService();
  late TabController _tab;
  List<WorldEntry> _worlds = [];
  List<CharacterEntry> _characters = [];
  bool _loaded = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tab = TabController(length: 2, vsync: this);
    appSettings.addListener(_rebuild);
    _loadData();
  }

  Future<void> _loadData() async {
    final worlds = await SandboxStorage.loadWorlds();
    final chars  = await SandboxStorage.loadCharacters();
    if (mounted) setState(() { _worlds = worlds; _characters = chars; _loaded = true; });
  }

  void _rebuild() { if (mounted) setState(() {}); }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    appSettings.removeListener(_rebuild);
    _tab.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    backgroundColor: appSettings.bgColor,
    body: SafeArea(child: Column(children: [
      _buildTopBar(),
      _buildTabBar(),
      Expanded(child: !_loaded
        ? const Center(child: SizedBox(width: 20, height: 20,
            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 1.5, color: cSmoke)))
        : TabBarView(
          controller: _tab,
          children: [
            _WorldsTab(worlds: _worlds, onAdd: _addWorld,
                onEdit: _editWorld, onDelete: _deleteWorld),
            _CharactersTab(characters: _characters, worlds: _worlds,
                onAdd: _addCharacter, onEdit: _editCharacter,
                onDelete: _deleteCharacter),
          ],
        )),
    ])),
    floatingActionButton: _buildFAB(),
  );

  Widget _buildTopBar() => Container(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
    decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
    child: Row(children: [
      GestureDetector(
        onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        child: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios, color: cSmoke, size: 16),
      ),
      const SizedBox(width: 12),
      const Text('Sandbox', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
          color: cParchment)),
      const Spacer(),
      const Text('L o r e', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
          color: cGold, letterSpacing: 5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
    ]),
  );

  Widget _buildTabBar() => Container(
    decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
    child: TabBar(
      controller: _tab,
      indicatorColor: cGold,
      indicatorWeight: 1,
      labelColor: cGold,
      unselectedLabelColor: cSmoke,
      labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
          fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: 3),
      tabs: const [Tab(text: 'WORLDS'), Tab(text: 'CHARACTERS')],
    ),
  );

  Widget _buildFAB() => AnimatedBuilder(
    animation: _tab,
    builder: (_, _) => GestureDetector(
      onTap: _tab.index == 0 ? _addWorld : _addCharacter,
      child: Container(
        width: 52, height: 52,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: cInk, border: Border.all(color: cGold),
            shape: BoxShape.circle),
        child: const Icon(Icons.add, color: cGold, size: 22),
      ),
    ),
  );

  // â”€â”€ World CRUD â”€â”€
  void _addWorld() => _openWorldEditor(null);
  void _editWorld(WorldEntry w) => _openWorldEditor(w);
  void _deleteWorld(String id) {
    setState(() => _worlds.removeWhere((w) => w.id == id));
    SandboxStorage.saveWorlds(_worlds);
    SandboxSync.pushWorlds(_worlds);
    _fs.incrementUserCounter('worldsCreated', -1);
  }

  void _openWorldEditor(WorldEntry? existing) {
    Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(WorldEditorScreen(
      world: existing,
      onSave: (w) {
        final isNew = existing == null;
        setState(() {
          if (existing != null) {
            final i = _worlds.indexWhere((x) => x.id == existing.id);
            if (i != -1) {
              _worlds[i] = w;
            } else {
              _worlds.insert(0, w);
            }
          } else {
            _worlds.insert(0, w);
          }
        });
        SandboxStorage.saveWorlds(_worlds);
        SandboxSync.pushWorlds(_worlds);
        if (isNew) _fs.incrementUserCounter('worldsCreated', 1);
      },
    )));
  }

  // â”€â”€ Character CRUD â”€â”€
  void _addCharacter() => _openCharacterEditor(null);
  void _editCharacter(CharacterEntry c) => _openCharacterEditor(c);
  void _deleteCharacter(String id) {
    setState(() => _characters.removeWhere((c) => c.id == id));
    SandboxStorage.saveCharacters(_characters);
    SandboxSync.pushCharacters(_characters);
    _fs.incrementUserCounter('charactersCreated', -1);
  }

  void _openCharacterEditor(CharacterEntry? existing) {
    Navigator.of(context).push(fadeRoute(CharacterEditorScreen(
      character: existing,
      worlds: _worlds,
      onSave: (c) {
        final isNew = existing == null;
        setState(() {
          if (existing != null) {
            final i = _characters.indexWhere((x) => x.id == existing.id);
            if (i != -1) {
              _characters[i] = c;
            } else {
              _characters.insert(0, c);
            }
          } else {
            _characters.insert(0, c);
          }
        });
        SandboxStorage.saveCharacters(_characters);
        SandboxSync.pushCharacters(_characters);
        if (isNew) _fs.incrementUserCounter('charactersCreated', 1);
      },
    )));
  }
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// WORLDS TAB
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class _WorldsTab extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<WorldEntry> worlds;
  final VoidCallback onAdd;
  final void Function(WorldEntry) onEdit;
  final void Function(String) onDelete;
  const _WorldsTab({required this.worlds, required this.onAdd,
      required this.onEdit, required this.onDelete});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (worlds.isEmpty) {
      return _emptyState('No worlds yet.',
        'Tap + to start building one.');
    }
    return ScrollConfiguration(
      behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
      child: ListView.builder(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        itemCount: worlds.length,
        itemBuilder: (_, i) => _WorldCard(
          world: worlds[i],
          onTap: () => onEdit(worlds[i]),
          onDelete: () => onDelete(worlds[i].id),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _WorldCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final WorldEntry world;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final VoidCallback onDelete;
  const _WorldCard({required this.world, required this.onTap,
      required this.onDelete});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => GestureDetector(
    onTap: onTap,
    onLongPress: () => _showActions(context),
    child: Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: cInk,
          border: Border.all(color: world.isDraft ? cAsh : cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.4))),
      child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        Row(children: [
          Expanded(child: Text(world.name, style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, color: cParchment))),
          if (world.isDraft)
            Container(padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                child: const Text('DRAFT', style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 8,
                    color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
        ]),
        if (world.genre.isNotEmpty) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Text(world.genre, style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
              fontSize: 10, color: cGold, letterSpacing: 2)),
        ],
        if (world.overview.isNotEmpty) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Text(world.overview.length > 120
              ? '${world.overview.substring(0, 120)}...'
              : world.overview,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.6)),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        Row(children: [
          _pill('${world.locations.length} locations', cSmoke),
          const SizedBox(width: 6),
          _pill('${world.factions.length} factions', cSmoke),
          const Spacer(),
          const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, color: cSmoke, size: 16),
        ]),
      ]),
    ),
  );

  Widget _pill(String label, Color color) => Container(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
    decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.4))),
    child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
        fontSize: 9, color: color, letterSpacing: 1)),
  );

  void _showActions(BuildContext context) => showModalBottomSheet(
    context: context,
    backgroundColor: cInk,
    builder: (_) => Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
      child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
        Container(width: 32, height: 3,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(color: cAsh,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2))),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
        _sheetAction(context, Icons.edit_outlined, 'Edit world', onTap),
        _sheetAction(context, Icons.delete_outline, 'Delete world',
            onDelete, color: cEmber),
      ]),
    ),
  );
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// CHARACTERS TAB
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class _CharactersTab extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<CharacterEntry> characters;
  final List<WorldEntry> worlds;
  final VoidCallback onAdd;
  final void Function(CharacterEntry) onEdit;
  final void Function(String) onDelete;
  const _CharactersTab({required this.characters, required this.worlds,
      required this.onAdd, required this.onEdit, required this.onDelete});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (characters.isEmpty) {
      return _emptyState('No characters yet.',
        'Tap + to create one.');
    }
    return ScrollConfiguration(
      behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
      child: ListView.builder(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        itemCount: characters.length,
        itemBuilder: (_, i) {
          final c = characters[i];
          final linkedWorld = worlds
              .where((w) => w.id == c.linkedWorldId)
              .firstOrNull;
          return _CharacterCard(
            character: c,
            linkedWorld: linkedWorld,
            onTap: () => onEdit(c),
            onDelete: () => onDelete(c.id),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _CharacterCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final CharacterEntry character;
  final WorldEntry? linkedWorld;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final VoidCallback onDelete;
  const _CharacterCard({required this.character, required this.linkedWorld,
      required this.onTap, required this.onDelete});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => GestureDetector(
    onTap: onTap,
    onLongPress: () => _showActions(context),
    child: Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: cInk,
          border: Border(
            left: BorderSide(color: character.accentColor, width: 2),
            top: const BorderSide(color: cAsh),
            right: const BorderSide(color: cAsh),
            bottom: const BorderSide(color: cAsh),
          )),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Row(children: [
          // Initials circle
          Container(
            width: 44, height: 44,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                border: Border.all(color: character.accentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5))),
            child: Center(child: Text(
                character.name.isNotEmpty
                    ? character.name[0].toUpperCase() : '?',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, color: character.accentColor,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w300))),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 14),
          Expanded(child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
            Row(children: [
              Text(character.name, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                  color: cParchment)),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    border: Border.all(color: character.type ==
                        CharacterType.playerCharacter
                        ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.4) : cMagic.withValues(alpha: 0.4))),
                child: Text(
                    character.type == CharacterType.playerCharacter
                        ? 'PC' : 'NPC',
                    style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 8,
                        letterSpacing: 1,
                        color: character.type == CharacterType.playerCharacter
                            ? cGold : cMagic)),
              ),
            ]),
            if (character.pronouns.isNotEmpty || character.age.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 3),
              Text([
                if (character.pronouns.isNotEmpty) character.pronouns,
                if (character.age.isNotEmpty) character.age,
              ].join(' Â· '), style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
            ],
            if (linkedWorld != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text('â†³ ${linkedWorld!.name}', style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 11, color: cSmoke, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
            ],
          ])),
          const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, color: cSmoke, size: 16),
        ]),
      ),
    ),
  );

  void _showActions(BuildContext context) => showModalBottomSheet(
    context: context,
    backgroundColor: cInk,
    builder: (_) => Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
      child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
        Container(width: 32, height: 3,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(color: cAsh,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2))),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
        _sheetAction(context, Icons.edit_outlined, 'Edit character', onTap),
        _sheetAction(context, Icons.delete_outline, 'Delete character',
            onDelete, color: cEmber),
      ]),
    ),
  );
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// WORLD EDITOR SCREEN
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class WorldEditorScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final WorldEntry? world;
  final void Function(WorldEntry) onSave;
  const WorldEditorScreen({super.key, this.world, required this.onSave});
  @override State<WorldEditorScreen> createState() => _WorldEditorScreenState();
}

class _WorldEditorScreenState extends State<WorldEditorScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late TabController _tab;
  late WorldEntry _working;

  // Controllers for each field
  late TextEditingController _nameCtrl, _genreCtrl, _overviewCtrl,
      _toneCtrl, _historyCtrl, _rulesCtrl, _notesCtrl;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tab = TabController(length: 5, vsync: this);
    final w = widget.world;
    _working = w != null
        ? WorldEntry(
            id: w.id, name: w.name, genre: w.genre,
            overview: w.overview, tone: w.tone,
            locations: List.from(w.locations),
            factions: List.from(w.factions),
            history: w.history, rules: w.rules,
            notes: w.notes, isDraft: w.isDraft)
        : WorldEntry(id: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
            name: '');
    _nameCtrl     = TextEditingController(text: _working.name);
    _genreCtrl    = TextEditingController(text: _working.genre);
    _overviewCtrl = TextEditingController(text: _working.overview);
    _toneCtrl     = TextEditingController(text: _working.tone);
    _historyCtrl  = TextEditingController(text: _working.history);
    _rulesCtrl    = TextEditingController(text: _working.rules);
    _notesCtrl    = TextEditingController(text: _working.notes);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tab.dispose();
    for (final c in [_nameCtrl, _genreCtrl, _overviewCtrl,
        _toneCtrl, _historyCtrl, _rulesCtrl, _notesCtrl]) {
      c.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _save() {
    _working.name     = _nameCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.genre    = _genreCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.overview = _overviewCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.tone     = _toneCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.history  = _historyCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.rules    = _rulesCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.notes    = _notesCtrl.text.trim();
    widget.onSave(_working);
    Navigator.of(context).pop();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    backgroundColor: appSettings.bgColor,
    body: SafeArea(child: Column(children: [
      // Header
      Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
        child: Row(children: [
          GestureDetector(onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
              child: const Icon(Icons.close, color: cSmoke, size: 18)),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(child: TextField(
            controller: _nameCtrl,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, color: cParchment,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'World name...',
                hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cSmoke, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                    fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300),
                border: InputBorder.none),
            cursorColor: cGold,
          )),
          Row(children: [
            GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _working.isDraft = !_working.isDraft),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    border: Border.all(color: _working.isDraft ? cAsh : cGold)),
                child: Text(_working.isDraft ? 'DRAFT' : 'READY',
                    style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                        letterSpacing: 2,
                        color: _working.isDraft ? cSmoke : cGold)),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            GestureDetector(onTap: _save,
                child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
                    color: cParchment,
                    child: const Text('Save', style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                        color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 1)))),
          ]),
        ]),
      ),
      // Tab bar
      Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
        child: TabBar(
          controller: _tab,
          isScrollable: true,
          indicatorColor: cGold,
          indicatorWeight: 1,
          labelColor: cGold,
          unselectedLabelColor: cSmoke,
          labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
              fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 2),
          tabs: const [
            Tab(text: 'OVERVIEW'),
            Tab(text: 'LOCATIONS'),
            Tab(text: 'FACTIONS'),
            Tab(text: 'HISTORY'),
            Tab(text: 'RULES'),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      Expanded(child: TabBarView(controller: _tab, children: [
        // Overview tab
        _editorScrollable([
          _field('Genre', _genreCtrl, hint: 'e.g. Dark Fantasy, Sci-Fi Noir'),
          _field('Overview', _overviewCtrl, maxLines: 6,
              hint: 'The world in a paragraph...'),
          _field('Tone', _toneCtrl,
              hint: 'e.g. Dark, morally grey, slow burn'),
        ]),
        // Locations
        _ListEditor<WorldLocation>(
          items: _working.locations,
          labelField: (l) => l.name,
          descField: (l) => l.description,
          emptyLabel: 'No locations yet',
          addLabel: 'Add location',
          newItem: () => WorldLocation(name: ''),
          onUpdate: () => setState(() {}),
        ),
        // Factions
        _ListEditor<WorldFaction>(
          items: _working.factions,
          labelField: (f) => f.name,
          descField: (f) => f.description,
          emptyLabel: 'No factions yet',
          addLabel: 'Add faction',
          newItem: () => WorldFaction(name: ''),
          onUpdate: () => setState(() {}),
        ),
        // History
        _editorScrollable([
          _field('History', _historyCtrl, maxLines: 12,
              hint: 'What happened before the story begins...'),
        ]),
        // Rules
        _editorScrollable([
          _field('World rules', _rulesCtrl, maxLines: 12,
              hint: 'Magic systems, physical laws, what death means here...'),
        ]),
      ])),
    ])),
  );

  Widget _editorScrollable(List<Widget> children) =>
      ScrollConfiguration(behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          child: Column(children: children)));

  Widget _field(String label, TextEditingController ctrl,
      {int maxLines = 1, String hint = ''}) =>
      Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        Text(label.toUpperCase(), style: const TextStyle(
            fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
            color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3)),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        TextField(
          controller: ctrl,
          maxLines: maxLines,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: cParchment,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.7),
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            hintText: hint,
            hintStyle: const TextStyle(color: cSmoke,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, fontSize: 13),
            enabledBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
                borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
            focusedBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
                borderSide: BorderSide(color: cSmoke)),
            filled: true, fillColor: cInk,
          ),
          cursorColor: cGold,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
      ]);
}

// Generic list editor for locations/factions
class _ListEditor<T> extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<T> items;
  final String Function(T) labelField;
  final String Function(T) descField;
  final String emptyLabel;
  final String addLabel;
  final T Function() newItem;
  final VoidCallback onUpdate;
  const _ListEditor({required this.items, required this.labelField,
      required this.descField, required this.emptyLabel,
      required this.addLabel, required this.newItem,
      required this.onUpdate});
  @override State<_ListEditor<T>> createState() => _ListEditorState<T>();
}

class _ListEditorState<T> extends State<_ListEditor<T>> {
  int? _editingIndex;

  void _setName(T item, String v) {
    if (item is WorldLocation) item.name = v;
    if (item is WorldFaction) item.name = v;
  }

  void _setDesc(T item, String v) {
    if (item is WorldLocation) item.description = v;
    if (item is WorldFaction) item.description = v;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => ScrollConfiguration(
    behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
    child: ListView(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16), children: [
      ...List.generate(widget.items.length, (i) {
        final item = widget.items[i];
        final editing = _editingIndex == i;
        final nameCtrl = TextEditingController(text: widget.labelField(item));
        final descCtrl = TextEditingController(text: widget.descField(item));
        return Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: cInk, border: Border.all(color: editing ? cSmoke : cAsh)),
          child: editing
              ? Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
                  TextField(controller: nameCtrl,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: cParchment,
                          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Name...',
                          hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cSmoke),
                          border: InputBorder.none),
                      cursorColor: cGold,
                      onChanged: (v) => _setName(item, v)),
                  const Divider(color: cAsh),
                  TextField(controller: descCtrl,
                      maxLines: 3,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
                          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.6),
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Description...',
                          hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cSmoke),
                          border: InputBorder.none),
                      cursorColor: cGold,
                      onChanged: (v) => _setDesc(item, v)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Row(children: [
                    GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () {
                        _setName(item, nameCtrl.text);
                        _setDesc(item, descCtrl.text);
                        setState(() => _editingIndex = null);
                        widget.onUpdate();
                      },
                      child: const Text('Done', style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                          color: cGold, letterSpacing: 1)),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () => setState(() {
                        widget.items.removeAt(i);
                        _editingIndex = null;
                        widget.onUpdate();
                      }),
                      child: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline,
                          size: 16, color: cEmber),
                    ),
                  ]),
                ])
              : GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => setState(() => _editingIndex = i),
                  child: Row(children: [
                    Expanded(child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                      Text(widget.labelField(item).isEmpty
                          ? '(unnamed)' : widget.labelField(item),
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14,
                              color: cParchment, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                      if (widget.descField(item).isNotEmpty)
                        Text(widget.descField(item).length > 60
                            ? '${widget.descField(item).substring(0, 60)}...'
                            : widget.descField(item),
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12,
                                color: cSmoke, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                    ])),
                    const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, size: 14, color: cSmoke),
                  ]),
                ),
        );
      }),
      GestureDetector(
        onTap: () => setState(() {
          widget.items.add(widget.newItem());
          _editingIndex = widget.items.length - 1;
        }),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh,
              style: BorderStyle.solid)),
          child: Row(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center, children: [
            const Icon(Icons.add, size: 14, color: cSmoke),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(widget.addLabel, style: const TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2)),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    ]),
  );
}

// CHARACTER EDITOR SCREEN
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class CharacterEditorScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final CharacterEntry? character;
  final List<WorldEntry> worlds;
  final void Function(CharacterEntry) onSave;
  const CharacterEditorScreen({super.key, this.character,
      required this.worlds, required this.onSave});
  @override State<CharacterEditorScreen> createState() =>
      _CharacterEditorScreenState();
}

class _CharacterEditorScreenState extends State<CharacterEditorScreen> {
  late CharacterEntry _working;
  late TextEditingController _nameCtrl, _pronounsCtrl, _ageCtrl,
      _appearanceCtrl, _personalityCtrl, _backstoryCtrl,
      _relationshipsCtrl, _notesCtrl;

  final _accentColors = [
    cGold, cIce, cEmber, cMagic, cVine,
    const Color(0xFFa0c4a0), const Color(0xFFc4a0a0),
    Colors.white70,
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final c = widget.character;
    _working = c != null
        ? CharacterEntry(
            id: c.id, name: c.name, pronouns: c.pronouns, age: c.age,
            appearance: c.appearance, personality: c.personality,
            backstory: c.backstory, relationships: c.relationships,
            notes: c.notes, type: c.type, linkedWorldId: c.linkedWorldId,
            accentColor: c.accentColor)
        : CharacterEntry(id: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
            name: '');
    _nameCtrl          = TextEditingController(text: _working.name);
    _pronounsCtrl      = TextEditingController(text: _working.pronouns);
    _ageCtrl           = TextEditingController(text: _working.age);
    _appearanceCtrl    = TextEditingController(text: _working.appearance);
    _personalityCtrl   = TextEditingController(text: _working.personality);
    _backstoryCtrl     = TextEditingController(text: _working.backstory);
    _relationshipsCtrl = TextEditingController(text: _working.relationships);
    _notesCtrl         = TextEditingController(text: _working.notes);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final c in [_nameCtrl, _pronounsCtrl, _ageCtrl, _appearanceCtrl,
        _personalityCtrl, _backstoryCtrl, _relationshipsCtrl, _notesCtrl]) {
      c.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _save() {
    _working.name          = _nameCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.pronouns      = _pronounsCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.age           = _ageCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.appearance    = _appearanceCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.personality   = _personalityCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.backstory     = _backstoryCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.relationships = _relationshipsCtrl.text.trim();
    _working.notes         = _notesCtrl.text.trim();
    widget.onSave(_working);
    Navigator.of(context).pop();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    backgroundColor: appSettings.bgColor,
    body: SafeArea(child: Column(children: [
      // Header
      Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
                child: Row(children: [
          GestureDetector(onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
              child: const Icon(Icons.close, color: cSmoke, size: 18)),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          // Accent colour dot
          GestureDetector(
            onTap: _pickAccentColor,
            child: Container(width: 20, height: 20,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle, color: _working.accentColor,
                    border: Border.all(color: Colors.white24))),
          ),

          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(child: TextField(
            controller: _nameCtrl,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, color: cParchment,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Character name...',
                hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cSmoke, fontSize: 20,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300),
                border: InputBorder.none),
            cursorColor: cGold,
          )),
          GestureDetector(onTap: _save,
              child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
                  color: cParchment,
                  child: const Text('Save', style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                      color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 1)))),
        ]),
      ),
      // Quick meta row
      Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
        child: Row(children: [
          // PC / NPC toggle
          GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => setState(() => _working.type =
                _working.type == CharacterType.playerCharacter
                    ? CharacterType.npc : CharacterType.playerCharacter),
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(
                  color: _working.type == CharacterType.playerCharacter
                      ? cGold : cMagic)),
              child: Text(_working.type == CharacterType.playerCharacter
                  ? 'Player Character' : 'NPC',
                  style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                      letterSpacing: 2,
                      color: _working.type == CharacterType.playerCharacter
                          ? cGold : cMagic)),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(child: TextField(
              controller: _pronounsCtrl,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke),
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  hintText: 'Pronouns',
                  hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cSmoke, fontSize: 12),
                  border: InputBorder.none, isDense: true),
              cursorColor: cGold)),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          SizedBox(width: 60, child: TextField(
              controller: _ageCtrl,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke),
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  hintText: 'Age',
                  hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cSmoke, fontSize: 12),
                  border: InputBorder.none, isDense: true),
              cursorColor: cGold)),
        ]),
      ),
      // Linked world
      if (widget.worlds.isNotEmpty)
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
              border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: cAsh))),
          child: Row(children: [
            const Text('World', style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 3)),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(child: ScrollConfiguration(
              behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                child: Row(children: [
                  _worldChip(null, 'None'),
                  ...widget.worlds.map((w) => _worldChip(w.id, w.name)),
                ]),
              ),
            )),
          ]),
        ),
      // Fields
      Expanded(child: ScrollConfiguration(
        behavior: NoGlowBehavior(),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          child: Column(children: [
            _field('Appearance', _appearanceCtrl, maxLines: 4),
            _field('Personality', _personalityCtrl, maxLines: 4),
            _field('Backstory', _backstoryCtrl, maxLines: 6),
            _field('Relationships', _relationshipsCtrl, maxLines: 4),
            _field('Notes', _notesCtrl, maxLines: 4),
          ]),
        ),
      )),
    ])),
  );

  Widget _worldChip(String? id, String label) {
    final active = _working.linkedWorldId == id;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => setState(() => _working.linkedWorldId = id),
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            border: Border.all(color: active ? cGold : cAsh),
            color: active ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.1) : Colors.transparent),
        child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
            fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 1,
            color: active ? cGold : cSmoke)),
      ),
    );
  }

    void _pickAccentColor() {
    LoreColourPicker.show(
      context,
      current: _working.accentColor,
      onPicked: (c) {
        setState(() => _working.accentColor = c);
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _field(String label, TextEditingController ctrl, {int maxLines = 1}) =>
      Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        Text(label.toUpperCase(), style: const TextStyle(
            fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
            color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3)),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        TextField(
          controller: ctrl,
          maxLines: maxLines,
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: appSettings.baseFontSize,
              color: cParchment, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.7),
          decoration: const InputDecoration(
            enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
            focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                borderSide: BorderSide(color: cSmoke)),
            filled: true, fillColor: cInk,
          ),
          cursorColor: cGold,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
      ]);
}

    ]));

Widget _sheetAction(BuildContext context, IconData icon, String label,
    VoidCallback onTap, {Color color = cMist}) =>

      onTap: () { Navigator.of(context).pop(); onTap(); },

        child: Row(children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 18, color: color),
          const SizedBox(width: 16),
          Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: color,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
        ]),
      ),
    );
