import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart' as crypto;
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:firebase_messaging/firebase_messaging.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'crypto_service.dart';
import '../models/world.dart';
import '../settings.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show kIsWeb;

class AuthService {
  static final AuthService _instance = AuthService._internal();
  factory AuthService() => _instance;
  AuthService._internal();

  final FirebaseAuth _auth = FirebaseAuth.instance;
  final FirebaseFirestore _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;

  static const _codeKey        = 'lore_user_code';
  static const _nameKey        = 'lore_user_name';
  static const _pinHashKey     = 'lore_pin_hash';
  static const _pinSaltKey     = 'lore_pin_salt';
  static const _pinVersionKey  = 'lore_pin_version';
  static const _pinLengthKey   = 'lore_pin_length';
  static const _lockModeKey    = 'lore_lock_mode';
  static const _lockTimingKey  = 'lore_lock_timing';
  static const _bgTimestampKey = 'lore_bg_timestamp';
  static const _mobileSessionKey = 'lore_mobile_session';
  static const _webSessionKey    = 'lore_web_session';
  static const _biometricsKey = 'lore_biometrics_enabled';

  // â”€â”€ PIN policy â”€â”€
  static const int pinMinLength = 6;
  static const int maxPinAttempts = 5;
  static const Duration lockoutDuration = Duration(minutes: 5);
  static const int _pinIterations = 600000;

  String? _cachedCode;
  String? _cachedName;

  String? get currentCode => _cachedCode;
  String? get currentName => _cachedName;
  User? get firebaseUser => _auth.currentUser;
  bool get isLoggedIn => _auth.currentUser != null && _cachedCode != null;

  final _pbkdf2 = crypto.Pbkdf2(
    macAlgorithm: crypto.Hmac.sha256(),
    iterations: _pinIterations,
    bits: 256,
  );

  // â”€â”€ Code generation â”€â”€
  String _generateCode() {
    const chars = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
    final rand = Random.secure();
    final part1 = List.generate(4, (_) => chars[rand.nextInt(chars.length)]).join();
    final part2 = List.generate(4, (_) => chars[rand.nextInt(chars.length)]).join();
    return 'LR-$part1-$part2';
  }

  List<int> _randomBytes(int length) {
    final rnd = Random.secure();
    return List<int>.generate(length, (_) => rnd.nextInt(256));
  }

  // â”€â”€ PIN hashing â”€â”€
  String _hashPinSha256(String pin) =>
      sha256.convert(utf8.encode(pin)).toString();

  Future<String> _hashPinPbkdf2(String pin, List<int> salt) async {
    final key = await _pbkdf2.deriveKey(
      secretKey: crypto.SecretKey(utf8.encode(pin)),
      nonce: salt,
    );
    final bytes = await key.extractBytes();
    return base64.encode(bytes);
  }

  // â”€â”€ Display name availability â”€â”€
  Future<bool> isNameAvailable(String name) async {
    final query = await _db
        .collection('users')
        .where('displayName', isEqualTo: name.toLowerCase().trim())
        .limit(1)
        .get();
    return query.docs.isEmpty;
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // REGISTER
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  Future<RegisterResult> register(String displayName) async {
    try {
      final name = displayName.trim();
      if (name.isEmpty) return RegisterResult.error('Name cannot be empty.');
      if (name.length < 2 || name.length > 24) {
        return RegisterResult.error('Name must be 2â€“24 characters.');
      }
      if (!RegExp(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+$').hasMatch(name)) {
        return RegisterResult.error('Letters, numbers, _ and - only.');
      }

      if (_auth.currentUser == null) {
        await _auth.signInAnonymously();
      }

      final available = await isNameAvailable(name);
      if (!available) return RegisterResult.error('That name is already taken.');

      String code;
      bool codeExists = true;
      int attempts = 0;
      do {
        code = _generateCode();
        final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(code).get();
        codeExists = doc.exists;
        attempts++;
        if (attempts > 10) {
          return RegisterResult.error('Could not generate a unique code. Try again.');
        }
      } while (codeExists);

      final uid = _auth.currentUser!.uid;

      await _db.collection('users').doc(code).set({
        'code': code,
        'displayName': name.toLowerCase().trim(),
        'displayNameOriginal': name,
        'uid': uid,
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'lastSeen': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'isDiscoverable': true,
        'deviceLocked': true,
        'sessionVersion': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
        'genres': [],
        'bio': '',
        'writingStyle': '',
        'postFrequency': '',
      });

      await _saveLocal(code, name);
      saveFcmToken();
      return RegisterResult.success(code, name);
    } on FirebaseException catch (e) {
      return RegisterResult.error('${e.code}: ${e.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      return RegisterResult.error('Unexpected error: $e');
    }
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // LOGIN
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
    Future<LoginResult> login(String code) async {
    try {
      final clean = code.trim().toUpperCase();
      if (clean.isEmpty) {
        return LoginResult.error('Please enter your code.');
      }

      if (_auth.currentUser == null) {
        await _auth.signInAnonymously();
      }

      final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(clean).get();
      if (!doc.exists) {
        return LoginResult.error('Code not found. Check and try again.');
      }

      final data = doc.data() ?? {};
      final locked = data['deviceLocked'] as bool? ?? false;
      final transferPending = data['transferRequestedAt'] != null;

      if (locked || transferPending) {
        return LoginResult.deviceLocked();
      }

      // Rotate the mobile session version to kick out other phones
      final newVersion = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;

      await _db.collection('users').doc(clean).update({
        'lastSeen': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'deviceLocked': true,
        'mobileSessionVersion': newVersion,
      });

      final name = data['displayNameOriginal'] as String? ?? '';
      await _saveLocal(clean, name);
      await _saveSessionVersion(newVersion);
      saveFcmToken();
      return LoginResult.success(clean, name);
    } on FirebaseException catch (e) {
      return LoginResult.error('${e.code}: ${e.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      return LoginResult.error('Unexpected error: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<LoginResult> loginWeb(String code) async {
    try {
      final clean = code.trim().toUpperCase();
      if (_auth.currentUser == null) {
        await _auth.signInAnonymously();
      }

      final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(clean).get();
      if (!doc.exists) {
        return LoginResult.error('Code not found. Check and try again.');
      }

      final data = doc.data() ?? {};
      final name = data['displayNameOriginal'] as String? ?? '';
      
      // Generate a new web session version (kicks out other web browsers)
      final newVersion = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;

      await _db.collection('users').doc(clean).update({
        'webSessionVersion': newVersion,
        'lastSeen': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
      
      await _saveLocal(clean, name);
      await _saveSessionVersion(newVersion);
      saveFcmToken();
      return LoginResult.success(clean, name);
    } on FirebaseException catch (e) {
      return LoginResult.error('${e.code}: ${e.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      return LoginResult.error('Unexpected error: $e');
    }
  }

  // â”€â”€ Restore session from local storage â”€â”€

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // RESTORE / SIGN OUT
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

    // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // SESSION VERSION (remote sign-out)
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

    Future<void> _saveSessionVersion(int? version) async {
    if (version == null) return;
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (kIsWeb) {
      await prefs.setInt(_webSessionKey, version);
    } else {
      await prefs.setInt(_mobileSessionKey, version);
    }
  }

  Future<bool> verifySessionVersion() async {
    final code = _cachedCode;
    if (code == null) return true;
    try {
      final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(code).get();
      if (!doc.exists) return true;
      final data = doc.data()!;

      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();

      if (kIsWeb) {
        final cloudWeb = data['webSessionVersion'] as int?;
        if (cloudWeb == null) return true; // Legacy account fallback
        final localWeb = prefs.getInt(_webSessionKey);
        if (localWeb == null) {
          await prefs.setInt(_webSessionKey, cloudWeb);
          return true;
        }
        return localWeb == cloudWeb;
      } else {
        final cloudMobile = data['mobileSessionVersion'] as int?;
        if (cloudMobile == null) return true; // Legacy account fallback
        final localMobile = prefs.getInt(_mobileSessionKey);
        if (localMobile == null) {
          await prefs.setInt(_mobileSessionKey, cloudMobile);
          return true;
        }
        return localMobile == cloudMobile;
      }
    } catch (_) {
      return true; // Fail open if offline
    }
  }

  /// Rotates the session version. The current device adopts the new
  /// value so it stays signed in; every other device fails the next
  /// verifySessionVersion() and is returned to Landing.
    Future<void> signOutOtherDevices() async {
    final code = _cachedCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    final v = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    
    await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update({
      'mobileSessionVersion': v,
      'webSessionVersion': v,
    });
    
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (kIsWeb) {
      await prefs.setInt(_webSessionKey, v);
    } else {
      await prefs.setInt(_mobileSessionKey, v);
    }
  }

  Future<bool> restoreSession() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final code = prefs.getString(_codeKey);
    final name = prefs.getString(_nameKey);

    if (code == null || name == null) return false;

    if (_auth.currentUser == null) {
      try {
        await _auth.signInAnonymously();
      } catch (_) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    _cachedCode = code;
    _cachedName = name;
    saveFcmToken();
    return true;
  }

  Future<bool> unlockWithPin(String pin) async {
    final code = _cachedCode;
    if (code == null) return false;
    return CryptoService().unlockPrivateKey(userCode: code, pin: pin);
  }

  Future<void> signOut() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(_codeKey);
    await prefs.remove(_nameKey);
    await prefs.remove(_pinHashKey);
    await prefs.remove(_pinSaltKey);
    await prefs.remove(_pinVersionKey);
    await prefs.remove(_pinLengthKey);
    await prefs.remove(_lockModeKey);
    await prefs.remove(_lockTimingKey);
    await prefs.remove(_mobileSessionKey);
    await prefs.remove(_webSessionKey);

        final code = _cachedCode;
    if (code != null) {
      if (kIsWeb) {
        // Remove the web session so you can log in on another PC later
        await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update({
          'webSessionVersion': FieldValue.delete(),
        });
      } else {
        await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update({
          'deviceLocked': false,
          'mobileSessionVersion': FieldValue.delete(),
        });
      }
    }
        _cachedCode = null;
    _cachedName = null;
    CryptoService().lock();

    // Wipe local sandbox and preferences so the next account on this
    // device doesn't inherit anything from the one signing out.
    await SandboxStorage.clear();
    await appSettings.resetForSignOut();

    await _auth.signOut();
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // PIN â€” local (fast, used by lock screen)
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

  /// Persists a new PIN. Enforces the length policy. Writes both the
  /// local copy (for the lock screen) and the server copy (for transfer
  /// recovery). Also generates or re-encrypts the E2E keypair.
  ///
  /// Throws ArgumentError if the PIN is shorter than [pinMinLength].
  Future<void> savePin(String pin) async {
    if (pin.length < pinMinLength) {
      throw ArgumentError('PIN must be at least $pinMinLength digits.');
    }
    if (!RegExp(r'^\d+$').hasMatch(pin)) {
      throw ArgumentError('PIN must contain digits only.');
    }

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final salt = _randomBytes(32);
    final hash = await _hashPinPbkdf2(pin, salt);

    await prefs.setString(_pinHashKey, hash);
    await prefs.setString(_pinSaltKey, base64.encode(salt));
    await prefs.setString(_pinVersionKey, 'pbkdf2');
    await prefs.setInt(_pinLengthKey, pin.length);

    final code = _cachedCode;
    if (code != null) {
      await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update({
        'pinHash': hash,
        'pinSalt': base64.encode(salt),
        'pinHashVersion': 'pbkdf2',
        'pinLength': pin.length,
        'pinAttempts': 0,
        'pinLockedUntil': FieldValue.delete(),
      });

      final crypto = CryptoService();
      if (crypto.isUnlocked) {
        // Key already in memory â€” safe to re-encrypt with the new PIN.
        await crypto.reEncryptPrivateKeyWithNewPin(
            userCode: code, newPin: pin);
      } else {
        // Key NOT in memory. Check Firestore before doing anything
        // destructive: if this account already has an encrypted private
        // key on file, generating a new keypair here would permanently
        // orphan every existing session. Try the PIN against the
        // existing key instead.
        final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(code).get();
        final hasExistingKey =
            doc.data()?['encryptedPrivateKey'] != null;

        if (!hasExistingKey) {
          // Fresh account. Safe to generate.
          await crypto.generateAndSaveKeypair(
              userCode: code, pin: pin);
        } else {
          // Existing account on a wiped device. Try to unlock with the
          // PIN the user entered.
          final unlocked = await crypto.unlockPrivateKey(
              userCode: code, pin: pin);
          if (!unlocked) {
            throw ArgumentError(
              'This account already has encryption keys, and the PIN you '
              'entered does not unlock them. Use your original PIN â€” '
              'otherwise older content will stay locked on this device.',
            );
          }
          // Unlock succeeded. The key is now in memory and is already
          // encrypted with this same PIN on Firestore â€” nothing to save.
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /// Local PIN check. Handles legacy sha256 hashes and current pbkdf2.
  Future<bool> verifyPin(String pin) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final stored = prefs.getString(_pinHashKey);
    if (stored == null) return false;

    final version = prefs.getString(_pinVersionKey) ?? 'sha256';
    if (version == 'sha256') {
      return _hashPinSha256(pin) == stored;
    }
    final saltB64 = prefs.getString(_pinSaltKey);
    if (saltB64 == null) return false;
    final candidate = await _hashPinPbkdf2(pin, base64.decode(saltB64));
    return candidate == stored;
  }

  Future<bool> hasPin() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getString(_pinHashKey) != null;
  }

  Future<int> pinLength() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getInt(_pinLengthKey) ?? pinMinLength;
  }

  Future<void> removePin() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(_pinHashKey);
    await prefs.remove(_pinSaltKey);
    await prefs.remove(_pinVersionKey);
    await prefs.remove(_pinLengthKey);
    final code = _cachedCode;
    if (code != null) {
      await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update({
        'pinHash': FieldValue.delete(),
        'pinSalt': FieldValue.delete(),
        'pinHashVersion': FieldValue.delete(),
        'pinAttempts': FieldValue.delete(),
        'pinLockedUntil': FieldValue.delete(),
      });
    }
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // PIN â€” remote (used by login / transfer)
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

  /// Verifies a PIN against the server. Manages attempt counting, lockout,
  /// legacy hash upgrade, and security notifications.
  Future<PinVerifyResult> verifyPinRemote(String code, String pin) async {
    if (_auth.currentUser == null) {
      await _auth.signInAnonymously();
    }

    final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(code).get();
    if (!doc.exists) {
      return PinVerifyResult(success: false, error: 'Account not found.');
    }
    final data = doc.data()!;

    // Lock check
    final lockedUntilRaw = data['pinLockedUntil'];
    if (lockedUntilRaw is Timestamp) {
      final lockedUntil = lockedUntilRaw.toDate();
      if (lockedUntil.isAfter(DateTime.now())) {
        return PinVerifyResult(
          success: false,
          isLocked: true,
          lockedUntil: lockedUntil,
          attemptsRemaining: 0,
          error: 'Account locked.',
        );
      }
    }

    final storedHash = data['pinHash'] as String?;
    if (storedHash == null) {
      return PinVerifyResult(
          success: false, error: 'No PIN set on this account.');
    }
    final version = data['pinHashVersion'] as String? ?? 'sha256';
    final saltB64 = data['pinSalt'] as String?;

    // Compute candidate hash
    String candidateHash;
    if (version == 'pbkdf2') {
      if (saltB64 == null) {
        return PinVerifyResult(
            success: false, error: 'Corrupt PIN data on server.');
      }
      candidateHash = await _hashPinPbkdf2(pin, base64.decode(saltB64));
    } else {
      candidateHash = _hashPinSha256(pin);
    }

    // â”€â”€ Failure path â”€â”€
    if (candidateHash != storedHash) {
      final prevAttempts = (data['pinAttempts'] as int?) ?? 0;
      final newAttempts = prevAttempts + 1;
      final willLock = newAttempts >= maxPinAttempts;

      final update = <String, dynamic>{
        'pinAttempts': willLock ? 0 : newAttempts,
      };
      if (willLock) {
        final lockUntil = DateTime.now().add(lockoutDuration);
        update['pinLockedUntil'] = Timestamp.fromDate(lockUntil);
        await _notifySecurity(
          code,
          'Account locked after failed PIN attempts',
          'Someone tried to access your account with the wrong PIN $maxPinAttempts times. '
              'It has been locked for ${lockoutDuration.inMinutes} minutes. '
              'If this wasn\'t you, someone may have your unique code.',
        );
      } else if (newAttempts >= 3) {
        await _notifySecurity(
          code,
          'Failed PIN attempts on your account',
          '$newAttempts failed attempts. The account locks after $maxPinAttempts.',
        );
      }

      try {
        await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update(update);
      } catch (e) {
        print('[verifyPinRemote] attempt-write failed: $e');
      }

      return PinVerifyResult(
        success: false,
        attemptsRemaining: willLock ? 0 : maxPinAttempts - newAttempts,
        error: willLock
            ? 'Account locked for ${lockoutDuration.inMinutes} minutes.'
            : 'Incorrect PIN.',
      );
    }

    // â”€â”€ Success path â”€â”€
    final update = <String, dynamic>{
      'pinAttempts': 0,
      'pinLockedUntil': FieldValue.delete(),
    };

    // Silent upgrade of legacy sha256 hash to pbkdf2. We have the plaintext
    // PIN right here, so this is a free opportunity to migrate.
    if (version != 'pbkdf2') {
      final newSalt = _randomBytes(32);
      final newHash = await _hashPinPbkdf2(pin, newSalt);
      update['pinHash'] = newHash;
      update['pinSalt'] = base64.encode(newSalt);
      update['pinHashVersion'] = 'pbkdf2';
    }

    try {
      await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update(update);
    } catch (e) {
      print('[verifyPinRemote] success-write failed: $e');
    }

    return PinVerifyResult(success: true, attemptsRemaining: maxPinAttempts);
  }

  /// Completes a login after the user has verified their PIN. This is the
  /// "transfer account" path â€” code + PIN, then we claim the device.
  Future<LoginResult> completeLoginWithPin({
    required String code,
    required String pin,
  }) async {
    try {
      if (_auth.currentUser == null) {
        await _auth.signInAnonymously();
      }

      final clean = code.trim().toUpperCase();
      final verification = await verifyPinRemote(clean, pin);

      if (verification.isLocked) {
        return LoginResult.error(
            verification.error ?? 'Account locked. Try again later.');
      }
      if (!verification.success) {
        final remaining = verification.attemptsRemaining;
        final base = verification.error ?? 'Incorrect PIN.';
        final msg = remaining > 0
            ? '$base $remaining attempt${remaining == 1 ? '' : 's'} remaining.'
            : base;
        return LoginResult.error(msg);
      }

      // Rotate the session version on transfer. This tells every other
      // device signed in to the account â€” including the one that
      // requested the transfer â€” that its session is no longer valid.
      final newVersion = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
      await _db.collection('users').doc(clean).update({
        'deviceLocked': true,
        'transferRequestedAt': FieldValue.delete(),
        'lastSeen': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'mobileSessionVersion': newVersion,
        'webSessionVersion': FieldValue.delete(), // Kicks out any old PC sessions
      });

      final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(clean).get();
            final data = doc.data() ?? {};
      final name = data['displayNameOriginal'] as String? ?? '';

      // â”€â”€ BLOCK IF ALREADY LOGGED IN ON ANOTHER PC â”€â”€
      if (data['webSessionVersion'] != null) {
        return LoginResult.error(
            'Account is already linked to a PC. Please use your phone to "Sign out other devices" before linking a new one.');
      }
      await _saveLocal(clean, name);
      await _saveSessionVersion(newVersion);
      saveFcmToken();
      return LoginResult.success(clean, name);
    } on FirebaseException catch (e) {
      return LoginResult.error('${e.code}: ${e.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      return LoginResult.error('Unexpected error: $e');
    }
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // LOCK SCREEN ATTEMPTS (local + notify)
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  //
  // The lock screen verifies PINs locally, so it needs its own attempt
  // tracking. Counts are stored in SharedPreferences and reset on a
  // successful unlock. Notifications are still fired via Firestore so
  // the user sees them the next time they're signed in â€” even if the
  // device is lost or wiped.
  static const _lockAttemptsKey = 'lore_lockscreen_attempts';
  static const _lockAttemptsTsKey = 'lore_lockscreen_last_attempt';
  static const _lockAttemptsWindow = Duration(hours: 1);

  /// Records a failed lock screen attempt. Fires a security notification
  /// at 3, 5, and 10 attempts within the rolling window.
  Future<void> recordFailedLockScreenAttempt() async {
    final code = _cachedCode;
    if (code == null) return;

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    final lastTs = prefs.getInt(_lockAttemptsTsKey);

    int attempts = 0;
    if (lastTs != null &&
        now - lastTs < _lockAttemptsWindow.inMilliseconds) {
      attempts = prefs.getInt(_lockAttemptsKey) ?? 0;
    }

    attempts++;
    await prefs.setInt(_lockAttemptsKey, attempts);
    await prefs.setInt(_lockAttemptsTsKey, now);

    if (attempts == 3 || attempts == 5 || attempts == 10) {
      await _notifySecurity(
        code,
        'Failed lock screen attempts',
        '$attempts failed attempts on your device. '
            'If this isn\'t you, someone may have your phone.',
      );
    }
  }

  /// Clears the lock screen attempt counter â€” called on successful unlock.
  Future<void> clearLockScreenAttempts() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(_lockAttemptsKey);
    await prefs.remove(_lockAttemptsTsKey);
  }


  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // SECURITY NOTIFICATIONS
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  Future<void> _notifySecurity(
    String code,
    String title,
    String subtitle,
  ) async {
    try {
      await _db.collection('notifications').add({
        'toCode': code,
        'type': 'security_warning',
        'title': title,
        'subtitle': subtitle,
        'data': <String, dynamic>{},
        'read': false,
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      print('[security] notify failed: $e');
    }
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // LOCK SETTINGS
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
    Future<void> setBiometricsEnabled(bool enabled) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool(_biometricsKey, enabled);
  }

  Future<bool> isBiometricsEnabled() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getBool(_biometricsKey) ?? false;
  }

    Future<bool> silentUnlock() async {
    final code = _cachedCode;
    if (code == null) return false;
    return CryptoService().silentUnlock(code);
  }
  
  Future<void> saveLockMode(String mode) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(_lockModeKey, mode);
  }

  Future<String> getLockMode() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getString(_lockModeKey) ?? 'none';
  }

  Future<void> saveLockTiming(String timing) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(_lockTimingKey, timing);
  }

  Future<String> getLockTiming() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getString(_lockTimingKey) ?? 'always';
  }

  Future<void> saveBackgroundTimestamp() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setInt(_bgTimestampKey, DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch);
  }

  Future<bool> shouldLock() async {
    final mode = await getLockMode();
    if (mode == 'none') return false;
    final timing = await getLockTiming();
    if (timing == 'always') return true;
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final ts = prefs.getInt(_bgTimestampKey);
    if (ts == null) return true;
    final elapsed = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch - ts;
    if (timing == 'close') return false;
    return elapsed > 5 * 60 * 1000;
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // DEVICE TRANSFER
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  Future<void> releaseDeviceLock() async {
    final code = _cachedCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update({
      'deviceLocked': false,
      'transferRequestedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // LOCAL STORAGE
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  Future<void> _saveLocal(String code, String name) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(_codeKey, code);
    await prefs.setString(_nameKey, name);
    _cachedCode = code;
    _cachedName = name;
  }

  Future<void> saveFcmToken() async {
    final code = _cachedCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    try {
      final messaging = FirebaseMessaging.instance;
      await messaging.requestPermission(alert: true, badge: true, sound: true);
      final token = await messaging.getToken();
      if (token != null) {
        await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update({'fcmToken': token});
      }
      messaging.onTokenRefresh.listen((newToken) {
        _db.collection('users').doc(code).update({'fcmToken': newToken});
      });
    } catch (e) {
      print('[FCM] token save failed: $e');
    }
  }
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// RESULT TYPES
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class RegisterResult {
  final bool success;
  final String? code;
  final String? name;
  final String? errorMessage;

  RegisterResult._({required this.success, this.code, this.name, this.errorMessage});
  factory RegisterResult.success(String code, String name) =>
      RegisterResult._(success: true, code: code, name: name);
  factory RegisterResult.error(String message) =>
      RegisterResult._(success: false, errorMessage: message);
}

class LoginResult {
  final bool success;
  final bool isDeviceLocked;
  final String? code;
  final String? name;
  final String? errorMessage;

  LoginResult._({required this.success, this.isDeviceLocked = false, this.code, this.name, this.errorMessage});
  factory LoginResult.success(String code, String name) =>
      LoginResult._(success: true, code: code, name: name);
  factory LoginResult.deviceLocked() =>
      LoginResult._(success: false, isDeviceLocked: true);
  factory LoginResult.error(String message) =>
      LoginResult._(success: false, errorMessage: message);
}

class PinVerifyResult {
  final bool success;
  final bool isLocked;
  final DateTime? lockedUntil;
  final int attemptsRemaining;
  final String? error;
  const PinVerifyResult({
    required this.success,
    this.isLocked = false,
    this.lockedUntil,
    this.attemptsRemaining = 5,
    this.error,
  });
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
import 'package:pointycastle/export.dart' as pc;

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// CryptoService
//
// Architecture:
//   â€¢ Each user has an RSA-2048 keypair generated on registration.
//   â€¢ Public key stored in Firestore (users/{code}/publicKey).
//   â€¢ Private key encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a key derived
//     from the user's PIN via PBKDF2-SHA256 (100k iterations).
//     The encrypted private key is stored BOTH in flutter_secure_storage
//     (fast local access) and Firestore (for device transfer).
//   â€¢ Each session has a random 256-bit AES session key, encrypted
//     separately with each participant's public key and stored in
//     the session document.
//   â€¢ All post/brainstorm/ooc content is encrypted with the session
//     key using AES-256-GCM before hitting Firestore.
//
// What Firestore sees:
//   users/{code}:
//     publicKey: "base64 RSA public key"      â† public, fine
//     encryptedPrivateKey: "base64 blob"      â† encrypted with PIN
//     privateKeySalt: "base64 salt"           â† salt for PBKDF2
//     privateKeyIv: "base64 IV"               â† IV for AES-GCM
//
//   sessions/{id}:
//     sessionKey_{code}: "base64 blob"        â† session key encrypted with user's RSA public key
//
//   sessions/{id}/posts/{id}:
//     content: "base64 AES-GCM ciphertext"    â† encrypted
//     iv: "base64 IV"                         â† unique per message
//     (everything else stays plaintext)
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

class CryptoService {
  static final CryptoService _instance = CryptoService._internal();
  factory CryptoService() => _instance;
  CryptoService._internal();

  final _storage = const FlutterSecureStorage(
    aOptions: AndroidOptions(encryptedSharedPreferences: true),
  );
  final _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  final _aesGcm = AesGcm.with256bits();
  final _pbkdf2 = Pbkdf2(
    macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256(),
    iterations: 100000,
    bits: 256,
  );

  // â”€â”€ In-memory cache of the unlocked session keys â”€â”€
  // sessionId â†’ SecretKey (AES-256)
  final Map<String, SecretKey> _sessionKeyCache = {};

  // â”€â”€ In-memory RSA private key (loaded once on unlock) â”€â”€
  pc.RSAPrivateKey? _privateKey;
  pc.RSAPublicKey? _publicKey;

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // REGISTRATION â€” generate keypair + save
  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  /// Call after PIN is set. Generates RSA keypair, encrypts private key
  /// with PIN-derived key, saves everything.
  Future<void> generateAndSaveKeypair({
    required String userCode,
    required String pin,
  }) async {
    // Generate RSA-2048 keypair using PointyCastle
    final keypair = _generateRSAKeypair();
    _privateKey = keypair.privateKey;
    _publicKey = keypair.publicKey;

    // Encode public key to base64 for Firestore
    final pubKeyB64 = _encodePublicKey(keypair.publicKey);

    // Encrypt private key with PIN (for Firestore backup + PIN-lock flow)
    final privKeyBytes = _encodePrivateKeyToBytes(keypair.privateKey);
    final salt = _randomBytes(32);
    final pinKey = await _deriveKeyFromPin(pin, salt);
    final nonce = _aesGcm.newNonce();
    final encrypted = await _aesGcm.encrypt(
      privKeyBytes,
      secretKey: pinKey,
      nonce: nonce,
    );

    final encPrivB64 = base64.encode(encrypted.cipherText + encrypted.mac.bytes);
    final saltB64 = base64.encode(salt);
    final ivB64 = base64.encode(nonce);

    // Store PIN-encrypted key in secure storage + Firestore (for transfer recovery)
    await _storage.write(key: 'lore_enc_priv_$userCode', value: encPrivB64);
    await _storage.write(key: 'lore_priv_salt_$userCode', value: saltB64);
    await _storage.write(key: 'lore_priv_iv_$userCode', value: ivB64);
    // Also store raw key bytes in secure storage for no-lock-screen silent unlock
    await _storage.write(
      key: 'lore_raw_priv_$userCode',
      value: base64.encode(privKeyBytes),
    );

    // Store in Firestore (encrypted version only â€” raw never leaves device)
    await _db.collection('users').doc(userCode).update({
      'publicKey': pubKeyB64,
      'encryptedPrivateKey': encPrivB64,
      'privateKeySalt': saltB64,
      'privateKeyIv': ivB64,
    });
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // LOGIN â€” unlock private key with PIN
  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  /// Call on login/unlock after PIN verified. Loads and decrypts private key.
  /// Falls back to Firestore if secure storage is empty (new device after transfer).
  Future<bool> unlockPrivateKey({
    required String userCode,
    required String pin,
  }) async {
    try {
      String? encPrivB64 = await _storage.read(key: 'lore_enc_priv_$userCode');
      String? saltB64 = await _storage.read(key: 'lore_priv_salt_$userCode');
      String? ivB64 = await _storage.read(key: 'lore_priv_iv_$userCode');

      // New device â€” pull from Firestore
      if (encPrivB64 == null || saltB64 == null || ivB64 == null) {
        final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(userCode).get();
        if (!doc.exists) return false;
        final data = doc.data()!;
        encPrivB64 = data['encryptedPrivateKey'] as String?;
        saltB64 = data['privateKeySalt'] as String?;
        ivB64 = data['privateKeyIv'] as String?;
        if (encPrivB64 == null || saltB64 == null || ivB64 == null) return false;

        // Re-cache in secure storage on this new device
      await _storage.write(key: 'lore_enc_priv_$userCode', value: encPrivB64);
      await _storage.write(key: 'lore_priv_salt_$userCode', value: saltB64);
      await _storage.write(key: 'lore_priv_iv_$userCode', value: ivB64);
      }

      final salt = base64.decode(saltB64);
      final iv = base64.decode(ivB64);
      final encBytes = base64.decode(encPrivB64);

      // Split ciphertext and MAC (last 16 bytes)
      final cipherText = encBytes.sublist(0, encBytes.length - 16);
      final mac = Mac(encBytes.sublist(encBytes.length - 16));

      final pinKey = await _deriveKeyFromPin(pin, salt);
      final decrypted = await _aesGcm.decrypt(
        SecretBox(cipherText, nonce: iv, mac: mac),
        secretKey: pinKey,
      );

      _privateKey = _decodePrivateKeyFromBytes(Uint8List.fromList(decrypted));

      // Cache the raw key locally so future cold-starts can use
      // silentUnlock without needing the PIN again.
      await _storage.write(
        key: 'lore_raw_priv_$userCode',
        value: base64.encode(Uint8List.fromList(decrypted)),
      );

      // Also load public key
      final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(userCode).get();
      final pubKeyB64 = doc.data()?['publicKey'] as String?;
      if (pubKeyB64 != null) {
        _publicKey = _decodePublicKey(pubKeyB64);
      }

      return true;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Whether the private key is currently loaded in memory
  bool get isUnlocked => _privateKey != null;

    /// True if Firestore has encrypted private-key material for this user.
  /// Used after a device wipe: local secure storage is empty but the
  /// account's keys still exist server-side.
  Future<bool> hasRemoteKeyMaterial(String userCode) async {
    try {
      final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(userCode).get();
      return doc.data()?['encryptedPrivateKey'] != null;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Silent unlock for users with lock screen disabled.
  /// Uses raw private key from secure storage (never leaves device).
  Future<bool> silentUnlock(String userCode) async {
    if (_privateKey != null) return true;
    try {
      final rawB64 = await _storage.read(key: 'lore_raw_priv_$userCode');
      if (rawB64 == null) return false;
      _privateKey = _decodePrivateKeyFromBytes(base64.decode(rawB64));
      // Load public key from Firestore
      final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(userCode).get();
      final pubKeyB64 = doc.data()?['publicKey'] as String?;
      if (pubKeyB64 != null) _publicKey = _decodePublicKey(pubKeyB64);
      return _privateKey != null;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Clear private key from memory (on sign out)
  void lock() {
    _privateKey = null;
    _publicKey = null;
    _sessionKeyCache.clear();
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // SESSION KEY â€” create and retrieve
  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  /// Create a new session key for a new session. Encrypts it with
  /// both participants' public keys and writes to Firestore.
  Future<void> createSessionKey({
    required String sessionId,
    required String myCode,
    required String partnerCode,
  }) async {
    // Generate random 256-bit session key
    final sessionKey = await _aesGcm.newSecretKey();
    final sessionKeyBytes = await sessionKey.extractBytes();

    // Cache locally
    _sessionKeyCache[sessionId] = sessionKey;

    // Fetch partner's public key
    final partnerDoc = await _db.collection('users').doc(partnerCode).get();
    final partnerPubKeyB64 = partnerDoc.data()?['publicKey'] as String?;
    if (partnerPubKeyB64 == null) return;
    final partnerPubKey = _decodePublicKey(partnerPubKeyB64);

    // Encrypt session key with my public key and partner's public key
    final myEncrypted = _rsaEncrypt(
        Uint8List.fromList(sessionKeyBytes), _publicKey!);
    final partnerEncrypted = _rsaEncrypt(
        Uint8List.fromList(sessionKeyBytes), partnerPubKey);

    await _db.collection('sessions').doc(sessionId).update({
      'sessionKey_$myCode': base64.encode(myEncrypted),
      'sessionKey_$partnerCode': base64.encode(partnerEncrypted),
    });
  }

  /// Get the session key for a session, decrypting it with our private key.
  /// Caches in memory after first load.
  Future<SecretKey?> getSessionKey({
    required String sessionId,
    required String myCode,
  }) async {
    if (_sessionKeyCache.containsKey(sessionId)) {
      return _sessionKeyCache[sessionId];
    }
    if (_privateKey == null) return null;

    try {
      final doc = await _db.collection('sessions').doc(sessionId).get();
      final encKeyB64 = doc.data()?['sessionKey_$myCode'] as String?;
      if (encKeyB64 == null) return null;

      final encKeyBytes = base64.decode(encKeyB64);
      final keyBytes = _rsaDecrypt(encKeyBytes, _privateKey!);
      final sessionKey = SecretKey(keyBytes);
      _sessionKeyCache[sessionId] = sessionKey;
      return sessionKey;
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // ENCRYPT / DECRYPT CONTENT
  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  /// Encrypt a string, returns {'cipher': base64, 'iv': base64}
  Future<Map<String, String>> encryptContent(
      String plaintext, SecretKey sessionKey) async {
    final nonce = _aesGcm.newNonce();
    final encrypted = await _aesGcm.encrypt(
      utf8.encode(plaintext),
      secretKey: sessionKey,
      nonce: nonce,
    );
    final cipherWithMac =
        encrypted.cipherText + encrypted.mac.bytes;
    return {
      'cipher': base64.encode(cipherWithMac),
      'iv': base64.encode(nonce),
    };
  }

  /// Decrypt a content blob back to plaintext string.
  /// Returns null if decryption fails (key mismatch, corrupt data).
  Future<String?> decryptContent({
    required String cipherB64,
    required String ivB64,
    required SecretKey sessionKey,
  }) async {
    try {
      final raw = base64.decode(cipherB64);
      final iv = base64.decode(ivB64);
      final cipherText = raw.sublist(0, raw.length - 16);
      final mac = Mac(raw.sublist(raw.length - 16));
      final decrypted = await _aesGcm.decrypt(
        SecretBox(cipherText, nonce: iv, mac: mac),
        secretKey: sessionKey,
      );
      return utf8.decode(decrypted);
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // UPDATE PIN â€” re-encrypt private key with new PIN
  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  Future<void> reEncryptPrivateKeyWithNewPin({
    required String userCode,
    required String newPin,
  }) async {
    if (_privateKey == null) return;
    final privKeyBytes = _encodePrivateKeyToBytes(_privateKey!);
    final salt = _randomBytes(32);
    final pinKey = await _deriveKeyFromPin(newPin, salt);
    final nonce = _aesGcm.newNonce();
    final encrypted = await _aesGcm.encrypt(
      privKeyBytes,
      secretKey: pinKey,
      nonce: nonce,
    );
    final encPrivB64 =
        base64.encode(encrypted.cipherText + encrypted.mac.bytes);
    final saltB64 = base64.encode(salt);
    final ivB64 = base64.encode(nonce);

    await _storage.write(key: 'lore_enc_priv_$userCode', value: encPrivB64);
    await _storage.write(key: 'lore_priv_salt_$userCode', value: saltB64);
    await _storage.write(key: 'lore_priv_iv_$userCode', value: ivB64);
    // Keep raw key up to date for silent unlock
    await _storage.write(
      key: 'lore_raw_priv_$userCode',
      value: base64.encode(privKeyBytes),
    );

    await _db.collection('users').doc(userCode).update({
      'encryptedPrivateKey': encPrivB64,
      'privateKeySalt': saltB64,
      'privateKeyIv': ivB64,
    });
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // PRIVATE HELPERS
  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  Future<SecretKey> _deriveKeyFromPin(String pin, List<int> salt) async {
    final pinBytes = utf8.encode(pin);
    final secretKey = SecretKey(pinBytes);
    return _pbkdf2.deriveKey(secretKey: secretKey, nonce: salt);
  }

  Uint8List _randomBytes(int length) {
    final rand = Random.secure();
    return Uint8List.fromList(
        List.generate(length, (_) => rand.nextInt(256)));
  }

  // RSA keypair generation
  ({pc.RSAPublicKey publicKey, pc.RSAPrivateKey privateKey})
      _generateRSAKeypair() {
    final secureRandom = pc.FortunaRandom();
    final seedSource = Random.secure();
    final seeds = List<int>.generate(32, (_) => seedSource.nextInt(256));
    secureRandom.seed(pc.KeyParameter(Uint8List.fromList(seeds)));

    final keyGen = pc.RSAKeyGenerator()
      ..init(pc.ParametersWithRandom(
        pc.RSAKeyGeneratorParameters(BigInt.parse('65537'), 2048, 64),
        secureRandom,
      ));

    final pair = keyGen.generateKeyPair();
    return (
      publicKey: pair.publicKey as pc.RSAPublicKey,
      privateKey: pair.privateKey as pc.RSAPrivateKey,
    );
  }

  // RSA OAEP encrypt (for small payloads like session keys)
  Uint8List _rsaEncrypt(Uint8List data, pc.RSAPublicKey publicKey) {
    final cipher = pc.OAEPEncoding(pc.RSAEngine())
      ..init(true, pc.PublicKeyParameter<pc.RSAPublicKey>(publicKey));
    return cipher.process(data);
  }

  Uint8List _rsaDecrypt(Uint8List data, pc.RSAPrivateKey privateKey) {
    final cipher = pc.OAEPEncoding(pc.RSAEngine())
      ..init(false, pc.PrivateKeyParameter<pc.RSAPrivateKey>(privateKey));
    return cipher.process(data);
  }

  // Key serialisation â€” DER-like encoding via BigInt components
  String _encodePublicKey(pc.RSAPublicKey key) {
    final map = {
      'n': key.modulus.toString(),
      'e': key.exponent.toString(),
    };
    return base64.encode(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(map)));
  }

  pc.RSAPublicKey _decodePublicKey(String b64) {
    final map = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(base64.decode(b64))) as Map;
    return pc.RSAPublicKey(
      BigInt.parse(map['n'] as String),
      BigInt.parse(map['e'] as String),
    );
  }

  Uint8List _encodePrivateKeyToBytes(pc.RSAPrivateKey key) {
    final map = {
      'n': key.modulus.toString(),
      'e': key.exponent.toString(),
      'p': key.p.toString(),
      'q': key.q.toString(),
    };
    return Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(map)));
  }

  pc.RSAPrivateKey _decodePrivateKeyFromBytes(Uint8List bytes) {
    final map = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(bytes)) as Map;
    final n = BigInt.parse(map['n'] as String);
    final e = BigInt.parse(map['e'] as String);
    final p = BigInt.parse(map['p'] as String);
    final q = BigInt.parse(map['q'] as String);
    return pc.RSAPrivateKey(n, e, p, q);
  }
}

import 'dart:math';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'auth_service.dart';
import 'crypto_service.dart';

/// Result of ensureDemoSession â€” everything the caller needs to open the room.
class DemoSession {
  final String sessionId;
  final String partnerCode;
  final String partnerName;
  final String genre;
  const DemoSession({
    required this.sessionId,
    required this.partnerCode,
    required this.partnerName,
    required this.genre,
  });
}

/// Developer tools for testing the app solo.
///
/// The trick: the fake partner is created with OUR public key. That means
/// the session key is encrypted twice â€” once to us, once to the fake
/// partner â€” but both encryptions can be decrypted with our private key.
/// So posts written by either side round-trip correctly.
///
/// Later this becomes "Experience mode" â€” a curated walkthrough session
/// for new users. Same machinery, different content.
class DevTools {
  static final _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  static final _auth = AuthService();
  static final _crypto = CryptoService();

  /// Creates (or returns an existing) demo session with a fake partner.
  /// Returns null if a PIN hasn't been set (no RSA keypair on file).
  static Future<DemoSession?> ensureDemoSession({
    String partnerName = 'Echo',
    String genre = 'Fantasy',
    bool seedPosts = true,
  }) async {
    final myCode = _auth.currentCode;
    final myName = _auth.currentName;
    if (myCode == null || myName == null) {
      print('[DevTools] Not signed in');
      return null;
    }

    // Reuse an existing demo session if there is one
    final existing = await _db
        .collection('sessions')
        .where('participants', arrayContains: myCode)
        .where('isDemo', isEqualTo: true)
        .limit(1)
        .get();

    if (existing.docs.isNotEmpty) {
      final doc = existing.docs.first;
      final data = doc.data();
      final participants = List<String>.from(data['participants'] ?? []);
      final fakeCode = participants.firstWhere(
        (p) => p != myCode,
        orElse: () => '',
      );
      final names = Map<String, dynamic>.from(data['participantNames'] ?? {});

      // Retroactively seed Echo's stats for demo sessions created
      // before this feature existed.
      await _seedFakePartnerStats(doc.id, fakeCode);

      return DemoSession(
        sessionId: doc.id,
        partnerCode: fakeCode,
        partnerName: names[fakeCode] as String? ?? partnerName,
        genre: data['genre'] as String? ?? genre,
      );
    }

    // Need the current user's public key on file to clone it onto the fake
    final myDoc = await _db.collection('users').doc(myCode).get();
    final myPubKey = myDoc.data()?['publicKey'] as String?;
    if (myPubKey == null) {
      print('[DevTools] No public key on file â€” set a PIN first');
      return null;
    }

    // Create the fake partner, using OUR public key so we can decrypt both sides
    final fakeCode = _randomCode();
    await _db.collection('users').doc(fakeCode).set({
      'code': fakeCode,
      'displayName': partnerName.toLowerCase(),
      'displayNameOriginal': partnerName,
      'uid': 'demo-${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      'lastSeen': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      'isDiscoverable': false,
      'deviceLocked': false,
      'genres': [genre],
      'bio': 'A quiet voice at the edge of the story.',
      'writingStyle': 'Descriptive Â· Atmospheric Â· Slow burn',
      'postFrequency': 'Whenever you are',
      'publicKey': myPubKey, // â† the whole trick
      'isDemo': true,
    });

    // Create the session
    final sessionRef = await _db.collection('sessions').add({
      'participants': [myCode, fakeCode],
      'participantNames': {myCode: myName, fakeCode: partnerName},
      'genre': genre,
      'status': 'active',
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      'lastPostAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      'postCount': 0,
      'isDemo': true,
    });

    // Create the session key. Encrypted once to me and once to "fake" â€”
    // both use our public key, so both decrypt with our private key.
    try {
      await _crypto.createSessionKey(
        sessionId: sessionRef.id,
        myCode: myCode,
        partnerCode: fakeCode,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      print('[DevTools] createSessionKey failed: $e');
    }

    // Give Echo a stat block so the PARTNER STATS panel has content.
    try {
      await _seedFakePartnerStats(sessionRef.id, fakeCode);
    } catch (e) {
      print('[DevTools] seedFakePartnerStats failed: $e');
    }

    if (seedPosts) {
      await _seedPosts(sessionRef.id, fakeCode, partnerName);
    }

    return DemoSession(
      sessionId: sessionRef.id,
      partnerCode: fakeCode,
      partnerName: partnerName,
      genre: genre,
    );
  }

    /// Seeds a stat block for the fake partner so partner-stats display
  /// works in the demo room. Idempotent â€” won't clobber if one exists.
  static Future<void> _seedFakePartnerStats(
      String sessionId, String fakeCode) async {
    if (fakeCode.isEmpty) return;
    final ref = _db
        .collection('sessions')
        .doc(sessionId)
        .collection('stats')
        .doc(fakeCode);
    final existing = await ref.get();
    if (existing.exists) return;

    await ref.set({
      'name': 'Echo',
      'useTiles': false,
      'stats': [
        {
          'name': 'Vitality',
          'value': 320,
          'isPool': true,
          'maxValue': 320,
          'barColor': 0xFF7BAF7B, // muted green
          'barStyle': 'stripe',
          'segments': 10,
        },
        {
          'name': 'Focus',
          'value': 180,
          'isPool': true,
          'maxValue': 180,
          'barColor': 0xFF7AB8D4, // ice blue
          'barStyle': 'blocks',
          'segments': 12,
        },
        {
          'name': 'Wounds',
          'value': 40,
          'isPool': true,
          'maxValue': 40,
          'barColor': 0xFFD4614A, // ember red
          'barStyle': 'cuts',
          'segments': 8,
        },
      ],
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  static String _randomCode() {
    const chars = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
    final rnd = Random.secure();
    final p1 = List.generate(4, (_) => chars[rnd.nextInt(chars.length)]).join();
    final p2 = List.generate(4, (_) => chars[rnd.nextInt(chars.length)]).join();
    return 'LR-$p1-$p2';
  }

  static Future<void> _seedPosts(
    String sessionId,
    String fakeCode,
    String fakeName,
  ) async {
    final sessionKey = await _crypto.getSessionKey(
      sessionId: sessionId,
      myCode: fakeCode,
    );
    if (sessionKey == null) {
      print('[DevTools] No session key â€” skipping seed posts');
      return;
    }

    final seeds = <({String content, String? location})>[
      (
        content:
            'The inn at Whitethorn sits at the edge of the moor, its '
            'windows flickering with a light that never quite reaches the '
            'road. Travellers say the barkeep knows every name before it '
            'is spoken.',
        location: 'Whitethorn Inn',
      ),
      (
        content:
            'Rain began before dawn. It fell steady and grey, turning the '
            'cobbles to slate and the smell of wet stone into something '
            'almost like memory. I waited by the north gate, as we agreed.',
        location: 'North Gate',
      ),
      (
        content:
            'The letter was sealed with wax the colour of dried blood. It '
            'bore no name â€” only the mark of the Ninth House, which has '
            'not been seen in these lands for two hundred years.',
        location: null,
      ),
    ];

    for (final seed in seeds) {
      final enc = await _crypto.encryptContent(seed.content, sessionKey);
      await _db
          .collection('sessions')
          .doc(sessionId)
          .collection('posts')
          .add({
        'authorCode': fakeCode,
        'authorName': fakeName,
        'characterName': fakeName,
        'locationName': seed.location,
        'content': enc['cipher']!,
        'contentIv': enc['iv'],
        'quotedPostId': null,
        'quotedContent': null,
        'quotedContentIv': null,
        'quotedAuthor': null,
        'encrypted': true,
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'edited': false,
      });
    }

    await _db.collection('sessions').doc(sessionId).update({
      'postCount': seeds.length,
    });
  }

  /// Wipes every demo user and demo session this user has created.
  /// Useful when iterating on seeded content.
  static Future<void> clearDemoData() async {
    final myCode = _auth.currentCode;
    if (myCode == null) return;

    // Demo sessions + their posts
    final sessions = await _db
        .collection('sessions')
        .where('participants', arrayContains: myCode)
        .where('isDemo', isEqualTo: true)
        .get();
    for (final s in sessions.docs) {
      final posts = await s.reference.collection('posts').get();
      for (final p in posts.docs) {
        await p.reference.delete();
      }
      final ooc = await s.reference.collection('ooc').get();
      for (final o in ooc.docs) {
        await o.reference.delete();
      }
      await s.reference.delete();
    }

    // Demo users
    final users =
        await _db.collection('users').where('isDemo', isEqualTo: true).get();
    for (final u in users.docs) {
      await u.reference.delete();
    }
  }
}


--- FILE: C:\Flutter Dev\lore2-1\lib\services\firestore_service.dart ---

import 'dart:math';
import 'dart:ui' show Color;
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import '../models/world.dart';
import 'auth_service.dart';
import 'crypto_service.dart';

class FirestoreService {
  static final FirestoreService _instance = FirestoreService._internal();
  factory FirestoreService() => _instance;
  FirestoreService._internal();

  final FirebaseFirestore _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  final AuthService _auth = AuthService();
  final CryptoService _crypto = CryptoService();

  // â”€â”€ Helper: get session key, creating it if needed â”€â”€
    Future<dynamic> _sessionKey(String sessionId) async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return null;

    // Fast path â€” cached or private key already loaded.
    var key = await _crypto.getSessionKey(sessionId: sessionId, myCode: code);
    if (key != null) return key;

    // Private key already unlocked but no session key. Try to self-heal
    // the case where the initial createSessionKey failed silently.
    if (_crypto.isUnlocked) {
      if (await _tryRecoverSessionKey(sessionId, code)) {
        key = await _crypto.getSessionKey(
            sessionId: sessionId, myCode: code);
      }
      return key;
    }

    // Private key is being unlocked (post-transfer, post-PIN-entry).
    // Poll briefly. 10 Ã— 500ms = 5s ceiling. Bail immediately if the
    // unlock finishes but the key still isn't there.
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
      key = await _crypto.getSessionKey(sessionId: sessionId, myCode: code);
      if (key != null) return key;
      if (_crypto.isUnlocked) {
        if (await _tryRecoverSessionKey(sessionId, code)) {
          key = await _crypto.getSessionKey(
              sessionId: sessionId, myCode: code);
        }
        return key;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  /// Self-heals a session whose sessionKey_{myCode} field is missing.
  /// Happens when the initial createSessionKey call failed (partner
  /// didn't have a public key yet, network hiccup, etc). We have
  /// everything we need now, so just write it.
  Future<bool> _tryRecoverSessionKey(String sessionId, String myCode) async {
    try {
      final doc = await _db.collection('sessions').doc(sessionId).get();
      if (!doc.exists) return false;
      final data = doc.data()!;
      final participants =
          List<String>.from(data['participants'] ?? []);
      if (!participants.contains(myCode)) return false;

      // Already there? Then the prior attempt just failed to decrypt
      // (key mismatch â€” different problem).
      if (data['sessionKey_$myCode'] != null) return false;

      String partnerCode = '';
      for (final p in participants) {
        if (p != myCode) {
          partnerCode = p;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (partnerCode.isEmpty) return false;

      // Partner must have a public key on file â€” otherwise there's
      // nothing to encrypt to and we can't help.
      final partnerDoc =
          await _db.collection('users').doc(partnerCode).get();
      if (partnerDoc.data()?['publicKey'] == null) return false;

      await _crypto.createSessionKey(
        sessionId: sessionId,
        myCode: myCode,
        partnerCode: partnerCode,
      );
      print('[sessionKey] recovered key for $sessionId');
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      print('[sessionKey] recovery failed for $sessionId: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Throws if the session key is unavailable â€” refuses to write plaintext.
  Future<dynamic> _requireSessionKey(String sessionId) async {
    final key = await _sessionKey(sessionId);
    if (key == null) {
      throw StateError('Session key unavailable â€” refusing to write plaintext');
    }
    return key;
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // USER PROFILE
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> getProfile(String code) async {
    final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(code).get();
    return doc.exists ? doc.data() : null;
  }

  Future<void> updateProfile(Map<String, dynamic> data) async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update({
      ...data,
      'lastSeen': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  
  /// Atomically increments a numeric counter field on the current user's
  /// doc. Uses FieldValue.increment so concurrent writes from another
  /// device (or a retry) can't clobber the value. Missing fields are
  /// treated as 0 by Firestore. Silently no-ops if we're not signed in.
  Future<void> incrementUserCounter(String key, int delta) async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    try {
      await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update({
        key: FieldValue.increment(delta),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      print('[incrementUserCounter] $key delta=$delta failed: $e');
    }
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // DISCOVERY
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

  Stream<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> discoverableUsers({
    String? genre,
    int limit = 20,
  }) {
    final myCode = _auth.currentCode;
    Query query = _db
        .collection('users')
        .where('isDiscoverable', isEqualTo: true)
        .limit(limit);

    if (genre != null && genre.isNotEmpty) {
      query = query.where('genres', arrayContains: genre);
    }

    return query.snapshots().map((snap) => snap.docs
        .map((d) => d.data() as Map<String, dynamic>)
        .where((u) => u['code'] != myCode)
        .toList());
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // INTERESTS (requests)
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

  Future<void> sendInterest({
    required String toCode,
    required String message,
    required String genre,
  }) async {
    final fromCode = _auth.currentCode!;
    final fromName = _auth.currentName!;

    await _db.collection('interests').add({
      'fromCode': fromCode,
      'fromName': fromName,
      'toCode': toCode,
      'message': message,
      'genre': genre,
      'status': 'pending',
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    await _addNotification(
      toCode: toCode,
      type: 'interest',
      title: 'New interest from $fromName',
      subtitle: '$genre Â· Just now',
      data: {'fromCode': fromCode, 'genre': genre},
    );
  }

  Future<String> respondToInterest({
    required String interestId,
    required String fromCode,
    required String fromName,
    required String genre,
    required bool accepted,
  }) async {
    final myCode = _auth.currentCode!;
    final myName = _auth.currentName!;
    final interestRef = _db.collection('interests').doc(interestId);

    // Transaction: only the first responder wins. A double-tap or a retry
    // sees status != 'pending' and bails, so we can't create two sessions.
    final sessionId = await _db.runTransaction<String>((tx) async {
      final snap = await tx.get(interestRef);
      if (!snap.exists) return '';
      final data = snap.data()!;
      if (data['status'] != 'pending') return '';

      tx.update(interestRef, {
        'status': accepted ? 'accepted' : 'declined',
        'respondedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });

      if (!accepted) return '';

      final sessionRef = _db.collection('sessions').doc();
      tx.set(sessionRef, {
        'participants': [myCode, fromCode],
        'participantNames': {myCode: myName, fromCode: fromName},
        'genre': genre,
        'status': 'brainstorm',
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'lastPostAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'postCount': 0,
      });
      return sessionRef.id;
    });

    if (sessionId.isEmpty) return '';

    // Post-transaction, best-effort. If either fails the session still
    // exists â€” the user can regenerate the key by re-opening the room.
    try {
      await _crypto.createSessionKey(
        sessionId: sessionId,
        myCode: myCode,
        partnerCode: fromCode,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      print('[respondToInterest] createSessionKey failed: $e');
    }

    try {
      await _addNotification(
        toCode: fromCode,
        type: 'accepted',
        title: '$myName accepted your request',
        subtitle: '$genre Â· Just now',
        data: {'sessionId': sessionId, 'genre': genre},
      );
    } catch (e) {
      print('[respondToInterest] notification failed: $e');
    }

    return sessionId;
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // SESSIONS (RP + Brainstorm)
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

  Stream<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> mySessions() {
    final code = _auth.currentCode!;
    return _db
        .collection('sessions')
        .where('participants', arrayContains: code)
        .snapshots()
        .map((snap) => snap.docs.map((d) {
              final data = d.data();
              data['id'] = d.id;
              return data;
            }).toList());
  }

  /// Sets or clears the session title. Empty string removes the title.
  Future<void> updateSessionTitle(String sessionId, String title) async {
    final trimmed = title.trim();
    if (trimmed.isEmpty) {
      await _db.collection('sessions').doc(sessionId).update({
        'title': FieldValue.delete(),
      });
    } else {
      await _db.collection('sessions').doc(sessionId).update({
        'title': trimmed,
        'titleUpdatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    }
  }


  Future<void> updateSessionStatus(String sessionId, String status) async {
    await _db.collection('sessions').doc(sessionId).update({
      'status': status,
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // POSTS (RP Room)
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

  Stream<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> sessionPosts(String sessionId) {
    return _db
        .collection('sessions')
        .doc(sessionId)
        .collection('posts')
        .snapshots()
        .asyncMap((snap) async {
          final sessionKey = await _sessionKey(sessionId);
          final docs = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
          for (final d in snap.docs) {
            final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(d.data());
            data['id'] = d.id;

            if (data['encrypted'] == true && sessionKey != null) {
              final cipher = data['content'] as String?;
              final iv = data['contentIv'] as String?;
              if (cipher != null && iv != null) {
                final plain = await _crypto.decryptContent(
                  cipherB64: cipher,
                  ivB64: iv,
                  sessionKey: sessionKey,
                );
                data['content'] = plain ?? '[encrypted]';
              }
              final qCipher = data['quotedContent'] as String?;
              final qIv = data['quotedContentIv'] as String?;
              if (qCipher != null && qIv != null) {
                final qPlain = await _crypto.decryptContent(
                  cipherB64: qCipher,
                  ivB64: qIv,
                  sessionKey: sessionKey,
                );
                data['quotedContent'] = qPlain;
              }
            }
            docs.add(data);
          }
          docs.sort((a, b) {
            final at = a['createdAt'];
            final bt = b['createdAt'];
            if (at == null) return -1;
            if (bt == null) return 1;
            return (at as dynamic).compareTo(bt as dynamic);
          });
          return docs;
        });
  }

  Future<void> addPost({
    required String sessionId,
    required String content,
    String? quotedPostId,
    String? quotedContent,
    String? quotedAuthor,
    String? characterName,
    String? locationName,
  }) async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    final name = _auth.currentName;
    if (code == null || name == null) {
      print('[addPost] ERROR: currentCode or currentName is null');
      return;
    }
    print('[addPost] Writing post to session $sessionId by $code');

    try {
      final sessionKey = await _requireSessionKey(sessionId);

      final enc = await _crypto.encryptContent(content, sessionKey);
      final storedContent = enc['cipher']!;
      final storedIv = enc['iv'];

      String? storedQuotedContent;
      String? storedQuotedIv;
      if (quotedContent != null) {
        final qEnc = await _crypto.encryptContent(quotedContent, sessionKey);
        storedQuotedContent = qEnc['cipher'];
        storedQuotedIv = qEnc['iv'];
      }

      final batch = _db.batch();
      final postRef = _db
          .collection('sessions')
          .doc(sessionId)
          .collection('posts')
          .doc();

      batch.set(postRef, {
        'authorCode': code,
        'authorName': name,
        'characterName': characterName,
        'locationName': locationName,
        'content': storedContent,
        'contentIv': storedIv,
        'quotedPostId': quotedPostId,
        'quotedContent': storedQuotedContent,
        'quotedContentIv': storedQuotedIv,
        'quotedAuthor': quotedAuthor,
        'encrypted': true,
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'edited': false,
      });

      batch.update(_db.collection('sessions').doc(sessionId), {
        'lastPostAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'postCount': FieldValue.increment(1),
        'lastPostAuthor': code,
        'status': 'active',
      });

      await batch.commit();
      print('[addPost] Success');

      final partnerCode = await _getPartnerCode(sessionId, code);
      if (partnerCode != null) {
        final wordCount = content.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
            .where((w) => w.isNotEmpty).length;
        await _addNotification(
          toCode: partnerCode,
          type: 'rp_post',
          title: '$name posted',
          subtitle: '$wordCount words',
          data: {'sessionId': sessionId},
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('[addPost] FAILED: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> editPost({
    required String sessionId,
    required String postId,
    required String newContent,
  }) async {
    final sessionKey = await _requireSessionKey(sessionId);
    final enc = await _crypto.encryptContent(newContent, sessionKey);
    await _db
        .collection('sessions')
        .doc(sessionId)
        .collection('posts')
        .doc(postId)
        .update({
      'content': enc['cipher']!,
      'contentIv': enc['iv'],
      'encrypted': true,
      'edited': true,
      'editedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  Future<void> deletePost({
    required String sessionId,
    required String postId,
  }) async {
    // Batch: either both writes land or neither does, so postCount
    // can't drift if the second write fails.
    final batch = _db.batch();
    batch.delete(_db
        .collection('sessions')
        .doc(sessionId)
        .collection('posts')
        .doc(postId));
    batch.update(_db.collection('sessions').doc(sessionId), {
      'postCount': FieldValue.increment(-1),
    });
    await batch.commit();
  }

  Stream<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> brainstormMessages(String sessionId) {
    return _db
        .collection('sessions')
        .doc(sessionId)
        .collection('brainstorm')
        .snapshots()
        .asyncMap((snap) async {
          final sessionKey = await _sessionKey(sessionId);
          final docs = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
          for (final d in snap.docs) {
            final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(d.data());
            data['id'] = d.id;
            if (data['encrypted'] == true && sessionKey != null) {
              final cipher = data['content'] as String?;
              final iv = data['contentIv'] as String?;
              if (cipher != null && iv != null) {
                final plain = await _crypto.decryptContent(
                  cipherB64: cipher, ivB64: iv, sessionKey: sessionKey);
                data['content'] = plain ?? '[encrypted]';
              }
            }
            docs.add(data);
          }
          docs.sort((a, b) {
            final at = a['createdAt'];
            final bt = b['createdAt'];
            if (at == null) return -1;
            if (bt == null) return 1;
            return (at as dynamic).compareTo(bt as dynamic);
          });
          return docs;
        });
  }

  Future<void> addBrainstormMessage({
    required String sessionId,
    required String content,
    required String type,
  }) async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    final name = _auth.currentName;
    if (code == null || name == null) return;

    final sessionKey = await _requireSessionKey(sessionId);
    final enc = await _crypto.encryptContent(content, sessionKey);
    final storedContent = enc['cipher']!;
    final storedIv = enc['iv'];

    await _db
        .collection('sessions')
        .doc(sessionId)
        .collection('brainstorm')
        .add({
      'authorCode': code,
      'authorName': name,
      'content': storedContent,
      'contentIv': storedIv,
      'encrypted': true,
      'type': type,
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    final partnerCode = await _getPartnerCode(sessionId, code);
    if (partnerCode != null) {
      await _addNotification(
        toCode: partnerCode,
        type: 'brainstorm_message',
        title: '$name sent a message',
        subtitle: 'New message',
        data: {'sessionId': sessionId},
      );
    }
  }

  /// Change a brainstorm message's type after the fact. Used by the
  /// prelude pin menu â€” someone long-presses a chat message and
  /// promotes it to a rule / character / world / plot pin, or converts
  /// a pin back to chat.
  Future<void> setBrainstormMessageType({
    required String sessionId,
    required String messageId,
    required String type,
  }) async {
    await _db
        .collection('sessions')
        .doc(sessionId)
        .collection('brainstorm')
        .doc(messageId)
        .update({'type': type});
  }



  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
