  Future<void> addOocMessage({
    required String sessionId,
    required String content,
    bool isSystem = false,
  }) async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    final name = _auth.currentName;
    if (code == null || name == null) return;

    String storedContent = content;
    String? storedIv;
    if (!isSystem) {
      final sessionKey = await _requireSessionKey(sessionId);
      final enc = await _crypto.encryptContent(content, sessionKey);
      storedContent = enc['cipher']!;
      storedIv = enc['iv'];
    }

    await _db
        .collection('sessions')
        .doc(sessionId)
        .collection('ooc')
        .add({
      'authorCode': isSystem ? 'system' : code,
      'authorName': isSystem ? 'System' : name,
      'content': storedContent,
      'contentIv': storedIv,
      'encrypted': !isSystem,
      'isSystem': isSystem,
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    if (!isSystem) {
      final partnerCode = await _getPartnerCode(sessionId, code);
      if (partnerCode != null) {
        await _addNotification(
          toCode: partnerCode,
          type: 'ooc_message',
          title: '$name (OOC)',
          subtitle: 'New message',
          data: {'sessionId': sessionId},
        );
      }
    }
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // NOTIFICATIONS
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

  Stream<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> myNotifications() {
    final code = _auth.currentCode!;
    return _db
        .collection('notifications')
        .where('toCode', isEqualTo: code)
        .orderBy('createdAt', descending: true)
        .limit(50)
        .snapshots()
        .map((snap) => snap.docs.map((d) {
              final data = d.data();
              data['id'] = d.id;
              return data;
            }).toList());
  }

  Future<void> markNotificationRead(String notifId) async {
    await _db.collection('notifications').doc(notifId).update({'read': true});
  }

  /// Returns the other participant's code, or null if the session has
  /// no valid partner (missing, single-participant, or the caller isn't
  /// in the list). Previously returned '' which callers treated as truthy.
  Future<String?> _getPartnerCode(String sessionId, String myCode) async {
    try {
      final doc = await _db.collection('sessions').doc(sessionId).get();
      if (!doc.exists) return null;
      final participants =
          List<String>.from(doc.data()?['participants'] ?? []);
      if (participants.length < 2) return null;
      for (final p in participants) {
        if (p != myCode) return p;
      }
      return null;
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _addNotification({
    required String toCode,
    required String type,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    Map<String, dynamic>? data,
  }) async {
    await _db.collection('notifications').add({
      'toCode': toCode,
      'type': type,
      'title': title,
      'subtitle': subtitle,
      'data': data ?? {},
      'read': false,
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  // â”€â”€ Invite Codes â”€â”€

  Future<String> generateInviteCode(String ownerCode) async {
    // Delete any existing unused invite code for this user
    final existing = await _db.collection('invites')
        .where('ownerCode', isEqualTo: ownerCode)
        .where('used', isEqualTo: false)
        .get();
    for (final doc in existing.docs) {
      await doc.reference.delete();
    }

    // Random.secure() so two users generating in the same millisecond
    // don't collide. Retry a few times in case the doc already exists.
    const chars = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
    final rnd = Random.secure();

    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt++) {
      final buf = StringBuffer();
      for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        buf.write(chars[rnd.nextInt(chars.length)]);
      }
      final code = buf.toString();
      final ref = _db.collection('invites').doc(code);
      final snap = await ref.get();
      if (!snap.exists) {
        await ref.set({
          'code': code,
          'ownerCode': ownerCode,
          'used': false,
          'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        });
        return code;
      }
    }

    throw StateError('Failed to generate unique invite code');
  }

  Future<String?> getActiveInviteCode(String ownerCode) async {
    final snap = await _db.collection('invites')
        .where('ownerCode', isEqualTo: ownerCode)
        .where('used', isEqualTo: false)
        .limit(1)
        .get();
    if (snap.docs.isEmpty) return null;
    return snap.docs.first.id;
  }

  Future<String?> validateInviteCode(String inviteCode) async {
    final doc = await _db.collection('invites')
        .doc(inviteCode.trim().toUpperCase()).get();
    if (!doc.exists) return null;
    final data = doc.data()!;
    if (data['used'] == true) return null;
    return data['ownerCode'] as String?;
  }

  Future<void> redeemInviteCode({
    required String inviteCode,
    required String fromCode,
    required String fromName,
  }) async {
    final trimmed = inviteCode.trim().toUpperCase();
    final inviteRef = _db.collection('invites').doc(trimmed);

    // Transaction: only one client can successfully mark the invite
    // used. A second simultaneous redeem reads used:true and returns null.
    final ownerCode = await _db.runTransaction<String?>((tx) async {
      final snap = await tx.get(inviteRef);
      if (!snap.exists) return null;
      final data = snap.data()!;
      if (data['used'] == true) return null;
      tx.update(inviteRef, {
        'used': true,
        'usedBy': fromCode,
        'usedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
      return data['ownerCode'] as String?;
    });

    if (ownerCode == null) return;

    try {
      await _addNotification(
        toCode: ownerCode,
        type: 'invite_request',
        title: 'Invite redeemed',
        subtitle: '$fromName wants to brainstorm with you',
        data: {
          'fromCode': fromCode,
          'fromName': fromName,
          'inviteCode': trimmed,
        },
      );
    } catch (e) {
      print('[redeemInviteCode] notification failed: $e');
    }
  }

  // â”€â”€ Block System â”€â”€

  Future<void> blockUser({
    required String myCode,
    required String blockedCode,
    required bool archiveSessions,
  }) async {
    await _db.collection('blocks').doc('${myCode}_$blockedCode').set({
      'blockerCode': myCode,
      'blockedCode': blockedCode,
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });

    if (archiveSessions) {
      final snap = await _db.collection('sessions')
          .where('participants', arrayContains: myCode)
          .get();
      for (final doc in snap.docs) {
        final participants =
            List<String>.from(doc.data()['participants'] ?? []);
        if (participants.contains(blockedCode)) {
          await doc.reference.update({'status': 'archived'});
        }
      }
    }
  }

  Future<bool> isBlocked({
    required String myCode,
    required String otherCode,
  }) async {
    final a = await _db.collection('blocks')
        .doc('${myCode}_$otherCode').get();
    final b = await _db.collection('blocks')
        .doc('${otherCode}_$myCode').get();
    return a.exists || b.exists;
  }

  Future<void> unblockUser({
    required String myCode,
    required String blockedCode,
  }) async {
    await _db.collection('blocks').doc('${myCode}_$blockedCode').delete();
  }

  Future<List<String>> getBlockedCodes(String myCode) async {
    final snap = await _db.collection('blocks')
        .where('blockerCode', isEqualTo: myCode)
        .get();
    return snap.docs.map((d) => d.data()['blockedCode'] as String).toList();
  }

  Future<List<String>> getWhoBlockedMe(String myCode) async {
    final snap = await _db.collection('blocks')
        .where('blockedCode', isEqualTo: myCode)
        .get();
    return snap.docs.map((d) => d.data()['blockerCode'] as String).toList();
  }

  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
  // SESSION STAT BLOCKS
  // â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

  /// One stat block per participant per session. Stored under the session
  /// (not the user doc) so it lives and dies with the RP â€” no bleed across
  /// sessions and nothing to clean up when the session is archived.
  Stream<Map<String, StatBlock>> sessionStats(String sessionId) {
    return _db
        .collection('sessions')
        .doc(sessionId)
        .collection('stats')
        .snapshots()
        .map((snap) {
      final result = <String, StatBlock>{};
      for (final doc in snap.docs) {
        try {
          result[doc.id] = _statBlockFromMap(doc.data());
        } catch (e) {
          print('[sessionStats] failed to parse ${doc.id}: $e');
        }
      }
      return result;
    });
  }

  /// Writes my stat block for this session. Pass `null` to remove it.
  Future<void> saveSessionStats(String sessionId, StatBlock? block) async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    final ref = _db
        .collection('sessions')
        .doc(sessionId)
        .collection('stats')
        .doc(code);
    if (block == null) {
      try {
        await ref.delete();
      } catch (_) {}
    } else {
      try {
        await ref.set(_statBlockToMap(block));
        print('[stats] wrote ${block.stats.length} stats for $code '
            'in session $sessionId');
      } catch (e) {
        print('[stats] WRITE FAILED: $e');
        rethrow;
      }
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> _statBlockToMap(StatBlock block) => {
        'name': block.name,
        'useTiles': block.useTiles,
        'stats': block.stats
            .map((s) => {
                  'name': s.name,
                  'value': s.value,
                  'isPool': s.isPool,
                  'maxValue': s.maxValue,
                  'barColor': s.barColor.toARGB32(),
                  'barStyle': s.barStyle.name,
                  'segments': s.segments,
                })
            .toList(),
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      };

  StatBlock _statBlockFromMap(Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final list = (data['stats'] as List<dynamic>? ?? []);
    return StatBlock(
      name: data['name'] as String? ?? 'Stats',
      useTiles: data['useTiles'] as bool? ?? false,
      stats: list.map((raw) {
        final m = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw as Map);
        return StatEntry(
          name: m['name'] as String? ?? '',
          value: (m['value'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
          isPool: m['isPool'] as bool? ?? false,
          maxValue: (m['maxValue'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
          barColor: m['barColor'] != null
              ? Color(m['barColor'] as int)
              : null,
          barStyle: StatBarStyle.values.firstWhere(
            (x) => x.name == m['barStyle'],
            orElse: () => StatBarStyle.stripe,
          ),
          segments: (m['segments'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 10,
        );
      }).toList(),
    );
  }
}


--- FILE: C:\Flutter Dev\lore2-1\lib\services\sandbox_sync.dart ---

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'auth_service.dart';
import '../models/world.dart';

/// Result of a cloud pull â€” null if nothing was there.
class SandboxPull {
  final List<WorldEntry> worlds;
  final List<CharacterEntry> characters;
  const SandboxPull({required this.worlds, required this.characters});
}

/// Mirrors the local sandbox storage to Firestore so worlds and
/// characters survive a device wipe or account transfer.
///
/// Push is debounced â€” a user editing five worlds in a row produces one
/// write, not five. Pull replaces local (cloud wins on login).
class SandboxSync {
  static final _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  static final _auth = AuthService();

  static Timer? _worldsDebounce;
  static Timer? _charsDebounce;
  static List<WorldEntry>? _pendingWorlds;
  static List<CharacterEntry>? _pendingChars;

  /// Queue a push of the world list. Called after every local save.
  static void pushWorlds(List<WorldEntry> worlds) {
    _pendingWorlds = worlds;
    _worldsDebounce?.cancel();
    _worldsDebounce = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 1), _flushWorlds);
  }

  /// Queue a push of the character list.
  static void pushCharacters(List<CharacterEntry> chars) {
    _pendingChars = chars;
    _charsDebounce?.cancel();
    _charsDebounce = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 1), _flushChars);
  }

  /// Force any pending writes to land now. Call on sign-out so nothing
  /// is lost to the debounce window.
  static Future<void> flush() async {
    _worldsDebounce?.cancel();
    _charsDebounce?.cancel();
    await _flushWorlds();
    await _flushChars();
  }

  static Future<void> _flushWorlds() async {
    final worlds = _pendingWorlds;
    if (worlds == null) return;
    _pendingWorlds = null;
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    try {
      await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update({
        'sandboxWorlds':
            jsonEncode(worlds.map((w) => w.toJson()).toList()),
        'sandboxUpdatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      print('[SandboxSync] worlds push failed: $e');
    }
  }

  static Future<void> _flushChars() async {
    final chars = _pendingChars;
    if (chars == null) return;
    _pendingChars = null;
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return;
    try {
      await _db.collection('users').doc(code).update({
        'sandboxCharacters':
            jsonEncode(chars.map((c) => c.toJson()).toList()),
        'sandboxUpdatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      print('[SandboxSync] characters push failed: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Pulls the cloud copy and writes it to local storage. Called from
  /// every successful login path. Safe to call when there's nothing in
  /// the cloud â€” it just no-ops.
  static Future<void> syncOnLogin() async {
    final pull = await SandboxSync.pull();
    if (pull == null) {
      // Account has never synced. Start clean so a previous user's
      // sandbox can't leak through if sign-out cleanup was skipped
      // (force-quit, crash, etc.).
      await SandboxStorage.saveWorlds(<WorldEntry>[]);
      await SandboxStorage.saveCharacters(<CharacterEntry>[]);
      return;
    }
    await SandboxStorage.saveWorlds(pull.worlds);
    await SandboxStorage.saveCharacters(pull.characters);
  }


  /// Read the cloud copy. Returns null if the account has never synced.
  /// Malformed data returns null rather than throwing â€” the local copy
  /// stays as-is and the user can keep working.
  static Future<SandboxPull?> pull() async {
    final code = _auth.currentCode;
    if (code == null) return null;
    try {
      final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(code).get();
      if (!doc.exists) return null;
      final data = doc.data();
      if (data == null) return null;

      final worldsRaw = data['sandboxWorlds'] as String?;
      final charsRaw = data['sandboxCharacters'] as String?;
      if (worldsRaw == null && charsRaw == null) return null;

      final worlds = <WorldEntry>[];
      final chars = <CharacterEntry>[];

      if (worldsRaw != null) {
        try {
          final list = jsonDecode(worldsRaw) as List;
          for (final e in list) {
            worlds.add(WorldEntry.fromJson(
                Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)));
          }
        } catch (e) {
          print('[SandboxSync] worlds parse failed: $e');
        }
      }
      if (charsRaw != null) {
        try {
          final list = jsonDecode(charsRaw) as List;
          for (final e in list) {
            chars.add(CharacterEntry.fromJson(
                Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)));
          }
        } catch (e) {
          print('[SandboxSync] characters parse failed: $e');
        }
      }

      return SandboxPull(worlds: worlds, characters: chars);
    } catch (e) {
      print('[SandboxSync] pull failed: $e');
      return null;
    }
  }
}

import 'package:audioplayers/audioplayers.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// SOUND KEYS
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class SoundKey {
  static const rpPost        = 'sound_rp_post';
  static const brainstormMsg = 'sound_brainstorm_msg';
  static const oocMsg        = 'sound_ooc_msg';
  static const interestSent  = 'sound_interest_sent';
  static const sessionAccept = 'sound_session_accept';
  static const moodSwitch    = 'sound_mood_switch';
  static const masterMute    = 'sound_master_mute';

  static const all = [
    rpPost,
    brainstormMsg,
    oocMsg,
    interestSent,
    sessionAccept,
    moodSwitch,
  ];

  static const labels = {
    rpPost:        'RP post sent',
    brainstormMsg: 'Prelude message',
    oocMsg:        'OOC message',
    interestSent:  'Interest sent',
    sessionAccept: 'Session accepted',
    moodSwitch:    'Mood shift',
  };
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// SOUND SERVICE â€” singleton
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
class SoundService {
  SoundService._();
  static final SoundService instance = SoundService._();

  final _pool = <String, AudioPlayer>{};
  SharedPreferences? _prefs;
  bool _loaded = false;

  // Sound file map
  static const _files = {
    SoundKey.rpPost:        'sounds/chime.mp3',
    SoundKey.brainstormMsg: 'sounds/writing_on_parchment.mp3',
    SoundKey.oocMsg:        'sounds/chime2.mp3',
    SoundKey.interestSent:  'sounds/folding_paper.mp3',
    SoundKey.sessionAccept: 'sounds/stamp.mp3',
    SoundKey.moodSwitch:    'sounds/page_turn.mp3',
  };

  Future<void> init() async {
    if (_loaded) return;
    _prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    _loaded = true;
  }

  bool get masterMute => _prefs?.getBool(SoundKey.masterMute) ?? false;

  bool isEnabled(String key) {
    if (masterMute) return false;
    return _prefs?.getBool(key) ?? true;
  }

  Future<void> setMasterMute(bool value) async {
    await _prefs?.setBool(SoundKey.masterMute, value);
  }

  Future<void> setEnabled(String key, bool value) async {
    await _prefs?.setBool(key, value);
  }

  Future<void> play(String key) async {
    await init();
    if (!isEnabled(key)) return;
    final file = _files[key];
    if (file == null) return;
    try {
      // Reuse or create player for this key
      _pool[key] ??= AudioPlayer();
      await _pool[key]!.stop();
      await _pool[key]!.play(AssetSource(file));
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void dispose() {
    for (final p in _pool.values) {
      p.dispose();
    }
    _pool.clear();
  }
}

// Global shorthand
final sounds = SoundService.instance;

                      letterSpacing: 1,
                      color: active ? cGold : cSmoke)),
            ),
          );
        }).toList()),
      ],
    );
  }

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: onTap,
      child: Container(

        )),

      onTap: onTap,
      child: Container(

        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: c,
          shape: BoxShape.circle,
          border: Border.all(
            color: selected ? cGold : Colors.white24,
            width: selected ? 3 : 1,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

                    color: cEmber.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Reset',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 9, color: cParchment, letterSpacing: 2))),
                  ),
                )),
              ]),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (confirm != true) return;
    await appSettings.setProfileGradient(
        [const Color(0xFF080808), const Color(0xFF0E0E0E)]);
    await appSettings.setProfileBorderColor(const Color(0xFF2a2a2a));
    await appSettings.setProfileBorderStyle('solid');
    for (final k in _textKeys) {
      await appSettings.setTextColour(k, null);
    }
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  @override

    final mq = MediaQuery.of(context);

    return Container(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: mq.size.height * 0.85),

  Widget _section(String text) => Text(text,
      style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
          color: cGold, letterSpacing: 3));

  Widget _colourRow({
    required String label,
    required Color? current,
    required ValueChanged<Color?> onPicked,

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(children: [
          Text(label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          if (current != null)
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
              child: const Text('set',
                  style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 8,
                      color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
            ),
        ]),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        SizedBox(
          height: 34,
          child: ListView(
            scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
            children: [
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => onPicked(null),
                child: Container(
                  width: 34, height: 34,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    border: Border.all(color: current == null ? cGold : cAsh),
                    color: current == null
                        ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.08) : Colors.transparent,
                  ),
                  child: Center(child: Icon(
                    Icons.format_color_reset_outlined,
                    size: 16,
                    color: current == null ? cGold : cSmoke,
                  )),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              ..._palette.map((c) => GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => onPicked(c),
                child: Container(
                  width: 34, height: 34,
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: c,
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: current == c ? cGold : Colors.white24,
                      width: current == c ? 3 : 1,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              )),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => LoreColourPicker.show(
                  context,
                  current: current ?? cGold,
                  onPicked: onPicked,
                ),
                child: Container(
                  width: 34, height: 34,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    border: Border.all(color: cGold),
                    color: cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                  ),
                  child: const Center(child: Icon(Icons.colorize, size: 16, color: cGold)),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _borderStyleRow() {
    const options = ['solid', 'double', 'glow', 'none'];
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        const Text('Border style',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: options.map((o) {
          final active = _borderStyle == o;
          return GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => _setBorderStyle(o),
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                border: Border.all(color: active ? cGold : cAsh),
                color: active ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.08) : Colors.transparent,
              ),
              child: Text(o[0].toUpperCase() + o.substring(1),
                  style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                      letterSpacing: 1,
                      color: active ? cGold : cSmoke)),
            ),
          );
        }).toList()),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// A compact, procedural spec for a TCG card frame.
///
/// Everything the frame draws is derived from [seed] plus a handful
/// of on/off flags, so an entire card style costs a few bytes on disk
/// while still allowing tens of thousands of unique combinations.
class CardFrameSpec {
  final int seed;
  final Color accent;
  final bool glow;    // soft outer glow on the corners
  final bool ornate;  // small diamonds inside each corner
  final bool dense;   // more tick marks / rails

  const CardFrameSpec({
    required this.seed,
    required this.accent,
    this.glow = false,
    this.ornate = false,
    this.dense = false,
  });

  CardFrameSpec copyWith({
    int? seed,
    Color? accent,
    bool? glow,
    bool? ornate,
    bool? dense,
  }) =>
      CardFrameSpec(
        seed: seed ?? this.seed,
        accent: accent ?? this.accent,
        glow: glow ?? this.glow,
        ornate: ornate ?? this.ornate,
        dense: dense ?? this.dense,
      );
}

/// Wraps [child] in a procedurally-drawn frame. Use on the card face;
/// the painter draws to the same bounds as the child, so it will sit
/// exactly around whatever you pass in.
class CardFrame extends StatelessWidget {
  final CardFrameSpec spec;
  final Widget child;
  /// 0..1 for animated glow. Leave 0 for static cards.
  final double pulse;

  const CardFrame({
    super.key,
    required this.spec,
    required this.child,
    this.pulse = 0,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => CustomPaint(
        painter: _CardFramePainter(spec: spec, pulse: pulse),
        child: child,
      );
}

class _CardFramePainter extends CustomPainter {
  final CardFrameSpec spec;
  final double pulse;
  _CardFramePainter({required this.spec, required this.pulse});

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final rnd = Random(spec.seed);
    final color = spec.accent;

    // â”€â”€ Derived procedural params â”€â”€
    final cornerLen     = 10.0 + rnd.nextDouble() * 18;   // 10â€“28
    final cornerThick   = 1.2  + rnd.nextDouble() * 2.2;  // 1.2â€“3.4
    final innerInset    = 5.0  + rnd.nextDouble() * 4.0;  // 5â€“9
    final hasTopRail    = rnd.nextBool();
    final hasBottomRail = rnd.nextBool();
    final hasLeftRail   = rnd.nextBool();
    final hasRightRail  = rnd.nextBool();
    final tickCount     = spec.dense ? 5 + rnd.nextInt(5) : 2 + rnd.nextInt(3);

    // â”€â”€ Outer hairlines â”€â”€
    final outerPaint = Paint()
      ..color = color.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = 1
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.square;
    canvas.drawRect(
      Rect.fromLTWH(0.5, 0.5, size.width - 1, size.height - 1),
      outerPaint,
    );

    // â”€â”€ Corner brackets â”€â”€
    final bracketPath = Path()
      ..moveTo(0, cornerLen)
      ..lineTo(0, 0)
      ..lineTo(cornerLen, 0)
      ..moveTo(size.width - cornerLen, 0)
      ..lineTo(size.width, 0)
      ..lineTo(size.width, cornerLen)
      ..moveTo(0, size.height - cornerLen)
      ..lineTo(0, size.height)
      ..lineTo(cornerLen, size.height)
      ..moveTo(size.width - cornerLen, size.height)
      ..lineTo(size.width, size.height)
      ..lineTo(size.width, size.height - cornerLen);

    // Glow pass first so the crisp bracket sits on top of its own halo.
    if (spec.glow) {
      final glowPaint = Paint()
        ..color = color.withValues(alpha: 0.30 + pulse * 0.30)
        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
        ..strokeWidth = cornerThick * 2.6
        ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
        ..maskFilter = const MaskFilter.blur(BlurStyle.normal, 8);
      canvas.drawPath(bracketPath, glowPaint);
    }

    final bracketPaint = Paint()
      ..color = color.withValues(alpha: 0.9)
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = cornerThick
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.square;
    canvas.drawPath(bracketPath, bracketPaint);

    // â”€â”€ Mid-rails (partial lines centred on each edge) â”€â”€
    final railPaint = Paint()
      ..color = color.withValues(alpha: 0.45)
      ..strokeWidth = cornerThick * 0.7
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.square;

    if (hasTopRail || hasBottomRail) {
      final railLen = size.width * (0.22 + rnd.nextDouble() * 0.26);
      if (hasTopRail) {
        canvas.drawLine(
          Offset(size.width / 2 - railLen / 2, 0.5),
          Offset(size.width / 2 + railLen / 2, 0.5),
          railPaint,
        );
      }
      if (hasBottomRail) {
        canvas.drawLine(
          Offset(size.width / 2 - railLen / 2, size.height - 0.5),
          Offset(size.width / 2 + railLen / 2, size.height - 0.5),
          railPaint,
        );
      }
    }
    if (hasLeftRail || hasRightRail) {
      final railLen = size.height * (0.22 + rnd.nextDouble() * 0.26);
      if (hasLeftRail) {
        canvas.drawLine(
          Offset(0.5, size.height / 2 - railLen / 2),
          Offset(0.5, size.height / 2 + railLen / 2),
          railPaint,
        );
      }
      if (hasRightRail) {
        canvas.drawLine(
          Offset(size.width - 0.5, size.height / 2 - railLen / 2),
          Offset(size.width - 0.5, size.height / 2 + railLen / 2),
          railPaint,
        );
      }
    }

    // â”€â”€ Tick marks along top and bottom â”€â”€
    final tickPaint = Paint()
      ..color = color.withValues(alpha: 0.35)
      ..strokeWidth = 1
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.square;
    for (int i = 0; i < tickCount; i++) {
      final x = size.width * (i + 1) / (tickCount + 1);
      if (x < cornerLen + 4 || x > size.width - cornerLen - 4) continue;
      canvas.drawLine(Offset(x, 0), Offset(x, 4), tickPaint);
      canvas.drawLine(
          Offset(x, size.height - 4), Offset(x, size.height), tickPaint);
    }

    // â”€â”€ Inner guide line â”€â”€
    canvas.drawRect(
      Rect.fromLTWH(
        innerInset,
        innerInset,
        size.width - innerInset * 2,
        size.height - innerInset * 2,
      ),
      Paint()
        ..color = color.withValues(alpha: 0.18)
        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
        ..strokeWidth = 0.8,
    );

    // â”€â”€ Corner ornaments â”€â”€
    if (spec.ornate) {
      final diamondPaint = Paint()..color = color.withValues(alpha: 0.7);
      final d = innerInset + 5;
      void diamond(Offset c, double r) {
        final p = Path()
          ..moveTo(c.dx, c.dy - r)
          ..lineTo(c.dx + r, c.dy)
          ..lineTo(c.dx, c.dy + r)
          ..lineTo(c.dx - r, c.dy)
          ..close();
        canvas.drawPath(p, diamondPaint);
      }
      diamond(Offset(d, d), 2.5);
      diamond(Offset(size.width - d, d), 2.5);
      diamond(Offset(d, size.height - d), 2.5);
      diamond(Offset(size.width - d, size.height - d), 2.5);
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _CardFramePainter old) =>
      old.pulse != pulse ||
      old.spec.seed != spec.seed ||
      old.spec.accent != spec.accent ||
      old.spec.glow != spec.glow ||
      old.spec.ornate != spec.ornate ||
      old.spec.dense != spec.dense;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../theme.dart';

class LoreColourPicker extends StatefulWidget {
  final Color current;
  final void Function(Color) onPicked;
  
  const LoreColourPicker({
    super.key,
    required this.current,
    required this.onPicked,
  });

  /// Helper to show it as a bottom sheet
  static void show(BuildContext context, {
    required Color current,
    required void Function(Color) onPicked,
  }) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => LoreColourPicker(
        current: current,
        onPicked: onPicked,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<LoreColourPicker> createState() => _LoreColourPickerState();
}

class _LoreColourPickerState extends State<LoreColourPicker> {
  late Color _picked;
  late TextEditingController _hexCtrl;

  double _hue = 0;
  double _sat = 1;
  double _val = 1;

  final List<Color> _quickPicks = [
    cParchment, cGold, cIce, cEmber, cMagic, cVine, Colors.white,
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _picked = widget.current;
    final hexString = _picked.toARGB32().toRadixString(16).padLeft(8, '0');
    _hexCtrl = TextEditingController(
      text: hexString.substring(2).toUpperCase(),
    );
    
    final hsv = HSVColor.fromColor(_picked);
    _hue = hsv.hue;
    _sat = hsv.saturation;
    _val = hsv.value;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _hexCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _updateHSV({double? h, double? s, double? v}) {
    setState(() {
      _hue = h ?? _hue;
      _sat = s ?? _sat;
      _val = v ?? _val;
      _picked = HSVColor.fromAHSV(1.0, _hue, _sat, _val).toColor();
      final hexString = _picked.toARGB32().toRadixString(16).padLeft(8, '0');
      _hexCtrl.text = hexString.substring(2).toUpperCase();
    });
  }

  void _updateFromHex(String val) {
    if (val.length == 6) {
      try {
        final newColor = Color(int.parse('FF$val', radix: 16));
        setState(() {
          _picked = newColor;
          final hsv = HSVColor.fromColor(_picked);
          _hue = hsv.hue;
          _sat = hsv.saturation;
          _val = hsv.value;
        });
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  Widget _buildSlider({
    required String label,
    required List<Color> colors,
    required double value, // 0.0 to 1.0
    required ValueChanged<double> onChanged,
  }) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(label, style: const TextStyle(
            fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9, 
            color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2)),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) {
            return GestureDetector(
              onHorizontalDragUpdate: (details) {
                final percent = (details.localPosition.dx / constraints.maxWidth).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                onChanged(percent);
              },
              onHorizontalDragStart: (details) {
                final percent = (details.localPosition.dx / constraints.maxWidth).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                onChanged(percent);
              },
              onTapDown: (details) {
                final percent = (details.localPosition.dx / constraints.maxWidth).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                onChanged(percent);
              },
              child: Container(
                height: 28,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                  gradient: LinearGradient(colors: colors),
                  border: Border.all(color: cAsh),
                ),
                child: Stack(
                  children: [
                    Positioned(
                      left: (value * constraints.maxWidth) - 8,
                      top: 0, bottom: 0,
                      child: Center(
                        child: Container(
                          width: 16, height: 16,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            color: Colors.transparent,
                            border: Border.all(color: Colors.white, width: 2),
                            boxShadow: const [BoxShadow(color: Colors.black45, blurRadius: 2)],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    )
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Center(
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 400),
        child: Material(
          color: cInk,
          shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(14)),
          ),
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
              Container(width: 32, height: 3,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(color: cAsh,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2))),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              const Text('PICK COLOUR', style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                  color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              
              Row(children: [
                Container(
                  width: 44, height: 44,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: _picked,
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    border: Border.all(color: cAsh),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 16),
                Expanded(
                  child: Row(children: [
                    const Text('#', style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 20, color: cGold)),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: _hexCtrl,
                        style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 18, color: cParchment, letterSpacing: 2),
                        decoration: const InputDecoration(
                          isDense: true,
                          hintText: 'FFFFFF',
                          hintStyle: TextStyle(color: cAsh, letterSpacing: 2),
                          border: InputBorder.none,
                        ),
                        onChanged: _updateFromHex,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ]),
                ),
              ]),
              
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              
              Wrap(
                spacing: 8,
                children: _quickPicks.map((c) {
                  final isSelected = _picked.value == c.value;
                  return GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () {
                      setState(() {
                        _picked = c;
                        _hexCtrl.text = c.value.toRadixString(16).substring(2).toUpperCase();
                        final hsv = HSVColor.fromColor(_picked);
                        _hue = hsv.hue; _sat = hsv.saturation; _val = hsv.value;
                      });
                    },
                    child: Container(
                      width: 28, height: 28,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: c, shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        border: Border.all(color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.transparent, width: 2),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }).toList(),
              ),
              
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              
              _buildSlider(
                label: 'HUE',
                colors: const [
                  Color(0xFFFF0000), Color(0xFFFFFF00), Color(0xFF00FF00),
                  Color(0xFF00FFFF), Color(0xFF0000FF), Color(0xFFFF00FF), Color(0xFFFF0000)
                ],
                value: _hue / 360.0,
                onChanged: (v) => _updateHSV(h: v * 360.0),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              _buildSlider(
                label: 'SATURATION',
                colors: [
                  HSVColor.fromAHSV(1.0, _hue, 0.0, _val).toColor(),
                  HSVColor.fromAHSV(1.0, _hue, 1.0, _val).toColor(),
                ],
                value: _sat,
                onChanged: (v) => _updateHSV(s: v),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              _buildSlider(
                label: 'BRIGHTNESS',
                colors: [
                  HSVColor.fromAHSV(1.0, _hue, _sat, 0.0).toColor(),
                  HSVColor.fromAHSV(1.0, _hue, _sat, 1.0).toColor(),
                ],
                value: _val,
                onChanged: (v) => _updateHSV(v: v),
              ),
              
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: () {
                  widget.onPicked(_picked);
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
                child: Container(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                  color: cParchment,
                  child: const Center(child: Text('Use this colour',
                      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                          fontSize: 10, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 2))),
                ),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}


--- FILE: C:\Flutter Dev\lore2-1\lib\widgets\foil_overlay.dart ---

import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// Paints a subtle static holo pattern across the card face. When the
/// user drags a finger across it, a bright highlight follows the touch
/// and a streak sweeps with it. On release the highlight eases back to
/// a resting position, so cards in a list stay completely still until
/// someone actually touches them.
///
/// Uses a raw [Listener] rather than a [GestureDetector] so it does NOT
/// consume tap events â€” the parent card remains tappable.
class FoilOverlay extends StatefulWidget {
  final Widget child;
  final Color accent;
  final bool enabled;
  /// 0..1 â€” overall strength of the foil effect.
  final double intensity;
  /// Seeds the static band pattern, so each card is visibly different.
  final int seed;

  const FoilOverlay({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    required this.accent,
    this.enabled = true,
    this.intensity = 0.6,
    this.seed = 0,
  });

  @override
  State<FoilOverlay> createState() => _FoilOverlayState();
}

class _FoilOverlayState extends State<FoilOverlay>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  /// Where the highlight rests when nothing is touching the card.
  /// Slightly above centre reads as "lit from above".
  static const Offset _rest = Offset(0.5, 0.35);

  Offset _touch = _rest;
  late final AnimationController _activity;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _activity = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 700),
      value: 0,
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _activity.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onPointer(Offset local, Size size) {
    if (size.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() {
      _touch = Offset(
        (local.dx / size.width).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
        (local.dy / size.height).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
      );
      _activity.value = 1.0;
    });
  }

  void _release() {
    if (_activity.value == 0) return;
    _activity.animateTo(0, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!widget.enabled) return widget.child;

    return LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, constraints) {
      final size = constraints.biggest;
      return Listener(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.translucent,
        onPointerDown: (e) => _onPointer(e.localPosition, size),
        onPointerMove: (e) => _onPointer(e.localPosition, size),
        onPointerUp: (_) => _release(),
        onPointerCancel: (_) => _release(),
        child: Stack(
          children: [
            widget.child,
            Positioned.fill(
              child: IgnorePointer(
                child: AnimatedBuilder(
                  animation: _activity,
                  builder: (_, _) {
                    final t = _activity.value;
                    final light = Offset.lerp(_touch, _rest, 1 - t)!;
                    return CustomPaint(
                      painter: _FoilPainter(
                        light: light,
                        activity: t,
                        accent: widget.accent,
                        intensity: widget.intensity,
                        seed: widget.seed,
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    });
  }
}

class _FoilPainter extends CustomPainter {
  final Offset light;      // normalised 0..1
  final double activity;   // 0..1
  final Color accent;
  final double intensity;
  final int seed;

  _FoilPainter({
    required this.light,
    required this.activity,
    required this.accent,
    required this.intensity,
    required this.seed,
  });

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final rect = Offset.zero & size;
    _paintBaseBands(canvas, size, rect);
    if (activity > 0.005) _paintHighlight(canvas, size, rect);
  }

  /// Static holo bands â€” always visible, no animation. Two or three
  /// soft diagonal washes tinted by the accent, offset by [seed] so
  /// every card reads differently at a glance.
  void _paintBaseBands(Canvas canvas, Size size, Rect rect) {
    final rnd = Random(seed);
    final bandCount = 2 + rnd.nextInt(3);
    final lean = (rnd.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.7; // -0.35 .. 0.35

    for (int i = 0; i < bandCount; i++) {
      final t = (i + 1) / (bandCount + 1);
      // Rotate through hues anchored on the accent, so cards with
      // different accents look genuinely different, not just recoloured.
      final accentHue = HSLColor.fromColor(accent).hue;
      final hue = (accentHue + (i - bandCount / 2) * 35 + rnd.nextDouble() * 20) % 360;

      final band = HSLColor.fromAHSL(
        0.055 * intensity,
        hue,
        0.65,
        0.60,
      ).toColor();

      final centerX = size.width * (0.5 + lean + (t - 0.5) * 0.6);
      final shaderRect = Rect.fromCenter(
        center: Offset(centerX, size.height * 0.5),
        width: size.longestSide * 0.55,
        height: size.longestSide * 1.6,
      );

      final paint = Paint()
        ..shader = LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
          colors: [Colors.transparent, band, Colors.transparent],
          stops: const [0.0, 0.5, 1.0],
        ).createShader(shaderRect);
      canvas.drawRect(rect, paint);
    }
  }

  /// The moving light. A soft radial halo (white core â†’ accent ring)
  /// plus a bright streak that sweeps toward the touch point.
  void _paintHighlight(Canvas canvas, Size size, Rect rect) {
    final center = Offset(light.dx * size.width, light.dy * size.height);
    final radius = size.longestSide * 0.75;

    // Halo
    final halo = Paint()
      ..shader = RadialGradient(
        colors: [
          Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.20 * activity * intensity),
          accent.withValues(alpha: 0.12 * activity * intensity),
          Colors.transparent,
        ],
        stops: const [0.0, 0.35, 1.0],
      ).createShader(Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: radius));
    canvas.drawRect(rect, halo);

    // Streak â€” reads as the "shine" of moving foil.
    final streak = Paint()
      ..shader = LinearGradient(
        begin: Alignment.topLeft,
        end: Alignment.bottomRight,
        colors: [
          Colors.transparent,
          accent.withValues(alpha: 0.16 * activity),
          Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.14 * activity),
          Colors.transparent,
        ],
        stops: const [0.0, 0.35, 0.55, 1.0],
      ).createShader(Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: radius));
    canvas.drawRect(rect, streak);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _FoilPainter old) =>
      old.light != light ||
      old.activity != activity ||
      old.accent != accent ||
      old.intensity != intensity ||
      old.seed != seed;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../settings.dart';

class FriendsStrip extends StatelessWidget {
  final VoidCallback onFindFriends;
  final void Function(String code) onFriendTap;

  const FriendsStrip({
    super.key,
    required this.onFindFriends,
    required this.onFriendTap,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final myCode = AuthService().currentCode;
    if (myCode == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    final style = appSettings.styleForBlock(AppSettings.blockSettings);
    final borderColor = style.borderColor ?? cAsh;

    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot>(
      stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('users')
          .doc(myCode)
          .collection('friends')
          .limit(10)
          .snapshots(),
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        final docs = snapshot.data?.docs ?? [];
        final hasFriends = docs.isNotEmpty;

        return Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 8),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: style.background ?? cInk,
            border: Border.all(color: borderColor, width: 1.5),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
          ),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              // Header row (like the Settings full-width block)
              InkWell(
                onTap: hasFriends ? null : onFindFriends, // Tap header to find if empty
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 14, 4),
                  child: Row(children: [
                    Icon(Icons.people_outline, size: 18, color: style.accent ?? cSmoke),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    const Text('FRIENDS', style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                        color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2)),
                    const Spacer(),
                    if (!hasFriends)
                      const Text('FIND â†’', style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                          color: cGold, letterSpacing: 1)),
                  ]),
                ),
              ),
              // Horizontal friend list
              if (hasFriends)
                SizedBox(
                  height: 72,
                  child: ListView.builder(
                    scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 4, 14, 12),
                    itemCount: docs.length,
                    itemBuilder: (context, i) {
                      final friendCode = docs[i].id;
                      return _FriendAvatar(
                        code: friendCode,
                        onTap: () => onFriendTap(friendCode),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                )
              else
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 0, 14, 12),
                  child: Text('Find partners to start building your circle.',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke,
                          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _FriendAvatar extends StatelessWidget {
  final String code;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  const _FriendAvatar({required this.code, required this.onTap});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot>(
      stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(code).snapshots(),
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (!snapshot.hasData) return const SizedBox(width: 60);
        final data = snapshot.data!.data() as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
        final name = data['displayNameOriginal'] as String? ?? '?';
        final status = data['statusText'] as String? ?? '';
        final initial = name.isNotEmpty ? name[0].toUpperCase() : '?';
        final color = data['accentColor'] != null ? Color(data['accentColor'] as int) : cGold;

        return GestureDetector(
          onTap: onTap,
          child: Container(
            width: 110,
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 10),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: cVoid.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
              border: Border.all(color: cAsh),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 32, height: 32,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    color: cInk,
                    border: Border.all(color: color),
                  ),
                  child: Center(child: Text(initial,
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: color,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w300))),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Text(name, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
                              color: cParchment, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300)),
                      if (status.isNotEmpty) ...[
                        const SizedBox(height: 2),
                        Text(status, maxLines: 2, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 9,
                                color: cSmoke, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                                height: 1.2)),
                      ]
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../settings.dart';
import 'shared.dart';

/// A single tile in the home grid.
class HomeGridBlock {
  final IconData icon;
  final String title;
  final String subtitle;
  final int? badge;
  final Color accent;
  final bool fullWidth;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final VoidCallback? onLongPress;
  final BlockStyle style;

  const HomeGridBlock({
    required this.icon,
    required this.title,
    required this.subtitle,
    required this.onTap,
    this.onLongPress,
    this.style = const BlockStyle(),
    this.badge,
    this.accent = cSmoke,
    this.fullWidth = false,
  });
}

/// Two-column grid of tappable blocks. Tap pushes a full-screen route
/// supplied by the caller. Long-press opens the customization sheet.
class HomeGrid extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<HomeGridBlock> blocks;
  const HomeGrid({super.key, required this.blocks});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 8),
      child: LayoutBuilder(
        builder: (_, constraints) {
          final halfWidth = (constraints.maxWidth - 10) / 2;
          return Wrap(
            spacing: 10,
            runSpacing: 10,
            children: blocks.map((b) {
              final width = b.fullWidth ? constraints.maxWidth : halfWidth;
              return SizedBox(
                width: width,
                child: _HomeGridTile(block: b, fullWidth: b.fullWidth),
              );
            }).toList(),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _HomeGridTile extends StatelessWidget {
  final HomeGridBlock block;
  final bool fullWidth;
  const _HomeGridTile({required this.block, required this.fullWidth});

  // Effective values â€” style overrides win, block defaults fill in.
  Color get _bg => block.style.background ?? cInk;
  Color get _borderColor => block.style.borderColor ?? cAsh;
  Color get _accent => block.style.accent ?? block.accent;

  BoxDecoration _tileDecoration() {
    // Base
    final decoration = BoxDecoration(
      color: _bg,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
    );

    switch (block.style.borderStyle) {
      case 'thick':
        return decoration.copyWith(
          border: Border.all(color: _borderColor, width: 3),
        );
      case 'faded':
        return decoration.copyWith(
          border: Border.all(color: _borderColor.withValues(alpha: 0.35), width: 1),
        );
      case 'glow':
        return decoration.copyWith(
          border: Border.all(color: _borderColor.withValues(alpha: 0.7), width: 1),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: _borderColor.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
              blurRadius: 12,
              spreadRadius: 1,
            ),
          ],
        );
      default: // solid
        return decoration.copyWith(
          border: Border.all(color: _borderColor, width: 1.5),
        );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return LoreTap(
      onTap: block.onTap,
      onLongPress: block.onLongPress,
      child: Container(
        height: fullWidth ? 64 : 96,
        decoration: _tileDecoration(),
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: fullWidth ? 16 : 14,
          vertical: fullWidth ? 12 : 14,
        ),
        child: fullWidth ? _fullWidthLayout() : _stackedLayout(),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _stackedLayout() {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
      children: [
        Row(children: [
          Icon(block.icon, size: 18, color: _accent),
          const Spacer(),
          if (block.badge != null && block.badge! > 0)
            _badge()
          else
            const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, size: 16, color: cSmoke),
        ]),
        Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(block.title,
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14, color: cMist,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, letterSpacing: 0.3)),
            const SizedBox(height: 2),
            Text(block.subtitle,
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                    color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _fullWidthLayout() {
    return Row(children: [
      Icon(block.icon, size: 18, color: _accent),
      const SizedBox(width: 12),
      Expanded(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(block.title,
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14, color: cMist,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, letterSpacing: 0.3)),
            if (block.subtitle.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 1),
              Text(block.subtitle,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                      color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
      if (block.badge != null && block.badge! > 0) _badge(),
      const SizedBox(width: 4),
      const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, size: 16, color: cSmoke),
    ]);
  }

  Widget _badge() {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _accent,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
      ),
      child: Text('${block.badge}',
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: cVoid,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../settings.dart';
import 'shared.dart';

/// A single stat to display on the profile card.
class ProfileStat {
  final String key;
  final String label;
  final String value;
  const ProfileStat({
    required this.key,
    required this.label,
    required this.value,
  });
}

/// The big card at the top of the home screen.
///
/// Pure display + one interaction: tapping anywhere (except the code
/// reveal) opens the full profile editor. The card itself doesn't load
/// anything; main.dart computes the stats and passes them in.
class HomeProfileCard extends StatefulWidget {
  final String name;
  final String code;
  final String bio;
  final List<ProfileStat> stats;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final VoidCallback? onLongPress;

  const HomeProfileCard({
    super.key,
    required this.name,
    required this.code,
    required this.bio,
    required this.stats,
    required this.onTap,
    this.onLongPress,
  });

  @override
  State<HomeProfileCard> createState() => _HomeProfileCardState();
}

class _HomeProfileCardState extends State<HomeProfileCard> {
  bool _codeRevealed = false;

  Future<void> _revealCode() async {
    if (_codeRevealed) return;
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => _CodeDialog(
        title: 'UNIQUE CODE',
        body:
            'This is your permanent identity on Lore. It cannot be changed '
            'or recovered.\n\nNever share it with anyone. It is only needed '
            'if you transfer to a new device.',
        actionLabel: 'Reveal',
        actionColor: cGold,
      ),
    );
    if (confirm == true && mounted) {
      setState(() => _codeRevealed = true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _copyCode() async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => _CodeDialog(
        title: 'COPY UNIQUE CODE',
        body:
            'Only do this if you are transferring to a new device.\n\n'
            'Never give your unique code to anyone else â€” it is your '
            'permanent identity and cannot be changed.',
        actionLabel: 'Copy anyway',
        actionColor: cEmber,
      ),
    );
    if (confirm == true && mounted) {
      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: widget.code));
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
        backgroundColor: cInk,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(),
        content: Text('Unique code copied. Guard it carefully.',
            style: TextStyle(color: cParchment, fontSize: 13,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
      ));
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: appSettings,
      builder: (_, _) {
        return LoreTap(
          onTap: widget.onTap,
          onLongPress: widget.onLongPress,
          child: Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 8),
            decoration: _cardDecoration(),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  _buildHeader(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  _buildBio(),
                  if (widget.stats.isNotEmpty) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 20),
                    _buildStats(),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHeader() {
    return Row(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Container(
          width: 56, height: 56,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            shape: BoxShape.circle,
            border: Border.all(color: cAsh),
            color: cVoid.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
          ),
          child: const Icon(Icons.person, color: cSmoke, size: 28),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 16),
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(widget.name, style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, color: cParchment)),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              _codeRevealed ? _revealedCodeRow() : _hiddenCodeRow(),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, size: 18, color: cSmoke),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _hiddenCodeRow() {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: _revealCode,
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      child: const Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
        child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
          Icon(Icons.lock_outline, size: 11, color: cSmoke),
          SizedBox(width: 5),
          Text('UNIQUE CODE â€” tap to reveal',
              style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                  color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _revealedCodeRow() {
    return Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
      Text(widget.code, style: const TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 12,
          color: cGold, letterSpacing: 2)),
      const SizedBox(width: 8),
      GestureDetector(
        onTap: _copyCode,
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        child: const Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.all(4),
          child: Icon(Icons.copy, size: 13, color: cSmoke),
        ),
      ),
      const SizedBox(width: 4),
      GestureDetector(
        onTap: () => setState(() => _codeRevealed = false),
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        child: const Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.all(4),
          child: Icon(Icons.visibility_off, size: 13, color: cSmoke),
        ),
      ),
    ]);
  }

  Widget _buildBio() {
    final text = widget.bio.isEmpty ? 'Tap to add a bio...' : widget.bio;
    return Text(
      text,
      maxLines: 2,
      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
      style: TextStyle(
        fontSize: 13,
        color: widget.bio.isEmpty ? cSmoke : cMist,
        fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
        height: 1.6,
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStats() {
    return Wrap(
      spacing: 10,
      runSpacing: 10,
      children: widget.stats.map((s) => _statChip(s)).toList(),
    );
  }

  Widget _statChip(ProfileStat s) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: cVoid.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
        border: Border.all(color: cAsh),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Text(s.value, style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
              color: cParchment, height: 1.1)),
          const SizedBox(height: 2),
          Text(s.label.toUpperCase(), style: const TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 8,
              color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1.5)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  BoxDecoration _cardDecoration() {
    final gradient = appSettings.profileGradient;
    final borderColor = appSettings.profileBorderColor;
    final style = appSettings.profileBorderStyle;

    Border border;
    List<BoxShadow>? shadows;

    switch (style) {
      case 'double':
        border = Border.all(color: borderColor, width: 3);
        break;
      case 'glow':
        border = Border.all(color: borderColor.withValues(alpha: 0.7), width: 1);
        shadows = [BoxShadow(
            color: borderColor.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
            blurRadius: 16, spreadRadius: 2)];
        break;
      case 'none':
        border = Border.all(color: Colors.transparent, width: 1);
        break;
      default:
        border = Border.all(color: borderColor, width: 1.5);
    }

    return BoxDecoration(
      gradient: LinearGradient(
        begin: Alignment.topLeft,
        end: Alignment.bottomRight,
        colors: gradient,
      ),
      border: border,
      boxShadow: shadows,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
    );
  }
}

class _CodeDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  final String title;
  final String body;
  final String actionLabel;
  final Color actionColor;
  const _CodeDialog({
    required this.title,

  @override

          Text(title, style: TextStyle(

          const SizedBox(height: 12),

              ),
            )),
          ]),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../theme.dart';

class Lore3DCard extends StatefulWidget {
  final Widget child;
  final Color foilColor;
  const Lore3DCard({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.foilColor = cGold,
  });

  @override
  State<Lore3DCard> createState() => _Lore3DCardState();
}

class _Lore3DCardState extends State<Lore3DCard> {
  double _rotateX = 0;
  double _rotateY = 0;
  Offset _glare = Offset.zero;
  bool _active = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => LayoutBuilder(
    builder: (context, constraints) {
      final w = constraints.maxWidth;
      final h = constraints.maxHeight == double.infinity
          ? 300.0
          : constraints.maxHeight;

      return Listener(
        onPointerDown: (e) => _update(e.localPosition, w, h, true),
        onPointerMove: (e) => _update(e.localPosition, w, h, true),
        onPointerUp: (_) => _reset(),
        onPointerCancel: (_) => _reset(),
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
          curve: Curves.easeOut,
          transform: Matrix4.identity()
            ..setEntry(3, 2, 0.0015)
            ..rotateX(_rotateX)
            ..rotateY(_rotateY),
          transformAlignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Stack(children: [
            widget.child,
            if (_active)
              Positioned.fill(
                child: IgnorePointer(
                  child: ClipRect(
                    child: Container(
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        gradient: RadialGradient(
                          center: Alignment(
                            (_glare.dx / w) * 2 - 1,
                            (_glare.dy / h) * 2 - 1,
                          ),
                          radius: 1.1,
                          colors: [
                            widget.foilColor.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                            widget.foilColor.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                            Colors.transparent,
                          ],
                          stops: const [0.0, 0.35, 0.7],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
          ]),
        ),
      );
    },
  );

  void _update(Offset local, double w, double h, bool active) {
    setState(() {
      _active = active;
      // Cap tilt at ~8 degrees each direction
      _rotateY = ((local.dx / w) - 0.5) * 0.28;
      _rotateX = (0.5 - (local.dy / h)) * 0.28;
      _glare = local;
    });
  }

  void _reset() {
    setState(() {
      _rotateX = 0;
      _rotateY = 0;
      _active = false;
    });
  }
}
