import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../theme.dart';

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// DATA MODEL
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
enum LogEntryType { rule, character, location, event, note }
enum CharacterRole { main, side, npc }

class LogEntry {
  final String id;
  final LogEntryType type;
  final String title;
  final String body;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  final CharacterRole? role;
  final String? source; // 'dice', 'mood', 'location', 'character', etc.
  final Map<String, dynamic>? meta;

  LogEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.title,
    required this.body,
    required this.createdAt,
    this.role,
    this.source,
    this.meta,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'id': id,
        'type': type.name,
        'title': title,
        'body': body,
        'createdAt': createdAt.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
        if (role != null) 'role': role!.name,
        if (source != null) 'source': source,
        if (meta != null) 'meta': meta,
      };

  static LogEntry fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) => LogEntry(
        id: j['id'] as String,
        type: LogEntryType.values.firstWhere(
          (t) => t.name == j['type'],
          orElse: () => LogEntryType.note,
        ),
        title: j['title'] as String? ?? '',
        body: j['body'] as String? ?? '',
        createdAt: DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(j['createdAt'] as int),
        role: j['role'] != null
            ? CharacterRole.values.firstWhere(
                (r) => r.name == j['role'],
                orElse: () => CharacterRole.side,
              )
            : null,
        source: j['source'] as String?,
        meta: j['meta'] != null
            ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(j['meta'] as Map)
            : null,
      );
}

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// STORAGE â€” one log per session
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
class SessionLog extends ChangeNotifier {
  SessionLog._(this._storageKey);
  final String _storageKey;

  static final Map<String, SessionLog> _cache = {};

  factory SessionLog.forSession(String sessionId) {
    final key = sessionId.isEmpty ? 'default' : sessionId;
    return _cache.putIfAbsent(key, () => SessionLog._('lore_log_$key'));
  }

  final List<LogEntry> _entries = [];
  bool _loaded = false;
  Future<void>? _loading;

  List<LogEntry> get all => List.unmodifiable(_entries);

  Future<void> load() {
    if (_loaded) return Future.value();
    return _loading ??= _doLoad();
  }

  Future<void> _doLoad() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString(_storageKey);
    if (raw != null) {
      try {
        final list = jsonDecode(raw) as List<dynamic>;
        _entries
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(list.map((e) =>
              LogEntry.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))));
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    _loaded = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _storageKey,
      jsonEncode(_entries.map((e) => e.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> _add(LogEntry e) async {
    await load();
    _entries.insert(0, e);
    await _save();
  }

  Future<void> addRule(String title, String body) =>
      _add(_make(type: LogEntryType.rule, title: title, body: body));

  Future<void> addCharacter(String name, String desc, CharacterRole role) =>
      _add(_make(
          type: LogEntryType.character,
          title: name,
          body: desc,
          role: role));

  Future<void> addLocation(String name, String desc) =>
      _add(_make(type: LogEntryType.location, title: name, body: desc));

  Future<void> addNote(String title, String body) =>
      _add(_make(type: LogEntryType.note, title: title, body: body));

  Future<void> addEvent({
    required String title,
    required String body,
    String? source,
    Map<String, dynamic>? meta,
  }) =>
      _add(_make(
          type: LogEntryType.event,
          title: title,
          body: body,
          source: source,
          meta: meta));

  Future<void> remove(String id) async {
    _entries.removeWhere((e) => e.id == id);
    await _save();
  }

  Future<void> update(LogEntry e) async {
    final i = _entries.indexWhere((x) => x.id == e.id);
    if (i != -1) {
      _entries[i] = e;
      await _save();
    }
  }

  LogEntry _make({
    required LogEntryType type,
    required String title,
    required String body,
    CharacterRole? role,
    String? source,
    Map<String, dynamic>? meta,
  }) =>
      LogEntry(
        id: '${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}_${Random().nextInt(9999)}',
        type: type,
        title: title,
        body: body,
        createdAt: DateTime.now(),
        role: role,
        source: source,
        meta: meta,
      );
}

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// PUBLIC ENTRY POINTS
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
class SessionLogSheet {
  /// Opens the full log sheet.
  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context, String sessionId) async {
    final log = SessionLog.forSession(sessionId);
    await log.load();
    if (!context.mounted) return;
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      isScrollControlled: true,
            builder: (ctx) => Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(
            bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
        child: SessionLogView(log: log), // Changed here!
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Opens the "add to log" dialog for a chunk of highlighted text.
  static Future<void> promptFromSelection({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String sessionId,
    required String selectedText,
  }) async {
    final log = SessionLog.forSession(sessionId);
    await log.load();
    if (!context.mounted) return;
    await showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => _AddFromSelectionDialog(
        log: log,
        selectedText: selectedText,
      ),
    );
  }
}

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// SHEET
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
class SessionLogView extends StatefulWidget {
  final SessionLog log;
  final bool isSidebar;
  const SessionLogView({super.key, required this.log, this.isSidebar = false});
  @override
  State<SessionLogView> createState() => _SessionLogViewState();
}

class _SessionLogViewState extends State<SessionLogView> {
  int _tab = 0;
  final _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  String _query = '';
  String? _expandedId;

  static const _tabLabels = ['RULES', 'CAST', 'PLACES', 'LOG', 'NOTES'];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.log.addListener(_onLogChanged);
    _searchCtrl.addListener(() {
      setState(() => _query = _searchCtrl.text.trim().toLowerCase());
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.log.removeListener(_onLogChanged);
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onLogChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  List<LogEntry> get _filtered {
    return widget.log.all.where((e) {
      // Tab filter
      switch (_tab) {
        case 0:
          if (e.type != LogEntryType.rule) return false;
          break;
        case 1:
          if (e.type != LogEntryType.character) return false;
          break;
        case 2:
          if (e.type != LogEntryType.location) return false;
          break;
        case 3:
          if (e.type != LogEntryType.event) return false;
          break;
        case 4:
          if (e.type != LogEntryType.note) return false;
          break;
      }
      if (_query.isEmpty) return true;
      final hay = '${e.title} ${e.body} ${e.source ?? ''}'.toLowerCase();
      return hay.contains(_query);
    }).toList();
  }

  Future<void> _addNew() async {
    // LOG tab (events) and NOTES tab both default to note â€” events are
    // auto-generated and can't be added by hand.
    final defaultType = (_tab == 3 || _tab == 4)
        ? LogEntryType.note
        : _tabToType(_tab);
    final result = await showDialog<_AddResult>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => _AddEntryDialog(type: defaultType),
    );
    if (result == null) return;
    await _commit(result);
  }

  LogEntryType _tabToType(int tab) {
    switch (tab) {
      case 0:
        return LogEntryType.rule;
      case 1:
        return LogEntryType.character;
      case 2:
        return LogEntryType.location;
      default:
        return LogEntryType.note;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _commit(_AddResult r) async {
    switch (r.type) {
      case LogEntryType.rule:
        await widget.log.addRule(r.title, r.body);
        break;
      case LogEntryType.character:
        await widget.log
            .addCharacter(r.title, r.body, r.role ?? CharacterRole.side);
        break;
      case LogEntryType.location:
        await widget.log.addLocation(r.title, r.body);
        break;
      case LogEntryType.event:
      case LogEntryType.note:
        await widget.log.addNote(r.title, r.body);
        break;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _editEntry(LogEntry e) async {
    final result = await showDialog<_AddResult>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => _AddEntryDialog(
        type: e.type,
        initialTitle: e.title,
        initialBody: e.body,
        initialRole: e.role,
        isEditing: true,
      ),
    );
    if (result == null) return;
    await widget.log.update(LogEntry(
      id: e.id,
      type: result.type,
      title: result.title,
      body: result.body,
      createdAt: e.createdAt,
      role: result.role,
      source: e.source,
      meta: e.meta,
    ));
  }

  Future<void> _deleteEntry(LogEntry e) async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => Dialog(
        backgroundColor: cInk,
        shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
            const Text('DELETE ENTRY', style: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                color: cEmber, letterSpacing: 4)),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(e.title.isEmpty ? '(untitled)' : e.title,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: cMist,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            Row(children: [
              Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                  child: const Center(child: Text('Cancel',
                      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                          fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
                ),
              )),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                  color: cEmber.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
                  child: const Center(child: Text('Delete',
                      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                          fontSize: 9, color: cParchment, letterSpacing: 2))),
                ),
              )),
            ]),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (confirm == true) await widget.log.remove(e.id);
  }

    @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final mq = MediaQuery.of(context);
    return Container(
      constraints: widget.isSidebar 
          ? const BoxConstraints() 
          : BoxConstraints(maxHeight: mq.size.height * 0.85),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: cInk,
        borderRadius: widget.isSidebar 
            ? BorderRadius.zero 
            : const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(14)),
      ),
      child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
        // Drag handle (only on mobile sheet)
        if (!widget.isSidebar)
          Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10, bottom: 4),
            width: 32, height: 3,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: cAsh, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2)),
          ),
        // Header
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 12),
          child: Row(children: [
            const Text('SESSION LOG', style: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 11,
                color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
            const Spacer(),
            // Close button (only on mobile sheet)
            if (!widget.isSidebar)
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                child: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 18, color: cSmoke),
              ),
          ]),
        ),
        // Search
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 10),
          child: TextField(
            controller: _searchCtrl,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cParchment),
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              hintText: 'Search entries...',
              hintStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
              prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search, size: 16, color: cSmoke),
              suffixIcon: _query.isNotEmpty
                  ? GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () => _searchCtrl.clear(),
                      child: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 14, color: cSmoke),
                    )
                  : null,
              filled: true, fillColor: cVoid,
              contentPadding:
                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4, horizontal: 8),
              enabledBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero),
              focusedBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: cSmoke),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero),
            ),
            cursorColor: cGold,
          ),
        ),
        // Tab row
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 10),
          child: Row(
            children: List.generate(_tabLabels.length, (i) {
              final active = _tab == i;
              return Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => setState(() {
                  _tab = i;
                  _expandedId = null;
                }),
                child: Container(
                  margin: EdgeInsets.only(
                      right: i < _tabLabels.length - 1 ? 6 : 0),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: active
                        ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.1) : Colors.transparent,
                    border: Border.all(color: active ? cGold : cAsh),
                  ),
                  child: Center(child: Text(_tabLabels[i],
                      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                          fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 1,
                          color: active ? cGold : cSmoke))),
                ),
              ));
            }),
          ),
        ),
        const Divider(color: cAsh, height: 1),
        // List
        Expanded(
          child: _filtered.isEmpty
              ? _buildEmpty()
              : ListView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 16),
                  itemCount: _filtered.length,
                  itemBuilder: (_, i) => _buildEntryCard(_filtered[i]),
                ),
        ),
        // Add button
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 10, 20, 20),
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: cAsh)),
          ),
          child: GestureDetector(
            onTap: _addNew,
            child: Container(
              width: double.infinity,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
              color: cParchment,
              child: const Center(child: Text('+ ADD NEW ENTRY',
                  style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 10,
                      color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 2))),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildEmpty() {
    final label = _query.isEmpty
        ? 'Nothing in this section yet.'
        : 'No matches for "$_query".';
    return Center(child: Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),
      child: Text(label, textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
    ));
  }

  Widget _buildEntryCard(LogEntry e) {
    final expanded = _expandedId == e.id;
    final (label, color) = _labelAndColor(e);
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => setState(() => _expandedId = expanded ? null : e.id),
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: cVoid,
          border: Border(
            left: BorderSide(color: color, width: 2),
            top: const BorderSide(color: cAsh),
            right: const BorderSide(color: cAsh),
            bottom: const BorderSide(color: cAsh),
          ),
        ),
        child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 10, 12, 8),
            child: Row(children: [
              Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  fontSize: 8, color: color, letterSpacing: 2)),
              const Spacer(),
              Text(_humanTime(e.createdAt),
                  style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 8, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
            ]),
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 6),
            child: Text(e.title.isEmpty ? '(untitled)' : e.title,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                    color: cParchment)),
          ),
          if (e.body.isNotEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 10),
              child: Text(expanded ? e.body : _preview(e.body),
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
                      height: 1.6)),
            ),
          if (expanded) ...[
            Container(height: 1, color: cAsh),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
              child: Row(children: [
                GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => _editEntry(e),
                  child: const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(8),
                    child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
                      Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, size: 12, color: cSmoke),
                      SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Text('Edit', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
                          color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 1)),
                    ]),
                  ),
                ),
                const Spacer(),
                GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => _deleteEntry(e),
                  child: const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(8),
                    child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
                      Icon(Icons.delete_outline, size: 12, color: cEmber),
                      SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Text('Delete', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11,
                          color: cEmber, letterSpacing: 1)),
                    ]),
                  ),
                ),
              ]),
            ),
          ],
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _preview(String s) {
    if (s.length <= 120) return s;
    return '${s.substring(0, 120)}â€¦';
  }

  (String, Color) _labelAndColor(LogEntry e) {
    switch (e.type) {
      case LogEntryType.rule:
        return ('RULE', cGold);
      case LogEntryType.character:
        switch (e.role ?? CharacterRole.side) {
          case CharacterRole.main:
            return ('MAIN CHARACTER', cEmber);
          case CharacterRole.side:
            return ('SIDE CHARACTER', cIce);
          case CharacterRole.npc:
            return ('NPC', cSmoke);
        }
      case LogEntryType.location:
        return ('LOCATION', cVine);
      case LogEntryType.event:
        final s = (e.source ?? '').toLowerCase();
        if (s == 'dice') return ('DICE ROLL', cMagic);
        if (s == 'mood') return ('MOOD', cIce);
        if (s == 'location') return ('LOCATION CHANGE', cVine);
        if (s == 'character') return ('CHARACTER SWITCH', cEmber);
        return ('EVENT', cMist);
      case LogEntryType.note:
        return ('NOTE', cMist);
    }
  }

  String _humanTime(DateTime t) {
    final d = DateTime.now().difference(t);
    if (d.inSeconds < 60) return 'just now';
    if (d.inMinutes < 60) return '${d.inMinutes}m ago';
    if (d.inHours < 24) return '${d.inHours}h ago';
    if (d.inDays < 7) return '${d.inDays}d ago';
    return '${t.year}-${t.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
        '${t.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }
}

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// ADD / EDIT DIALOG
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
class _AddResult {
  final LogEntryType type;
  final String title;
  final String body;
  final CharacterRole? role;
  _AddResult({
    required this.type,
    required this.title,
    required this.body,
    this.role,
  });
}

class _AddEntryDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final LogEntryType type;
  final String? initialTitle;
  final String? initialBody;
  final CharacterRole? initialRole;
  final bool isEditing;

  const _AddEntryDialog({
    required this.type,
    this.initialTitle,
    this.initialBody,
    this.initialRole,
    this.isEditing = false,
  });

  @override
  State<_AddEntryDialog> createState() => _AddEntryDialogState();
}

class _AddEntryDialogState extends State<_AddEntryDialog> {
  late LogEntryType _type;
  late TextEditingController _titleCtrl;
  late TextEditingController _bodyCtrl;
  CharacterRole _role = CharacterRole.side;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _type = widget.type;
    _titleCtrl = TextEditingController(text: widget.initialTitle ?? '');
    _bodyCtrl = TextEditingController(text: widget.initialBody ?? '');
    _role = widget.initialRole ?? CharacterRole.side;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _titleCtrl.dispose();
    _bodyCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String _titleHint() {
    switch (_type) {
      case LogEntryType.rule:
        return 'Rule name...';
      case LogEntryType.character:
        return 'Character name...';
      case LogEntryType.location:
        return 'Place name...';
      case LogEntryType.event:
      case LogEntryType.note:
        return 'Title...';
    }
  }

  void _save() {
    final title = _titleCtrl.text.trim();
    final body = _bodyCtrl.text.trim();
    if (title.isEmpty && body.isEmpty) return;
    Navigator.pop(context, _AddResult(
      type: _type,
      title: title.isEmpty ? _autoTitle(body) : title,
      body: body,
      role: _type == LogEntryType.character ? _role : null,
    ));
  }

  String _autoTitle(String body) {
    final first = body.split(RegExp(r'[\n\.!?]')).first.trim();
    if (first.length <= 40) return first;
    return '${first.substring(0, 40)}â€¦';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
      insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 500),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(widget.isEditing ? 'EDIT ENTRY' : 'NEW ENTRY',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 9, color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              if (!widget.isEditing) ...[
                const Text('TYPE', style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2)),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: [
                  _typeChip('Rule', LogEntryType.rule),
                  _typeChip('Character', LogEntryType.character),
                  _typeChip('Location', LogEntryType.location),
                  _typeChip('Note', LogEntryType.note),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
              ],
              if (_type == LogEntryType.character) ...[
                const Text('ROLE', style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2)),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: [
                  _roleChip('Main', CharacterRole.main),
                  _roleChip('Side', CharacterRole.side),
                  _roleChip('NPC', CharacterRole.npc),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
              ],
              TextField(
                controller: _titleCtrl,
                autofocus: true,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: cParchment),
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  hintText: _titleHint(),
                  hintStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                  filled: true, fillColor: cVoid,
                  enabledBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero),
                  focusedBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: cGold),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero),
                ),
                cursorColor: cGold,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextField(
                controller: _bodyCtrl,
                maxLines: 6, minLines: 3,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist, height: 1.6),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  hintText: 'Description or details...',
                  hintStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                  filled: true, fillColor: cVoid,
                  enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero),
                  focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: cGold),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero),
                ),
                cursorColor: cGold,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              Row(children: [
                Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Cancel',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
                  ),
                )),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                  onTap: _save,
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    color: cParchment,
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Save',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 10, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 2))),
                  ),
                )),
              ]),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _typeChip(String label, LogEntryType t) {
    final active = _type == t;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => setState(() => _type = t),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 7),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          border: Border.all(color: active ? cGold : cAsh),
          color: active ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.1) : Colors.transparent,
        ),
        child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
            fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: 1,
            color: active ? cGold : cSmoke)),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _roleChip(String label, CharacterRole r) {
    final active = _role == r;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => setState(() => _role = r),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 7),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          border: Border.all(color: active ? cGold : cAsh),
          color: active ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.1) : Colors.transparent,
        ),
        child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
            fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: 1,
            color: active ? cGold : cSmoke)),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// ADD FROM HIGHLIGHTED TEXT
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
class _AddFromSelectionDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final SessionLog log;
  final String selectedText;
  const _AddFromSelectionDialog({
    required this.log,
    required this.selectedText,
  });
  @override
  State<_AddFromSelectionDialog> createState() =>
      _AddFromSelectionDialogState();
}

class _AddFromSelectionDialogState extends State<_AddFromSelectionDialog> {
  LogEntryType _type = LogEntryType.character;
  CharacterRole _role = CharacterRole.side;
  late TextEditingController _titleCtrl;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _titleCtrl = TextEditingController(text: _autoTitle(widget.selectedText));
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _titleCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String _autoTitle(String body) {
    final first = body.split(RegExp(r'[\n\.!?]')).first.trim();
    if (first.length <= 40) return first;
    return '${first.substring(0, 40)}â€¦';
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    final title = _titleCtrl.text.trim();
    final body = widget.selectedText.trim();
    if (title.isEmpty) return;

    switch (_type) {
      case LogEntryType.rule:
        await widget.log.addRule(title, body);
        break;
      case LogEntryType.character:
        await widget.log.addCharacter(title, body, _role);
        break;
      case LogEntryType.location:
        await widget.log.addLocation(title, body);
        break;
      case LogEntryType.event:
      case LogEntryType.note:
        await widget.log.addNote(title, body);
        break;
    }

    if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final preview = widget.selectedText.length > 200
        ? '${widget.selectedText.substring(0, 200)}â€¦'
        : widget.selectedText;

    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: cInk,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
      insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 500),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              const Text('ADD TO LOG', style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                  color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                    border: Border(
                        left: BorderSide(color: cSmoke, width: 2))),
                child: Text('"$preview"',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cMist,
                        fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.6)),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              const Text('TYPE', style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2)),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: [
                _chip('Rule', LogEntryType.rule),
                _chip('Character', LogEntryType.character),
                _chip('Location', LogEntryType.location),
                _chip('Note', LogEntryType.note),
              ]),
              if (_type == LogEntryType.character) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                const Text('ROLE', style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                    color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2)),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: [
                  _rchip('Main', CharacterRole.main),
                  _rchip('Side', CharacterRole.side),
                  _rchip('NPC', CharacterRole.npc),
                ]),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              const Text('TITLE', style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2)),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              TextField(
                controller: _titleCtrl,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: cParchment),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  filled: true, fillColor: cVoid,
                  enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero),
                  focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: cGold),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero),
                ),
                cursorColor: cGold,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              Row(children: [
                Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Cancel',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 10, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
                  ),
                )),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                  onTap: _save,
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    color: cParchment,
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Save',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 10, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 2))),
                  ),
                )),
              ]),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _chip(String label, LogEntryType t) {
    final active = _type == t;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => setState(() => _type = t),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 7),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          border: Border.all(color: active ? cGold : cAsh),
          color: active ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.1) : Colors.transparent,
        ),
        child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
            fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: 1,
            color: active ? cGold : cSmoke)),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _rchip(String label, CharacterRole r) {
    final active = _role == r;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => setState(() => _role = r),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 7),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          border: Border.all(color: active ? cGold : cAsh),
          color: active ? cGold.withValues(alpha: 0.1) : Colors.transparent,
        ),
        child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
            fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: 1,
            color: active ? cGold : cSmoke)),
      ),
    );
  }
}

Future<void> showBlockDialog({
  required BuildContext context,
  required String partnerName,
  required String myCode,
  required String partnerCode,
  required FirestoreService fs,
}) async {
  bool archiveSessions = true;

  await showDialog(
    context: context,
    builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
      builder: (ctx, setState) => Dialog(
        backgroundColor: cInk,
        shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              const Text('BLOCK USER', style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 9,
                  color: cEmber, letterSpacing: 4)),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text('Block $partnerName?',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                      color: cParchment)),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              const Text(
                'They will not be able to send you interests, messages, or find your card.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cSmoke,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.6)),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => setState(() => archiveSessions = !archiveSessions),
                child: Row(children: [
                  Container(
                    width: 16, height: 16,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      border: Border.all(color: archiveSessions ? cEmber : cAsh),
                      color: archiveSessions ? cEmber.withValues(alpha: 0.2) : Colors.transparent,
                    ),
                    child: archiveSessions
                      ? const Icon(Icons.check, size: 12, color: cEmber)
                      : null,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  const Expanded(child: Text('Archive all sessions with this user',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: cMist))),
                ]),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              Row(children: [
                Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Cancel',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
                  ),
                )),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () async {
                    Navigator.of(ctx).pop();
                    await fs.blockUser(
                      myCode: myCode,
                      blockedCode: partnerCode,
                      archiveSessions: archiveSessions,
                    );
                    if (context.mounted) {
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
                        backgroundColor: cInk,
                        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                        shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
                        content: Text('$partnerName has been blocked.',
                            style: const TextStyle(color: cParchment,
                                fontSize: 13, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                      ));
                      // Pop back to home
                      Navigator.of(context).popUntil((r) => r.isFirst);
                    }
                  },
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    color: cEmber.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
                    child: const Center(child: Text('Block',
                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontSize: 9, color: cParchment, letterSpacing: 2))),
                  ),
                )),
              ]),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}
class LoreTap extends StatefulWidget {
  final Widget child;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final VoidCallback? onLongPress;
  final HitTestBehavior behavior;

  const LoreTap({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.onTap,
    this.onLongPress,
    this.behavior = HitTestBehavior.opaque,
  });

  @override
  State<LoreTap> createState() => _LoreTapState();
}

class _LoreTapState extends State<LoreTap> {
  bool _isTapped = false;
  bool _isHovered = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // If there is no onTap and no onLongPress, it's not clickable.
    // Don't show the pointer cursor or the hover effect.
    final isClickable = widget.onTap != null || widget.onLongPress != null;

    return MouseRegion(
      opaque: true,
      cursor: isClickable ? SystemMouseCursors.click : SystemMouseCursors.basic,
      onEnter: (_) {
        if (isClickable && mounted) setState(() => _isHovered = true);
      },
      onExit: (_) {
        if (isClickable && mounted) setState(() => _isHovered = false);
      },
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: widget.behavior,
        onTapDown: isClickable ? (_) => setState(() => _isTapped = true) : null,
        onTapUp: isClickable ? (_) => setState(() => _isTapped = false) : null,
        onTapCancel: isClickable ? () => setState(() => _isTapped = false) : null,
        onTap: widget.onTap,
        onLongPress: widget.onLongPress,
        child: AnimatedOpacity(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
          // Tapped gets dimmest (0.6), Hovered gets slightly dimmed (0.85), Default is 1.0
          opacity: _isTapped ? 0.6 : (_isHovered ? 0.85 : 1.0),
          child: widget.child,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';

/// Change this to your actual support inbox before shipping.
const String kSupportEmail = 'lore.the.rp.app@gmail.com';

/// A small tappable link that opens a support dialog. The user reviews
/// the message, optionally describes what happened, and copies it into
/// their email app.
///
/// The dialog never asks for the PIN â€” emails are not a secure channel,
/// and a working PIN is already the recovery mechanism.
class SupportLink extends StatelessWidget {
  final String? knownCode;
  final String? contextNote;
  final String label;

  const SupportLink({
    super.key,
    this.knownCode,
    this.contextNote,
    this.label = 'Need help? Contact support',
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => _open(context),
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
        child: Text(
          label,
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: const TextStyle(
            fontFamily: 'monospace',
            fontSize: 9,
            color: cSmoke,
            letterSpacing: 1,
            decoration: TextDecoration.underline,
            decorationColor: cAsh,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _open(BuildContext context) {
    final auth = AuthService();
    final code = (knownCode ?? auth.currentCode ?? '').trim();
    final ctrl = TextEditingController();

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => Dialog(
        backgroundColor: cInk,
        shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(),
        insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 500),
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                const Text('ACCOUNT SUPPORT',
                    style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 9, color: cGold, letterSpacing: 4)),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                const Text(
                  'If you can\'t sign in â€” for example if your device was '
                  'stolen or your PIN stopped working â€” send the message '
                  'below to the address shown.',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cMist,
                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.7),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                const Text('YOUR UNIQUE CODE',
                    style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 3)),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Container(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: cVoid,
                    border: Border.all(color: cAsh),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    code.isEmpty ? '(I don\'t have my code)' : code,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: 16,
                      color: code.isEmpty ? cSmoke : cGold,
                      letterSpacing: 3,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                const Text('WHAT HAPPENED?',
                    style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 3)),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                TextField(
                  controller: ctrl,
                  maxLines: 5,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cParchment,
                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.6),
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'My phone was stolen on... / my PIN stopped working...',
                    hintStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: cSmoke,
                        fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                    filled: true, fillColor: cVoid,
                    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderSide: BorderSide(color: cAsh),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero),
                    focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderSide: BorderSide(color: cGold),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.zero),
                  ),
                  cursorColor: cGold,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    border: Border.all(color: cEmber.withValues(alpha: 0.4)),
                  ),
                  child: const Row(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Icon(Icons.warning_amber_outlined,
                          color: cEmber, size: 16),
                      SizedBox(width: 10),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          'Send this to $kSupportEmail. '
                          'Never send your PIN by email â€” we will never ask for it.',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: cEmber,
                              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, height: 1.6),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                Row(children: [
                  Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          border: Border.all(color: cAsh)),
                      child: const Center(child: Text('Close',
                          style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                              fontSize: 9, color: cSmoke, letterSpacing: 2))),
                    ),
                  )),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Expanded(child: GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () async {
                      final note = ctrl.text.trim();
                      final buf = StringBuffer()
                        ..writeln('Hi Lore support,')
                        ..writeln()
                        ..writeln('I need help with my account.')
                        ..writeln()
                        ..writeln('Unique code: ${code.isEmpty ? "(not known)" : code}')
                        ..writeln('What happened: ${note.isEmpty ? "(not described)" : note}')
                        ..writeln();
                      if (contextNote != null) {
                        buf.writeln('($contextNote)');
                        buf.writeln();
                      }
                      buf.writeln('â€” sent from the Lore app');
                      await Clipboard.setData(
                          ClipboardData(text: buf.toString()));
                      if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      if (context.mounted) {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
                          backgroundColor: cInk,
                          content: Text(
                              'Paste this into an email to $kSupportEmail',
                              style: const TextStyle(color: cParchment)),
                        ));
                      }
                    },
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                      color: cParchment,
                      child: const Center(child: Text('Copy message',
                          style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace',
                              fontSize: 9, color: cVoid, letterSpacing: 2))),
                    ),
                  )),
                ]),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
